text: Base sa nauna nga rebelasyon ni anay Sen.
english: Based on the earlier revelation of former Sen.

text: Antonio Trillanes, yara sa Davao City ang anay heneral, samtang suno naman kay Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla, posible yara sa Pampanga ang senador.
english: Antonio Trillanes said the former general is in Davao City, while Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said the senator may be in Pampanga.

text: Wala bala kamo sang carpet sa inyo balay kag kahoy ang inyo salog?
english: Do you have no carpet in your house and your floors are wood?

text: Aba, indi magkabalaka bangud may pamaagi agud nga magka-carpet ikaw!
english: Well, don't worry because there is a way to have a carpet!

text: Iluga lang ang ginhimo sang isa ka Spanish artist nga si Selva Aparicio sa diin pinaagi sa hand carving, nakahimo ini sang carpet sa iya mismo kahoy nga salog.
english: Just imitate the work of a Spanish artist named Selva Aparicio where through hand carving, he made a carpet on his own wooden floor.

text: Wala ka sang kwarta nga gastuhon kag ini nga carpet ang permanente na nga naka-ukit.
english: You have no money to spend and this carpet is permanently etched.

text: Suno kay Aparicio, ang carpet nga iya gin hand-carv ang kabahin sang iya thesis.
english: According to Aparicio, the carpet he hand-carved is part of his thesis.

text: Di bala kadam-an sa disenyo sang mga carpet ang lunsay mga bulak?
english: Aren't most of the carpet designs all flowers?

text: Apang ang iya ni Aparicio ang pinasahi bangud ang childhood memories niya amo mismo ang naka-ukit sa carpet.
english: But Aparicio's is special because his childhood memories are carved on the carpet.

text: Nangin viral naman ini sa social kag nag-angkon sa pagdayaw gikan sa mga netizens.
english: It went viral on social media and earned praise from netizens.

text: Nagbungguanay ang duha ka mga salakyan sa atubang sang St.
english: Two vehicles collided in front of St.

text: Claire Subdivision, Barangay Hibao-an Norte, Mandurriao, Iloilo City kaina sang kaagahon.
english: Claire Subdivision, Barangay Hibao-an Norte, Mandurriao, Iloilo City this morning.

text: Ini nagresulta sa pag-angkon sang minor injuries sang pito ka mga tawo nga sakay sang duha ka salakyan.
english: This resulted in minor injuries to seven people in the two vehicles.

text: Ang involved nga mga salakyan amo ang isa ka Hyundai Accent nga ginamaneho ni alyas “Jun”, 29 anyos, residente sang San Pedro, Molo; kag isa ka Mitsubishi Xpander nga may lima ka sakay nga ginamaneho ni alyas “AD”, 25 anyos.
english: The involved vehicles were a Hyundai Accent driven by alias “Jun”, 29 years old, resident of San Pedro, Molo; and a Mitsubishi Xpander with five occupants driven by alias “AD”, 25 years old.

text: Bangud sa impact, nagkaya gid ang Mirtsubishi.
english: Due to the impact, the Mirtsubishi was completely destroyed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Patrolman Arman J. Angcoy, papuli na kuntani sa San Miguel ang Xpander sang natabo ang insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Patrolman Arman J. Angcoy said the Xpander was heading home to San Miguel when the incident occurred.

text: Ginatudlo nga rason amo ang pagpang-agaw sang linya bangud ang driver ang yara sa impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: The reason is believed to be lane grabbing because the driver was under the influence of alcohol.

text: Sa dugang pa nga pagpangusisa, halin sa smallville ang mga mag-abyan nga sakay sang itom nga Xpander.
english: Further investigation revealed that the friends were from smallville in a black Xpander.

text: Nagapadayon naman ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad sa insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Nag-withdraw sa kumpetisyon sa Paris Olympics ang 19-anyos nga team captain sang Japan women’s artistic gymnastics team nga si Shoko Miyata matapos nalapas sini ang code of conduct sang squad paagi sa iya pagpanigarilyo kag pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: Japan women's artistic gymnastics team captain Shoko Miyata, 19, withdrew from the Paris Olympics after she violated the squad's code of conduct by smoking and drinking alcohol.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini sang Japanese Gymnastics Association kun sa diin nakasaad man nga nakabalik na si Miyata sa Japan matapos nga nagbiya sa training camp sang team sa Monaco para magpaidalom sa imbestigasyon.
english: The Japanese Gymnastics Association announced that Miyata had returned to Japan after leaving the team's training camp in Monaco to undergo an investigation.

text: Bangud nakumpirma sa imbestigasyon nga na-violate sini ang ila pagsulundan, apat na lang sa baylo nga lima ang ipadala sang Japan sa gymnastics sa Summer Games.
english: Because the investigation confirmed that she violated their rules, Japan will send only four gymnasts instead of five to the Summer Games.

text: Sunod man nga nagpangayo sang pasaylo si JGA President Tadashi Fujita samtang naga-atubang ini sa media kaupod ang personal coach ni Miyata nga si Mutsumi Harada.
english: JGA President Tadashi Fujita also apologized as he appeared before the media alongside Miyata's personal coach Mutsumi Harada.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa Paris Games kuntani ang tyansa sang Japan women’s gymnastics team nga makakuha sang team medal sa labing-una nga tion halin sang natabo ang 1964 Tokyo Olympics.
english: The Paris Games would have given the Japan women's gymnastics team a chance to win a team medal for the first time since the 1964 Tokyo Olympics.

text: Ginrason sang coach ni Miyata nga naka-eksperyensya ang amo nga gymnast sang “extreme pressure” nga mag-perform sa “highest level” rason nga posible nahimo sini ang amo nga sala.
english: Miyata's coach argued that the gymnast experienced "extreme pressure" to perform at the "highest level" which is why he may have committed the mistake.

text: “She was spending her days really burdened with so much pressure,” pahayag sang coach samtang nagahibi.
english: “She was spending her days really burdened with so much pressure,” the coach said through tears.

text:
“I would implore people to understand that.”

Indi ini ang una nga bes nga matunog nga naistoryahan ang mental health kadungan sang Olympiada nga amo ang ginakabig nga pinakadaku nga entablado para sa mga atleta sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english:
“I would implore people to understand that.”

This is not the first time that mental health has been loudly discussed during the Olympics, which is considered the biggest stage for athletes around the world.

text: Sang 2021, sang ginpatigayon ang Olympics sa Tokyo, Japan, matandaan nga ang decorated American gymnast kag six-time Olympic medalist nga si Simone Biles ang nag-atras man sa women’s all-around final agud pasulabihon ang iya mental health.
english: In 2021, when the Olympics were held in Tokyo, Japan, it can be recalled that decorated American gymnast and six-time Olympic medalist Simone Biles also withdrew from the women’s all-around final to prioritize her mental health.

text: Isa ang artistic gymnastics sa most popular sports sa Summer Games.
english: Artistic gymnastics is one of the most popular sports at the Summer Games.

text: Sa sini nga edition sang Olympiada sa Paris, France, magasugod ang hinampang sa Hulyo 27 kag magatakop sa Agusto 5.
english: In this edition of the Olympiad in Paris, France, the games will start on July 27 and end on August 5.

text: Temprano nga gin-adjourn ang plenary session sa Kamara sa tunga sang huring-huring nga may ouster plot batok kanday Speaker Lord Allan Velasco kag Majority Leader Leyte Representative Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.
english: The plenary session in the House was adjourned early amid rumors of an ouster plot against Speaker Lord Allan Velasco and Majority Leader Leyte Representative Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.

text: Taktika sa House leaderships nga i-adjourn ang session sang mas temprano ukon likawan gid nga magpatigayon sang regular sessions kun may napanimahuan nga ouster plan.
english: Tactics in House leaderships to adjourn the session earlier or avoid holding regular sessions if there is an ouster plan.

text: Una nga nagpaguwa sang statement si Romualdez nga wala siya sang tuyo nga pahalinon sa pwesto si Velasco bangud sandig sa alegasyon, siya ang nagapanguna sa plano nga pahalinon si Velasco.
english: Romualdez earlier issued a statement saying he had no intention of removing Velasco from office because, according to allegations, he was the leader of the plan to remove Velasco.

text: Nagrason pa si Romualdez nga ang focus niya subong amo ang kandidatura sang ila standard-bearer sa Lakas-CMD nga si Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio nga magapadalagan sa pagka-bise presidente sa 2022 elections.
english: Romualdez argued that his focus now is the candidacy of their standard-bearer in Lakas-CMD, Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio who will run for vice president in the 2022 elections.

text: Sang ulihi, may plot twist bangud nag-guwa ang impormasyon nga indi lang si Velasco ang tuyo sang ouster plot kundi pati si Romualdez.
english: Later, there was a plot twist as information came out that not only Velasco was the target of the ouster plot but also Romualdez.

text: Si Velasco kag Romualdez ang lunsay suod nga supporters ni Sara Duterte.
english: Velasco and Romualdez are both close supporters of Sara Duterte.

text: Kun basehan ang numero sang mga mamalidha sa Kamara, halos 70% sa mga ini ang halin sa PDP-Laban — numero nga may potensyal nga islan ang liderato sa lower house.
english: Based on the number of lawmakers in the House, nearly 70% of them are from the PDP-Laban — a number that has the potential to change the leadership in the lower house.

text: Ang PDP-Laban amo subong ang ruling party ukon partido ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The PDP-Laban is now the ruling party of President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Una diri, gina-alegar nga may natabo nga indi paghangpanay sa tunga sang mga Duterte bangud sa desisyon ni Sara nga magdalagan sa pagka-bise presidente sa idalom sang Lakas-CMD party.
english: Earlier, it was alleged that there was a misunderstanding between the Dutertes over Sara's decision to run for vice president under the Lakas-CMD party.

text: Bangud sang ginhimo sang presidential daughter, nag-isol sa vice presidential race si Sen.
english: Because of the presidential daughter's actions, Sen.

text: Bong Go, vice presidential bet sang PDP-Laban kag close aide sang amay nga Duterte.
english: Bong Go, vice presidential bet of PDP-Laban and close aide of Duterte's father.

text: Ang natabo: nagpadalagan si Go sa pagka-presidente sa idalom sang lain nga partido.
english: What happened: Go ran for president under a different party.

text: Makasumpong ni Go si former Sen.
english: Go will face former Sen.

text: Bongbong Marcos nga amo ang runningmate ni Sara Duterte sa eleksyon.
english: Bongbong Marcos who is Sara Duterte's runningmate in the election.

text: Ginapahayag nga gina-target nga pahalinon si Velasco bangud suod ini nga kaalyado ni Sara Duterte kag ginbuligan pa sini si Sara nga magkampanya para sa Hugpong ng Pagbabago senatorial candidates sang 2019.
english: Velasco is reportedly being targeted for removal because he is a close ally of Sara Duterte and helped Sara campaign for the Hugpong ng Pagbabago senatorial candidates in 2019.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, pakaisa naman ni Marcos si Romualdez kag kun matandaan, nakaupod pa si Romualdez sa Cebu City agud nga makaistoryahanay sanday Sara kag Bongbong.
english: On the other hand, Romualdez is Marcos' cousin and if you remember, Romualdez was with him in Cebu City to talk to Sara and Bongbong.

text: Wala pa sang statement halin kay Velasco as of press time.
english: There was no statement from Velasco as of press time.

english: ## — with reports from Manila Bulletin, Inquirer

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — Tuyo sang weightlifter nga si John Ceniza nga makahimo sang maragtas bangud nagalaum ang weightlifting nga makaangkon sang isa pa ka medalya para sa Pilipinas sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 — Weightlifter John Ceniza aims to make history as weightlifting hopes to win another medal for the Philippines at the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Si Ceniza magapaindis-indis sa 61kg nga kategorya samtang magahimo sang iya debut sa Summer Games.
english: Ceniza will compete in the 61kg category while making her Summer Games debut.

text: Ang 26-anyos nga si Ceniza, ang 13 ka tuig na nga naga-weightlifting kag padayon nga naga-uswag sa iya karera.
english: Ceniza, 26, has been weightlifting for 13 years and continues to improve in her career.

text: Maathag nga nagsugod ini tanan sang wala sia gintugutan sang iya utod nga gamiton ang pila sang iya bag-o nga mga kagamitan.
english: Apparently, it all started when his brother wouldn’t let him use some of his new equipment.

text: Si Ceniza nagsiling nga siya kag ang kaupod nga Paris weightlifter nga si Elreen Ando nagsugod sa isport nga magkaupod kag karon, ang weightlifting nagahatag sang iya mga kinahanglanon.
english: Ceniza said she and fellow Paris weightlifter Elreen Ando started in the sport together and now, weightlifting provides for her needs.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang pag-motivate sang iya kaugalingon, nagbunga sang pilak nga mga medalya sa 2019 kag 2023 nga mga edisyon sang Southeast Asian Games.
english: She also stated that motivating herself, resulted in silver medals in the 2019 and 2023 editions of the Southeast Asian Games.

text: Nakakuha man siya sang bronze medal sa 2020 International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) sa Rome.
english: He also won a bronze medal at the 2020 International Weightlifting Federation (IWF) in Rome.

text: Sang 2024, nakakuha si Ceniza sang kinahanglanon nga mga puntos sa pag-book sang tiket pakadto sa Paris.
english: In 2024, Ceniza earned the necessary points to book a ticket to Paris.

text: Si Ceniza, magakontra sa mga heavyweights sang 61kg weight class.
english: Ceniza will compete in the heavyweights of the 61kg weight class.

text: Ang magabalik sa kategorya amo ang duha ka pinakamataas nga nagtapos sa amo man nga dibisyon sa Tokyo, ang gold medalist nga si Li Frabin sang China kag ang silver medalist nga si Eko Yuli Irawan sang Indonesia.
english: Returning to the category will be the top two finishers in the same division in Tokyo, gold medalist Li Frabin of China and silver medalist Eko Yuli Irawan of Indonesia.

text: Magapaindis-indis man sa amo man nga kategorya ang Amerikano nga kampeon nga si Hampton Morris pila ka bulan pagkatapos niya mabutang ang world record sang clean and jerk sa 176 kilograms, ang una nga tion nga ang isa ka Amerikano nakabutang sang world record sa seniors division sa sulod sang 55 ka tuig.
english: Also competing in the same category will be American champion Hampton Morris months after setting the world record of the clean and jerk at 176 kilograms, the first time an American has set a world record in the seniors division in 55 years.

text: Kalakip si Ceniza sa 22 ka mga Filipino athletes padulong sa Paris.
english: Ceniza is among 22 Filipino athletes heading to Paris.

text: Magaupod siya sa mga kaupod nga weightlifters nga sanday Elreen Ando kag Vanessa Sarno sa nasambit nga torneo.
english: She will join fellow weightlifters Elreen Ando and Vanessa Sarno in the tournament.

text: Nagkulob sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Balesin Island, Polillo, Quezon ang isa ka sakayan nga may karga nga 23 ka mga tawo.
english: A boat carrying 23 people capsized in the waters of Balesin Island, Polillo, Quezon.

text: Suno sa impormasyon, nakisakay lang ang mga residente sang isla pakadto sa Atimonan kag Mauban bangud wala sang biyahe sang pumpboat sang amo nga tion.
english: According to information, the residents of the island just took a ride to Atimonan and Mauban because there was no pumpboat service at that time.

text: Nadulaan sang ba­lanse ang sakayan gani nagkulob ini.
english: The boat lost its balance and capsized.

text: Madasig naman nga nakapatigayon sang rescue operation ang Bantay Dagat rason nga naluwas ang tanan nga pasahero.
english: The Bantay Dagat quickly conducted a rescue operation and all the passengers were rescued.

text: Ginpadal-an naman sang Enforcement Inspection Apprehension Report sang Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) ang kapitan sang sakayan bangud sa paglayag nga wala sang clearance halin sa ahensya kag pagpasakay sang mga indi oto­risado nga pasahero.
english: The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) sent an Enforcement Inspection Apprehension Report to the captain of the boat for sailing without clearance from the agency and boarding unauthorized passengers.

text: Gintuman na sang alkalde sa Paris, France ang promisa sini nga maglangoy sa bantog nga River Seine agud pamatud-an nga malimpyo na ini kag sarang gid mangin venue sang swimming events para sa 2024 Olympics.
english: The mayor of Paris, France has fulfilled his promise to swim in the famous River Seine to prove that it is clean and can become a venue for swimming events for the 2024 Olympics.

text: Suksok ni Paris Mayor Anne Hidalgo ang wetsuit kag googles sang nagpanaog na ini sa tubig kaupod si Tony Estanguet nga amo ang head sang Paris Olympics Organizing Committee.
english: Paris Mayor Anne Hidalgo was wearing a wetsuit and googles when she went down into the water with Tony Estanguet, head of the Paris Olympics Organizing Committee.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan pa kuntani ang schedule sang 65-anyos nga alkalde nga tumanon ang iya promisa apang wala nadayon bangud santo sa water tests, ang E.Coli bacteria nga amo ang palatandaan sang fecal matter ang 10 ka beses nga mas mataas ipaanggid sa otorisado sini nga limit rason nga delikado gid sa ikaayong lawas sang magalangoy.
english: Last month, the 65-year-old mayor was scheduled to fulfill his promise but was canceled because according to water tests, the E.Coli bacteria, which is a sign of fecal matter, is 10 times higher than the authorized limit, which is very dangerous for the health of swimmers.

text: Talalupangdon nga kadungan sang paglangoy sang alkalde sa River Seine, absent si French President Emmanuel Macron bangud sa ginakasakuan sini nga political crisis bangud sa snap parliamentary elections sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: It is noteworthy that while the mayor was swimming in the River Seine, French President Emmanuel Macron was absent due to his political crisis due to the snap parliamentary elections last month.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, ang una nga naglangoy sa suba agud mapamatud-an nga matinlo na ini amo si French Sports Minister Amélie Oudéa-Castéra.
english: Last week, the first to swim in the river to prove it was clean was French Sports Minister Amélie Oudéa-Castéra.

text: Yara sa 1.4 billion euros (ukon P87.41-billion) ang gingasto agud nga malikawan nga magkadto ang mga higko sa suba, apang nagapaslawan gihapon ang amo nga suba nga makapasar sa water quality tests tubtub sa pagsugod sang Hulyo.
english: About 1.4 billion euros (or P87.41-billion) were spent to prevent waste from entering the river, but the river still failed to pass water quality tests until the beginning of July.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa amo nga suba nakatalana ang triathlon kag marathon swimming legs sang Olympics nga magasugod na sa Hulyo 26 tubtub sa Agusto 11.
english: The river is scheduled to host the triathlon and marathon swimming legs of the Olympics from July 26 to August 11.

text: Madamo ang nahangawa sa health condition sang komedyante nga si Boobay matapos ini nga natumba sa stage samtang naga-host sang town fiesta sa Aparri, Cagayan.
english: Many are concerned about the health condition of comedian Boobay after he fell on stage while hosting a town fiesta in Aparri, Cagayan.

text: Kaupod sini ang isa pa ka komedyante nga si Pepita Curtis sang natabo ang insidente.
english: He was accompanied by another comedian, Pepita Curtis, when the incident occurred.

text: Nakit-an sa livestream nga gulpi lang nga nag-untat sa pagkanta si Boobay samtang nga naga-focus ang camera kay Pepita.
english: The livestream showed that Boobay suddenly stopped singing while the camera focused on Pepita.

text: Pila ka segundos ang nagligad, natumba na ini kag ginbuligan sang staff members.
english: Seconds later, he collapsed and was helped by staff members.

text: Bangud sa natabo, gilayon nga nag-commercial break ang livestream samtang ginklaro naman ni Pepita nga na-outbalance lang ang iya upod.
english: Due to the incident, the livestream immediately went to a commercial break while Pepita clarified that her companion was just outbalanced.

text: Sang naka-recover na, nagbalik si Boobay sa stage kag ginpadayon ang iya nga performance.
english: After recovering, Boobay returned to the stage and continued his performance.

text: Ginklaro man ni Sparkle vice president Joy Marcelo nga natumba lamang si Boobay bangud nasilawan ini sang lights sa stage.
english: Sparkle vice president Joy Marcelo also clarified that Boobay only fell because he was hit by the lights on the stage.

text: Gin-athag man sang iya co-host nga si Pepita nga wala sang problema kay Boobay kag nagpahuway ini sa hotel pagkatapos sang programa sa Aparri.
english: His co-host Pepita also clarified that there was no problem with Boobay and he rested at the hotel after the Aparri program.

text: Sang Abril sang nagligad nga tuig, matandaan nga natabo man ini sa nasambit nga comedian sa tunga-tunga sang interview kay Boy Abunda.
english: In April last year, it can be recalled that the same thing happened to the said comedian in the middle of an interview with Boy Abunda.

text: Gulpi na ini nga wala nagsabat kag nagakaurungan lamang apang sang ulihi naumpawan man.
english: He was suddenly unresponsive and just stunned but later he was relieved.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nagaka-eksperyensyahan pa sini ang pila sa aftereffects pagkatapos sang stroke nga iya naagyan sang 2016.
english: He said he is still experiencing some of the aftereffects after the stroke he suffered in 2016.

text: Nagahibubun-ot ang iban nga mga driver sang electronic bikes kag electronic tricycles (e-bikes kag e-trikes) kasunod sang anunsyo sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) nga ipang-impound ini nga mga salakyan nga madakpan nga naga-operate sa mayor nga mga dalanon.
english: Some drivers of electronic bikes and electronic tricycles (e-bikes and e-trikes) are reluctant following the announcement of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) to impound these vehicles caught operating on major roads.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Gacita, nagabyahe sang e-bike sa Duran, Iloilo City Proper, iya ginpahayag nga madasig mag-akto ang gobyerno sa mga bagay nga indi man nila makuwartahan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Gacita, an e-bike rider in Duran, Iloilo City Proper, said the government is quick to act on things that they cannot afford.

text: Suno sa iya, may iban man nga drivers nga indi salawayon kag nagasunod gid sa patakaran.
english: He said there are other drivers who are not guilty and follow the rules.

text: Gindugang niya nga madulaan gid ang iban sang palangabuhian kag magutman ang ila pamilya kun mangdakop na ang awtoridad.
english: He added that some will lose their livelihood and their families will starve if the authorities arrest them.

text: Sa iya bahin, nagalab-ot sa P400 tubtub P500 ang iya kita sa pagbyahe halin alas sais sa aga tubtub alas singko sa hapon, apang ginabayad pa sini ang P170 sa arkila kada adlaw.
english: For his part, he earns P400 to P500 from traveling from 6 am to 5 pm, but he still pays P170 for rent every day.

text: Base sa pasalig ni LTO chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao sa plenary session sa Senado, maga-umpisa ang pagpangdakop sa e-trikes sa Disyembre 1.
english: Based on the assurance of LTO chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao in the plenary session of the Senate, the seizure of e-trikes will begin on December 1.

text: Namunuhan sa Senado nga indi kaangay sa traditional tricycles, indi rehistrado sa LTO ang e-trike kag e-bike operators kag drivers, wala sang lisensya, kag wala man sang insurance.
english: He led the Senate that unlike traditional tricycles, e-trike and e-bike operators and drivers are not registered with the LTO, do not have a license, and do not have insurance.

text: May suhestyon man sa upper chamber nga dapat maghimo sang kasugtanan ang LTO kag ang local government unit nga ma-regulate ini nga mga salakyan, apang dapat siguruhon nga indi man mapatay ang palangabuhian sang traditional tricycles.
english: There is also a suggestion in the upper chamber that the LTO and the local government unit should make an agreement to regulate these vehicles, but it should be ensured that the livelihood of traditional tricycles is not killed.

text: Nalab-ot sang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala ang bag-o nga career-high world ranking nga 155 sa Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) duha ka semana matapos nga nagsaka sa rank no.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala achieved a new career-high world ranking of 155 in the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) two weeks after climbing to rank no.

text: Kasunod sini, siya kag ang iya French partner nga si Estelle Cascino ang nag-abanse naman sa W100 Vitoria-Gasteiz doubles quarterfinal matapos ginlutos ang mag-utod kag home bets nga sanday Carolina kag Jimena Gomez, 6-3, 6-2, sa Spain.
english: Subsequently, she and her French partner Estelle Cascino advanced to the W100 Vitoria-Gasteiz doubles quarterfinals after defeating sisters and home bets Carolina and Jimena Gomez, 6-3, 6-2, in Spain.

text: Na-sweep nanday Eala kag Cascino ang mag-utod sa sulod lamang sang 56 minutos rason nga na-set ang hampang batok kanday Victoria Bervid sang Czechia kag Laura Mair sang Italy.
english: Eala and Cascino swept the sisters in just 56 minutes, setting the match against Victoria Bervid of Czechia and Laura Mair of Italy.

text: Kun matandaan, sang Marso, nakuha man sang 19-anyos nga tennis sensation ang doubles title sini kaupod ang iya French partner sa W75 Croissy-Beaubourg sa France.
english: In March, the 19-year-old tennis sensation also won her doubles title with her French partner at W75 Croissy-Beaubourg in France.

text: Maga-compete man si Eala sa W100 Vitoria-Gasteiz batok kay Lian Tran sang Netherlands.
english: Eala will also compete in the W100 Vitoria-Gasteiz against Lian Tran of the Netherlands.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, matandaan nga nalutos si Eala sa Wimbledon main draw sa kamot ni Lulu Sun, 7-6(3), 7-5 sang New Zealand sa final round sang qualifier.
english: Last month, Eala lost the Wimbledon main draw to Lulu Sun, 7-6(3), 7-5 of New Zealand in the final round of the qualifier.

text: Luyag mo bala mag-istar sa malinong, malayo sa pollution, malayo sa masako nga lugar kag wala ka sang kaiping nga mga panimalay?

text: Antes ang selebrasyon sang World Toilet Day, ginpahamtang sang Department of Health (DOH) kag Zero Open Defecation (ZOD) Team nga 54% ukon 98 sa masobra 180 ka barangay sa Iloilo City ang verified kag validated na bilang compliant sa ZOD program.
english: Ahead of the celebration of World Toilet Day, the Department of Health (DOH) and Zero Open Defecation (ZOD) Team said that 54% or 98 of the more than 180 barangays in Iloilo City have been verified and validated as compliant with the ZOD program.

text: Ang programa, nga gin-umpisahan tatlo ka tuig ang nagligad nga nagatinguha nga malikawan ang open defecation kag mapalapnag ang paggamit sang husto kag malimpyo nga kasilyas.
english: The programme, which was launched three years ago aims to prevent open defecation and spread the use of correct and clean toilets.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jennifer Christie Avenir, Chief sa Environmental Sanitation Division, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan matuman ang Level 1 compliance — paggamit sang kasilyas, wala sang open defecation, kag wala sang exposed feces ukon diapers sa palibot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jennifer Christie Avenir, Chief of the Environmental Sanitation Division, said Level 1 compliance must be met — use of toilets, no open defecation, and no exposed feces or diapers in the environment.

text: Padayon nga ginapadasig sang DOH ang mga barangay officials nga mag-apply para sa ZOD assessment, kag target nila ang full compliance sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The DOH continues to encourage barangay officials to apply for the ZOD assessment, and they target full compliance next year.

text: Apang ang pinakamabudlay nga bahin amo gihapon ang mga coastal barangay, kun diin madamo pa ang nagapamuhin kag nagapangihi sa baybayon.
english: But the most difficult part is still the coastal barangays, where many still defecate and urinate on the beach.

text: Gina-edukar man sang ahensya ang pumuluyo bahin sa risgo sang acute gastroenteritis, ilabi na kun may exposed feces kag basura sa palibot.
english: The agency is also educating the public about the risk of acute gastroenteritis, especially if there are exposed feces and garbage in the environment.

text: Padayon ang ZOD Team sa validation agud masiguro nga tanan nga barangay sa syudad mangin fully compliant sa programa.
english: The ZOD Team continues to validate to ensure that all barangays in the city are fully compliant with the program.

text: Ang titulo sang Argentines amo ang naghimo sa ila nga pinakamadinalag-on nga team sa maragtas sang Copa America samtang nagapangaduha naman ang Uruguay nga may 15 ka mga titulo.#
english: Argentina's title made them the most successful team in Copa America history while Uruguay came second with 15 titles.

text: Ang makabakal sang salakyan ang ginakabig isa sa pinakamalipay nga tion sang imo nga kabuhi apang para sa isa ka motorista, ang iya kuntani nga handom ang nangin isa na lang ka nightmare.
english: Buying a car is considered one of the happiest moments of your life but for a motorist, his dream has become a nightmare.

text: Excited ang isa ka Indian national nga magmaneho sang iya brand new car samtang ginahitso ang tanan sa isa ka store agud nga makuha na niya ini.
english: An Indian national is excited to drive his brand new car while waiting for everything in a store so that he can get it.

text: Samtang yara sa sulod sang salakyan ang isa ka empleyado sang store agud nga ma-testingan kuntani ang salakyan, aksidente ini nakadiretso sa pader kag nakabunggo.
english: While a store employee was inside the vehicle to test the vehicle, he accidentally went straight into the wall and hit it.

text: Sa pihak nga mangin malipayon ang buyer, naglingin pa ang ulo sini bangud wasak gid ang nauna nga bahin sang salakyan nga iya kuntani baklon.
english: Although the buyer was happy, he was still dizzy because the front part of the car he was going to buy was badly damaged.

text: Naghuna-huna pa ang buyer nga gin-prank lamang siya sang empleyado apang natukiban nga matuod nga aksidente ang natabo.
english: The buyer thought that the employee was just pranking him but it turned out that it was a real accident.

text: Nagpamahog si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga i-withhold ang disbursement sang pondo sa idalom sang 2022 national budget.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte has threatened to withhold the disbursement of funds under the 2022 national budget.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang iya pag-akusar sa mga senador sa pag-paralyze sang gobyerno paagi sa pagpain sang manubo nga pondo.
english: This comes after he accused senators of paralyzing the government by setting aside meager funding.

text: Ang pahayag ni Duterte ang kasunod sang pagpadayon sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee sa imbestigasyon sa ginapahayag kurapsyon sa multi-billion-peso purchase sang personal protective equipment sang 2020.
english: Duterte's statement follows the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee's continued investigation into alleged corruption in the multi-billion-peso purchase of personal protective equipment in 2020.

text: Matandaan nga nag-isyu ang presidente agud dumilian ang government officials lakip na ang miyembro sang iya Gabinete nga magtabong sa amo nga hearing sa Senado.
english: The president issued a motion to ban government officials including members of his Cabinet from attending the hearing in the Senate.

text: Suno kay Duterte, ginapahog sang Senado nga panubuan ang pondo sang mga opisina sang taga-executive department bangud wala naga-attend sa hearing ang mga opisyal.
english: According to Duterte, the Senate is threatening to reduce the funds of the executive department offices because officials do not attend hearings.

text: “You call my memorandum stupid.
english: “You call my memorandum stupid.

text: Well, I challenge you bring your arguments to the proper court and I will answer you.
english: Well, I challenge you bring your arguments to the proper court and I will answer you.

text: You threaten the budget of the executive because the officials refuse to attend to your hearing..
english: You threatened the budget of the executive because the officials refused to attend your hearing..

text: Ito yung mga pang abuso talaga sa gobyerno pag demokrasya.
english: These are the real abuses of government in democracy.

text: Itong separation of power, co equal, and they threaten to paralyze government,” suno sa presidente.
english: This separation of power, co equal, and they threaten to paralyze government,” the president said.

text: Apang suno sa presidente, bisan i-zero pa sang Senado ang budget para sa Office of the President, ma-agi man gihapon sa iya ang budget.
english: However, the president said that even if the Senate zeroes the budget for the Office of the President, the budget will still pass through him.

text: “O i-zero budget mo ang OP (Office of the President).
english: “Or you zero budget the OP (Office of the President).

text: Sige nga gawin mo.
english: Go ahead and do it.

text: Bakit aabot pa ‘yang pera ninyo kung hindi magdaan sa akin?
english: Why will your money reach me if it doesn't go through me?

text: Eh, kung hindi ako mag release.
english: Eh, if I don't release.

text: Akala ni’yo kayo lang ang marunong!”
english: You think you’re the only ones who know!”

text: Nagluntad ang sunog kaina sang aga sa Zone 11, Brgy.
english: The fire broke out this morning in Zone 11, Brgy.

text: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City, nga naglamon sa isa ka abandonado kag bag-o pa lang natukod nga two-storey house.
english: Calaparan, Arevalo, Iloilo City, which engulfed an abandoned and newly built two-storey house.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Brgy.

text: Kagawad Rodrigo Montaño, iya ginpahayag nga ginapanag-iyahan sang isa ka construction worker sang una ang two storey nga balay, samtang ang isa naman ka balay abandonado na bangud nagsaylo na ang nagapuyo sa iban nga lugar.
english: Kagawad Rodrigo Montaño, he said the two-storey house was previously owned by a construction worker, while the other house is abandoned because the residents have moved to other places.

text: Suno sa mga pumuluyo nakabati sila sang “nagsinagabong” antes naglapta ang kalayo, rason nga nagduda sila nga mahimo nga may electrical short circuit ukon may naglupok anay antes nagluntad ang dako nga sunog.
english: Suno sa mga pumuluyo nakabati sila sang “nagsinagabong” antes naglapta ang kalayo, rason nga nagduda sila nga mahimo nga may electrical short circuit ukon may naglupok anay antes nagluntad ang dako nga sunog.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginkadtuan ini sang masobra pulo ka mga fire trucks nga nagresponde sa lugar agud mapalong ang kalayo.
english: More than 10 fire trucks responded to the scene to extinguish the fire.

text: Nagpahamtang naman ang barangay sang evacuation centers, kag naka-standby man ang food assistance para sa mga apektado nga residente.
english: The barangay has set up evacuation centers, and food assistance is also on standby for the affected residents.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) sa gintunaan sang sunog.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) is still investigating the cause of the fire.

text: Isa ka masakit kag masubo nga istorya ang nagbukas sa publiko sa isa ka pamilya nga nagselebrar pa sang ila ‘new beginnings’ kuntani sa ila isa ka selfie antes ang trahedya.
english: A painful and sad story has opened up to the public about a family who celebrated their 'new beginnings' with a selfie before the tragedy.

text: Ginkilala ang mag-asawa nga doktor nga sanday Dr. Komi Vyas kag Dr. Prateek Joshi, upod ang ila tatlo ka kabataan, ang nagkuha pa sang malipayon nga selfie sa sulod sang Air India, kag wala gali sila nakahibalo nga ini na gali ang ila katapusan nga litrato upod bilang isa ka pamilya.
english: The couple were identified as Dr. Komi Vyas and Drs. Prateek Joshi, along with their three children, even took a happy selfie inside Air India, and little did they know that it was actually their last photo together as a family.

text: Si Dr. Vyas, nga nagatrabaho sa Udaipur, nagbiya na sa iya trabaho para magasugod kuntani sang ila bag-o nga kabuhi sa London, kaupod ang iya bana nga si Dr. Joshi kag ang ila mga anak.
english: Drs. Vyas, who works in Udaipur, had left her job to start their new life in London, along with her husband Dr. Joshi and their children.

text: Makita sa selfie ang ila mga anak nga kapid nga sanday Nakul kag Pradyut, lima ka tuig ang edad, kag ang ila 8-anyos nga anak nga si Miraya.
english: The selfie shows their twin children Nakul and Pradyut, five years old, and their 8-year-old daughter Miraya.

text: Suno kay Nayan, pakaisa ni Dr. Joshi: ”They left for Ahmedabad yesterday to take the flight to London.
english: According to Nayan, cousin of Dr. Joshi: ”They left for Ahmedabad yesterday to take the flight to London.

text: Prateek had come here just two days ago to take his wife and children with him.
english: Prateek had come here just two days ago to take his wife and children with him.

text: Sa subong, ang bug-os nga komunidad medikal kag mga pamilya sang mga biktima ang nagapangasubo sa natabo nga trahedya.
english: Today, the entire medical community and families of the victims are mourning the tragedy.

text: Text by: Bombo James Daccer Silverio
english: Text by: Bombo James Daccer Silverio

text: Matapos ang tatlo ka adlaw nga search and retrieval operations, magkasunod nga narekober ang lawas sang tatlo ka tawo nga gin-anod sang baha sa Dinalupihan, Bataan kasunod sang paglaslas nga bagyo kag habagat.
english: After three days of search and retrieval operations, the bodies of three people who were washed away by floods in Dinalupihan, Bataan following the typhoon and habagat were recovered.

text: Sa report, narekober ang bangkay sang duha ka solterito nga gin-anod sang baha sa suba sa lugar.
english: According to the report, the bodies of two young men who were washed away in the river in the area were recovered.

text: Suno sa Bataan Police Provincial Office, nakit-an ang mga bangkay sa magkatuhay nga lugar sa kilid sang suba sa Barangay Balsik kag Pulo, Hermosa.
english: According to the Bataan Police Provincial Office, the bodies were found in different areas along the river in Barangay Balsik and Pulo, Hermosa.

text: Ginpangunahan sang Dinalupihan MDRRMO ang retrieval operation kabulig ang Balanga City DRRMO kag Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).
english: The Dinalupihan MDRRMO led the retrieval operation in collaboration with the Balanga City DRRMO and Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP).

text: Ginreport naman sang Orion MDRRMO nga may isa pa ka bangkay nga nasapwan nga nagalutaw-lutaw malapit sa Port Capinpin sa Barangay Puting Buhangin, Orion.
english: The Orion MDRRMO reported that another body was found floating near Port Capinpin in Barangay Puting Buhangin, Orion.

text: Ang biktima isa ka 50-anyos nga tripulante sang Northridge Shipping vessel nga naka-dock sa pantalan kag nalumos sa kasagsagan sang malain nga panahon.
english: The victim was a 50-year-old crew member of the Northridge Shipping vessel that was docked in the harbor and drowned in the midst of bad weather.

text: Napilian ang BTS member nga si Jin nga magkapot sang Olympic torch sa Olympic Torch Relay.
english: BTS member Jin was selected to hold the Olympic torch in the Olympic Torch Relay.

text: Ginpatigayon ini sa Louvre Pyramid sa Paris, 11 ka adlaw antes ang pag-umpisa sang 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: It was held at the Louvre Pyramid in Paris, 11 days before the start of the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Ang Paris Olympic flame ang ginpasiga sa Greece kag nag-abot sa France sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: The Paris Olympic flame was lit in Greece and arrived in France last month.

text: Ilibot ini sa masobra 400 ka mga lugar sa France antes makalab-ot sa Jardins du Trocadero sa Paris nga amo ang venue sang opening ceremony.
english: It will tour more than 400 venues in France before arriving at the Jardins du Trocadero in Paris which is the venue for the opening ceremony.

english: The international multi-sport event will start on July 27 and run until August 11.

english: It will be attended by 15,000 athletes from 206 countries.

text: Nagbuya sang mga tinaga si Iloilo First District Rep.
english: Iloilo First District Rep.

text: Dr. Janette Garin agud kontrahon ang una nga mga pahayag ni incumbent first district Board Member Renee ‘Coy’ Valencia, isa sa mga magapadalagan sa pagka-alkalde sa banwa sang Tigbauan.
english: Dr. Janette Garin to counter the initial statements of incumbent first district Board Member Renee 'Coy' Valencia, one of the mayoral candidates in Tigbauan town.

text: Si Valencia kag si Dr. Garin ang pareho nga yara sa idalom sang National Unity Party (NUP), apang sa 2022 elections, lain nga kandidato ang suportahan sang kongresista sa Tigbauan: gina-endorso sini si former Tigbauan Vice Mayor Dr. Roel ‘Biboy’ Jarina sang Lakas-CMD Party.Gintawag ni Garin nga misleading ang mga statement ni Valencia.
english: Valencia and Drs. Garin is both under the National Unity Party (NUP), but in the 2022 elections, the Tigbauan congressman will support a different candidate: he endorses former Tigbauan Vice Mayor Dr. Roel 'Biboy' Jarina of the Lakas-CMD Party. Garin called Valencia's statements misleading.

text: Suno kay Garin, indi matuod nga “indi na sila updanay” sang nagligad nga 2019 elections.
english: According to Garin, it is not true that “they are no longer together” during the last 2019 elections.

text: Pareho sila suno sa iya nga si anay 4th District Rep.
english: He said they are both former 4th District Rep.

text: Dr. Ferjenel Biron ang gin-suportahan sa governatorial race apang, “nakita sang mag-asawa nga Valencia nga sa surveys, leading si Governor Defensor.
english: Dr. Ferjenel Biron was supported in the governorship race but, “the Valencia couple saw that in the surveys, Governor Defensor was leading.

text: Amo man ang balik-balik nila ka istorya sa amon nga kun sin-o ang manugdaog sa surveys, sila ang imawan ta,” suno kay Garin.
english: They also repeatedly told us that whoever wins the surveys, they will be our friends,” Garin said.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpahayag man ni Garin nga kuntani “indi lang pag-gamiton sa pamulitika” ang pagtaliwan ni the late Guimbal Mayor Oscar ‘Oca’ Garin.
english: Garin also said that the death of the late Guimbal Mayor Oscar 'Oca' Garin should not be used for politics.

text: Una nga ginpahayag ni Valencia nga suod sila kay Oca Garin.
english: Valencia earlier said they were close to Oca Garin.

text:
Apang suno sa kongresista, sang buhi pa ang Garin patriarch, “nagalikaw ini sa discussions kananda (mag-asawa nga Valencia) bangud pirme may intriga against sa sitting officers.”

Wala man ginpalampas ni Garin ang pahayag ni Valencia nga ginpatawag sang una ang iya bana nga si Dennis Valencia agud tanyagan nga mangin mayor nga “wala sang kontra kag wala sang gasto.” Indi ini matuod suno kay Garin bangud “it is the other way around: ang mga Valencia ang gusto-gusto gid nga mag-istorya.”

Ginpaathag ni Garin nga kay Jarina ang ila nga suporta bangud si Jarina amo ang luyag sang 70% sang populasyon sang Tigbauan.
english:
But according to the congressman, when the Garin patriarch was alive, “he avoided discussions with them (the Valencia couple) because there was always an intrigue against the sitting officers.”

Garin also did not ignore Valencia's statement that her husband, Dennis Valencia, was earlier summoned to be offered to become mayor “without opponent and without expense.” Garin said this is not true because “it is the other way around: the Valencians are the ones who like to talk.”

Garin explained that their support is for Jarina because Jarina is the wish of 70% of the population of Tigbauan.

text: Maathag man suno kay Garin nga makit-an ini sa eleksyon bangud sa tanan nga incumbent councilors nga maga-pa-eleher liwat sa 2022, isa lang gid ang nag-upod kay Valencia.
english: Garin said it is clear that this will be seen in the election because of all the incumbent councilors who will be re-elected in 2022, only one joined Valencia.

text: Ang nabilin ang magaupod kay Jarina.
english: The rest will go with Jarina.

text: Ipatuman sa bwas ang pagsaka sa presyo sang gatong.
english: The fuel price increase will be implemented tomorrow.

text: Suno kay Rodela Romero, Assistant Secretary sang Department of Energy (DOE) Oil Industry Management Bureau ang pagduso sang US Federal Reserve nga buhinan ang interest rate ang nagpatimbuok sang demand nga nagresulta sa oil price hike.
english: According to Rodela Romero, Assistant Secretary of the Department of Energy (DOE) Oil Industry Management Bureau, the US Federal Reserve's push to reduce interest rates has boosted demand resulting in an oil price hike.

text:

english:
Here are the oil price hikes to be implemented:

Gasoline – P1.10Diesel – P0.20.Kerosene – No change

text: Naghilibion si Miss Universe 2023 Sheynnis Palacios kadungan sang motorcade nga gin-preparar sa iya tour diri sa Pilipinas — isa ka parada nga daw nangin homecoming parade para sa iya, bagay nga wala sini na-eksperyensyahan sa iya kaugalingon nga pungsod.
english: Naghilibion si Miss Universe 2023 Sheynnis Palacios kadungan sang motorcade nga gin-preparar sa iya tour diri sa Pilipinas — isa ka parada nga daw nangin homecoming parade para sa iya, bagay nga wala sini na-eksperyensyahan sa iya kaugalingon nga pungsod.

text: Gintinguhaan sini nga makontrol ang luha samtang ginasinggitan sang mga Pinoy ang iya pangalan kag ang pangalan sang iya pungsod nga Nicaragua.
english: He tried to hold back tears as Filipinos shouted his name and the name of his country Nicaragua.

text: Bitbit kag ginahakos sang beauty queen ang Nicaraguan flag samtang nagaparada.
english: The beauty queen carries and hugs the Nicaraguan flag while parading.

text: Si Sheynnis, 23, nga nagdaog sa El Salvador sang nagligad nga tuig amo ang labing-una nga Nicaraguan nga nakakuha sang Miss Universe title.
english: Sheynnis, 23, who won in El Salvador last year is the first-ever Nicaraguan to win the Miss Universe title.

text: Mainit ini nga gin-abi-abi sang mga tawo sa iya pungsod sa Central America kag una man nga ginpanginbulahan sang Nicaraguan regime apang sang ulihi amat-amat nga naglas-ay sang nahibaluan nga isa siya sa nangin kabahin sang 2018 protests.
english: He was warmly welcomed by the people of his Central American country and was initially congratulated by the Nicaraguan regime but later gradually became angry when it was learned that he was one of the participants in the 2018 protests.

text: Ang amo nga protesta sang 2018 ang nagtuyo nga pahalinon si President Daniel Ortega nga amo ang naghimo sa Nicaragua nga isa ka authoritarian state sa iya latest stint bilang president.
english: That 2018 protest aimed to oust President Daniel Ortega, who turned Nicaragua into an authoritarian state in his latest stint as president.

text: Tatlo ka bulan ang amo nga protesta kun sa diin 320 ang napatay.
english: The protest lasted three months and 320 people were killed.

text: Mangin ang outfit ni Sheynnis sa Miss Universe ang may yara sang white dress kag blue cape nga reference man sa ila nga national flag nga gin-ban matapos ang 2018.
english: Even Sheynnis' Miss Universe outfit features a white dress and blue cape that is also a reference to their national flag that was banned after 2018.

text: Kasunod man sang pagdaog ni Sheynnis, gin-ban sa ila pungsod ang ila nga national director sa Miss Universe Nicaragua bangud nga suno sa reports, ang entourage ni Sheynnis ang ginasuspetsahan nga simbolo sang pagpamatok sa gobyerno.
english: Following Sheynnis' victory, the national director of Miss Universe Nicaragua was banned from the country because, according to reports, Sheynnis' entourage was suspected of being a symbol of opposition to the government.

text: Bangud sang amo nga hitabo, wala man sang natabo nga homecoming activities para sa beauty queen kag tubtub lamang sa hypothetical image kag imahinasyon ang nahimo sang Nicaraguan beauty pageant fans bilang selebrasyon sa iya kadalag-an.#
english: Because of the incident, there were no homecoming activities for the beauty queen and Nicaraguan beauty pageant fans were able to create only hypothetical images and imaginations as a celebration of her victory.

text: Umaasa si Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman Sen.
english: Senate Blue Ribbon Committee Chairman Sen.

text: Panfilo Lacson na papasa na sa Senado ang Independent People’s Commission bill sa susunod na linggo.
english: Panfilo Lacson said the Independent People's Commission bill will be passed in the Senate next week.

text: Ang naturang panukalang batas ang nakikitang magpapalakas sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) na binuo sa pamamagitan ng isang executive order para imbestigahan ang mga anomalyang bumabalot sa mga public infrastructure project sa nakalipas na sampung taon.
english: The bill is expected to strengthen the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) established through an executive order to investigate anomalies surrounding public infrastructure projects over the past decade.

text: Ayon kay Lacson, batid ng Senado ang mga hamon na kinakaharap ng naturang komisyon mula noong ito ay binuo.
english: According to Lacson, the Senate is aware of the challenges facing the commission since its inception.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, wala aniyang miyembro ng Senado na tumatanggi o kumukuwestyon sa naturang panukala at lahat ng mga Senador ay nagpahayag ng kanilang pagsuporta para sa itatayong bagong komisyon.
english: Currently, no member of the Senate opposes or questions the proposal and all Senators have expressed their support for the new commission.

text: Binigyang-diin ng batikang Senador ang pangangailangang mabigyan ang ICI ng independence at immunity mula sa anumang impluwensiya at political issue upang makapagtrabahong mag-isa.
english: The Senator stressed the need to give the ICI independence and immunity from any influence and political issues in order to work together.

text: Umaasa ang Senador na susunod din ang Kamara de Representantes sa magiging hakbang ng Senado o kung hindi man ay mas mauunang ipasa ang House version.
english: The Senator hopes that the House of Representatives will follow the steps of the Senate or if not, the House version will be passed first.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, ang isa sa mga inaaral na lamang ng mataas na kapulungan ay ang pagbibigay ng contempt power sa bubuuing komisyon, bilang dagdag sa kasalukuyang kapangyarihan na naibigay sa ICI noong ito ay itinatag.
english: Currently, one of the issues being studied by the upper house is the granting of contempt powers to the new commission, in addition to the current powers granted to the ICI when it was established.

text: Ani Lacson, walang silbi na mabigyan ng subpoena powers ang ICI kung wala itong kapangyarihan na magpataw ng contempt sa sinumang iimbitahang resource person.
english: According to Lacson, there is no point in giving the ICI subpoena powers if it does not have the power to impose contempt on any invited resource person.

text: Binigyang-diin ng Senador ang pangangailangang magkaroon ng isang independent body na mag-iimbestiga, maghahain ng kaso, at maghahabol sa mga ninanakaw na pondo ng gobiyerno mula sa mga pampublikong proyekto.
english: The Senator stressed the need for an independent body to investigate, prosecute, and pursue the theft of government funds from public projects.

text: Ang mga smartphones ukon gadgets ang kilala nga may pinakamadamo nga bakterya ukon mikrobyo.
english: Smartphones or gadgets are known to harbor the most bacteria or germs.

text: Gani bilang sabat, may yara sang ginhimo ang United Kingdom nga labing una nga antimicrobial smartphone sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: So in response, the United Kingdom has developed the world’s first antimicrobial smartphone.

text: Ang ini nga smartphone ang ginatawag nga CAT S42 sa diin ginakabig ini nga pinakamatinlo nga smartphone nga imo mabakal.
english: This smartphone is called the CAT S42 where it is considered the cleanest smartphone you can buy.

text: Ini bangud maka-protekta ini gikan sa yab-ok kag tubig.
english: This is because it can protect from dust and water.

text: Indi mapatihan?
english: Unbelievable?

text: Gina-engganyo mismo sang maufacturer ang mga nagagamit sang sini nga smartphone nga hugasan kag i-sanitize ini.
english: The manufacturer itself encourages users of this smartphone to wash and sanitize it.

text: Indi ka magkabalaka bangud indi magguba ang imo cellphone ilabi na sa tuig 2021 nga may yara ini sang extra layer sang proteksyon nga ginatawag “Biomaster antimicrobial technology” nga amo ang nagapa-untat sa paglapta sang germs.
english: Don't worry because your cellphone will not break especially in 2021 that it has an extra layer of protection called “Biomaster antimicrobial technology” which stops the spread of germs.

text: Gani sa masunod nga tuig, lauman mo nga indi lang pinggan kag baso ang imo ginahugasan kundi mangin ang imo naman nga cellphone!
english: So next year, expect to wash not only dishes and glasses but also your cellphone!

text: Nalakip sa mga napatay sa plane crash sa India ang pila ka mga estudyante sa dormitoryo sang isa ka medical college.
english: Among those killed in a plane crash in India were several students in a medical college dormitory.

text: Masobra 290 ang patay sang nagtibusok ang eroplano nga padulong sa London kag may karga nga 242 ka tawo.
english: More than 290 people were killed when a London-bound plane carrying 242 people crashed.

text: Naka-take off lang ini sa airport sang western city sang Ahmedabad sang nag-crash ini sa dormitory sang isa ka medical college kun sa diin may yara sang mga nagatinir nga estudyante.
english: It was just taking off from the airport of the western city of Ahmedabad when it crashed into the dormitory of a medical college where there were students.

text: Ini ang ginakabig nga worst aviation disaster sa kalibutan sa sini nga dekada.
english: It is considered the worst aviation disaster in the world in this decade.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa amo nga trahedya, isa lang ang survivor nga amo ang pasahero nga nagapungko sa tupad sang emergency exit.
english: It was learned that in the tragedy, only one survivor was the passenger sitting next to the emergency exit.

text: Ginklaro ni Punong Barangay Joseph Poral sang Barangay Tacas, Jaro nga alegasyon lamang ang nagalapta nga isyu may kaangtanan sa ginpatigayon nga pay-out sang Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa ila lugar.
english: Punong Barangay Joseph Poral of Barangay Tacas, Jaro clarified that the issue regarding the pay-out of the Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) in their area is only an allegation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo PB Poral, iya ginpahayag nga tuman gid ang iya kakibot sang mabatian nga nadalahig ang iya barangay sa amo nga kontrobersiya, samtang wala man sang natabo nga ano man nga klase sang pay-out sa Tacas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo PB Poral, he said he was shocked to hear that his barangay was involved in the controversy, while there was no pay-out in Tacas.

text: Suno sa iya, wala man siya sang ideya kun sin-o ang nagapamangkot ukon nagapanglista sang mga benepisyaryo sa ila barangay, kag kun may matuod gid nga releasing, kuntani una siya makahibalo bilang kapitan sang lugar.
english: He said he has no idea who is asking or listing the beneficiaries in their barangay, and if there is a real releasing, he should have known first as the barangay captain.

text: Ginpaathag pa ni Poral nga matinlo ang iya konsensya kag wala gid siya sang ideya sa ginapanghatag nga AICS nga ginareklamo, bangud wala man ini nag-agi sa iya opisina.
english: Poral explained that he has a clean conscience and has no idea about the distribution of AICS that is being complained about, because it did not pass through his office.

text: Ginpangabay man niya ang nagareklamo nga kun may kamatuoran gid ang ila alegasyon, magpadulong lamang sa Barangay Hall kag isugid ang impormasyon kag pangalan sang nagkuha sang bahin sang ayuda agud matigayon nga masolusyunan amo nga problema.
english: He also asked the complainant that if there is truth in their allegation, just go to the Barangay Hall and tell the information and name of the person who took part of the aid so that the problem can be resolved.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahayag ni PB Poral nga handa siya nga magpaidalom sa imbestigasyon sang DSWD kun kinahanglan para mapat-od ang kamatuoran sa likod sang isyu bahin sa AICS.
english: On the other hand, PB Poral said he is ready to undergo an investigation by the DSWD if necessary to determine the truth behind the issue regarding AICS.

text: Naka-schedule subong nga adlaw, Mayo 5, ang motorcade nga pakigbahinan ni Miss Universe 2023 Sheynnis Palacios diri sa Pilipinas.
english: Miss Universe 2023 Sheynnis Palacios is scheduled to participate in the motorcade today, May 5, here in the Philippines.

text: Suno sa Miss Universe Philippines Organization, balantayan ini sa Mall of Asia complex sa Pasay City 5:00 karon sa hapon.
english: According to the Miss Universe Philippines Organization, it will be held at the Mall of Asia complex in Pasay City at 5:00 pm today.

text: “Philippines!
english: “Philippines!

text: Let’s show Miss Universe 2023 SHEYNISS PALACIOS, and the Universe, the warm welcome Filipinos are famous for!
english: Let’s show Miss Universe 2023 SHEYNISS PALACIOS, and the Universe, the warm welcome Filipinos are famous for!

text: Join us in a grand WELCOME MOTORCADE for our reigning Queen!,” pahayag sang organisasyon.
english: Join us in a grand WELCOME MOTORCADE for our reigning Queen!,” the organization said in a statement.

text: Mayo 1 sang nag-abot ang Nicaraguan beauty queen sa Pilipinas halin sa iya pagbisita sa Thailand.
english: The Nicaraguan beauty queen arrived in the Philippines on May 1 from her visit to Thailand.

text: Lakip ini sa iya nga Asian Tour kun sa diin una na ini nga nakakadto sa Laos, Cambodia, kag China.
english: This is part of his Asian Tour where he has previously visited Laos, Cambodia, and China.

text: Siya ang ikatlo nga reigning Miss Universe titleholder nga nagbisita sa Pilipinas kasunod kay 2021 queen Harnaaz Sandhu kag 2022 winner R’Bonney Gabriel.
english: She is the third reigning Miss Universe titleholder to visit the Philippines after 2021 queen Harnaaz Sandhu and 2022 winner R’Bonney Gabriel.

text: Magaupod man si Palacios sa iban nga aktibidad sa Miss Universe Phiippines antes ini magbiya sa pungsod sa Mayo 7.
english: Palacios will also participate in other Miss Universe Philippines activities before she leaves the country on May 7.

text: Samtang nagapadayon ang pag-recover sa mga bangkay sa natabo nga plane crash sa India, isa ka lalaki ang nakit-an nga milagro nga nakaluwas.
english: As efforts continue to recover bodies from a plane crash in India, a man has been found miraculously alive.

text: Ini amo si Vishwash Kumar Ramesh, isa ka British citizen nga nakapungko sa 11A, sang natabo ang trahedya nga nagpatay sa masobra 200 nga mga tawo.
english: This was Vishwash Kumar Ramesh, a British citizen who was seated in 11A, when the tragedy that killed more than 200 people occurred.

text: “Thirty seconds after take-off, there was a loud noise,” pahayag sini sa atubang sang reporters.
english: “Thirty seconds after take-off, there was a loud noise,” he told reporters.

text: “There were dead bodies around me.
english: “There were dead bodies around me.

text: I got scared.
english: I got scared.

text: I got up and ran.
english: I got up and ran.

text:
There were pieces of the plane everywhere.”

Naglapta na ang video sini sa social media kun sa diin makit-an ang impact injuries sa iya lawas.
english:
There were pieces of the plane everywhere.”

A video of him has been circulating on social media showing impact injuries on his body.

text: Nagakiang-kiang ini, may gisi ang bayo, kag may dugo ang nawong sang nakit-an sang mga tawo.
english: He was limping, his clothes were torn, and his face was covered with blood when people saw him.

text: Tumandok sang India si Ramesh apang nagapuyo sa London sa nagligad nga duha ka dekada kaupod ang iya asawa kag anak.
english: Ramesh is a native of India but has been living in London for the past two decades with his wife and son.

text: Nagbalik ini sa India para kuntani sa family reunion apang natabo ini nga trahedya.
english: He returned to India for a family reunion but tragedy struck.

text: Sa inisyal nga impormasyon, kaupod niya sa flight ang iya utod nga si Ajay Vishwaskumar nga missing pa subong.
english: According to initial information, he was accompanied on the flight by his brother Ajay Vishwaskumar, who is still missing.

text: 242 ang sakay sang eroplano sang nag-crash ini sa residential area partikular sa medical college hostel sa guwa sang airport sa Ahmedabad.
english: 242 were on board the plane when it crashed in the residential area particularly the medical college hostel outside the airport in Ahmedabad.

text: Pakadto kuntani ini sa Gatwick Airport sa London.
english: It was supposed to be on its way to Gatwick Airport in London.

text: Sa mga na-recover nga bangkay, wala pa sang kumpirmasyon kun ini mga pasahero ukon mga tawo nga yara na nga daan sa area kag nadalahig lang sang natabo ang plane crash.
english: Of the bodies recovered, there is no confirmation whether they are passengers or people who were already in the area and were involved in the plane crash.

text: Ginhingyo na sa mga himata nga maghatag sang DNA samples agud matumod ang mga nagkalamatay suno kay state health secretary Dhananjay Dwivedi.
english: Relatives have been asked to provide DNA samples to identify the deceased, state health secretary Dhananjay Dwivedi said.

text: “The building on which it has crashed is a doctors’ hostel… we have cleared almost 70% to 80% of the area and will clear the rest soon,” suno sa senior police officer sa amo nga syudad.
english: “The building on which it has crashed is a doctors’ hostel… we have cleared almost 70% to 80% of the area and will clear the rest soon,” said a senior police officer in the city.

text: Sa inisyal nga report halin sa Air India, ang ila mga pasahero nagalakip sang 217 adults, 11 ka kabataan, kag duha ka mga lapsag.
english: According to the initial report from Air India, their passengers included 217 adults, 11 children, and two infants.

text: Sa sini nga numero, 169 ang Indian nationals, 53 ang Britons, pito ang Portuguese, kag isa ang Canadian.
english: Of this number, 169 are Indian nationals, 53 are Britons, seven are Portuguese, and one is Canadian.

text: Sandig sa Aviation tracking site nga Flightradar24, ang involved sa insidente amo ang Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner nga isa sa pinaka-moderno nga passenger aircraft nga ginagamit subong.
english: According to the aviation tracking site Flightradar24, the one involved in the incident was a Boeing 787-8 Dreamliner which is one of the most modern passenger aircraft in use today.

text: Base pa sa Aviation Safety Network database, ini ang una nga crash sa Dreamliner nga nag-umpisa sang commercial nga pagpalupad sang eroplano sadtong 2011.#
english: Based on the Aviation Safety Network database, this is the first crash in a Dreamliner that started commercial flights in 2011.#

text: Padayon ang kabaskugon sang Tropical Depression Wilma samtang mahinay ini nga nagahukag psa nakatundan padulong sa Eastern Visayas.
english: Tropical Depression Wilma continues to strengthen as it slowly moves westward towards Eastern Visayas.

text: Ulihi nga nasiplatan ang sentro sang bagyo Wilma sa kalayuon nga 180km nasidlangan sang Borongan City, Eastern Samar.
english: The center of typhoon Wilma was last spotted 180km east of Borongan City, Eastern Samar.

text:
May dala ini sang kabaskugon nga hangin nga nagalab-ot sa 45km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos tubtob 55km/h.

Nagahulag ini sang mahinay pa-nakatunda

Signal No.
english:
It brought winds of up to 45km/h near the center and gusts of up to 55km/h.

It is moving slowly westward

Signal No.

text: 1Luzon:Southern nga bahin sang Sorsogon kag mainland Masbate lakip ang Ticao Island.
english: 1Luzon:Southern part of Sorsogon and mainland Masbate including Ticao Island.

text: Visayas:Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, Samar, Biliran, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Cebu lakip ang Bantayan kag Camotes Islands, Bohol, naaminhan kag sentro nga bahin sang Negros Occidental, Siquijor, Negros Oriental, naaminhan nga bahin sang Iloilo, nasidlangan nga bahin sang Capiz, kag Guimaras.
english: Visayas: Northern Samar, Eastern Samar, Samar, Biliran, Leyte, Southern Leyte, Cebu including Bantayan and Camotes Islands, Bohol, northern and central parts of Negros Occidental, Siquijor, Negros Oriental, northern part of Iloilo, eastern part of Capiz, and Guima.

text: Mindanao:Surigao del Norte lakip ang Siargao kag Bucas Grande Islands, Dinagat Islands, naaminhan nga bahin sang Surigao del Sur, naaminhan nga bahin sang Agusan del Norte, kag Camiguin.
english: Mindanao:Surigao del Norte including Siargao and Bucas Grande Islands, Dinagat Islands, northern part of Surigao del Sur, northern part of Agusan del Norte, and Camiguin.

text: Sarangan mo bala nga ibaligya ang imo nawong?
english: Can you afford to sell your face?

text: Kun huo, may yara sang isa ka Japanese company nga luyag mabatian ang imo sabat.
english: If yes, there is a Japanese company that would like to hear your answer.

text: Ini bangud negosyo nila amo ang pagbakal sang imo nawong agud man nga ibaligya ini bilang hyper-realistic 3D printed masks.
english: This is because their business is to buy your face in order to also sell it as hyper-realistic 3D printed masks.

text: Literal nga FACE MASK ang ginabaligya sang sini nga kompaniya.
english: This company is literally selling a FACE MASK.

text: Ang pagbakal sang nawong sang tawo ang nagabalor sang 40,000 yen ukon masobra P18,000 samtang kun ini naman ang ibaligya sang kompaniya, nagabalor ini sang masobra P45,000.
english: The purchase of a human face costs 40,000 yen or more than P18,000 while if the company sells it, it costs more than P45,000.

text: Sang gin-anunsyar ini sang kompaniya, madamo ang nag-kwestyon sa proyekto sa diin tubtob subong indi pa maathag kun ano ang tinutuyo sang amo nga kompaniya.
english: When the company announced this, many questioned the project where until now it is not clear what the purpose of the company.

text: Sa mga luyag nga ibaligya ang rights sang ila nawong, nagakadapat nga naga edad ikaw sang 20 anyos pataas kag naka base sa Tokyo.
english: For those who want to sell the rights to their face, you must be 20 years old and above and based in Tokyo.

text: Nagpasaka si Bea Alonzo sang kaso nga cyber libel batok sa showbiz columnists kag online hosts nga sanday Cristy Fermin kag Ogie Diaz kag iban pa nila nga co-hosts sa ila nga online programs.
english: Bea Alonzo filed a case of cyber libel against showbiz columnists and online hosts Cristy Fermin and Ogie Diaz and their other co-hosts in their online programs.

text: Sa iya pagkadto sa Quezon City Prosecutors Office, nag-file man ang aktres sang reklamo batok sa online basher nga nagapakuno-kuno nga suod sa iya.
english: During her visit to the Quezon City Prosecutors Office, the actress also filed a complaint against the online basher who pretended to be close to her.

text: Sa complaint affidavit sang aktres, nakasaad nga biktima siya sang “false, malicious, and damaging information” halin sa tawo nga nagapakuno-kuno nga close sa iya kag ginbalhag ini kag gin-discuss sa online shows nanday Diaz kag Fermin apisar nga wala sang basis.
english: The actress' complaint affidavit states that she was the victim of "false, malicious, and damaging information" from someone who pretended to be close to her and published and discussed it on Diaz and Fermin's online shows despite having no basis.

text: Lakip man diri ang gina-alegar sunod-sunod nga insulto kay Bea sa ila nga columns kag shows amo man ang isyu sang gina-alegar indi sini husto nga pagbayad sang buwis.
english: This includes the alleged series of insults to Bea in their columns and shows as well as the issue of her alleged improper payment of taxes.

text: Matandaan nga Pebrero sang nangin kaundan sang balita si Bea kasunod sang ila pagkansela sang ila engagement ni Dominic Roque.
english: It can be recalled that Bea became the subject of news in February after they canceled their engagement with Dominic Roque.

text: Ang una nga nagkumpirma sang split sang amo nga tion amo si Boy Abunda.
english: The first to confirm the split at the time was Boy Abunda.

text: Sa official statement anay sang couple, ila ginpahayag: “Unfortunately, some even confirmed our break-up without our consent, and some created ridiculous stories that had no basis and were utterly false, so we felt the need to share this announcement with great sadness, for our peace of mind and our families.”#
english: In an official statement, the couple said: “Unfortunately, some even confirmed our break-up without our consent, and some created ridiculous stories that had no basis and were utterly false, so we felt the need to share this announcement with great sadness, for our peace of mind and our families.”#

text: Kumpyansa si Coach Steve Kerr nga mangin maayo na ang kondisyon sang NBA superstar kag three-time Olympic gold medalist nga si Kevin Durant kun magsugod na ang hampang sang USA men’s basketball team sa Paris Olympics.
english: Coach Steve Kerr is confident that NBA superstar and three-time Olympic gold medalist Kevin Durant will be in good shape when the USA men’s basketball team starts playing at the Paris Olympics.

text: Byernes sang nag-abot ang Team USA sa Abu Dhabi para sa duha ka naka-schedule na nga exhibition games batok sa Australia (July 15) kag Serbia (July 17) bilang preparasyon sa Olympiada.
english: It was Friday when Team USA arrived in Abu Dhabi for two already scheduled exhibition games against Australia (July 15) and Serbia (July 17) in preparation for the Olympiad.

text: Yara man si Durant sa session sa NYU Abu Dhabi campus subong nga weekend apang wala ini gihapon nag-upod sa iya teammates sa practice.
english: Durant was also in session at the NYU Abu Dhabi campus this weekend but still did not join his teammates in practice.

text: Ginalantaw nga bangud ini gihapon sa calf strain nga iya naangkon duha ka semana na ang nagligad.
english: It is believed to be due to the same calf strain he suffered two weeks ago.

text: Sa pihak sini, wala nagakahangawa si Kerr kag ginkumpirma man sini nga wala pa sang naistoryahan nga contingency plans agud nga islan ang Phoenix Suns forward sa roster.
english: Meanwhile, Kerr is not worried and confirmed that no contingency plans have been discussed to replace the Phoenix Suns forward on the roster.

text: ‘Individual work’ lang anay ang himuon ni KD suno sa coach kag nagapati sila nga mangin “okay” ini pag-abot sa Paris Games.
english: The coach said KD will only do 'individual work' and they believe it will be “okay” when it comes to the Paris Games.

text: Nahibaluan nga magluwas kay Durant, yara sa American ‘super-team’ sa Olympic Games ang NBA leading scorer nga si LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Anthony Davis, Anthony Edwards, kag ang recently crowned NBA champions nga sanday Jayson Tatum kag Jrue Holiday sang Boston Celtics.
english: In addition to Durant, the American 'super-team' at the Olympic Games includes NBA leading scorer LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Anthony Davis, Anthony Edwards, and recently crowned NBA champions Jayson Tatum and Jrue Holiday of the Boston Celtics.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, opisyal nga nag-atras sa team si Kawhi Leonard kag ginbuslan sang ikatatlo nga Celtic nga si Derrick White.
english: The other day, Kawhi Leonard officially withdrew from the team and was replaced by a third Celtic, Derrick White.

text: Lima tanan ka friendly games ang yara sa schedule sang USA antes ang Paris Games.
english: A total of five friendly games are on the USA’s schedule before the Paris Games.

text: Sa una nga tune-up match, ginlutos sini ang Canada 86-72 sa T-Mobile Arena sa Las Vegas.
english: In the first tune-up match, it defeated Canada 86-72 at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.

text: Nagtibusok ang Air India plane nga may sakay nga masobra sa 200 ka mga pasahero.
english: An Air India plane carrying more than 200 passengers crashed.

text: Natabo ini sa malapit sa airport sa western city sang India nga Ahmedabad.
english: It happened near the airport in the western Indian city of Ahmedabad.

text: Wala pa sang kumpirmasyon kun may fatalities.
english: There is no confirmation of any fatalities.

text: Padulong ang eroplano sa Gatwick airport sa London, UK.
english: The plane was heading to Gatwick airport in London, UK.

text: Natabo ang crash sang ma-take off na ang eroplano.
english: The crash occurred just as the plane was about to take off.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad kag pag-rescue sa mga pasahero.
english: Authorities are still investigating and rescuing the passengers.

text: Isa ka amay ang napreso matapos nga ginbuno ang isa ka soltero nga nagkastigo sa iya anak.
english: A father has been jailed after stabbing a young man who beat his son.

text: Ang suspek amo si alyas “Norman” samtang ang biktima amo si alyas “Edmar’.
english: The suspect was identified as “Norman” while the victim was identified as “Edmar”.

text: Suno sa otoridad, nakit-an ni Norman ang iya anak nga si Patrick nga ginakastigo ni Edmar gani iya ini ginpalapitan kag gintambagan.
english: According to the police, Norman saw his son Patrick being beaten by Edmar so he approached him and advised him.

text: Apang, wala nag-untat si Edmar sa pagkastigo kay Norman rason nga ginkuha niya ang patalom sa iya hawak kag ginbuno sa likod ang biktima.
english: However, Edmar did not stop beating Norman so he took the knife from his waist and stabbed the victim in the back.

text: Matapos ang krimen, nagpauli ang mag-amay kag ginbilin nga duguon ang biktima.
english: After the crime, the father and son went home and left the victim bleeding.

text: Nadala pa sa Gumaca District Hospital ang biktima apang gindeklarar nga dead-on-arrival.
english: The victim was rushed to the Gumaca District Hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Naaresto naman ang suspek.
english: The suspect was arrested.

text: Yara na sa kustodiya sang National Bureau of Investigation ang negosyante nga si Cedric Lee matapos nga nagpaguwa na sang desisyon ang korte sa Taguig City nga guilty ini, si Deniece Cornejo, kag ang duha ka iban pa nga respondents sa kaso nga serious illegal detention nga ginpasaka sang host-comedian nga si Vhong Navarro.
english: Businessman Cedric Lee is now in the custody of the National Bureau of Investigation after a court in Taguig City issued a verdict that he, Deniece Cornejo, and two other respondents in the case of serious illegal detention filed by host-comedian Vhong Navarro.

text: Suno kay NBI director Atty. Medardo Dilemos, mismo si Lee ang nagpahibalo sa otoridad nga magasungka ini rason nga ginkadtuan sang agents sa isa ka lokasyon sa Mandaluyong kag didto ini gin-aresto.
english: According to NBI director Atty. Medardo Dilemos, Lee himself informed the authorities that he would surrender and the agents went to a location in Mandaluyong and arrested him there.

text: Sunod man nga ginkuhaan sang mugshot kag fingerprints ang nasambit nga businessman.
english: The businessman was also subjected to a mugshot and fingerprints.

text: Matandaan nga kaina sang aga sang ginkumpirma sang legal counsel ni Navarro nga si Atty. Alma Mallonga nga nagmandu ang korte nga i-detain gilayon si Cornejo.
english: Navarro's legal counsel, Atty. Alma Mallonga said the court ordered the immediate detention of Cornejo.

text: Indi present si Lee sa promulgation gani nga nagmandu pa ang korte nga ipaaresto ini.
english: Lee was not present at the promulgation so the court ordered his arrest.

text: Kun balikan ang gin-ugatan sang kaso, gin-akusaran ni Vhong si Lee nga nag-detain sa iya sang gab-i sang Enero 22, 2014 sa condominium unit sa Taguig City kun sa diin ginkastigo pa ini ni Lee kag sang iya mga kaupdanan kag gin-alegar nga ginpahog pa nga patyon.
english: Going back to the root of the case, Vhong accused Lee of detaining him on the night of January 22, 2014 in a condominium unit in Taguig City where Lee and his companions beat him and allegedly threatened to kill him.

text: Gin-alegar nga nag-demand pa si Lee sang P2 million kabaylo sang pagpaguwa kay Vhong samtang nagpasugot naman ang comedian-host nga magbayad sang P1 million.
english: Lee allegedly demanded P2 million in exchange for Vhong's release while the comedian-host agreed to pay P1 million.

text:
Nakasuhan man si Cornejo nga nag-claim nga gintuyo siya nga i-rape ni Vhong sang amo nga gab-i.

Ang nasambit nga rape allegation amo ang gingamit ni Lee nga justification kun ngaa ginkastigo si Vhong kag ginpwersa ini nga akuon ang pag-rape kay Cornejo sa amo nga gab-i.

Sa pihak nga bahin, may yara sang na-review nga CCTV footage nga amo naman ang gingamit sang kampo ni Vhong kag ginpanindugan nga physically impossible para sa host-actor nga i-rape si Cornejo sa sulod lamang sang tuman ka lip-ot nga tion.
english:
Cornejo was also charged with claiming that Vhong tried to rape her that night.

The rape allegation was used by Lee as a justification for beating Vhong and forcing him to confess to raping Cornejo that night.

On the other hand, there is a reviewed CCTV footage that was used by Vhong's camp and insisted that it was physically impossible for the host-actor to rape Cornejo in a very short period of time.

text: Ang iban pa nga mga akusado amo sanday Bernice Lee, Simeon Raz, Jr., Jose Paolo Gregorio Calma, Jed Fernandez kag Ferdinand Guerrero.
english: Other defendants are Bernice Lee, Simeon Raz, Jr., Jose Paolo Gregorio Calma, Jed Fernandez and Ferdinand Guerrero.

text: Nag-file si Lee sang motion para ibasura ang kaso apang gin-deny sang korte ang motion.
english: Lee filed a motion to dismiss the case but the court denied the motion.

text: Ginpasaka sang nasambit nga negosyante ang iya nga kaso sa Court of Appeals apang napaslawan man bangud nga ginpalig-on lamang sang appelate court ang ruling sang lower court.
