english: The businessman filed his case in the Court of Appeals but failed because the appeal court only upheld the ruling of the lower court.

text: Pareho nga 40 ka tuig nga pagka-preso ang sentensya kanday Lee, Cornejo, Guerrero, kag Palma Raz kag ginmanduan man nga magbayad sang P300,000 sa civil indemnity kag moral kag exemplary damages.
english: Lee, Cornejo, Guerrero, and Palma Raz were both sentenced to 40 years in prison and ordered to pay P300,000 in civil indemnity and moral and exemplary damages.

text: Samtang, una naman nga nagpasalamat si Navarro sa hustisya nga nahatag sa iya 10 ka tuig matapos iya na-file ang kaso.
english: Meanwhile, Navarro first thanked the justice given to him 10 years after he filed the case.

text: “Gusto ko munang [kunin] ang pagkakataon na ito para magpasalamat.
english: “I want to [take] this opportunity to say thank you.

text: Of course, maraming-maraming salamat Lord dahil lagi Kang nakagabay sa akin.
english: Of course, thank you very much Lord for always guiding me.

text: Sa dami nang pinagdaanan ko sa buhay nandiyan ka, Ikaw ang naging sentro ko at na napakatotoo Mo, kaya maraming-maraming salamat,” pahayag sang host.
english: In the many things I've been through in life, you've been there, you've been my center and you've been very real, so thank you very much,” the host said.

text: Pinaka-nangin emosyonal ini sang nagahatag na sang mensahe sa iya asawa nga si Tanya Bautista.
english: He became most emotional when he was giving a message to his wife, Tanya Bautista.

text: “Marami akong pagkukulang sa iyo pero hindi mo ako iniwan.
english: “I miss you a lot but you never left me.

text: Marami akong kasalanan pero nandiyan ka pa rin.
english: I've sinned a lot but you're still there.

text: Hayaan mong bumawi ako sa iyo sa abot ng aking makakaya hanggang sa huling sandali ng buhay ko.
english: Let me repay you as much as I can until the last moment of my life.

text: Mahal na mahal kita.
english: We are dearly loved.

text: Salamat,” pahayag ni Vhong nga amo na ang katapusan sang iya speech antes ang group hug nga ginhatag sang iya nga mga ka-trabaho sa “It’s Showtime!”#
english: Thank you,” Vhong said at the end of his speech before the group hug given by his colleagues on “It’s Showtime!”#

text: Nagpromisa si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga pondohan ang mga miyembro sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) nga magapadalagan sa 2022 elections.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte has promised to fund members of the Partido Demokratiko Pilipino-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) who will run in the 2022 elections.

text: Si Duterte amo ang chairman sang isa ka faction sang amo nga ruling party.
english: Duterte is the chairman of a faction of the ruling party.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga bisan wala man siya masami nga nagatambong sang ila nga political meetings, pat-od nga iga-kampanya niya ang iya nga ka-partido para sa general elections.
english: He said that although he does not often attend their political meetings, he will certainly campaign for his partymate for the general elections.

text: Pahayag pa ni Duterte, suportahan niya ang kampanya sang PDP-laban aspirants kag mahatag man siya sang isa ka sako nga kwarta agud masigurado lang nga madaog ang kandidato.
english: Duterte said he will support the campaign of the PDP-laban aspirants and will also give a sack of money to ensure that the candidate wins.

text: Indi maathag kun seryoso si Duterte ukon nalakip man ini sa iya “jokes” nga amo naman ang depensahan sang iya Gabinete.
english: It is not clear whether Duterte is serious or whether this is part of his “jokes” that his Cabinet will defend.

text: Una diri, nagkumpirma na ini nga maga-retiro na siya sa pulitika.
english: Earlier, he confirmed that he will retire from politics.

text: Ang PDP-Laban Cusi faction naman ang ulihi nga nag-appoint kay Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa bilang standard-bearer sa 2022 elections.
english: The PDP-Laban Cusi faction was the last to appoint Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa as the standard-bearer for the 2022 elections.

text: Naka-attend ka na bala sa isa ka kasal?
english: Have you ever attended a wedding?

text: Kadam-an nga nagakadto sa kasal amo ang mga mag-asawa.
english: Most people who come to the wedding are couples.

text: Apang nangin kontrobersyal ang isa ka Nigerian socialite nga si Mike Eze-Nwalie Nwogu, aka “Pretty Mike” matapos nga nag-attend sa isa ka high-profile wedding.
english: But Nigerian socialite Mike Eze-Nwalie Nwogu, aka “Pretty Mike” has become controversial after attending a high-profile wedding.

text: Bal-an mo kun pila kabilog kag kun sanday sin-o ang iya upod?
english: Do you know how many and who he was with?

text: Indi lang isa, indi duha, indi tatlo, indi pa gid apat ukon lima.
english: Not just one, not two, not three, not even four or five.

text: Kundi….anom!
english: But….six!

text: anom kabilog nga mga babaye ang iya upod nga lunsay mga nagabusong!
english: six women with him, all pregnant!

text: Ang mga ginabusong sang anom ka mga babaye ang gina-alegar lunsay mga kabataan ni Pretty Mike.
english: The pregnancies of the six women are allegedly all of Pretty Mike's children.

text: Ini ang indi lamang labing una nga tion nga ginkibot niya ang iya mga fans kag syempre indi man ini ang katapusan.
english: This is not only the first time she surprised her fans and of course it won’t be the last either.

text: Sang tinalikdan nga tuig, nagpost man si Pretty Mike sang pictures niya kaupod ang lima ka mga brides sa diin iya ginpahayag nga handom niya nga kaslon sa duha niya ka mga ex’s kag tatlo ka mga girlfriends.
english: Last year, Pretty Mike also posted pictures of himself with five brides where he said he wanted to marry two of his ex's and three girlfriends.

text: 𝗖𝗘𝗕𝗨 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 — Nagpabutyag sang kalipay ang mga organizers sang Palarong Pambansa 2024 bangud sa madinalag-on nga nagapadayon ang hinampang sa Cebu City kag kaiping nga mga Local Government Unit (LGU).
english: 𝗖𝗘𝗕𝗨 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 — The organizers of the Palarong Pambansa 2024 expressed their satisfaction with the successful ongoing of the games in Cebu City and neighboring Local Government Units (LGUs).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay John Pages, Chairman sang Cebu City Sports Commission, iya ginpahayag nga ang syudad ang nagahimo sang maayo bilang tagbalay sang pinakadaku nga pagtililipon sang mga student-athlete sa pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, John Pages, Chairman of the Cebu City Sports Commission, said the city is doing well as a host of the largest student-athlete gathering in the country.

text: Suno kay Pages, apisar nga may mga pagpanghangkat pareho sa logistics, video streaming, kag koneksyon sa internet, ang mga organizer sang meet ang gilayon nga nakahatag sang solusyon.
english: Pages said despite challenges such as logistics, video streaming, and internet connectivity, meet organizers were able to quickly come up with a solution.

text: Gin-ako niya nga bisan pa nga nakabaton sila sang nagkalainlain nga mga pagkabalaka kada adlaw angot sa mga billeting areas nga gina-istaran sang tagsa ka region, suno sa iya, gilayon nila ini nga naremedyohan.
english: He acknowledged that although they received various concerns every day regarding the billeting areas that each region resided in, he said they were able to remedy them immediately.

text: Ang kalabanan sang mga pagpanghangkat amo ang hanungod sa kulang nga suplay sang tubig, kag barado nga mga kasilyas.
english: Most of the challenges are related to inadequate water supply, and clogged toilets.

text: Gin-address man sang sini ang isyu sa posible kaso sang dengue kun sa diin ginreport nga may mga atleta nga nagpakita sang sintomas sang balatian nga dala sang lamok.
english: He also addressed the issue of possible dengue cases where it was reported that some athletes showed symptoms of the mosquito-borne disease.

text: Suno sa iya, ginalantaw subong sang mga organizers sang Palarong Pambansa 2024 ang ila medical records.
english: He said the organizers of the Palarong Pambansa 2024 are now looking at their medical records.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpahayag ni Pages nga ginahulat pa nila ang mga report gikan sa technical committee sang Palarong Pambansa 2024 angut sa isyu sang track oval sa Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC).
english: Meanwhile, Pages said they are still waiting for reports from the technical committee of the Palarong Pambansa 2024 regarding the issue of the track oval at the Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC).

text: Una na nga na-report nga ang rubberized track oval ang may duha ka metros nga kulang sa kinaandan nga 400 metros nga kalabaon.
english: It was previously reported that the rubberized track oval is two meters short of the usual 400 meters long.

text: Ginpasalig naman ni Acting Cebu City Mayor Raymond Alvin Garcia nga makig-istorya siya sa mga technical committees agud padasigon ang pagsolbar sang mga isyu sa palibot sang track oval.
english: Acting Cebu City Mayor Raymond Alvin Garcia assured that he will talk to the technical committees to expedite the resolution of issues around the track oval.

text: Dugang pa, ginpahayag sang acting mayor nga mangin tuman siya ka estrikto, ilabi na sa transportation concerns kun sa diin, hugot nga bantayan ang mga taxi operators nga naga-overcharge sa mga delegado sang Palarong Pambansa 2024.
english: In addition, the acting mayor said that he will be very strict, especially in transportation concerns where, strictly monitor the taxi operators who overcharge the delegates of the Palarong Pambansa 2024.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagakoordinar na ang natungdan sa Land Transportation Office (LTO) kag Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) agud magpatigayon sang imbestigasyon.
english: It is known that the concerned is already coordinating with the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) to conduct an investigation.

text: Inanunsyo ni Prosecutor General Richard Fadullon na sina dating senador Bong Revilla at dating kongresista Zaldy Co ay kabilang na sa mga bagong respondents sa mga reklamong may kinalaman sa umano’y ghost flood control projects sa Bulacan.
english: Prosecutor General Richard Fadullon announced that former senator Bong Revilla and former congressman Zaldy Co are among the new respondents in complaints related to alleged ghost flood control projects in Bulacan.

text: Ayon kay Fadullon, nagsumite na ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) ng karagdagang ebidensiya na tumutukoy kina Revilla at Co bilang mga proponent ng mga iniimbestigahang proyekto.
english: According to Fadullon, the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has already submitted additional evidence pointing to Revilla and Co as proponents of the projects under investigation.

text: Nabatid na may limang reklamong nakabinbin sa DOJ: tatlo ay nakasumite na para sa resolusyon, habang dalawang kaso ang nasa preliminary investigation pa matapos idagdag sina Revilla at Co bilang respondents.
english: It was learned that there are five complaints pending with the DOJ: three have already been submitted for resolution, while two cases are still under preliminary investigation after Revilla and Co were added as respondents.

text: Humiling ang dalawa ng extension para isumite ang kanilang counter-affidavits, at binigyan sila ng DOJ ng limang araw para tumugon.
english: The two requested an extension to submit their counter-affidavits, and the DOJ gave them five days to respond.

text: Target ngayon ng DOJ na maglabas ng resolusyon bago matapos ang taon.
english: The DOJ now targets to issue a resolution before the end of the year.

text: Sa kabila nito patuloy ang mga alegasyon sa pagitan ng ilang mambabatas, opisyal ng DPWH, at mga contractor hinggil sa umano’y kickbacks sa multi-billion pisong flood control projects na nadiskubreng substandard o hindi aktwal na naipatayo.
english: Meanwhile, allegations continue between some lawmakers, DPWH officials, and contractors regarding alleged kickbacks in multi-billion peso flood control projects that were discovered to be substandard or not actually implemented.

text: Kapwa itinanggi nina Revilla, Co, at iba pang mambabatas ang anumang pagkakasangkot sa flood control scandal.
english: Both Revilla, Co, and other lawmakers denied any involvement in the flood control scandal.

text: 𝗖𝗘𝗕𝗨 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 — Nagtulo ang luha kag daw indi makapati ang duha ka mga atleta nga pambato sang Western Visayas sa Palarong Pambasa 2024 matapos nga nakuha nila ang gold kag silver medal sa 200-meter run (elementary-girls).
english: 𝗖𝗘𝗕𝗨 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 — Two athletes from Western Visayas shed tears and couldn't believe their eyes at the Palarong Pambasa 2024 after they won the gold and silver medals in the 200-meter run (elementary-girls).

text: Ang nakakuha sang Gold amo si Princess Mae Lachica, incoming Grade 7 student; samtang ang nakakuha naman sang Silver amo si Ayena Dhawn Cabalfin, kag lunsay tumandok sang Carles, Iloilo.
english: Earning Gold were Princess Mae Lachica, incoming Grade 7 student; while the Silver was won by Ayena Dhawn Cabalfin, both natives of Carles, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Lachica, nga amo ang nakakuha sang gold, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang iya pagpasalamat sa iya nga iloy kag amay nga bug-os nga nagpakita sang suporta sa iya sugod sang siya naga-umpisa pa lamang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Lachica, who won the gold medal, said she is very grateful to her mother and father who have shown full support to her since she was just starting out.

text: Suno kay Lachica, nangin dako man ang kontribusyon sang iya trainers kag coaches agud nga makuha sini ang ginahandom nga bulawan.
english: According to Lachica, his trainers and coaches also contributed a lot to him to win the coveted gold.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga magapadayon ini sa pag-intra sa amo nga hinampang agud madepensahan ang amo nga titulo.
english: He also said that he will continue to participate in the game to defend the title.

text: Naghilibi-on naman si Cabalfin sa iya nabatyagan nga kalipay matapos makuha ang silver nga medalya.
english: Cabalfin shed tears of joy after winning the silver medal.

text: Nagpasalamat man ini sa Dios, sa iya pamilya, maestro, kag maestra bangud sa pagpakita sang hugot nga suporta sa iya tubtob nakuha sini ang medalya.
english: He also thanked God, his family, teachers, and teachers for showing strong support to him until he got the medal.

text: “Proud” si President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: “Proud” President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.

text: kag si First Lady Liza Marcos sa ila subang nga bata nga si House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos sa iya boluntaryo nga pagkadto kag pag-atubang sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) kasunod sang ginaalegar nga involvement sini sa budget insertions.
english: and First Lady Liza Marcos to their youngest son, House Majority Leader Sandro Marcos for his voluntary appearance before the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) following his alleged involvement in budget insertions.

text:
Kahapon sang nag-abot si Sandro sa ICI headquarters, apang gin-utod man ang livestreaming bangud naghingyo ang iya abogado sang executive session bangud sa “kritikal nga mga impormasyon.”

Kasunod sang session, ginsiling sang presidential son sa atubang sang reporters nga nakadepende na sa panel kun luyag nila nga isapubliko ang recording sang iya pag-atubang sa komisyon.
english:
Sandro arrived at the ICI headquarters yesterday, but the livestreaming was also cut off because his lawyer requested an executive session due to “critical information.”

Following the session, the presidential son told reporters that it is up to the panel whether they want to make public the recording of his appearance before the commission.

text: “Doon pa lang po bilang magulang ay proud sila sa kanilang anak,” suno kay Palace Press Officer Usec.
english: “Even as parents, they are proud of their son,” said Palace Press Officer Usec.

text: Claire Castro.
english: Claire Castro.

text: “Bilang magulang makikita natin kung papaano ba pinalaki ng mga magulang ang isang anak: disente, hindi takot, matapang na humarap sa imbestigasyon, hindi nagtago, nagboluntaryo pa, kinilala ang ICI — hindi tulad ng iba,” suno sa iya.
english: “As parents we can see how parents raised a child: decent, not afraid, brave to face the investigation, did not hide, volunteered, recognized the ICI — not like others,” he said.

text: Wala ini sang ginmensyonar nga pangalan apang kahapon, nagpadala sang sulat si Davao Rep.
english: He did not mention his name but yesterday, Davao Rep.

text: Paolo Duterte sa ICI nga indi siya mag-atubang sa panel.
english: Paolo Duterte to ICI that he will not appear before the panel.

text: Pahayag sang kongresista nga Duterte, wala sang hurisdiksyon ang ICI sa iya, kag ini nga komisyon suno sa iya ang ginagamit lang ni Marcos para sa political propaganda.
english: Congressman Duterte said the ICI has no jurisdiction over him, and the commission is being used by Marcos for political propaganda.

text: Sa kaangay nga press briefing subong nga aga, naghatag man sang reaksyon ni Castro sa pagpamalibad ni Duterte nga mag-atubang sa imbestigasyon.
english: In a similar press briefing this morning, Castro also gave his reaction to Duterte's refusal to face the investigation.

text: “May kasabihan tayo: ‘Buntot niya, hila niya.’ It means, you are responsible for the consequences of your own acts,” suno sa Palace official.
english: “We have a saying: ‘His tail, his pull.’ It means, you are responsible for the consequences of your own acts,” the Palace official said.

text: “Marami na pong mga mambabatas na gumalang sa pagpapatawag ng ICI, nagbigay ng kanilang mga response, ng kanilang mga nalalaman.
english: “Many lawmakers who respected the ICI summons, gave their responses, their knowledge.

text:
“Kung walang itinatago, hindi dapat magtago.”

Nahibaluan nga nag-atubang si Sandro sa ICI matapos ginlawag siya ni resigned Ako Bicol Representative Zaldy Co nga nag-insert sang at least P50 billion nga balor sang public works projects sa national budget sang 2023, 2024, kag 2025.
english:
"If you have nothing to hide, you shouldn't hide."

Sandro faced the ICI after resigned Ako Bicol Representative Zaldy Co accused him of inserting at least P50 billion worth of public works projects in the national budget for 2023, 2024, and 2025.

text: Una naman nga gin-deny sang presidential son ang amo nga alegasyon.
english: The presidential son earlier denied the allegation.

text: Sa iya pagsumite sang iya kaugalingon sa panel subong nga hapon, ginklaro sini nga boluntaryo ang iya pagkadto, wala siya gin-subpoena, indi siya subject sang imbestigasyon, kag nagkadto lamang siya agud makabulig sa imbestigasyon.#
english: Submitting himself to the panel this afternoon, he clarified that he came voluntarily, he was not subpoenaed, he is not the subject of an investigation, and he only came to assist in the investigation.#

text: Buka gid ang bagul sang isa ka mangunguma matapos matumbahan sang puno sang lubi sa Barangay Bucao, Polillo, Quezon.
english: A farmer's neck was wide open after being hit by a palm tree in Barangay Bucao, Polillo, Quezon.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Andrew”, 48-anyos kag residente sa amo nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Andrew, 48, resident of the same area.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nagatipon sang mga bunga sang lubi ang biktima kag tatlo ka kauod sini sa tunga sang mabaskog nga huyop sang hangin.
english: According to the investigation, the victim and three of his companions were gathering coconut fruits in the midst of strong winds.

text: Wala natalupangdan sang biktima ang pagkatumba sang puno sang lubi gani wala na ini nakalikaw kag naigo gid ang iya ulo nga rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: The victim did not notice the fall of the palm tree and could not escape and was hit in the head which caused his death.

text: SRI LANKA – Ano ang sarang mo himuon agud nga pamatud-an ang isa ka butang?
english: SRI LANKA – What can you do to prove something?

text: Ginkakibot sang mga local media outlets sa Sri Lanka sa ginpatigayon nga live press conference ang ginhimo ni Dilip Wedaarachchi, anay State Minister of Fisheries.
english: Local media outlets in Sri Lanka were shocked by the actions of Dilip Wedaarachchi, former State Minister of Fisheries, during a live press conference.

text: Ini bangud nga ginkaon mismo ni Dilip sa atubang sang mga reporters ang hilaw nga isda.
english: This is because Dilip himself ate the raw fish in front of the reporters.

text: Nakahibalo ka kun ngaa ginhimo niya ini?
english: Do you know why he did this?

text: Luyag man lang niya pamatud-an nga safe ang mga isda sa Sri Lanka matapos nga wala na sang may nagakaon sang isda bangud nag-angkon sang COVID-19 outbreak ang ila nga central fish market.
english: He also wanted to prove that the fish in Sri Lanka are safe after no one eats fish because of the COVID-19 outbreak in their central fish market.

text: Suno kay Dilip, tuman nga naapektuhan ang mga manugpangisda amo man ang mga nagabaligya sang isda sa merkado sa tuman nga pagnubo sang ila nga kita.
english: According to Dilip, fishermen as well as fish vendors in the market have been severely affected by the sharp drop in their income.

text: Bangud sa outbreak, madamo ang ginkakulbaan magkadto sa merkado sa pagpati nga malatnan ang mga ini sang virus.
english: Due to the outbreak, many people are afraid to go to the market believing that they will be infected with the virus.

text: Naghingabot file sang certificate of candidacy (COC) para sa pagka-presidente si Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa, Oktubre 8 — isa ka surprise move halin sa ruling party nga PDP-Laban.
english: Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa filed his certificate of candidacy (COC) for the presidency on October 8 — a surprise move from the ruling party PDP-Laban.

text: Mangin runningmate ni dela Rosa si Senator Bong Go.
english: Senator Bong Go will be dela Rosa's running mate.

text: Sunod nga ginpahayag sang PDP-Laban Faction nga matabo ang “Ba-Go 2022″… apang indi tanan ang nagapati sini.
english: The PDP-Laban Faction next claimed that “Ba-Go 2022″ will happen… but not everyone believes it.

text: May iban nga nagasiling nga taktika lang ini sang PDP-Laban bangud ang matuod gid nga standard bearer amo ang presidential daughter nga si Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio.
english: Some say it is just a tactic of the PDP-Laban because the real standard bearer is the presidential daughter, Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio.

text: Ang amo nga presidential daughter ang una na nga naka-file sang COC agud magpa-eleher liwat bilang alkalde sa Davao City.
english: The presidential daughter has already filed her COC to run for re-election as mayor of Davao City.

text: Apang sang nag-file sang COC si Bato, talalupangdon nga suksok sini ang Hugpong ng Pagbabago party shirt, ang regional party ni Sara Duterte.
english: But when Bato filed his COC, he was wearing the Hugpong ng Pagbabago party shirt, the regional party of Sara Duterte.

text: Sunod nga nagtunog ang espekulasyon nga may substitution nga matabo.
english: Next speculation rang out that a substitution would take place.

text: SUBSTITUTION: SIN-O ANG PWEDE?
english: SUBSTITUTION: WHO CAN?

text: Ginpaathag ni Atty. Wilfred Jay Balisado, regional director sang Commission on Elections (Comelec), ang ginatawag nga substitution sang mga kandidato.Una, ang substitution ang indi applicable para sa mga independent candidate.
english: Atty. explained. Wilfred Jay Balisado, regional director of the Commission on Elections (Comelec), the so-called substitution of candidates. First, the substitution is not applicable for independent candidates.

text: Kun i-iwithdraw sang political aspirant ang iya gin-file nga COC, “that’s the end of it” suno kay Balisado.
english: If a political aspirant withdraws his filed COC, “that’s the end of it,” Balisado said.

text: Ikaduha, kun ang aspirant nga maga-withdraw sang COC ang nagapadalagan sa idalom sang isa ka political party, mahimo maka-nominate ang partido sang isa ka kandidato nga magabulos sa kun sin-o man ang nag-withdraw.
english: Second, if the aspirant who withdraws the COC is running under a political party, the party can nominate a candidate to replace whoever withdrew.

text:
Tubtub sa Nobyembre 15 mahimo ini nga tikang apang dapat nga may yara sang “valid withdrawal kag valid substitution.”

Kinahanglan nga ang maga-substitute nga kandidato ang may yara sang Certificate of Nomination and Acceptance (CONA).
english:
Until November 15 this measure can be taken but there must be a “valid withdrawal and valid substitution.”

The substitute candidate must have a Certificate of Nomination and Acceptance (CONA).

text: Dapat man nga miyembro sang isa ka political party ang maga-substitute nga kandidato.
english: The substitute candidate must also be a member of a political party.

text: Suno kay Balisado, pwede na nga maka-withdraw kag ma-file ang substitution umpisa subong tubtub sa Nobyembre 15.##
english: According to Balisado, the substitution can be withdrawn and filed from now until November 15.##

text: Magabalik na ang face-to-face classes sa syudad sang Iloilo subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 26.
english: Face-to-face classes will resume in Iloilo City today, November 26.

text: Base sa nangin rekomendasyon sang City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) kay Mayor Raisa Treñas, wala na sang suspension sang klase sa pribado kag pampubliko nga eskwelahan sa syudad matapos nga ginbawi na ang wind signal sa bug-os nga rehiyon.
english: Based on the recommendation of the City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) to Mayor Raisa Treñas, there will be no suspension of classes in private and public schools in the city after the wind signal was withdrawn throughout the region.

text: Kun basehan ang Iloilo City Emergency Operations Center, 34 ka nga mga barangay ang nalubog sa baha kahapon kadungan ang mamunog nga pag-ulan dala ni Bagyo Verbena.
english: According to the Iloilo City Emergency Operations Center, 34 barangays were flooded yesterday during heavy rains caused by Typhoon Verbena.

text: Walo diri ang ginbaha sa Mandurriao; walo sa Molo; lima sa La Paz; apat sa City Proper, tatlo sa Lapuz; duha sa Jaro; kag duha sa Arevalo.
english: Eight of them were flooded in Mandurriao; eight in Molo; five in La Paz; four in City Proper, three in Lapuz; two in Jaro; and two in Arevalo.

text: 117 naman ka mga indibidwal nagikan sa 32 ka mga pamilya ang gin-evacuate.
english: 117 individuals from 32 families were evacuated.

text: Sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin sang PAGASA, ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 130 km nakatundan sang Coron, Palawan.
english: In the 5:00 am weather bulletin of PAGASA, the center of the typhoon was finally located at a distance of 130 km west of Coron, Palawan.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 85 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 105 km/h.

Magaguwa ini sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) buwas sa aga.
english:
It brought winds of 85 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 105 km/h.

It will leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) tomorrow morning.

text: Nagtaas ang output sang paghimo sang salakyan sang pungsod sang nagligad nga Hulyo, sa diin, ang Pilipinas mas mataas kon ipaanggid sa kaingod sini nga mga pungsod sa Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean).
english: The country's automobile manufacturing output increased last July, where, the Philippines was higher compared to its neighboring countries in the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean).

text: Santo sa Asean Automotive Federation, isa ka umbrella nga grupo sang mga asosasyon sang industriya gikan sa mga katapo nga ekonomiya sang regional bloc, nagapakita nga ang kadamuon sang paghimo sang pungsod nagsaka sang 26.7 percent sa 11,311 ka mga yunit gikan sa 8,925 ka mga yunit sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the Asean Automotive Federation, an umbrella group of industry associations from the regional bloc’s member economies, shows that the country’s manufacturing volume rose 26.7 percent to 11,311 units from 8,925 units last year.

text: Ang posting sang Hulyo nagsobra man sa 14.6-porsyento nga pagtaas sang nagligad nga bulan kag output nga 10,288 ka mga yunit.
english: July posting also exceeded last month’s 14.6-percent increase and output of 10,288 units.

text: Nagdala man sang iya year-to-date output ang performance sang Pilipinas sa 75,644 ka mga yunit, nga nagamarka sang 15.2-porsyento nga pagsaka kon ipaanggid sa 65,644 ka mga yunit nga ginhimo sa seven-month period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The Philippines' performance also brought its year-to-date output to 75,644 units, marking a 15.2-percent jump compared to the 65,644 units produced in the seven-month period last year.

text: CEBU CITY – Ginpasigurado sang pamunuan sang Palarong Pambansa nga ginatutukan nila ang medical condition sang kada atleta.
english: CEBU CITY – The management of the Palarong Pambansa assured that they are focusing on the medical condition of each athlete.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Rhoel Dejaño, pinuno sang Medical Team sang Palarong Pambansa 2024, iya ginpahayag nga humalin sang nag-umpisa ang mga hinampang kahapon partikular sa athletics, wala sila sang narekord nga dalagko nga mga insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Rhoel Dejaño, head of the Medical Team of the Palarong Pambansa 2024, said that since the start of the games yesterday particularly in athletics, they have not recorded any major incidents.

text: Suno kay Dejaño, kalabanan sa mga ginabatyag sang mga players amo ang pagbiring, paghapo, kag muscle cramps.
english: According to Dejaño, most of the players' symptoms are dizziness, fatigue, and muscle cramps.

text: Kun indi na masarangan sang isa ka players ang iya ginabatyag, may yara man suno sa natungdan sang infirmary agud mahatagan ang mga ini sang medical attention.
english: If a player can no longer cope with his illness, he said there is also an infirmary to give them medical attention.

text: Sa umpisa tubtob sa katapusan sang hinampang, may yara suno sa natungdan sang mga doctor kag physical therapist nga naka-stand by agud maghatag sang bulig sa mga atleta.
english: From the beginning to the end of the game, there are doctors and physical therapists on stand by to provide assistance to the athletes.

text: Matapos ang pila ka tuig nga wala nabatian sa pulitika, nagbalik na kag magapadalagan liwat sa pagka-alkalde sa Sara, Iloilo si anay Mayor Neptali “Tali” Salcedo.
english: After several years of absence from politics, former Mayor Neptali “Tali” Salcedo has returned and will run again for the mayoralty of Sara, Iloilo.

text: Atubangon ni Salcedo si Retired General kag incumbent Sara Mayor Jon Onick Aying, amo man si incumbent Vice Mayor Jess Salcedo.
english: Salcedo will face Retired General and incumbent Sara Mayor Jon Onick Aying, as well as incumbent Vice Mayor Jess Salcedo.

text: Madumduman nga nangin mainit ang pangalan ni Salcedo sang 2018 kun sa diin ginpasakaan siya sang kaso may kaangtanan sa One Time Big Time operation sang kapulisan sa ila nga balay sang Oktubre 17.
english: It can be recalled that Salcedo's name became hot in 2018 when he was charged in connection with the One Time Big Time operation of the police at his house on October 17.

text: Kaso nga illegal possession of firearms and ammunition kag illegal possession of explosives ang ginpasaka batok kay Salcedo.
english: Cases of illegal possession of firearms and ammunition and illegal possession of explosives were filed against Salcedo.

text: Kun matandaan, duha ang patay gikan sa pamilya ni Salcedo sang gin-raid sang pulis ang ila nga balay bangud sang ginapahayag kaangtanan sang pamilya sa illegal drug trade, gun-for-hire activities, gunrunning, kag pag-hire sang private armed groups nga naga-operate sa northern Iloilo province
english: It can be recalled that two members of Salcedo's family were killed when police raided their house due to the family's alleged links to illegal drug trade, gun-for-hire activities, gunrunning, and hiring of private armed groups operating in northern Iloilo province.

text: Madamo na nga sahi ukon nagkalain-lain nga disenyo sang face mask ang ginabaligya bangud yara kita sa tunga sang pandemya.
english: Many types or different designs of face masks are being sold because we are in the middle of a pandemic.

text: Apang isa ka kompaniya didto sa Estados Unidos ang nagatanyag sang face mask nga magluwas nga protektado ka sa virus, mabusog kapa bangud masimhutan mo man lang ang pinakapaborito nga breakfast… ini amo ang bacon.
english: But a company in the United States is offering a face mask that besides protecting you from the virus, you will be satisfied because you can smell your favorite breakfast... bacon.

text: Ang bacon-scented face mask ang ginatawag nga ‘Black Label Breathable Bacon’ nga may katuyuan nga makahatag sang eksperyensya sa mga tawo sa pagsimhot sang bacon sa bisan ano nga oras sa bisan diin nga lugar.
english: The bacon-scented face mask is called ‘Black Label Breathable Bacon’ with the aim of giving people the experience of smelling bacon at any time in any place.

text: Apang basi bala nga malipatan mo nga face mask lang ang imo ginasimhutan kag indi matuod nga bacon.
english: But maybe you forget that you're just smelling a face mask and not real bacon.

text: Indi mo gid pagtilawan ini ukon kaunon bangud indi ini ang masami mo nga ginapamahaw.
english: You would never taste it or eat it because it’s not what you usually have for breakfast.

text: Naghingyo ang fishers’ groups sa Department of Agriculture (DA) nga magpatunga kag sabton ang isyu kaangot sa ginapahayag pagsaka sang retail price sang isda sang tubtub sa P40 kada kilo.
english: The fishermen' groups have asked the Department of Agriculture (DA) to intervene and address the issue regarding the alleged increase in the retail price of fish to P40 per kilo.

text: Suno sa Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas, base sa ila monitoring, ang retail price sang tamudyos ang nagdangat na sa P260 per kilo ipaanggid sa presyo sini anay nga P180 tubtub sa P220.
english: According to the National Force of the Philippine Consumer Movement, based on their monitoring, the retail price of tamudyos has reached P260 per kilo compared to its previous price of P180 to P220.

text: Nakalab-ot naman ang tilapia sa P150 per kilo nga mataas man ipaanggid sa P100 to P120; samtang ang bangrus ang yara sa P240 per kilo halin sa P200.
english: Tilapia reached P150 per kilo which is also high compared to P100 to P120; while bangrus is at P240 per kilo from P200.

text: Indi rasonable suno sa grupo ang pagsaka sa presyo sa sini nga mga isda.
english: The group said the price increase for these fish is unreasonable.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga gina-control sang traders kag middlemen ang pag-presyo halin sa farmgate pakadto sa retail price.
english: He said traders and middlemen control pricing from farmgate to retail price.

text: Ginpanugyan man nga dapat direkta na nga magbakal ang gobyerno halin sa manugpangisda para masiguro nga ang isda ang mabaligya sa kasarangan nga presyo.
english: It was also suggested that the government should buy directly from the fishermen to ensure that the fish is sold at a reasonable price.

text: Dapat man suno sa grupo nga iduso gid ang pagpatuman sang price control sa idalom sang Republic Act 7581 ukon Automatic Price Control para ma-address ang manipulation kag profiteering.
english: The group also said that the implementation of price control under Republic Act 7581 or Automatic Price Control should be pushed to address manipulation and profiteering.

text:
View Post

Pilason ang duha ka sakay sang isa ka SUV matapos nga nahulog ini sa flyover sa Noveleta, Cavite.
english:
View Post

Two occupants of an SUV were injured after it fell off a flyover in Noveleta, Cavite.

text: Suno sa imbestigasyon, nadulaan sang kontrol ang driver sang salakyan kag nagbunggo anay sa isa ka poste bag-o nahulog sa taytay.
english: According to the investigation, the driver of the vehicle lost control and hit a pole before falling off the bridge.

text: Pareho nga nag-angkon sang malala nga pilas ang mga biktima kag ginabulong pa sa ospital.
english: Both victims sustained serious injuries and are still being treated at the hospital.

text: CEBU CITY – Na-break sang tumandok sang San Enrique, Iloilo ang record sa Javelin throw sa Palarong Pambansa 2024.
english: CEBU CITY – A native of San Enrique, Iloilo broke the record in the Javelin throw at the Palarong Pambansa 2024.

text: Ini amo si Charles Daniel Turla nga nakakuha sang gold medal sa Javelin throw.
english: This is Charles Daniel Turla who won a gold medal in the Javelin throw.

text: Si Turla ang pupil sa Gines-Quinolpan Elementary School sa San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: Turla is a student at Gines-Quinolpan Elementary School in San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Naghimo ini sang maragtas matapos nakarekord sang 60.26 meters.
english: She created history after recording 60.26 meters.

text: Nalapawan sini ang rekord nga 57.50 meters sang Palarong Pambansa 2016.
english: It broke the record of 57.50 meters of the Palarong Pambansa 2016.

text: Nagaserbe naman nga coach ni Turla sanday John Aghon kag Rommel Gardose.
english: Turla's coaches are John Aghon and Rommel Gardose.

text: Ginbawi na ang wind signal sa tanan nga lugar sa Western Visayas samtang nga nagahulag si Bagyo Verbena padulong sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Wind signals have been restored in all areas of Western Visayas as Typhoon Verbena moves towards the West Philippine Sea.

text: Base sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin sang PAGASA, ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 130 km nakatundan sang Coron, Palawan.
english: Based on the 5:00 am weather bulletin of PAGASA, the center of the typhoon was later located at a distance of 130 km west of Coron, Palawan.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 85 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 105 km/h.

Ang Calamian Islands kag extreme northern portion sang mainland Palawan ang nabatak sa signal number 2.
english:
It brought winds of 85 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 105 km/h.

The Calamian Islands and extreme northern portion of mainland Palawan are under signal number 2.

text: Signal No.
english: Signal No.

text: 1 naman sa Occidental Mindoro kag sa northern kag sa central portions of Palawan.
english: 1 in Occidental Mindoro and in the northern and central portions of Palawan.

text:
Padayon nga magahulag pa-West Philippine Sea ang Bagyo Verbena kag magaagi man sa Kalayaan Islands karon sa hapon ukon sa gab-i.

Antes ini nga mga development, pito ka beses nga nag-landfall ang bagyo lakip na sa Linapacan, Palawan; Bayabas, Surigao del Sur; Jagna, Bohol; Talisay City, Cebu; Vallehermoso, Negros Oriental; San Lorenzo, Guimaras; kag Miagao, Iloilo.
english:
Typhoon Verbena will continue to move towards the West Philippine Sea and will also pass through the Kalayaan Islands this afternoon or evening.

Before these developments, the typhoon made landfall seven times including in Linapacan, Palawan; Bayabas, Surigao del Sur; Jagna, Bohol; Talisay City, Cebu; Vallehermoso, Negros Oriental; San Lorenzo, Guimaras; and Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Magaguwa ini sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) buwas sa aga.
english: It will leave the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR) tomorrow morning.

text: Napilitan ang P-pop girl group nga BINI nga utdon kag indi pagpalawigon ang ila nga performance sa Bangus Festival sa Dagupan City bangud sa pila ka fans nga nalipong kag naglain ang pamatyag bangud sa tuman nga init.
english: P-pop girl group BINI was forced to cut short and not extend their performance at the Bangus Festival in Dagupan City due to some fans who fainted and felt unwell due to the extreme heat.

text: Isa ang BINI sa performers sa brand concert sa amo nga selebrasyon apang natabuan man nga ang Dagupan amo ang isa sa pinakamainit nga lugar sa pungsod kun sa diin nagatupa masami sa “danger level” ang heat index.
english: BINI was one of the performers at the brand concert during the celebration but it also happened that Dagupan is one of the hottest places in the country where the heat index often falls to the “danger level”.

text: Pila ka beses ginhingyo sa fans nga mag-isol kag indi na magsaka sa elevated spots kag indi magtikludanay.
english: Fans were repeatedly asked to stay away from elevated spots and not to kneel.

text:
Tato ka kanta lamang ang natapos sang BINI nga amo ang “Lagi,” “Huwag Muna Tayong Umuwi,” kag ang “Pantropiko.”

Ginkumpirma man sang Dagupan City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management nga may attendees matuod nga nalipong apang wala man sang seryoso nga halit.
english:
BINI finished only three songs, namely “Lagi,” “Let's Go First,” and “Pantropiko.”

The Dagupan City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management also confirmed that some attendees did faint but were not seriously injured.

text: Nagpangayo naman ang pasaylo ang girl group nga wala naglawig nga ila performance bangud nga indi na nila gusto nga makatuga pa sang halit.
english: The girl group apologized that their performance did not last long because they did not want to cause any more harm.

text: Nagpasalig man ang BINI nga magabalik sila sa Dagupan kag ginhingyo sa fans nga iprayoridad gid anay ang safety sa tanan nga tion.
english: BINI also assured that they will return to Dagupan and urged fans to prioritize safety at all times.

text: “Not everything will always be perfect and smooth sailing… I pray for your recovery and the wellness of everybody,” kabahin sang post ni Aiah.
english: “Not everything will always be perfect and smooth sailing… I pray for your recovery and the wellness of everybody,” Aiah’s post read.

text: “I hope for the upcoming shows and events, we all prioritize safety, wag mag tulakan, and since painit ng painit din ngayon dito sa Pinas, always bring water and stay hydrated!”
english: “I hope for the upcoming shows and events, we all prioritize safety, don't push, and since it's hot here in the Philippines, always bring water and stay hydrated!”

text: Pilason ang kapin 15 ka mga pasahero matapos natumba ang isa ka de-pampasahero nga bus sa national highway sa Bilar, Bohol.
english: More than 15 passengers were injured after a passenger bus overturned on the national highway in Bilar, Bohol.

text: Ang naaksidente amo ang Southern Star bus nga padulong kuntani sa Tagbilaran City halin sa Carmen.
english: The accident occurred when the Southern Star bus was heading to Tagbilaran City from Carmen.

text: Ginpahayag nga nadulaan sang kontrol sa manibela ang driver samtang yara sa kurbadahon nga porsyon sang dalan.
english: The driver reportedly lost control of the steering wheel while on the curved portion of the road.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagresponde ang Bilar Rescue Unit kag gindala ang mga pilason sa mga ospital sa Tagbilaran City.
english: The Bilar Rescue Unit immediately responded and took the injured to hospitals in Tagbilaran City.

text: Boluntaryo naman nga nagsungka sa Loboc Police Station ang bus driver nga si Jernel Alcantara.
english: The bus driver, Jernel Alcantara, voluntarily surrendered to the Loboc Police Station.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad.
english: Authorities are still investigating.

text: Tubtub sa Martes, Oktubre 12, gid lamang ang tyansa sang mga political aspirants nga maka-file sang petisyon kun makit-an nga nagapasabad-sabad lang ukon makabig nga nuisance candidate ang isa ka indibidwal nga magapadalagan man sa eleksyon.
english: Until Tuesday, October 12, political aspirants will only have the chance to file a petition if they find that an individual who is also running in the election is a nuisance candidate.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jonathan Sayno, election assistant sa Iloilo City – Comelec, iya ginpahayag nga ang pag-file sang petition batok sa isa ka political aspirant ang mahimo lamang sang isa man ka political aspirant nga nagapadalagan sa kaangay nga posisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jonathan Sayno, election assistant in Iloilo City – Comelec, he said that the filing of a petition against a political aspirant can only be done by another political aspirant running for the same position.

text: Posible mag-qualify bilang nuisance candidate ang isa kun nag-file ini sang certificate of candidacy agud himuon lamang nga kaladlawan ang election system ukon kun ginapatalang sini ang publiko.
english: A person may qualify as a nuisance candidate if he or she filed a certificate of candidacy to make fun of the election system or if he or she misleads the public.

text: Kun ma-identify ang isa bilang potential nuisance candidate, may oportunidad man ini nga depensahan ang iya nga kandidatura paagi sa isa ka hearing.
english: If one is identified as a potential nuisance candidate, he or she also has the opportunity to defend his or her candidacy through a hearing.

text: Sa idalom sang Comelec rules, ang commission ang pwede nga maka-file sang motu proprio cases agud madeklarar ang kandidato bilang nuisance candidate.
english: Under Comelec rules, the commission can file motu proprio cases to declare a candidate as a nuisance candidate.

text: Ang pag-file sang petition ang pwede nga mahimo sang personal ukon pwede man nga ipadala sa authorized representative, within five days halin sa katapusan nga adlaw sang filing sang COC.
english: The filing of the petition can be done in person or can be sent to the authorized representative, within five days from the last day of filing the COC.

text: Makaguluginhawa sang gamay ang mga motorista bangud sa isa pa gid ka hugnat sang oil price rollback nga ipatuman subong nga Septyembre.
english: Motorists can breathe a little easier with another phase of oil price rollback to be implemented this September.

text:
Base sa three-day outcome sang trading sa regional market, ginabanta nga may buhin sa presyo sa produktong-petrolyo nga amo ang masunod:

Gasolina – P0.85 to P1.25 per liter

Diesel – P1.10 to P1.50 per liter

Kerosene – P1.15 to P1.55 per liter

Kun basehan lamang ang Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) index, magatupa ang rollback sa P1.261 per liter sa gasolina, P1.544 per liter sa diesel kag P1.538 per liter sa kerosene products.
english:
Based on the three-day outcome of trading in the regional market, it is estimated that there will be a decrease in the price of petroleum products as follows:

Gasoline – P0.85 to P1.25 per liter

Diesel – P1.10 to P1.50 per liter

Kerosene – P1.15 to P1.55 per liter

Based on the Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) index alone, the rollback will fall to P1.261 per liter for gasoline, P1.544 per liter for diesel and P1.538 per liter for kerosene products.

text: Sa Lunes regular nga gina-anunsyo sang oil companies ang pinal nga price adjustment kag ginapatuman naman epektibo sa Martes sang aga.
english: Oil companies regularly announce the final price adjustment on Monday and implement it effective Tuesday morning.

text: Matandaan nga sini lang nga semana, may rollback man nga ginpatuman: P1.55 per liter sa gasolina, P1.30 per liter sa diesel, kag P1.40 per liter sa kerosene.
english: It can be recalled that this week, a rollback was also implemented: P1.55 per liter for gasoline, P1.30 per liter for diesel, and P1.40 per liter for kerosene.

text: Nagapanawagan subong sang bulig ang pamilya sang anay komedyante nga si Allan Padua ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga ”Mura” matapos nga masunog ang balay sini sa Brgy.
english: The family of former comedian Allan Padua or better known as ”Mura” is calling for help after his house burned down in Brgy.

text: Tupas, Ligao City sa Albay.
english: Tupas, Ligao City in Albay.

text: Base imbestigasyon sang Ligao Fire Station, ginlamon gid sang kalayo ang bilog nga balay sang komedyante kag wala sang bisan isa ka gamit ng nasalbar.
english: According to the investigation of the Ligao Fire Station, the fire engulfed the entire house of the comedian and not a single belonging was saved.

text: Nabilin na gid lang ang mga konkreto nga dingding sang duha ka panalgan nga puluy-an sang komedyante.
english: All that remains are the concrete walls of the comedian’s two-story home.

text: Nahibaluan nga nabudlayan man sa paglakat si Mura bangud sa ginasuprir nga kondisyon sa lawas.
english: It was learned that Mura also had difficulty walking due to his suffering from physical condition.

text: Ginapahayag nga temporaryo nga nagapasilong sa waiting shed ang pamilya ni Mura.
english: Mura's family is reportedly temporarily sheltering in a waiting shed.

text: Magapadalagan sa pagka-kongresista sa syudad sang Iloilo ang 80 anyos nga si Atty. Pascual ‘Junnie’ Espinosa Jr.
english: 80-year-old Atty. Pascual 'Junnie' Espinosa Jr.

text: bangud luyag niya ang maayo nga representasyon sa Kongreso.
english: because he wanted good representation in Congress.

text: Si Atty. Espinosa ang anak ni anay Congressman Pascual Espinosa, Sr.
english: Atty. Espinosa is the son of former Congressman Pascual Espinosa, Sr.

text:
Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Espinosa, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa iya legislative agenda amo ang mga masunod:

* Pagdala sang binilyon nga pondo sa syudad sang Iloilo paagi sa active participation sa budget deliberation sa Kongreso

* Pag-amyendar sa 1986 Constitution bangud nagapati siya nga indi ini makabig nga people’s constitution

* kag pagduso nga himuon nga federal form of government ang subong centralized form of government

Ginpabutyag ni Espinosa nga bilang abogado, apisar 80 anyos na ang iya nga edad, may ikasarang siya gihapon, may logic, makahangop sa international law — kag makasarang sa pag-debate sa Kamara.
english:
In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Espinosa said his legislative agenda includes the following:

* Bringing billions of funds to Iloilo City through active participation in budget deliberation in Congress

* Amending the 1986 Constitution because he believed it could not be considered a people’s constitution

* and proposing to make the current centralized form of government a federal form of government

Espinosa said that as a lawyer, despite being 80 years old, he is still capable, has logic, understands international law — and is able to debate in the House.

text: Gin-dismiss man sini ang notion nga nag-file lang siya sang iya nga Certificate of Candidacy (COC) agud nga magtuga sang confusion ukon pagpang-duha-duha sa mga botante.Ini bangud ang pangalan ni Espinosa ang malapit man sa pangalan ni Atty. Jose “Joe” Espinosa III, iya pakaisa, nga magapadalagan man sa pagka-Congressman sa syudad.
english: He also dismissed the notion that he only filed his Certificate of Candidacy (COC) to create confusion or doubt among voters. Jose “Joe” Espinosa III, his cousin, who will also run for Congressman in the city.

text: Suno kay Atty. Espinosa, mas nauna siya nga mag-file sang COC kag nakabati siya sang una nga indi magpadalagan sa kongreso si Joe III.
english: According to Atty. Espinosa said he filed his COC earlier and he heard earlier that Joe III would not run for congress.

text: “May the best man win!,” mensahe sini sa iya nga pakaisa nga isa man ka abogado.
english: “May the best man win!,” he messaged his cousin who is also a lawyer.

text: Magluwas sa iya pakaisa, makasumpong man ni Atty. Espinosa si incumbent Iloilo Lone District Rep.
english: Besides his cousin, Atty. Espinosa is incumbent Iloilo Lone District Rep.

text: Julienne ‘Jamjam’ Baronda.
english: Julienne ‘Jamjam’ Baronda.

text: Temporaryo nga dumilian ang pagpangisda sa pila ka parte sang Iloilo River halin Disyembre 1, 2025 tubtob Marso 31, 2026.
english: Fishing will be temporarily banned in some parts of the Iloilo River from December 1, 2025 to March 31, 2026.

text: Ini matapos napasar ang regulation ordinance no.
english: This is after the passage of regulation ordinance no.

text: 2025-027 ukon ang ordinansa nga naga-establisar sang closed fishing season sa Iloilo river halin sa Drilon Bridge tubtob Diversion bridge para sa fish stock restoration, livelihood improvement kag river biodiversity conservation.
english: 2025-027 or the ordinance establishing a closed fishing season in the Iloilo river from the Drilon Bridge to the Diversion bridge for fish stock restoration, livelihood improvement and river biodiversity conservation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ely Estante, executive assistant for agriculture, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang na-base sa study sang Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) nga sa amo nga mga bulan ang spawning ukon pagpamuto sang mga isda kaangay sang bulgan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ely Estante, executive assistant for agriculture, said this is based on a study by the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) that in those months the spawning of fish is like a bulgan.

text: Suno kay Estante, dako ini nga bulig para sa pagpadamo sang isda agud nga pagkatapos sang 4 ka bulan may ara naman sang pamuniton ang mga pumuluyo.
english: According to Estante, this is a big help for the breeding of fish so that after 4 months, the residents will have something to eat.

text: Sa idalom sang ordinansa, ang sin o man nga magbayolar ang may ara sang penalidad:1st offense: multa nga P1,000 ukon community service2nd offense: multa nga P2,000 ukon community service3rd offense: multa nga P5,000 kag confiscation sang catch and fishing gears kag pag-impound sang fishing boat.
english: Under the ordinance, anyone who violates the penalty: 1st offense: fine of P1,000 or community service2nd offense: fine of P2,000 or community service3rd offense: fine of P5,000 and confiscation of catch and fishing gears and impoundment of fishing boat.

text: Ang Office of the City Agriculturist ang nagakoordinar sa Bantay Dagat, Philippine National Police kag Barangay Officials para sa enforcement sang amo nga ordinansa.
english: The Office of the City Agriculturist is coordinating with Bantay Dagat, Philippine National Police and Barangay Officials for the enforcement of the ordinance.

text: CEBU CITY – Nakakuha na ang Western Visayas sang pinakauna nga gold medal sa Palarong Pambansa 2024 sa Cebu City.
english: CEBU CITY – Western Visayas has won its first gold medal at the Palarong Pambansa 2024 in Cebu City.

text: Ini amo si Sam Kenjie Bantillo kag naga-eskwela sa Don Casimero Andrada National High School sa Punta, Carles, Iloilo.
english: This is Sam Kenjie Bantillo and is studying at Don Casimero Andrada National High School in Punta, Carles, Iloilo.

text: Nagpangibabaw si Bantillo sa Secondary Level- Boys category sa Long Jump.
english: Bantillo dominated the Secondary Level- Boys category in the Long Jump.

text: Naka-record ini sang 7.07 meters sa Long Jump.
english: She recorded 7.07 meters in the Long Jump.

text: Suno kay Bantillo, tuman ang iya kalipay nga nakakuha sang bulawan nga medalya.
english: Bantillo said he was very happy to win the gold medal.

text: Ginahalad naman sini sa iya pamilya ang iya kadalag-an.
english: He dedicates his victory to his family.

text: CEBU CITY- Nakuha sang Region VII (Central Visayas) ang pinakauna nga gold medal sa Palarong Pambansa 2024 sa Cebu City.
english: CEBU CITY- Region VII (Central Visayas) won its first gold medal at the Palarong Pambansa 2024 in Cebu City.

text: Ini amo si Asia Paraase, 17, nga nagdaog sa 3,000-meter run sa secondary girls sa hampang ng ginpatigayon sa Cebu City Sports Complex subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 11.
english: This is Asia Paraase, 17, who won the 3,000-meter run in the secondary girls in the games held at the Cebu City Sports Complex today, July 11.

text: Nakuha naman sang Region VIII (Eastern Visayas) ang silver medal kag Region XI (Davao Region) naman ang nakakuha sang bronze medal.
english: Region VIII (Eastern Visayas) won the silver medal and Region XI (Davao Region) won the bronze medal.

text: “Masaya po ako kasi pride na rin po ito ng Central Visayas.
english: “I am happy because it is also the pride of Central Visayas.

text: Payback na rin po para sa preparation nila.
english: It's also payback for their preparation.

text: Masaya rin po kasi hindi lang din po kasi ito para sa akin kundi pati na rin po sa teammates ko,” pahayag ni Paraase.
english: It's fun because it's not only for me but also for my teammates,” Paraase said.

text: Si Paraase ang naga-eskwela sa Pajo National High School sang Lapu-Lapu City.
english: Paraase is studying at Pajo National High School in Lapu-Lapu City.

text: Nag-umpisa si Paraase sa paghampang sang athletics sang Grade 6 pa lang ini.
english: Paraase started playing athletics when he was in Grade 6.

text: Ikaduha ka beses na niya ini nga pagpasakop sa Palarong Pambansa, apang ini ang una nga kahigayunan nga nakakuha ini sang bulawan nga medalya.
english: This is his second time participating in the Palarong Pambansa, but this is the first time he has won a gold medal.

text: “Dine-dedicate ko po ito sa sarili ko.
english: “I dedicate this to myself.

text: Ang dami pong challenges na hinarap, nawawalan na rin po ako ng hope sa sarili ko.
english: The many challenges ahead, I'm losing hope in myself.

text: Ang saya ko po dahil nagawan ko ng paraan para hindi ako kainin ng kaba at takot,” dugang pa ni Paraase.
english: I am happy because I found a way not to be overwhelmed by fear and anxiety,” Paraase added.

text: Matapos makuha ang bulawan nga medalya sa Palarong Pambansa 2024, target naman ni Paraase nga padayunon ang handom sini nga matiglawas ang Pilipinas sa Asian Games kag Youth Games.
english: After winning the gold medal at the Palarong Pambansa 2024, Paraase targets to continue his dream of representing the Philippines in the Asian Games and Youth Games.

text: Ginkumparar ni Kamanggagawa Rep.
english: Kamanggagawa Rep.

text: Eli San Fernando ang suno sa iya kinalain sang “no work, no pay” policy sa tunga sang mga ordinary nga workers kag pila ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: Eli San Fernando explained the difference between the “no work, no pay” policy between ordinary workers and some government officials.

text: Pahayag pa ni San Fernando, “no work, no pay” ang polisa pag-abot sa mga ordinary nga workers apang may yara sang sweldo si Sen.
english: San Fernando said the policy is “no work, no pay” when it comes to ordinary workers but Sen.

text: Bato dela Rosa nga wala nagasulod.
english: Bato dela Rosa that does not enter.

text: “Totoo naman kasi, kahit saan mo hanapin walang nakasulat tungkol sa ‘no work, no pay policy’ sa rules.
english: “It's true, no matter where you look, there's nothing written about 'no work, no pay policy' in the rules.

text: Pero ‘di ba dapat ‘di na issue yan?
english: But shouldn't that be a non-issue?

text: Bilang mga halal na opisyal… dapat automatic na pumapasok ka,” pahayag niya.
english: As elected officials… you should automatically join,” he said.

text: “Ang ordinaryong manggagawa, kahit may problema ‘yan o wala, may sakit ‘yan o wala, may humahabol, may huma-hunting diyan o wala, papasok at papasok ‘yan para makuha niya nang buo ‘yung sahod niya,” dugang pa.
english: “The ordinary worker, whether he has a problem or not, whether he is sick or not, whether he is chasing, whether he is hunting or not, will come in and come in so that he can get his full salary,” he added.

text: Ginapanan-aw ang pagluntad sang fluvial flooding kun padayon ang pagbubo sang mamunog nga ulan sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Fluvial flooding is expected if heavy rains continue to fall in Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Cornelio Salinas, iya ginpahayag nga dako ang posibilidad sang riverine flooding sa probinsya kaangay sa Jalaur river sa Calinog kag Aganan River sa Pavia.
english: Cornelio Salinas, he said there is a high possibility of riverine flooding in the province such as the Jalaur river in Calinog and the Aganan River in Pavia.

text: Sa ginpatigayon nga Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction Council Meeting nga ginpangunahgan ni Gov.
english: In the Iloilo Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction Council Meeting chaired by Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr., hugot man ang pahanumdon nga tan-awon ang history sang landslide kag pagbaha sa  mga lugar agud mapreparahan kun kinahanglan mag-evacuate.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr., also strongly reminded to check the history of landslides and flooding in the areas to prepare if necessary to evacuate.

text: Ginhiwat ang pagsinapol kaupod ang 43 ka mga Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices kun sa diin nalakip man ang response clusters sang PDRRMO agud mapreparahan ang supply nga kinahanglanun sang publiko.
english: The meeting was held with the 43 Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices including the response clusters of the PDRRMO to prepare the supply needs of the public.

text: Text:Joedel Nollaga
english: Text:Joedel Nollaga

text: Sulod ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Alexie Brooks sa Top 3 Finalists sa Best in National Costume sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024 national costume competition sa Isulan, Sultan Kudarat.
english: Iloilo City representative Alexie Brooks is among the Top 3 Finalists in Best in National Costume at the Miss Universe Philippines 2024 national costume competition in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat.

text: Suksok ni Brooks ang bodysuit nga may detalye nga inspired sa desinyo sang damang nga “ugto-ugto”.
english: Brooks wore a bodysuit with details inspired by the cheetah “ugto-ugto” design.

text: Masterpiece ini sang Ilonggo designer nga si Tata Blas Pinuela nga amo man anay ang designer sang nagdaog ang La Paz Batchoy-inspired national costume sang Iloilo sa Miss World Philippines 2021.
english: It is a masterpiece of Ilonggo designer Tata Blas Pinuela who was also the designer when Iloilo's La Paz Batchoy-inspired national costume won Miss World Philippines 2021.

text: “Our people’s queen sported a bodysuit with sparkling multicolored details arranged in a design that resembles an eight-legged critter called “UGTO-UGTO”, an Ilonggo term for an orb-weaver spider.
english: “Our people’s queen sported a bodysuit with sparkling multicolored details arranged in a design that resembles an eight-legged critter called “UGTO-UGTO”, an Ilonggo term for an orb-weaver spider.

text: The posterior part is simply elegant and highlights the wearer’s voluptuousness.
english: The posterior part is simply elegant and highlights the wearer’s voluptuousness.

text: The bedazzled appendages affixed to the back represent balance and personal growth and a delicate-colored cephalothorax headpiece adorned with voluminous eyes finish the look,” kabahin sang paglaragway sa costume.
english: The bedazzled appendages affixed to the back represent balance and personal growth and a delicate-colored cephalothorax headpiece adorned with voluminous eyes finish the look,” is part of the costume description.

text: Nakabaton man ang Ilongga queen sang pagdayaw halin kay Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas: “With Tata Blas Pinuela’s exceptional talent and Alexie Brooks’ captivating representation, they have showcased the creative brilliance of Iloilo on a national stage.
english: The Ilongga queen also received praise from Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas: “With Tata Blas Pinuela’s exceptional talent and Alexie Brooks’ captivating representation, they have showcased the creative brilliance of Iloilo on a national stage.

text: We applaud their remarkable achievement, and they have made Iloilo City incredibly proud.
english: We applaud their remarkable achievement, and they have made Iloilo City incredibly proud.

text:
Nangibabaw na naman ang Ilonggo!”

Magluwas kay Brooks, napilian man bilang finalists sanday Tamara Ocier sang Tacloban kag Janet Hammond sang Southern California.
english:
Ilonggo has won again!”

Besides Brooks, Tamara Ocier of Tacloban and Janet Hammond of Southern California were also selected as finalists.

text: Patigayunon ang 2024 Miss Universe Philippines pageant sa Mall of Asia Arena sa Pasay City sa Mayo 22.#
english: The 2024 Miss Universe Philippines pageant will be held at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City on May 22.#

text:
[Trigger warning:violence, stabbing]

Patay ang isa ka lalaki matapos ginbuno sang iya amay sa San Emilio, Ilocos Sur.
english:
[Trigger warning:violence, stabbing]

A man was stabbed to death by his father in San Emilio, Ilocos Sur.

text: Santo sa imbestigasyon, nagpauli nga hubog ang biktima nga si Zaldy, 38-anyos kag nagbaisay sila sang amay nga suspek nga si Johnny, 65-anyos.
english: According to the investigation, the victim, Zaldy, 38, returned home drunk and had an argument with his father, Johnny, 65.

text: Suno sa San Emilio Police Station (SEPS), matapos nagbais, ginkuga sang anak ang iya amay.
english: According to the San Emilio Police Station (SEPS), after an argument, the son stabbed his father.

text: Didto na nagkuha sang kutsilyo ang padre de pamilya kag ginbuno sang makapila ka beses sa tiyan ang iya anak.
english: The father of the family took out a knife and stabbed his son several times in the stomach.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital ang biktima apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital but died on the spot.

text: Gilayon naman nga naaresto ang suspek matapos ang insidente kag nagapangatubang sang nagakaigo nga kaso.
english: The suspect was immediately arrested after the incident and is facing appropriate charges.

text: Daw ano ka ka-handa agud pamatud-an sa imo mga boss nga perfect ang tanan nga imo ginahimo sa imo trabaho?
english: How prepared are you to prove to your bosses that everything you do at work is perfect?

text: Didto sa probinsya sang Shandong sa East China, isa ka caretaker sang fertilizer company ang nag-inom sang tubig nga halin sa toilet bowl agud mapamatud-an sa iya mga boss nga malimpyo na ang iya nga gintinluan nga kasilyas.
english: In East China's Shandong province, a caretaker of a fertilizer company drank water from a toilet bowl to prove to his bosses that his cleaned toilet was clean.

text: Ang ginatumod nga Chinese caretaker ang may apelyido nga Luo.
english: The alleged Chinese caretaker has the surname Luo.

text: Kontrobersyal ang ginhimo ni Luo kag ginapiyestahan sa subong sa social media, samtang ang iban naman nga mga netizens ang nagpakamalaot sa mga employer sang caretaker kag nagpahayag nga ginapakahuy-an nila ang ila nga trabahador.
english: Luo's actions are controversial and are now being celebrated on social media, while other netizens have condemned the caretaker's employers and said they are humiliating their workers.

text: Depensa naman sang mga employer, voluntary ang ginhimo ni Luo kag sa pagkamatuod, pila ka tuig na niya ini nga ginahimo sa ila nga kompaniya.
english: The employers defended that Luo's actions were voluntary and in fact, he has been doing this for several years in their company.

text: Pamatuod lang ini suno sa ila sang perfection ni Luo kag tuman ini ka dedikado sa iya nga trabaho.
english: They say this is proof of Luo's perfection and dedication to his work.

text: Suno pa sa tagpamaba sang Xhongcheng Fertiliser Technology Company, confident gid si Luo sa iya pagpaninlo rason nga masarangan sini inumon ang tubig halin sa toilet bowl.
english: According to a spokesperson for Xhongcheng Fertilizer Technology Company, Luo is so confident in his cleanliness that he can drink water from the toilet bowl.

text:
Pahayag naman ni Luo pagkatapos sang iya nga ginhimo: “I hope that all positions in the company can do their work to the extreme.”

Ginkumpirma man sang mga ka-trabaho ni Luo nga ‘very committed’ siya sa iya trabaho umpisa sang ginhire siya sang 2014 kag ginapahayag pa nga isa ka “benchmark employee” sang kompaniya.
english:
Luo said after his actions: “I hope that all positions in the company can do their work to the extreme.”

Luo's colleagues also confirmed that he has been very committed to his job since he was hired in 2014 and is said to be a benchmark employee of the company.

text: Ginpaidalom sang Office of the Civil Defense Region 6 sa Red Alert status ang Western Visayas bangud sa epekto nga dala sang Bagyo Verbena.
english: The Office of the Civil Defense Region 6 has placed Western Visayas under Red Alert status due to the impact of Typhoon Verbena.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Melissa Banias, Chief sang Operation Section sang OCD 6, iya ginpahayag nga yara na sa Red Alert status ang rehiyon bangud sa heavy rainfall nga dala sang bagyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Melissa Banias, Chief of the Operation Section of OCD 6, said the region is already under Red Alert status due to the heavy rainfall brought by the typhoon.

text: Suno kay Atty. Banias, wala man sang storm surge sa mga coastal areas sa rehiyon apang lauman nga may ara sang sea level rise.
english: According to Atty. Banias, there is no storm surge in the coastal areas in the region but sea level rise is expected.

text: Pahayag pa niya, lapta ang pagbubu sang ulan sa nagkalain-lain sa rehiyon kun sa diin mabatyagan subong nga adlaw ang mamunog nga ulan.
english: He said the rain is widespread in various parts of the region where heavy rain is expected today.

text: Bilang preparasyon sa bagyo, ginahanda na ang response clusters sa rehiyon kag nagpatigayon man sang Pre-Disaster Risk Assessment (PREDRA).
english: In preparation for the typhoon, response clusters in the region are being prepared and have also conducted a Pre-Disaster Risk Assessment (PREDRA).

text: Nakastandby naman ang mga Search and Rescue Response (SRR) team sa pagpapanguna sang 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army kaupod ang Philippine Coast Guard, Bureau of Fire Protection kag Philippine National Police.
english: Search and Rescue Response (SRR) teams led by the 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army are on standby with the Philippine Coast Guard, Bureau of Fire Protection and Philippine National Police.

text: Sa subong, padayun ang pag-monitor sang operational center sang OCD 6 agud ma-monitor ang bagyo kag mapadasig ang koordinasyon sa pagresponde sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Meanwhile, the operational center of OCD 6 continues to monitor the typhoon and expedite coordination in responding to the residents.

text: Dugang pa ni Banias, bisan hasta lang sa tropical depression ang Bagyo Verbena, kinahanglan nga mag-aligmat sa gihapon ang publiko.
english: Banias added that even if Typhoon Verbena is only a tropical depression, the public should still be vigilant.

text: Text: Joedel Nollaga
english: Text: Joedel Nollaga

text: Aminado si Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong nga nabudlayan ang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sa operasyon sini bangud wala sang husto nga pondo.
english: Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong admitted that the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) is having difficulty in its operation due to lack of proper funds.

text: Sa interview kay Magalong, ginsiling sini nga siya mismo ang nagpagguwa sang kwarta sang nagserbe ini bilang Special Adviser sa ICI.
english: In an interview with Magalong, he said he himself released the money when he served as Special Adviser to ICI.

text: Suo sa iya, naglab-ot sa P30,000 ang ginhatag niya.
english: According to him, he donated P30,000.

text: Magluwas diri, may iban pa nga yara sa ICI na nagpagguwa man sang ila kaugalingon nga kwarta para sa ginahimo nga imbestigasyon sa flood control scam.
english: Besides, there are others in ICI who have also released their own money for the ongoing investigation into the flood control scam.

text: Isang tatlong taong gulang na bata ang nasawi matapos masagasaan ng grader sa Barangay Umilig, Buenavista, Guimaras.
english: A three-year-old child was injured after being hit by a grader in Barangay Umilig, Buenavista, Guimaras.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Rene Mercado, hepe ng Buenavista Municipal Police Station, inilahad niyang sinundo ng ama ang kanyang mag-ina gamit ang kanilang motorsiklo upang sana ay kumain sa isang fast food restaurant.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Captain Rene Mercado, chief of the Buenavista Municipal Police Station, said the father picked up his parents on their motorcycle to eat at a fast food restaurant.

text: Habang binabagtas nila ang nasabing barangay, sinipa umano ng ama ang isang bukol ng niyog na nasa kalsada, ngunit ito’y tumama sa unahang gulong ng kanilang motorsiklo na naging dahilan upang mawalan siya ng kontrol sa manibela.
english: While they were crossing the said barangay, the father allegedly kicked a coconut tree on the road, but it hit the front wheel of their motorcycle which caused him to lose control of the steering wheel.

text: Dahil sa lakas ng pagkakabangga, tumilapon ang mag-ina at bumagsak ang bata sa gilid ng kalsada — eksaktong sa daraanan ng isang grader na pababa ang takbo.
english: Due to the force of the collision, the mother and daughter tripped and the child fell to the side of the road — right in the path of a grader speeding downhill.

text: Hindi napansin agad ng driver ang bata, at nasagasaan ito.
english: The driver did not notice the child immediately, and hit him.

text: Ayon kay Captain Mercado, may mga residente pa umanong sumigaw upang abisuhan ang driver, ngunit huli na ang lahat.
english: According to Captain Mercado, some residents even shouted to warn the driver, but it was too late.

text: Agad namang isinugod ang bata sa pinakamalapit na ospital ngunit idineklara rin itong dead on arrival.
english: The child was rushed to the nearest hospital but was declared dead on arrival.

text: Kasalukuyan nang nasa kustodiya ng pulisya ang driver ng grader at nahaharap sa kasong Reckless Imprudence Resulting in Homicide.
english: The driver of the grader is currently in police custody and facing charges of Reckless Imprudence Resulting in Homicide.

text: INDIA – Mapati ka kag sa indi apang may lalaki sa Chennai, India nga ginkilala bilang “The Elephant Man” bangud sa kadakuon kag kabug-aton sang iya tu-o nga paa.
english: INDIA – Believe it or not but there is a man in Chennai, India who is known as “The Elephant Man” because of the size and weight of his right leg.

text: Si Arun Rajasingh, 34 anyos ang may yara sang genetic disorder kun sa diin ang iya tu-o nga paa ang nagabug-at sang 220 pounds kaangay sa kabug-aton sang bag-o lang ginbun-ag nga elepante.
english: Arun Rajasingh, 34, has a genetic disorder in which his right leg weighs 220 pounds equal to the weight of a newborn elephant.

text: Bangud sa naangkon nga genetic disorder, ang paa ni Rajasingh ang nagbanog sang makalima ka pilo gikan sa normal sini nga kadaku-on.
english: Due to the genetic disorder, Rajasingh's leg swelled to five times its normal size.

text: Sang pagbun-ag pa lang kay Rajasingh, bisan ang mga doktor ang nagpaandam sa iya ginikanan nga indi maglawig sa kalibutan ang ila anak.
english: As soon as Rajasingh was born, even the doctors warned his parents that their son would not live long.

text: Sa maayo nga palad, si Rajasingh ang nakatapos pa sa kurso nga Engineering kag nagsugod ang iya pag-antos sang nagbanog ang iya tu-o nga paa kag naga amat-amat naman sa pagbanog ang nawala sini nga paa.
english: Fortunately, Rajasingh had just finished his Engineering degree and his suffering began when his right leg swelled and his left leg slowly swelled.

text: Bangud sini, nagakinahanglan nga maggamit sang wheelchair ang natungdan para sa mga simple nga ulubrahon kaangay sang pagkuha sang bayo kag paggamit sang banyo.
english: As a result, the person needs to use a wheelchair for simple tasks such as getting dressed and using the bathroom.

text: Apisar sang iya kondisyon, wala nagakadulaan sang paglaum si Rajasingh nga may yara pa sang bulong sa iya kondisyon.
english: Despite his condition, Rajasingh does not lose hope that there is a cure for his condition.

text: Magapadalagan ang aktor nga si Robin Padilla sa pagka-senador sa 2022 national elections sa idalom sang ruling party nga Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) Cusi Wing.
english: Actor Robin Padilla will run for senator in the 2022 national elections under the ruling party Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) Cusi Wing.

text: Nagsumpa na si Padilla kaupod ang iya utod nga si Rommel Padilla.
english: Padilla was sworn in along with his brother Rommel Padilla.

text: Ang oathtaking ang gin-administer ni Department of Energy (DOE) Secretary kag PDP Laban President Alfonso Cusi.
english: The oathtaking was administered by Department of Energy (DOE) Secretary and PDP Laban President Alfonso Cusi.

text: Ginkumpirma sa statement sang PDP-Laban nga yara si Padilla sa senatorial slate sang ruling party, samtang ang iya utod naman ang magapadalagan bilang kongresista sa 1st District sang Nueva Ecija.
english: The PDP-Laban statement confirmed that Padilla is on the ruling party's senatorial slate, while his brother will run for congressman in the 1st District of Nueva Ecija.

text: Sang 2016 elections, isa si Padilla sa naghatag sang mabaskog nga suporta sa kandidatura ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: In the 2016 elections, Padilla was one of those who gave strong support to the candidacy of President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ginsuportahan man sini si Senator Christopher “Bong” Go sa eleksyon sang 2019.
english: He also supported Senator Christopher “Bong” Go in the 2019 election.

text: Nagapabilin sa Wind Signal No.
english: Remains on Wind Signal No.

text: 1 ang Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, Antique, kag Guimaras ukon ang bilog nga Western Visayas bangud sa Bagyo Verbena.
english: 1 Iloilo, Capiz, Aklan, Antique, and Guimaras or the entire Western Visayas due to Typhoon Verbena.

text: Sandig sa alas singko sa kaagahon nga weather bulletin sang state weather bureau, napabilin sang bagyo ang kabaskugon sini samtang nagahulag ini pa-naaminhan-nakatundan padulong sa Negros Island Region.
english: According to the 5:00 am weather bulletin of the state weather bureau, the typhoon maintained its strength as it moved northwest towards the Negros Island Region.

text: Base sa data sa Iloilo Doppler Weather Radar, ulihi nakit-an ang sentro sang bagyo sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Pinamungahan, Cebu.
english: Based on data from the Iloilo Doppler Weather Radar, the center of the typhoon was later located in the waters of Pinamungahan, Cebu.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga tubtub sa 55 km/h kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 90 km/h. Nagahulag si Verbena sa direksyon nga pa-naaminhan-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 25 km/h.

Magluwas sa Western Visayas, ang iban pa nga areas sa Visayas nga napaidalom sa Wind Signal No.
english:
It brought winds of up to 55 km/h and gusts of up to 90 km/h. Verbena is moving in a northwest direction at a speed of 25 km/h.

Aside from Western Visayas, other areas in the Visayas under Wind Signal No.

text: 1 amo ang Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, Siquijor, Cebu, Bohol, Samar, Eastern Samar, Biliran, Leyte, kag Southern Leyte.
