english: 1 are Negros Occidental, Negros Oriental, Siquijor, Cebu, Bohol, Samar, Eastern Samar, Biliran, Leyte, and Southern Leyte.

text: May areas man sa Luzon kag Mindanao nga nabatak sa amo nga wind signal kun sa diin posible ang minimal to minor impacts bangud sa mabaskog nga hangin.
english: There are also areas in Luzon and Mindanao that are affected by the wind signal where minimal to minor impacts are possible due to strong winds.

text: Magluwas diri, ang Northeast Monsoon ukon Amihan kag ang bagyo ang pareho nga magapamadlos sang hangin sa mga lugar nga may signal number lakip na sa Western Visayas.
english: In addition, the Northeast Monsoon or Amihan and the typhoon will both cause strong winds in areas with signal numbers including Western Visayas.

text: 11:10 PM kagab-i, nag-landfall ini sa Jagna, Bohol kag 2:40 kaina sang kaagahon, nag-landfall ini sa Talisay, Cebu.
english: 11:10 PM last night, it landfall in Jagna, Bohol and 2:40 this morning, it landfall in Talisay, Cebu.

text: Sa track forecast, magapadayon ini sa paghulag pa-nakatundan naaminhan-nakatundan sa Visayas antes magtuhaw sa West Philippine Sea buwas sa aga.
english: According to the track forecast, it will continue to move west northwest in the Visayas before emerging in the West Philippine Sea tomorrow morning.

text: Sunod ini nga magaliso pa-nakatundan kag magalabay sa naaminhan sang Kalayaan Islands kag magaguwa sa Philippine Area of Responsibility sa Huwebes sang aga.
english: It will next turn westward and pass north of the Kalayaan Islands and exit the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility on Thursday morning.

text: Samtang yari ini sa Visayas, magapabilin ini nga tropical depression.
english: While it is in the Visayas, it will remain a tropical depression.

text: Magalab-ot ini sa tropical storm category antes makaabot sa northern Palawan ukon possible man nga kun yara na ini sa West Philippine Sea.
english: It will reach the tropical storm category before reaching northern Palawan or possibly when it is in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Posible man suno sa weather bureau nga makadangat ini sa severe tropical storm category samtang yara sa tunga-tunga sang West Philippine Sea sa ibabaw nga parte sang Kalayaan Islands.
english: The weather bureau said it is also possible that it will reach the severe tropical storm category while it is in the middle of the West Philippine Sea in the upper part of the Kalayaan Islands.

text: SWITZERLAND – Mabakal ka bala sang fountain pen nga nagabalor sang kapin isa ka milyon ka pesos?
english: SWITZERLAND – Would you buy a fountain pen worth more than a million pesos?

text: Kun huo, isa ka Swiss premium writing tool company sa Switzerland ang naghimo sang limited-edition nga Astrograph fountain pen nga may korte kaangay sang rocket ship kag nasulod sa launch pad box.
english: If so, a Swiss premium writing tool company in Switzerland has created a limited-edition Astrograph fountain pen shaped like a rocket ship and enclosed in a launch pad box.

text: Ang nasambit nga fountain pen ang nagabalor sang $19,900 ukon masobra sa P960,000 kag ini ang pinakamabudlay nga writing tool nga gin-design sang kompaniya.
english: The fountain pen costs $19,900 or more than P960,000 and is the most difficult writing tool designed by the company.

text: Nga-a mahal ang Astrograph fountain pen?
english: Why is the Astrograph fountain pen so expensive?

text: Ini ang naga-unod sang 99 ka innovative components santo sa iya disenyo kag ang kada unit ang naga require sang masobra sa 500 ka manual operations agud mahimo.
english: It contains 99 innovative components based on its design and each unit requires more than 500 manual operations to manufacture.

text: Ang lawas sini ang may rocket-shape kag ang luxury launch pad box naman ang ginalakipan sang magnetic astronaut figurine nga naangot sa rocket agud mabatyagan ang space-age sang nasambit nga masterpiece.
english: The body is rocket-shaped and the luxury launch pad box includes a magnetic astronaut figurine attached to the rocket to give the space-age feel of the masterpiece.

text: Bilang pagkilala sa paggamit sang 99 ka components, 99 man ka bilog nga Astrograph fountain pen ang gin-release sang kompaniya kag ini ang mabakal sa balor nga P960,000.
english: In recognition of the use of 99 components, the company also released 99 pieces of Astrograph fountain pen which can be purchased at a price of P960,000.

text: Nanghakot sang awards ang P-pop group nga SB19 sa 14th and 15th Philippine Movie Press Club’s Star Awards for Music.
english: P-pop group SB19 won awards at the 14th and 15th Philippine Movie Press Club’s Star Awards for Music.

text:
Sanday Pablo, Stell, Felip, Ken, Justin, kag Josh Cullen sang SB19 ang nagbulsa sang 14th Star Awards for Music Song of the Year sa kanta nga “Mapa” halin sa album nga “Pagsibol.”

Nakuha man sang grupo ang Duo/Group Artist of the Year, Pop Album of the Year, Dance Recording of the Year, Duo/Group Concert of the Year, kag Music Video of the Year.
english:
Pablo, Stell, Felip, Ken, Justin, and Josh Cullen of SB19 pocketed the 14th Star Awards for Music Song of the Year for the song “Mapa” from the album “Pagsibol.”

The group also won Duo/Group Artist of the Year, Pop Album of the Year, Dance Recording of the Year, Duo/Group Concert of the Year, and Music Video of the Year.

text: Magluwas sa 14th Star Awards for Music, nakuha man sang P-pop group ang Music Video of the Year sa “WYAT (Where You At)” sa 15th Star Awards for Music.
english: In addition to the 14th Star Awards for Music, the P-pop group also won the Music Video of the Year for “WYAT (Where You At)” at the 15th Star Awards for Music.

text: Sa 14th kag 15th editions, ang veteran singers kag OPM Icons nga sanday Hajji Alejandro kag Vernie Varga ang ginhatagan sang Pilita Corrales Lifetime Achievement recognition samtang si Rey Valera kag Odette Quezada naman ang nahatagan sang Levi Celerio Lifetime Achievement Awards.
english: In the 14th and 15th editions, veteran singers and OPM Icons Hajji Alejandro and Vernie Varga were awarded the Pilita Corrales Lifetime Achievement recognition while Rey Valera and Odette Quezada were awarded the Levi Celerio Lifetime Achievement Awards.

text: Nagpaandam si Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Department of Agriculture (DA) Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: sa mga traders nga nagahimo sang tikang agud mabutang sa delikado ang ikaayong lawas sang mga consumers.
english: to traders who take steps to endanger the health of consumers.

text: Ini ang kasunod man sang natukiban sang Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) nga nagpositibo sa pesticides kag heavy metals ang mga ginpalapaw nga mga utanon sa Navotas.
english: This follows the discovery of the Bureau of Plant Industry (BPI) that the vegetables grown in Navotas tested positive for pesticides and heavy metals.

text: Sa nasambit nga insidente, masobra 300 ka tonelada nga white onions, carrots, kamatis kag enoki mushrooms ang nakumpiska gikan sa makeshift cold storage facilities kag 40-footer container van sa tunga-tunga sang Agosto bangud sa kakulang sa sanitary and phytosanitary import clearances para sa pag-import.
english: In the incident, more than 300 tons of white onions, carrots, tomatoes and enoki mushrooms were seized from makeshift cold storage facilities and a 40-footer container van in mid-August due to lack of sanitary and phytosanitary import clearances for importation.

text: “We cannot risk the health of Filipino consumers.
english: “We cannot risk the health of Filipino consumers.

text:
The DA legal team will determine legal actions that can be taken against these unscrupulous traders who not only evaded tariffs but also endangered consumer health.”

Suno kay Laurel, ginatun-an na subong sang legal team sang ahensya ang ipasaka sang kaso batok sa mga nagapamentaha nga traders.
english:
The DA legal team will determine legal actions that can be taken against these unscrupulous traders who not only evaded tariffs but also endangered consumer health.”

Laurel said the agency's legal team is now studying whether to file a case against the traders.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Plant Industry Director Gerald Glenn Panganiban, nagpositibo ang mga utanon sa nagkalain-lain nga pesticide residues nga “harmful to humans,” lakip na ang organophosphates, organochlorines, kag pyrethroids, mangin ang heavy metals kaangay sang cadmium kag lead.
english: Meanwhile, Plant Industry Director Gerald Glenn Panganiban said the vegetables tested positive for various pesticide residues that are “harmful to humans,” including organophosphates, organochlorines, and pyrethroids, as well as heavy metals such as cadmium and lead.

text: Magluwas diri, natumod man ang microbial contaminants lakip na ang E. coli, Listeria monocytogenes, kag Salmonella.
english: In addition, microbial contaminants including E. coli, Listeria monocytogenes, and Salmonella were also identified.

text: “The food safety analysis confirms that the allegedly smuggled crops contain pesticide residues, heavy metals, and microbiological contaminants that do not comply with our food safety regulations.”
english: “The food safety analysis confirms that the allegedly smuggled crops contain pesticide residues, heavy metals, and microbiological contaminants that do not comply with our food safety regulations.”

text:
Maga-updanay ang anay magkahagugma nga sanday Joshua Garcia kag Julia Barretto sa bag-o nga pelikula nga may tig-ulo nga “Un/happy For You.”

Istorya ini sang duha ka anay magkahagugma apang wala ginsapubliko ang iban nga mga detalye.
english:
Former lovers Joshua Garcia and Julia Barretto will star in a new film titled “Un/happy For You.”

It is the story of two former lovers but no other details were made public.

text: Natalana man ini nga ipaguwa subong nga tuig sa idalom sang direksyon ni Petersen Vargas.
english: It is also set to be released this year under the direction of Petersen Vargas.

text: Una nga nagka-trabaho ang duha sa “Vince and Kath and James” sang 2016, “Love You to the Stars and Back” sang 2017, “I Love You, Hater” sang 2018 kag “Block Z” sang 2020.
english: The two first worked together on “Vince and Kath and James” in 2016, “Love You to the Stars and Back” in 2017, “I Love You, Hater” in 2018 and “Block Z” in 2020.

text: Updanay man sila sa TV series nga “Ngayon at Kailanman” sang 2018.
english: They also starred together in the TV series “Now and Forever” in 2018.

text: 2019 sang ginkumpirma ang ila nga breakup kag subong pareho nga malipayon sa ila relasyon.
english: 2019 when their breakup was confirmed and now both are happy in their relationship.

text: Ka-low-key relationship ni Julia si Gerald Anderson halin sang Marso 2021, samtang si Joshua naman kag ang Pinay-French golfer nga si Emilienne Vigier halin sang 2023.
english: Julia has been in a low-key relationship with Gerald Anderson since March 2021, while Joshua and Pinay-French golfer Emilienne Vigier have been in a relationship since 2023.

text: Inilabas na ng Gilas Pilipinas ang line-up nila na sasabak sa Southeast Asian Games.
english: Gilas Pilipinas has released its line-up for the Southeast Asian Games.

text: Pangungunahan ni Norman Black na magiging coach ng men’s national basketball team.
english: It will be led by Norman Black who will coach the men’s national basketball team.

text: Siya kasi ang naging coach noon ng makuha ng men’s national basketball team ang gold medal sa SEA Games noong 2011.
english: He was the coach when the men's national basketball team won the gold medal at the SEA Games in 2011.

text: Ayon sa Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas (SBP) na ang lineup ay kinabibilangan ng professionals at college players na sumailalim sa apat na revision dahil sa eligibility requirerments ng organizers ng SEA Games.
english: According to the Philippine Basketball Association (SBP), the lineup includes professionals and college players who will undergo four revisions due to the eligibility requirements of the organizers of the SEA Games.

text: Ang lineups ay binubuo nina: Jamie Malonzo, Dalph Panopio, Thirdy Ravena, Matthew Wright, Ray Parks, Ced Manzano, Justin Chua , Robert Bolick, Von Pessumal, Allen Liwag, Abu Tratter at Veejay Pre.
english: The lineups consist of: Jamie Malonzo, Dalph Panopio, Thirdy Ravena, Matthew Wright, Ray Parks, Ced Manzano, Justin Chua, Robert Bolick, Von Pessumal, Allen Liwag, Abu Tratter and Veejay Pre.

text: Magahod na ang basketball fans kun ano nga national team ang ila suportahan sa palaabuton nga Paris Olympics!
english: Basketball fans are now buzzing about which national team they will support in the upcoming Paris Olympics!

text: Kumpleto na ang 12 ka nasyon nga maga-compete sa Olympiada kasunod sang pagdugang sang Spain, Puerto Rico, Greece, kag Brazil nga lunsay nagdaog sa finals sang ila ginpasakupan nga Olympic qualifiers.
english: The 12 nations that will compete in the Olympiad are complete with the addition of Spain, Puerto Rico, Greece, and Brazil, who all won the finals of their respective Olympic qualifiers.

text: Matandaan nga sa FIBA World Cup 2023 una nga ginhatag ang nauna nga spots sa Olympics nga amo ang four-time defending gold medalist nga United States, Canada, Australia, South Sudan, Japan, Serbia, kag Germany.
english: It can be recalled that in the FIBA ​​World Cup 2023, the first spots in the Olympics were given to the four-time defending gold medalist United States, Canada, Australia, South Sudan, Japan, Serbia, and Germany.

text: Awtomatiko naman nga ginhatag ang isa ka spot sa host nation nga amo ang France.
english: One spot was automatically given to the host nation, France.

text: Lakip sa balantayan sa Olympiada amo ang Group A nga bug-usan sang world no.
english: Among those to watch at the Olympiad is Group A, which consists of world no.

text: 2 nga Spain, Australia, Canada kag Greece.
english: 2 Spain, Australia, Canada and Greece.

text: Ang Canada ang nahatagan na sang bansag nga “Group of Death” bangud sa mapag-on nga roster nga pangunahan sang NBA players nga sanday Shai Gilgeous-Alexander kag Jamal Murray.
english: Canada has already been nicknamed the “Group of Death” due to a strong roster led by NBA players Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Jamal Murray.

text: Ang Greece naman ang pangunahan ni Giannis Antetokounmpo kag ini ang una nga tion sa sulod sang 16 ka tuig nga makasulod sila sa Olympiada.
english: Greece, led by Giannis Antetokounmpo, will qualify for the Olympics for the first time in 16 years.

text: Nagapabilin nga heavy favorite ang defending champions nga US nga pamunuan ni LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Kevin Durant kag Kawhi Leonard.
english: The defending champions US, led by LeBron James, Stephen Curry, Kevin Durant and Kawhi Leonard, remain heavy favorites.

text:
Mangin coach sang US si Steve Kerr kag tinguhaan sini nga makabawi matapos napaslawan nga makabulsa sang medalya sa 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.#

(Photo: ClutchPoints)
english:
Steve Kerr will become the coach of the US and will try to recover after failing to pocket a medal at the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup.#

(Photo: ClutchPoints)

text: Dismayado si Iloilo City Councilor Rex Sarabia sa pag-reject sang Department of Public Works and Highways – Iloilo City District Engineering Office (DPWH-ICDEO) sang hingyo sang Iloilo City Council nga dokumento angot sa flood control projects sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Rex Sarabia is disappointed with the rejection of the Iloilo City Council's request for documents regarding flood control projects in Iloilo City.

text: Ini nga request ang ginpaagi sa Quad Com on Waterways.
english: This request was made through the Quad Com on Waterways.

text: Matandaan nga nagpadala sang sulat ang City Council sa amo nga talatapan agud nga maghinyo sang mga nasambit nga dokumento sang Oktubre 29, bilang kabahin sang gina-conudct nga imbestigasyon sa mga proyekto sang DPWH sa Lone District.
english: The City Council sent a letter to the office requesting the documents on October 29, as part of the ongoing investigation into DPWH projects in the Lone District.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sarabia, iya ginpahayag nga nalakip sa mga gin-request sang syudad amo ang feasibility studies, bid bulletins, project contracts, payments release, inspection reports,detailed engineering designs, project impact analyses, kag statement of work accomplishments.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sarabia said the city's requests include feasibility studies, bid bulletins, project contracts, payments release, inspection reports, detailed engineering designs, project impact analyses, and statement of work accomplishments.

text: Suno sa konsehal, ang paghingyo sang dokumento ang kabahin sang ila inisyatibo agud masekyar ang mga iregularidad nga Proyekto sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: The councilor said the request for documents is part of their initiative to check irregularities in projects in Iloilo City.

text: Ginpahayag pa sini nga bangud ang Iloilo ang isa sa mga gina ehemplo ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: He said that because Iloilo is one of the examples of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: pag-abot sa palpak kag delayed nga mga proyekto.
english: when it comes to failed and delayed projects.

text: Dugang pa niya, isa man sa mga rason sa pag-request sang dokumento agud madeterminar kun ang mga proyekto nga ginatukod sa syudad sang Iloilo ang naghalin sa National Expenditure Program ukon Budget Insertion sa General Appropriations Act.
english: He added that one of the reasons for requesting the document is to determine whether the projects being built in Iloilo City come from the National Expenditure Program or Budget Insertion in the General Appropriations Act.

text: Pahayag pa ni Sarabia, nakabaton siya sang letter gikan sa DPWH-ICDEO sa diin wala sila ginpahanugotan nga makakuha sang mga nasambit nga dokumento sa diin suno sa amo nga opisina makabig ini nga isa ka “prejudicial premature disclosure”.
english: Sarabia said he received a letter from the DPWH-ICDEO where they were not allowed to obtain the said documents which according to the office is considered a “prejudicial premature disclosure”.

text: Ginklaro ni Sarabia nga wala sang intensyon ang komitiba nga magpakamalaot sa mga ginaalegar violations sang layi sa bahin sang ICDEO.
english: Sarabia clarified that the committee has no intention of condemning the alleged violations of the law on the part of the ICDEO.

text: Apang, luyag lamang nila nga masolusyonan ang wala-untat nga problema sang pag-binaha sa syudad.
english: However, they only want to solve the perennial problem of flooding in the city.

text: Nagtay-ug ang mabaskug nga 6.3 magnitude nga linog nga nagdugay naman sa pila ka segundo, natabo sa Colombian Capital of Bogota sini nga Dominggo, ini suno sa United States Geological Survey.
english: A 6.3-magnitude earthquake struck the Colombian capital of Bogota on Sunday, according to the United States Geological Survey.

text: Natabo ang linog malapit sa siyudad sang Paratebueno sa tunga-tunga nga bahin sang Colombia, mga 170 kilometros (105 ka milya) sa sidlangan sang Bogota, suno sa US Geological Survey (USGS).
english: The quake struck near the city of Paratebueno in central Colombia, about 170 kilometers (105 miles) east of Bogota, according to the US Geological Survey (USGS).

text: Wala man sang nareport nga casualties matapos ang linog nga nabatyagan man sa mga siyudad sang Medellin, Cali kag Manizales sa Colombia.
english: No casualties were reported after the quake was also felt in the cities of Medellin, Cali and Manizales in Colombia.

text: Ang linog, nga ginrekord sang Colombian National Geological Survey nga may kusog nga magnitude 6.5, amo ang isa sa pinakamakusog kag pinakamalawig nga nabatyagan sa kapital sa mga nagligad nga tuig.
english: The quake, recorded by the Colombian National Geological Survey with a magnitude of 6.5, was one of the strongest and longest felt in the capital in recent years.

text: Ginpahayag sang mayor sang Bogota nga si Carlos Fernando Galan nga ginpaaktibo na ang tanan nga mga disaster agencies.
english: Bogota Mayor Carlos Fernando Galan said all disaster agencies have been activated.

text: Ang pungsod yara sa Pacific ‘Ring of Fire,’ isa ka arko kun sa diin may mabaskog nga aktibidad sang linog kag bulkan, nga ginalakipan sang mga nagabunggo nga tectonic plates halin sa Japan, Southeast Asia, kag nagalab-ot tubtob sa Pacific basin pakadtu sa South America.
english: The country is located in the Pacific 'Ring of Fire,' an arc of intense earthquake and volcanic activity, which includes colliding tectonic plates from Japan, Southeast Asia, and extends from the Pacific basin to South America.

text: Text by: Bombo James Daccer Silverio
english: Text by: Bombo James Daccer Silverio

text: Napaidalom sa Wind Signal No.
english: Under Wind Signal No.

text: 1 ang Iloilo, Aklan, Capiz, Guimaras, kag Antique ukon ang bilog nga Western Visayas bangud sa bagyo Verbena.
english: 1 in Iloilo, Aklan, Capiz, Guimaras, and Antique or the entire Western Visayas due to Typhoon Verbena.

text: Sandig sa 5:00 am nga weather bulletin sang Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), ulihi nga nakit-an ang bagyo sa kalayuon nga 330 km nasidlangan sang Surigao City, Surigao del Norte.
english: According to the 5:00 am weather bulletin of the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), the typhoon was last spotted at a distance of 330 km east of Surigao City, Surigao del Norte.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga 45 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtub sa 55 km/h. Nagahulag ini pa-nakatundan sa kadasigon nga 30 km/h.

Magluwas sa Western Visayas, madamo nga areas sa Luzon, Visayas, kag Mindanao ang napaidalom subong sa Wind Signal No.
english:
It brought winds of 45 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 55 km/h. It is moving westward at a speed of 30 km/h.

Aside from Western Visayas, many areas in Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao are currently under Wind Signal No.

text: 1 kun sa diin posible ang minimal to minor impacts bangud sa mabaskog nga hangin.
english: 1 where minimal to minor impacts are possible due to strong winds.

text: Base sa track forecast, magahulag si Verbena pa-nakatundan naaminhan nakatundan kag maga-landfall ukon magalabay malapit sa northeastern Mindanao karon sa udto ukon karon sa hapon.
english: Based on the track forecast, Verbena will move west northwest and landfall or pass near northeastern Mindanao this afternoon or this afternoon.

text: Pagkatapos, magatabok ini sa Visayas kag sa northern portion sang Palawan halin subong nga adlaw tubtub sa Myerkules kag magatuhaw sa Myerkules sang aga.
english: Then, it will cross the Visayas and the northern portion of Palawan from today until Wednesday and will emerge on Wednesday morning.

text: Suno sa weather bureau, mahimo magbaskog ang bagyo antes ini mag-landfall sa northeastern Mindanao apang possible man nga magapabilin ini sa kategorya nga Tropical Depression samtang yara ini sa Philippine landmass.
english: According to the weather bureau, the typhoon may intensify before landfall in northeastern Mindanao but it is also possible that it will remain in the category of Tropical Depression while it is in the Philippine landmass.

text: Kun magtuhaw na ini sa West Philippine Sea, magabaskog pa ini kag mahimo nga tropical storm.
english: When it emerges in the West Philippine Sea, it will intensify and become a tropical storm.

text:
CLASS SUSPENSION

Gin-anunsyo naman sang Iloilo City Government ang automatic class suspension halin sa pre-school tubtub sa kindergarten bangud napaidalom ang syudad sang Iloilo sa signal no.
english:
CLASS SUSPENSION

The Iloilo City Government announced the automatic class suspension from pre-school to kindergarten because the city is under signal no.

text:
Yari ang announcement:

“As Iloilo City is under TCWS signal no.
english:
Here is the announcement:

“As Iloilo City is under TCWS signal no.

text:
1 – automatic class suspension from pre-school to kindergarten, public and private (DepEd Memo Order 22 s. 2024.”

Ini nga memorandum amo ang nagaplastar sang revised guidelines sa class and work suspension sa mga eskwelahan sa tion sang disasters kag emergencies agud mapabilin ang kaluwasan sang mga kabataan kag personnel.#
english:
1 – automatic class suspension from pre-school to kindergarten, public and private (DepEd Memo Order 22 s. 2024.”

This memorandum sets out revised guidelines on class and work suspension in schools during disasters and emergencies to maintain the safety of children and personnel.

text: Nagpirma ang basketball superstar nga si LeBron James sang bag-o nga duha-ka-tuig nga kontrata sa Los Angeles Lakers kag nagpasugot man nga mas manubo ang ibayad sa iya sa $104 million ukon P6.087-billion nga amo ang amount nga eligible siya kuntani nga mabaton.
english: Basketball superstar LeBron James signed a new two-year contract with the Los Angeles Lakers and agreed to pay him less than $104 million or P6.087-billion, the amount he would have been eligible to receive.

text: Sa naga-guwa nga inisyal nga mga report, yara sa $101.35 million ukon P5.9-billion ang kontrata nga ginpirmahan sang 39-anyos nga Lakers veteran para makasulod sa ika-23 nga season sa iya karera nga amo ang pinakamalawig nga karera sa bug-os nga maragtas sang liga.
english: According to initial reports, the 39-year-old Lakers veteran signed a $101.35 million or P5.9-billion contract to enter the 23rd season of his career, the longest in league history.

text: Ini nga pay cut ang katumbas sang malapit $2.7 million ukon P158-million.
english: This pay cut is equivalent to nearly $2.7 million or P158-million.

text: Ang buhin sa sweldo ang makabulig man sa Lakers nga ma-address ang problema sini sa salary cap restrictions.
english: The pay cut will also help the Lakers address their problem with salary cap restrictions.

text: Ginapahayag nga ang malapit $3 million nga pay cut kay James ang makabulig nga malikawan sang Lakers ang second apron penalties nga ginabanta magadangat sa $45,000.
english: James' nearly $3 million pay cut will reportedly help the Lakers avoid second apron penalties estimated at $45,000.

text: Ginalantaw nga daku nga pabor ang ginhimo sang amo nga leading scorer ilabi na bangud una na sini gin-anunsyo nga handa siya nga batunon ang daku nga buhin sa bayad kun makuha sang Lakers ang isa sa premier free agents kaangay kay Klay Thompson ukon DeMar DeRozan.
english: The leading scorer is seen as doing a big favor especially since he previously announced that he is ready to accept a large pay cut if the Lakers get one of the premier free agents like Klay Thompson or DeMar DeRozan.

text: Apang pareho man nga nagpirma ang duha ka players sa lain nga NBA teams — si Thompson sa Mavs, kag si DeRozan sa Sacramento.
english: But both players also signed with different NBA teams — Thompson with the Mavs, and DeRozan with Sacramento.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion nga nagpasugot si James nga may buhin sa ibayad sa iya.
english: This is the second time James has agreed to a discount.

text: Sang 2010, gin-report man nga nagpasugot man ini sa duha ka tuig nga $68-million ukon P3.98-billion nga kontrata sa Miami Heat.
english: In 2010, he also reportedly agreed to a two-year $68-million or P3.98-billion contract with the Miami Heat.

text: Bangud sa amo nga pay cut, nakatukod sang roster ang Heat nga nakadaog sang duha ka NBA titles kag apat ka sunod-sunod nga byahe sa NBA Finals.
english: Because of the pay cut, the Heat have built a roster that has won two NBA titles and four consecutive trips to the NBA Finals.

text: CHINA – Siling nila, “the only constant in life is change”, positibo man ukon negatibo.
english: CHINA – They say, “the only constant in life is change”, whether positive or negative.

text: Halimbawa diri amo ang “from rags to riches” nga istorya nga nagahatag sang inspirasyon sa tanan apang paano kun baliskad ang natabo kasubong abi sang milyonaryo nga nag-imol bangod sa sugal ukon iban pa nga bisyo.
english: An example of this is the “from rags to riches” story that inspires everyone but what if the opposite happened like a millionaire who became poor because of gambling or other addictions.

text: Apang indi tanan nga manggaranon nga nag-imol ang bangud sa sugal ukon bisyo bangud nga sa Jilin Province sa China, isa ka lalaki nga milyonaryo ang nag-imol bangud sa maayo nga kawsa.
english: But not all rich people who became poor because of gambling or addiction because in Jilin Province in China, a man who was a millionaire became poor because of a good cause.

text: Ang 29 anyos nga si Wang Yan ang naggasto sang iya manggad sa pag-rescue sang mga ido nga biktima sang pagpang-abuso.
english: Twenty-nine-year-old Wang Yan spent his fortune rescuing dogs who were victims of abuse.

text: Ang nasambit nga kawsa ni Wang Yan ang nag-umpisa sang nadula ang iya nga ido kag samtang ginapangita ang hinuptanan, nasaksihan niya mismo ang kalbaryo sang iban nga ido.
english: Wang Yan's cause began when his dog went missing and while searching for the pet, he witnessed the ordeal of other dogs.

text: Bangud sa kalouy, nagdesisyon si Wang Yan nga himuon ang iya factory nga isa ka animal rescue base.
english: Out of compassion, Wang Yan decided to turn his factory into an animal rescue base.

text: Ang minilyon ka pesos nga manggad ang gingamit sang natungdan sa rescue operations kag sa pagtatap sa mga ido tubtub nga naputo.
english: The millions of pesos were used for rescue operations and to take care of the dogs until they were killed.

text: Apang sa pihak sini, wala sang may ginhinulsulan si Wang Yan bangud luyag lang niya magbulig bangud ang manggad suno sa iya ang materyal lamang kag indi man ini madala sa pihak nga kinabuhi.
english: However, Wang Yan has no regrets because he just wants to help because wealth, he said, is only material and cannot be carried to the next life.

text: Bangud sa maayo nga hinimuan ni Wang Yan, madamo ang nagdayaw kag nagpalab-ot sang donasyon para sa mga rescue dogs.
english: Due to Wang Yan's good deed, many praised and donated for the rescue dogs.

text: Napasa na sang Senado ang ikaduha nga pagbasa sang ginaproponer nga P6.793 trillion national budget para sa tuig 2026.
english: The Senate has passed the second reading of the proposed P6.793 trillion national budget for 2026.

text: Matapos ang madugay nga interpellation ni Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano, napasa sa ikaduha nga pagbasa ang General Appropriations Bill (GAB) antes mag-ala 6 sang gabi sang Disyembre 4.
english: After a long interpellation by Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano, the General Appropriations Bill (GAB) was passed on second reading before 6 pm on December 4.

text: Target sang Senado nga masumiter ang budget sa ikatatlo kag ulihi nga pagbasa sa Disyembre 9.
english: The Senate targets to submit the budget on third and final reading on December 9.

text: Pagkatapos sni, igapatigayon ang bicameral deliberation sa masunod nga semana.
english: After that, the bicameral deliberation will be held next week.

text: Matandaan nga may yara sang mga pag-amyendar sa pila ka bahin sang national budget sang pagbuhin sa Foreign Assisted Projects , pagdugang sa National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund kag pagbalik sang 4Ps Program sa National Expenditure Program (NEP) level sa balor nga P11.17-bilyon.
english: It can be recalled that there were amendments to some parts of the national budget of cutting Foreign Assisted Projects, increasing the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund and returning the 4Ps Program to the National Expenditure Program (NEP) level at P11.17-billion.

text: Nagsaka ang unemployment rate sang Pilipinas sang nagligad nga Hulyo.
english: The Philippines' unemployment rate rose last July.

text: Santo sa Philippine Statistics Authority, ang wala sang trabaho nga mga Pilipino ang yara sa 4.7 percent, nga mas mataas sa 3.1 percent nga unemployment rate sang Hunyo.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority, the unemployment rate of Filipinos is 4.7 percent, higher than the 3.1 percent unemployment rate in June.

text: Ini ang nagakahulugan man nga 2.38 million Filipinos ang jobless sang bulan sang Hulyo, samtang 1.62 million naman ang unemployed sang nagligad nga Hunyo.
english: This also means that 2.38 million Filipinos were jobless in July, while 1.62 million were unemployed last June.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang underemployment, nagpabilin sa 12.1 percent, nagakahulugan ini nga 5.78 million ka mga mamumugon nga Pilipino ang nagapangita sang dugang nga oras sang trabaho ukon nagapangita sang dugang nga trabaho agud madugangan ang ila kita.
english: Underemployment, on the other hand, remained at 12.1 percent, meaning that 5.78 million Filipino workers are looking for more working hours or looking for more work to increase their income.

text: Ini nga numero yara sa 6.08 million sang Hunyo.
english: This figure stood at 6.08 million in June.

text: May 50.7 million naman ka mga mamumugon sa labor force sang Hulyo, mas manubo gikan sa 51.9 million sang Hunyo.
english: There were 50.7 million workers in the labor force in July, down from 51.9 million in June.

text: Nagpaguwa sang circular letter si Jaro Archbishop Midyphil B. Billones nga nagapanawagan sa mga tumuluo nga mag-upod sa patigayunon nga “Kahublagan Kontra Korapsyon” sa masunod nga Domingo, Nobyembre 30.
english: Jaro Archbishop Midyphil B. Billones issued a circular letter calling on the faithful to join the “Struggle Against Corruption” to be held next Sunday, November 30.

text: Sa iya sulat, gin-engganyo ni Archbishop Billiones ang mga parokya, religious communities, mga propesyunal, business groups, kabataan, kag civic organizations nga mag-isa para sa pagpanawagan sa pagtapna sa kurapsyon.
english: In his letter, Archbishop Billiones encouraged parishes, religious communities, professionals, business groups, children, and civic organizations to unite for the call to fight corruption.

text: Ginpanawagan sini ang pagpasakop sa mga aktibidad kaangay sang candle-lighting events kag pagtipon para sa pagpangamuyo.
english: He called for participation in activities such as candle-lighting events and gatherings for prayer.

text: Mahimo man mag-upod sa streaming kag photo campaigns nga may mga mensahe kontra sa kurapsyon kag magbutang sang puti nga ribbon sa guwa sang mga eskwelahan kag pampubliko nga lugar.
english: You can also join streaming and photo campaigns with anti-corruption messages and put up white ribbons outside schools and public places.

text: Ginbutang man ang pagbagting sang lingganay sang simbahan; pagpatigayon sang mga diskusyon sa mga buluthuan, parokya, kag mga komunidad; kag pagpatigayon sang sectoral mobilization para sa kamatuoran kag hustisya.
english: The church bell was also installed; facilitating discussions in schools, parishes, and communities; and facilitating sectoral mobilization for truth and justice.

text: Sa Nobyembre 30 nga kadungan man sang Bonifacio Day, ginapanan-aw nga 3,000 tubtub sa 5,000 ka mga indibidwal ang magatipon halin sa Jaro Plaza kag University of the Philippines–Visayas pakadto sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol para sa protesta nga maga-umpisa sa alas tres sa hapon.
english: On November 30, which also coincides with Bonifacio Day, 3,000 to 5,000 individuals are expected to gather from Jaro Plaza and the University of the Philippines-Visayas to the Iloilo Provincial Capitol for a protest that will start at 3 pm.

text: Sang Septyembre 21, matandaan nga may daku man nga hublag-protesta nga ginpatigayon sa Iloilo kun sa diin masobra sa 15,000 ka mga Ilonggo ang ang nagtipon sa amo man nga venue.
english: On September 21, a large protest was also held in Iloilo where more than 15,000 Ilonggos gathered at the same venue.

text: Wala pa sang direkta nga sabat sanday Catriona Gray kag Sam Milby apang matunog ang espekulasyon sang fans nga maayo na liwat ang relasyon sang duha kag posible nga madayon ang pagpakasal.
english: Catriona Gray and Sam Milby have not yet responded directly, but fans are speculating that the two are on good terms again and that the wedding may go ahead.

text: Ini kasunod sang post sang businesswoman nga si Pinky Tobiano kun sa diin nakit-an ang eksena sa garden party kun sa diin magkauapod sanday Cat kag Sam.
english: This follows a post by businesswoman Pinky Tobiano where she saw the scene at the garden party where Cat and Sam were together.

text: May candid video ang duha nga tupaday, samtang ang isa naman amo ang laragway kun sa diin naga-pose ang mga ini sa camera.
english: There is a candid video of the two sides, while the other is a picture where they pose for the camera.

text: Ini nga event ang kaangot sa birthday sang Cornerstone Entertainment president kag founder nga si Erickson Raymundo.
english: This event is in conjunction with the birthday of Cornerstone Entertainment president and founder Erickson Raymundo.

text: Ini amo man ang management company sang celebrity couple.
english: It is also the management company of the celebrity couple.

text: Nahibaluan nga nasapubliko ang relasyon sang Miss Universe 2018 kag heartthrob actor sang 2020, na-engage, kag naga-plano nga magpakasal subong nga tuig apang sang Pebrero, ginkumpirma sang ila talent agency nga may problema matuod sa relasyon sang duha apang ginatinguhaan nila nga ma-resolba ang amo nga mga isyu.
english: It is known that the relationship between Miss Universe 2018 and the heartthrob actor became public in 2020, got engaged, and plans to get married this year but in February, their talent agency confirmed that there are indeed problems in the relationship between the two but they are trying to resolve such issues.

text: Matapos nga ginkabos sa finals sang 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA), indi man makatapak sa Paris Olympics ang basketball superstar nga si Luka Doncic matapos nga nalutos ang Slovenia sa semifinals sang Olympic qualifying tournament sa Piraeus, Greece.
english: After being eliminated in the finals of the 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA), basketball superstar Luka Doncic will also miss the Paris Olympics after losing to Slovenia in the semifinals of the Olympic qualifying tournament in Piraeus, Greece.

text: Nagpanguna ang isa pa ka NBA star nga si Giannis Antetokounmpo agud nga tambakan sang Greece ang Slovenia, 96-68, sa amo nga semifinal match.
english: Another NBA star, Giannis Antetokounmpo, led the way for Greece to beat Slovenia, 96-68, in that semifinal match.

text: 21 puntos ang na-skor ni Doncic para sa ila national team nga opisyal na nga na-eliminate sa amo nga tournament.
english: Doncic scored 21 points for their national team, which was officially eliminated from the tournament.

text: Maatubang naman si Antetokounmpo kag ang Greece sa Croatia nga amo naman ang naglutos sa Dominican Republic sa pihak nga bracket sang semis, kun sa diin ang winner amo ang makakuha sang ticket para sa Paris.
english: Antetokounmpo and Greece will face Croatia, who beat the Dominican Republic in the other bracket of the semis, where the winner will get a ticket to Paris.

text: Matandaan nga madamo nga injuries ang naangkon ni Doncic sa NBA playoffs apang nabuligan ang Mavericks nga makakuha sang isa ka kadalag-an sa NBA finals batok sa nagkampyon nga Boston Celtics.
english: Doncic suffered several injuries in the NBA playoffs but helped the Mavericks to a victory in the NBA finals against the champion Boston Celtics.

text: Sinimulan na ng kumpanyang Meta ang pagtanggal sa mga bata sa Australia na may edad 16 na pababa mula sa kanilang social media na Facebook, Instagrams at Threads.
english: Meta has begun removing Australian children under the age of 16 from its social media Facebook, Instagrams and Threads.

text: Ayon sa Meta na isang linggo pa lamang bago ipatupad ang batas sa Australia nitong Disyembre 10 ay kanilang inalis ang mga social media users na mula sa Australia na menor de edad.
english: According to Meta, just a week before the law comes into force in Australia on December 10, they have removed social media users from Australia who are minors.

text: Tinatayang nasa 150,000 Facebook users at 350,000 Instagram accounts ang apektado.
english: An estimated 150,000 Facebook users and 350,000 Instagram accounts are affected.

text: Ang Australia ay siyang unang bansa na nagpatupad ng social media ban kung saan pagmumultahin nila ang social media companies ng nasa $33-M kapag hindi ito ipinatupad.
english: Australia is the first country to implement a social media ban where they will fine social media companies up to $33-M if it is not implemented.

text: USA – Bangud nga kulang-kulang sa tatlo ka bulan kag Christmas day na, indi gid madula si Santa Claus sa mga party kag iban pa nga mga aktibidad.
english: USA – With less than three months to go and Christmas Day, Santa Claus will never be missing from parties and other activities.

text: Apang, nakahibalo ka bala nga sa Colorado sa Estados Undios, ang mga ‘santa claus’ ang nagapaidalom sa pagtu-on agud mangin professional santa claus.
english: However, did you know that in Colorado in the United States, Santa Claus undergo training to become a professional Santa Claus.

text: Sa Santa University, ginatun-an kun paano mag-pose para sa picture, paano magdeal sa social media, paano magsabak sang bata, ano ang pagahimuon kun magpangayo ang bata sang regalo nga daw imposible kag kun paano mapabilin nga mangin healthy kag hydrated sa tion sang Christmas day.
english: At Santa University, students learn how to pose for pictures, how to deal with social media, how to conceive a child, what to do when a child asks for a gift that seems impossible and how to stay healthy and hydrated during Christmas day.

text: Ang four-day training program ang ginapatigayon sa ‘Noerr Pole’ ang corporate office sang Noerr Programs sa Colorado.
english: The four-day training program is being conducted at ‘Noerr Pole’ the corporate office of Noerr Programs in Colorado.

text: Suno kay Ruth Rosenquist, public relations director sang Noerr, ang nasambit nga kompaniya ang isa ka digital event imaging provider nga naga-recruit kag naga-train sang kaugalingon nga 70-member Santa Claus team.
english: According to Ruth Rosenquist, public relations director of Noerr, the company is a digital event imaging provider that recruits and trains its own 70-member Santa Claus team.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Wade Burleigh, nagatrabaho bilang professional santa, katuyu-an sang pagtukod sang Santa University amu ang paghatag sang magical experience sa mga bata.
english: Wade Burleigh, who works as a professional santa, said the purpose of establishing Santa University is to provide a magical experience to children.

text: Magluwas diri, ginpahayag ni Burleigh nga ginatudlu-an ang mga Santa kun paano mangin realistic bilang tawo samtang ginatungdan ang trabaho sang isa ka Santa Claus santo sa perception sang kabataan.
english: In addition, Burleigh said the Santas are taught how to be realistic as human beings while playing the role of a Santa Claus based on the perception of children.

text: Milagro ang kinahanglan agud nga islan sang presidential daughter nga si Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio ang iya pamat-od nga magpa-reelect bilang alkalde sang syudad sang Davao.
english: It will take a miracle for the presidential daughter, Davao City Mayor Sara Duterte-Carpio, to change her decision to run for re-election as mayor of Davao City.

text: Ini ang sabat sang iya utod nga si Davao City Vice Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte sang ginpamangkot kun posible ayhan nga maglain ang desisyon ni Sara kag posible ayhan nga magpadalagan ini bilang presidente.
english: This was the answer of her brother, Davao City Vice Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte when asked if it is possible that Sara's decision will change and it is possible that she will run for president.

text: Matandaan nga sang Sabado, Oktubre 2, sang nag-file si Sara sang Certificate of Candidacy (COC) agud magpadalagan liwat sang isa pa ka termino bilang alkalde.
english: It can be recalled that on Saturday, October 2, Sara filed her Certificate of Candidacy (COC) to run for another term as mayor.

text: Sang amo man nga adlaw, nag-file man si Senator Christopher Lawrence ‘Bong’ Go sang COC agud magpadalagan sa pagka-bise presidente sa idalom sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban).
english: On the same day, Senator Christopher Lawrence ‘Bong’ Go also filed his COC to run for vice president under the Philippine Democratic Party–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban).

text: Sang amo man nga adlaw, nakatabinas si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kag namensyonar sini nga SARA-GO sa gihapon ang mapadalagan sa 2022 national elections.
english: On the same day, President Rodrigo Duterte was able to mention that SARA-GO will still run in the 2022 national elections.

text: Wala sang paathag nga nakuha halin kay Sara apang suno sa iya utod nga si Baste, kilala niya si Sara nga wala sini ginasulit kun ano na ang iya nahambal.
english: No explanation was obtained from Sara but according to her brother Baste, he knows Sara and she does not repeat what she has already said.

text: Kun balikan naman ang una nga pahayag ni Sara, isa lang sa ila ni Presidente Duterte ang mapadalagan sa national position apang sang Sabado, nagkumpirma man si Presidente Duterte nga ma-retire na siya sa politika.
english: Going back to Sara's initial statement, only one of them and President Duterte will run for the national position but on Saturday, President Duterte also confirmed that he will retire from politics.

text: Gin-deploy ni U.S. President Donald Trump ang National Guard sa syudad sang Los Angeles agud kontrolon ang mga nagapadayon nga protesta nga kasunod sang ginpatuman sang iya administrasyon nga agresibo nga pagpangdakop sang mga ilegal nga imigrante.
english: U.S. President Donald Trump has deployed the National Guard to the city of Los Angeles to control ongoing protests that follow his administration’s enforced aggressive arrests of illegal immigrants.

text: Sang Biernes pa lang, nagatipon na ang mga raliyista sa guwa sang isa ka immigration holding center sa Alameda, nga nagapahayag sang ila pagpamatok sa ginatawag nila nga “mass arrests” sang mga undocumented immigrants.
english: As recently as Friday, rallyists were gathering outside an immigration holding center in Alameda, voicing their opposition to what they call “mass arrests” of undocumented immigrants.

text: Ang nasambit nga mga pagdakop resulta sang ginpabaskug nga kampanya sang Trump administration sa pagpatuman sang mga layi sa immigration nga nagresulta sa pagkaaresto sang masobra 44,000 ka tawo.
english: These arrests are the result of the Trump administration’s intensified campaign to enforce immigration laws that have resulted in the arrests of more than 44,000 people.

text: Bangud sang kinagamo, ginpadala ang 2,000 ka tropa sang National Guard sa lugar.
english: Due to the unrest, 2,000 National Guard troops were deployed to the area.

text: Naglala ang tensyon sang naggamit ang mga otoridad sang tear gas kag flash bang grenades.
english: Tensions escalated when authorities used tear gas and flash bang grenades.

text: Ginkondenar naman sang League of United Latin American Citizens (LULAC) ang desisyon ni Trump nga gamiton ang National Guard sa amo nga sitwasyon.
english: The League of United Latin American Citizens (LULAC) condemned Trump's decision to use the National Guard in such a situation.

text: Kumpleto na ang line-up ni Concepcion, Iloilo Mayor Dr. Raul Banias para sa iya pagpa-reelect sa 2022 elections.
english: Concepcion's line-up is complete. Raul Banias for his re-election in the 2022 elections.

text: Mangin runningmate ni Banias si Juvy Badiango, isa ka retired professor kag asawa sang anay konsehal sa amo nga banwa.
english: Banias' running mate will be Juvy Badiango, a retired professor and wife of a former councilor in the town.

text:
Yari ang lista sang political aspirants nga magapadalagan bilang konsehal sa idalom sang grupo ni Banias:

Incumbent councilors

Sa Oktubre 7 maga-file sang COC ang grupo ni Banias.
english:
Here is the list of political aspirants who will run as councilors under Banias' group:

Incumbent councilors
