Banias' group will file its COC on October 7.

text: Ginalantaw nga makasumpong ni Banias si Concepcion Vice Mayor Milliard Villanueva nga subong wala pa naka-file sang iya nga COC.
english: Banias is expected to challenge Concepcion Vice Mayor Milliard Villanueva who has not yet filed his COC.

text: Sang nagligad nga eleksyon, nagpadalagan si Banias sa idalom sang PDP-Laban.
english: In the last election, Banias ran under the PDP-Laban.

text: Sa subong, mapapili siya sa idalom sang National Unity Party (NUP) nga amo man ang ginsayluhan ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.
english: He is currently running under the National Unity Party (NUP) which was also replaced by Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Banias, iya ginpahayag nga padayunon niya ang mga programa agud matapna ang kapigaduhon sa amo nga banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Banias said he will continue the programs to curb poverty in the town.

text: “More than anything else, I think this time, mas maayo gid nga doktor anay ang madumala sa aton nga banwa bangud nga may ara pa kita sang pandemya,” pahayag ni Banias.
english: “More than anything else, I think this time, it is better for a doctor to lead our town because we still have a pandemic,” Banias said.

text: Subong nga naga damo na gid ang kaso sang COVID-19 sa bilog nga kalibutan, may mga tawo pa nga ginahimo rason ang nasambit nga balatian agud nga maghimo sang mga butang nga bentaha para sa ila.
english: Now that the number of cases of COVID-19 is increasing around the world, there are still people who use the disease as an excuse to do things that are advantageous for them.

text: Kaangay na lang bala sang 28 anyos nga lalaki sa India nga nagbutig sa iya pamilya nga kuno abi nagpositibo ini sa COVID-19 agud lang nga mabayaan ang iya asawa kag maupod ang iya nga kerida.
english: Like the 28-year-old man in India who lied to his family that he was positive for COVID-19 just to leave his wife and be with his girlfriend.

text: Gintawgan mismo ni Manish Mishra ang iya asawa nga ginpabalo nga positibo ini sa COVID-19 kag indi na sini luyag pa nga mabuhi.
english: Manish Mishra himself called his wife who was informed that she tested positive for COVID-19 and did not want to live anymore.

text: Gilayon man nga nagsala-sala ang iya pamilya bangud ginpatay sini dayon ang iya telepono.
english: His family immediately became suspicious because he immediately turned off his phone.

text: Nagpangayo sang bulig ang asawa sa Navi Mumbai Police agud nga makita ang iya bana kag nakig-angot man ini sa mga abyan sang lalaki kag nahibaluan nga may iban nga babaye si Manish sa sulod sang pila na ka tuig.
english: The wife sought help from Navi Mumbai Police to locate her husband and she also got in touch with the man’s friends and came to know that Manish had been with another woman for several years now.

text: Bangud sa pagpanikasog sang mga kapulisan, nakit-an nila si Manish sa syudad sang Indore kag ginpapauli balik sa iya nga asawa.
english: Thanks to the efforts of the police, they found Manish in Indore city and sent him back to his wife.

text: Desidido nga magpasaka sang kaso ang iloy sang Person With Disability (PWD) nga gin-alegar nga ginhimuslan sang Brgy.
english: The mother of a Person With Disability (PWD) who was allegedly raped by Brgy.

text: Tanod sa Brgy.
english: Tanod in Brgy.

text: San Pedro, Molo, Iloilo City sang Nobyembre 18 sang kaagahon.
english: San Pedro, Molo, Iloilo City on November 18 morning.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Inday, 28, kag may problema sa paminsaron.
english: The victim was identified as Inday, 28, and has mental problems.

text: Samtang, ang suspek amo si Alyas Topel, 48, kag isa ka Brgy.
english: Meanwhile, the suspect was identified as Topel, 48, and a resident of Brgy.

text: Tanod sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: Tanod of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo sa iloy ni Alyas Inday ginpahayag sini nga ipapreso gid niya ang suspek sa ginpahayag nga paghimulos sa iya nga bata.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Inday's mother said she will imprison the suspect for allegedly raping her daughter.

text: Suno sa iya, natulugan ini siya sang tion nga nadula ang iya anak nga si Inday kag ginpangita man ini gilayon sang iya nga stepfather apang wala ini nakita.
english: She said she fell asleep when her daughter Inday went missing and her stepfather immediately searched for her but could not find her.

text: Pagkatapos sang isa ka oras nagpauli ini nga may mga lutak kag didto nagduda ang iya iloy.
english: After an hour he came home with cracks and that’s when his mother got suspicious.

text: Una nga nagpamalibad si alyas Inday nga ginhimuslan ini, apang sa ulihi nagtuad ini sa iya iloy kun sa diin ginatudlo nga suspek amo ang isa ka Brgy.
english: Initially, Inday denied being raped, but later confessed to her mother. The suspect was identified as a Brgy.

text: Tanod.
english: Tanod.

text: Nahibaluan nga gindala ini sang suspek sa cr sang daan nga brgy.
english: It was learned that the suspect took it to the cr of the old brgy.

text: hall sang San Pedro, Molo kag didto natabo ang pa panghimulos.
english: hall of San Pedro, Molo and there the rape took place.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, natigayon man nga nakuhaan sang pahayag ang Punong Barangay sang amo nga lugar nga si Karl John Lapascua angot sa natabo nga paghimulos sang isa niya ka opisyal sa barangay.
english: Meanwhile, the Punong Barangay of the same area, Karl John Lapascua, was also able to get a statement regarding the incident of rape by one of his officials in the barangay.

text: Suno sa iya, wala sini gina-tolerate ang amo nga pinamatasan sa diin tuman na ka eskandaluso sa kadam-an.
english: He said he does not tolerate such behavior which is already scandalous to the public.

text: Pahayag pa niya, ginhingyo sini ang pamilya sang PWD nga bata nga magpaidalom sa Medico-legal agud nga may yara sang basehan kun ano gid man ang natabo.
english: He said he urged the family of the PWD child to undergo medico-legal so that there is a basis for what really happened.

text: Sa subong ginahikot na sang iloy ang mga papeles agud nga maka-file na sang kaso batok kay Alyas Topel nga amo ang suspek sang pagpanghimulos.
english: The mother is now preparing the papers to file a case against Alyas Topel who is the suspect of the rape.

text: Suportado sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang plano nga pagpagguwa sang reward money para sa gilayon nga pag-aresto kay anay AKO Bicol Partylist Representatives Zaldy Co.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) supports the plan to release reward money for the immediate arrest of former AKO Bicol Partylist Representatives Zaldy Co.

text: Suno kay acting PNP chief Lt.
english: According to acting PNP chief Lt.

text: Gen.
english: Gen.

text: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
english: Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.

text: padayon ang ila pakig-angot sa mga nagkalain-lain nga ahensya kaangay sang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) kag Office of the President para sa pag-aresto kay Co.
english: they continue to liaise with various agencies such as the Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) and the Office of the President for the arrest of Co.

text: Dugang pa sini, magapatigayon anay sila sang pormal nga rekomendasyon sa re4ward scheme kag naka-focus sila sa pag-aresto kay Co.
english: He added that they will first conduct a formal recommendation on the re4ward scheme and they are focused on arresting Co.

text: Ang nasambit nga reward ang makabulig sa komunidad para itudlo ang ginatiniran ni Co.
english: The reward will help the community identify the whereabouts of Co.

text: Naghina ang inflation rate sang bugas sang Agosto bangud sa gintingob nga epekto sang ginpanubo nga tariff rates sa imported nga bugas sa nasambit nga bulan.
english: The inflation rate of rice decreased in August due to the combined effect of reduced tariff rates on imported rice in the said month.

text: Suno kay Philippines Statistics Authority (PSA) chief kag National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, ang rice inflation ang nagnubo na lang sa 14.7% sang nagligad nga bulan kun ipaanggid sa 20.9% sang Hulyo.
english: According to Philippines Statistics Authority (PSA) chief and National Statistician Claire Dennis Mapa, rice inflation fell to 14.7% last month compared to 20.9% in July.

text: Ini na ang pinakanubo nga inflation print humalin sang Oktubre 2023 sang marekord ang 13.2%.
english: This is now the lowest inflation print since October 2023 when 13.2% was recorded.

text: Nagsanto ang pagnubo sang rice inflation sang Agosto sa ginalauman nga pagbarato sang presyo sini sa ikaduha nga quarter sang 2024.
english: The decline in rice inflation in August coincided with the expected easing of its price in the second quarter of 2024.

text: Matandaan nga ginpagwa ang Executive Order No.
english: It can be recalled that Executive Order No.

text: 62 nga nagabuhin sa tariff rates sa imported nga bugas sa 15% halin sa 35% nga epekto sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: 62 which reduces tariff rates on imported rice to 15% from 35% effect last month.

text: Kadungan sini, ginpahayag man sang ahensya nga ang pagnubo sa taripa sa imported nga bugas ang magapanubo man sa retail price sa kada kilo sang bugas sang P6 tubtob P7.
english: Meanwhile, the agency said the reduction in tariffs on imported rice will also reduce the retail price per kilo of rice by P6 to P7.

text: Isang sports utility vehicle (SUV) ang nagkalayo matapos nakabunggo sa isa ka poste sa national highway sa Tacurong City.
english: A sports utility vehicle (SUV) caught fire after hitting a pole on the national highway in Tacurong City.

text: Suno sa Tacurong City Police Office, gilayon nga nakagwa ang driver bag-o pa man ginlamon sang kalayo ang salakyan.
english: According to the Tacurong City Police Office, the driver immediately got out before the vehicle was engulfed in flames.

text: Ginapatihan nga natulugan sa pagmaneho ang driver rason kun ngaa nadulaan ini sang control kag nagbunggo sa street lights.
english: It is believed that the driver fell asleep while driving causing him to lose control and hit the street lights.

text: Wala naman sang iban pa nga na-report nga napilasan sa insidente.
english: No other injuries were reported in the incident.

text:
“Very happy and happily married.”

Ini ang status subong ni Angel Locsin apisar pa nga madugay na ini nga wala nakapakita sa publiko kag wala gid sang update sa fans kun kamusta ang iya sitwasyon.
english:
“Very happy and happily married.”

This is the current status of Angel Locsin despite the fact that she has not appeared in public for a long time and there is no update to the fans on how her situation is.

text: Ginklaro ini sang iya best friend nga si Dimples Romana sa pihak sang nagabalik-balik nga espekulasyon nga bulagay na si Angel kag ang iya bana nga si Neil Arce.
english: Her best friend Dimples Romana clarified this despite recurring speculations that Angel and her husband Neil Arce are separated.

text: Pahayag naman ni Dimples, nagakitaay gihapon sila sang beterana nga aktres, kag nakit-an sini nga maayo ang pagtatap ni Neil kay Angel.
english: Dimples said she still sees the veteran actress, and she saw that Neil is taking good care of Angel.

text: Gindugang man sini nga gina-enjoy sang mag-asawa ang ila tyempo nga malayo sa social media.
english: He also added that the couple is enjoying their time away from social media.

text: Pamatuod man ini suno kay Dimples nga indi tanan sa social media ang sarang makabulig gid sa isa ka tawo, kag mahimo gihapon mangin malipayon apisar wala ini.
english: Dimples said this is also proof that not everyone on social media can really help a person, and can still be happy even without it.

text: Nagpahayag man si Dimples nga mangin siya ang nagalaum man nga tapuson na ni Angel ang iya showbiz hiatus bangud madamo na gid nga fans ang nahidlaw sa iya.
english: Dimples also said that she hopes that Angel will end her showbiz hiatus because many fans miss her.

text: “She’s so light hearted and you just feel that she’s very very happy so once na mag-decide siya at pinag dadasal natin ‘yun na malapit na ‘yun, I’m excited that I get to work with her but this time, we get to bond with each other, hindi lang sa personal but sa work,” pahayag ni Dimples.
english: “She’s so light hearted and you just feel that she’s very very happy so once she decides and we pray that it’s almost there, I’m excited that I get to work with her but this time, we get to bond with each other, not just personally but at work,” Dimples said.

text: Si Angel, 38, ang isa sa pinakakilala nga aktres sa Pilipinas kag multi-awarded sa papel sini sa nagkalain-lain nga teleserye kag pelikula kangay sang Darna, Lobo, Love Me Again, In the Name of Love, Unofficially Yours, family drama nga One More Try, spy-action thriller series nga The General’s Daughter, kag madamo nga iban pa.#
english: Angel, 38, is one of the most famous actresses in the Philippines and multi-awarded for her roles in various television series and films such as Darna, Lobo, Love Me Again, In the Name of Love, Unofficially Yours, family drama One More Try, spy-action thriller series The General's Daugh, and many others.

text: Kun may problema ang mga tawo sa tubig, natural lang nga mabatian mo ang wangal diri kag wangal didto bangud isa ini sa aton nagapanguna nga kinahanglanon adlaw-adlaw.
english: When people have problems with water, it is natural to hear the wailing here and the wailing there because it is one of our basic daily needs.

text: Mahimo pa gani nga magsaylo pa kamo sang balay kun tuman gid ka pigado ang tubod sang tubig sa inyo ginatiniran nga lugar!
english: You may even have to move house if the water supply in your area is very poor!

text: Apang didto sa Bihar sa eastern India, isa ka tigulang ang ginbansagan nga “Canal Man” matapos ginpahayag nga 30 ka tuig na siya nga nagakutkot sang 3 ka kilometro nga water canal agud lamang masolusyunan ang kakulang sa tubig sa ila komunidad.
english: But in Bihar in eastern India, an elderly man was nicknamed the “Canal Man” after he allegedly dug a 3-kilometer water canal for 30 years just to solve the water shortage in his community.

text: Ang lalaki amo si Laungi Bhuiyan, nagapuyo sa isa ka nabukid nga bahin sa Kothilawa sa Gaya district kun sa diin tuman ka gamay ang suplay sang tubig bangud nagadiretso sa suba ang tubig-ulan.
english: The man was identified as Laungi Bhuiyan, who lives in a hilly area of ​​Kothilawa in Gaya district where the water supply is very low because rainwater goes straight to the river.

text: Agud madala ang tubig malapit sa iya balay, nadesisyunan ni Laungi nga gamiton ang bisan ano lang nga tools sa ila balay agud makakutkot sang 4 ka tapak nga kalapadon kag 3 ka tapak nga kadalumon nga kanal.
english: Agud madala ang tubig malapit sa iya balay, nadesisyunan ni Laungi nga gamiton ang bisan ano lang nga tools sa ila balay agud makakutkot sang 4 ka tapak nga kalapadon kag 3 ka tapak nga kadalumon nga kanal.

text: Wala sang bisan isa nga nagbulig kay Laungi, apang nagapati siya nga paagi sa iya tumalagsahon nga kapisan, mangin bugana gid ang suplay sang tubig sa ila komunidad kag makasagod sila sang mga sapat kag tanom nga wala sang problema sa tubig.
english: No one helped Laungi, but he believes that through his extraordinary efforts, the water supply in their community will be abundant and they will be able to raise animals and plants without water problems.

text: Kilala subong ang nasambit nga lalaki sa India kag nagahingyo ang mga netizens sa mga sektor kag gobyerno nga suportahan siya sa iya nga gina-obra para sa water canal.
english: The man is now well-known in India and netizens are urging the sectors and government to support him in his work for the water canal.

text: Ginpasalig ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. assured

text: nga padayunon ang mga lihok agud masigurado nga masarangan gihapon sang Filipino consumers ang presyo sang mga balaklon sa pungsod.
english: to continue efforts to ensure that Filipino consumers can still afford the prices of goods in the country.

text: Kabahin ini sang statement sang presidente matapos gin-report sang Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) nga nagtupa sa 3.3 percent ang inflation rate sa Pilipinas sang Agusto nga mas manubo sa 4.4% nga napagkit sang Hulyo.
english: This is part of the president's statement after the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) reported that the inflation rate in the Philippines fell to 3.3 percent in August, lower than the 4.4% recorded in July.

text: Suno kay Marcos, makabig nga kadalag-an para sa kada Pilipino ang mas manubo nga inflation.
english: According to Marcos, lower inflation is a victory for every Filipino.

text: “Ngayong araw, ipinagdiriwang natin ang isang tagumpay para sa bawat Pilipino.
english: “Today, we celebrate a victory for every Filipino.

text: Bumagsak ang inflation sa 3.3% ngayong Agosto mula sa 4.4% noong Hulyo,” pahayag sang chief executive.
english: Inflation fell to 3.3% this August from 4.4% in July,” the chief executive said.

text: Ginplastar sini ang mga tikang sang gobyerno kaangay sang pagbuhin sa taripa sa bugas kag ang pagbukas sang Kadiwa stores.
english: He laid out the government's measures such as the reduction in rice tariffs and the opening of Kadiwa stores.

text: Sa pagbuhin sa taripa suno sa iya, napanubo ang rice inflation halin sa 20.9 percent pa-us-os sa 14.7 percent kag ang meat inflation halin sa 4.8 percent panubo sa 4.0 percent.
english: With the reduction in tariffs, he said, rice inflation was reduced from 20.9 percent to 14.7 percent and meat inflation from 4.8 percent to 4.0 percent.

text: Gindugang man sini nga tuyo sang gobyerno nga pasangkaron pa ang Kadiwa program sa Visayas kag Mindanao para nga mangin kasarangan ang presyo sang basic goods.
english: He added that the government intends to expand the Kadiwa program in the Visayas and Mindanao to moderate the prices of basic goods.

text: Pahayag pa sini, gin-umpisahan naman ang controlled roll-out sang African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccines para masiguro ang bastante nga pork supply kag malikawan ang price hike sa karne sang baboy.
english: He said the controlled roll-out of African Swine Fever (ASF) vaccines has been launched to ensure sufficient pork supply and avoid a price hike in pork.

text: “These are concrete steps we’re taking to make sure that the ‘Bagong Pilipinas’ we promised is felt where it matters most – at home.
english: “These are concrete steps we’re taking to make sure that the ‘Bagong Pilipinas’ we promised is felt where it matters most – at home.

text: We will continue moving forward to ensure that every Filipino will achieve a more comfortable life through quality jobs and affordable goods,” pahayag ni Marcos.
english: We will continue moving forward to ensure that every Filipino will achieve a more comfortable life through quality jobs and affordable goods,” stated Marcos.

text: “Patuloy ang trabaho.
english: “The work continues.

text: Ipagpapatuloy natin ang pag-usad upang matiyak na makakamtan ng bawat Pilipino ang mas komportableng buhay—sa pamamagitan ng dekalidad na trabaho at murang bilihin.
english: We will continue to make progress to ensure that every Filipino can enjoy a more comfortable life—through quality jobs at affordable prices.

text: Para sa bawat Pilipino, para sa Bagong Pilipinas,” dugang sini.
english: For every Filipino, for the New Philippines,” he added.

text: Nahibaluan nga suno sa PSA, ang pagnubo sa inflation sang Agusto ang kasunod man sa paghagan-hagan sa pagsaka sa presyo sa pagkaon kag transportasyon.
english: According to the PSA, the decline in inflation in August also followed the easing of food and transportation price increases.

text: Sulod ang 3.3 percent sa 3.2-to 4-percent nga forecast sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) para sa Agusto.#
english: The 3.3 percent is within the Central Bank of the Philippines' (BSP) 3.2-to-4-percent forecast for August.

text: Pilason ang utod ni Kadayangan Special Geographic Area Mayor Duma Mascud matapos ini nga gin-ambush sa Midsayap, North Cotabato.
english: The brother of Kadayangan Special Geographic Area Mayor Duma Mascud was injured after he was ambushed in Midsayap, North Cotabato.

text: Ang biktima amo si Dhen Mascud.
english: The victim was identified as Dhen Mascud.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, ginamaneho sang biktima ang iya salakyan kag sang pagsampot sa lugar, hinali lang ini nga ginpaulanan sang bala sang wala pa nakilala nga mga indibidwal.
english: According to the investigation, the victim was driving his vehicle and when he arrived at the scene, he was suddenly shot by unidentified individuals.

text: Madasig naman nga nadala sa ospital ang biktima nga nag-angkon sang mga igo sang bala sa lawas.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital with gunshot wounds.

text: Nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga kapulisan sa posible nga motibo kag pagkilala sa mga tawo nga naghimo sang krimen.
english: Police are still investigating the possible motive and identity of the perpetrators.

text: Nakalab-ot naman sa Vietnam ang abilidad sang Filipino-American actress nga si Liza Soberano!
english: Filipino-American actress Liza Soberano's skills have reached Vietnam!

text: Nagpungko si Liza bilang judge sa 1st Ho Chi Minh City International Film Festival sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Liza sat as a judge at the 1st Ho Chi Minh City International Film Festival in that country.

text: Partikular sini nga gintutukan ang First or Second Film Category ukon ang kategorya para sa debut ukon second feature films sang bag-uhan nga directors kag talents halin sa lain-lain nga mga pungsod.
english: It specifically focused on the First or Second Film Category or the category for debut or second feature films by new directors and talents from different countries.

text: Kaupod sang aktres ang Vietnamese-American kag Oscar-winning editor sang “Whiplash” nga si Tom Cross, film producer nga si John Badalu, film director nga si Nguyen Thanh Van kag New York Asian Film Festival Executive Director nga si Samuel Jamier.
english: The actress was joined by Vietnamese-American and Oscar-winning editor of “Whiplash” Tom Cross, film producer John Badalu, film director Nguyen Thanh Van and New York Asian Film Festival Executive Director Samuel Jamier.

text: Sa Instagram, ginpahayag sang aktres nga bugal sini nga mangin isa sa jury members sang inaugural event.
english: On Instagram, the actress said she was proud to be one of the jury members of the inaugural event.

text: “Truly so inspired to continue working in an industry that encourages freedom of expression and challenges the way we think.
english: “Truly so inspired to continue working in an industry that encourages freedom of expression and challenges the way we think.

text: Congratulations to all winners!,” kabahin sang post nga ginkalipay naman sang iya fans.
english: Congratulations to all winners!,” part of the post that was delighted by his fans.

text: Si Liza man ang presenter sang Best Actress award.
english: Liza was also the presenter of the Best Actress award.

text: Sa amo man nga film fest ginkilala ang Pinoy talent paagi sa pelikula ni Sheron Dayoc nga “Gospel of the Beast” nga nagdaog sang Golden Star Award ukon Best Film.
english: At the same film fest, Pinoy talent was recognized through Sheron Dayoc's film “Gospel of the Beast” which won the Golden Star Award or Best Film.

text: Ginpamalabagan sang National Union of Peoples’ Lawyers (NUPL) ang paglubong kay anay Senate President Juan Ponce Enrile sa Libingan ng mga Bayani sa Fort Bonifacio, Taguig City.
english: The National Union of Peoples’ Lawyers (NUPL) has opposed the burial of former Senate President Juan Ponce Enrile at the Libingan ng mga Bayani in Fort Bonifacio, Taguig City.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginsiling sang grupo sa mga human rights lawyers nga ang paglubong kay Enrile sa Libingan ng mga Bayani amo ang pagbalewala sang mga halit nga ginbilin sang martial law.
english: In a statement, the group told human rights lawyers that burying Enrile at the Libingan ng mga Bayani was to ignore the damage left by martial law.

text: Para sa grupo, ang amo nga tikang ang seryoso nga pagtiko sang maragtason nga pahadumdom sa pareho sang rebisyonismo sang ginlubong si anay Pres.
english: For the group, the move is a serious distortion of historical reminders of the likes of revisionism when former Pres.

text: Ferdinand Marcos Sr.
english: Ferdinand Marcos Sr.

text: sa pareho nga sementeryo sang 2016.
english: at the same cemetery in 2016.

text: Ginpanindugan sang grupo nga ang Libingan ng mga Bayani ang indi lulubngan para sa mga nagguba sang domokrasya ukon nagapanguna sa sistematiko nga pag-abuso, kundi ginhimo ini para sa mga nangin inspirasyon kag maayo nga halimbawa nga wala kanday Marcos Sr.
english: The group insisted that the Libingan ng mga Bayani is not a grave for those who destroyed democracy or led systematic abuse, but for those who became an inspiration and a good example without Marcos Sr.

text: kag Enrile.
english: and Enrile.

text: Suno sa grupo, si Enrile nga nagserbe bilang defense minister sa idalom sang Marcos Se.
english: According to the group, Enrile, who served as defense minister under Marcos Se.

text: ang siya nanguna sa sentro sang martial law, kaangay sang lapnagon nga pag-aresto, pagpriso, torture, pagkadula sang mga indibidwal, media shutdowns, kag pagpuhag sang mga sibili.
english: he presided over the center of martial law, such as widespread arrests, imprisonment, torture, disappearances, media shutdowns, and displacement of civilians.

text: Subong nga adlaw, ginpatigayonh ang necrological service para kay Enrile sa Senado bilang anay Senate President.
english: Today, a necrological service was held for Enrile in the Senate as former Senate President.

text: Ginaduso nga pasangkaron pa ang produksyon sang isda kag manok sa pungsod bangud sa risgo nga dala sang liwat nga pagbalik sang African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak.
english: It is proposed to expand fish and poultry production in the country due to the risk of a resurgence of the African Swine Fever (ASF) outbreak.

text: Suno sa Philippine Rural Reconstruction Movement (PRRM), mabutang sa alang-alang ang food security sang Pilipinas ilabi na bangud 450 na ka mga barangay ang may aktibo liwat nga kaso sang amo nga balatian sa baboy.
english: According to the Philippine Rural Reconstruction Movement (PRRM), the food security of the Philippines will be put at risk especially since 450 barangays have active cases of the disease in swine.

text: Suno kay PRRM president Edicio dela Torre, dapat nga magsaka ang produksyon sang iban nga protein sources para malab-ot gihapon ang demand sa palaabuton nga holiday season.
english: According to PRRM president Edicio dela Torre, production of other protein sources should increase to meet demand in the upcoming holiday season.

text: Sa subong, mas daku ang inventory sang imported dressed chicken sa cold storage facilities ipaanggid sa local produce.
english: Currently, there is a larger inventory of imported dressed chicken in cold storage facilities compared to local produce.

text: Sandig sa data sang National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS), ang inventory ang nagdangat sa 31,917 metric tons sang nagligad nga semana kun sa diin 68% ang imported kag 10,315 MT naman ang locally produced.
english: According to the data of the National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS), the inventory reached 31,917 metric tons last week of which 68% was imported and 10,315 MT was locally produced.

text: Kadam-an sa imported dressed chicken ang yara sa Calabarzon, Central Luzon kag Metro Manila.
english: Most of the imported dressed chicken is in Calabarzon, Central Luzon and Metro Manila.

text: Bangud sini suno sa grupo, dapat man nga buhinan na ang importasyon kag magtutok na lang sa local production.
english: Because of this, the group said, imports should be reduced and focus on local production.

text: Ginalauman nga magadangat ang total chicken production sa 2.26 million metric tons sa yearend, apang 1.68 million MT lamang ang demand kag ginapanan-aw nga ang ending stock ang magatupa sa 780,000 MT.
english: Total chicken production is expected to reach 2.26 million metric tons this yearend, but demand is only 1.68 million MT and ending stock is expected to fall to 780,000 MT.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa bahin sang hog industry, ginhingyo sang hograisers’ groups sa Department of Agriculture (DA) nga dasig-dasigon man ang vaccination sa mga baboy para mapunggan ang dugang nga kapierdehan sa swine industry kag indi man tuman nga maapektuhan liwat ang local pork production kag ang supply.#
english: On the part of the hog industry, hograisers' groups urged the Department of Agriculture (DA) to expedite the vaccination of pigs to prevent further losses in the swine industry and not to affect local pork production and supply.

text: USA – Nagapangita ka bala sang ka date ukon mangin ka partner for life?
english: USA – Are you looking for a date or a partner for life?

text: Isa ka kompaniya sa New York sa Estados Unidos ang may pinasahi nga ginatanyag para sa mga single.
english: A company in New York in the United States has a special offer for singles.

text: Ang nasambit nga matchmaking service ang ginatawag nga ‘Smell Dating’.
english: The said matchmaking service is called ‘Smell Dating’.

text: Ini ang ka pareho sang blind date apang ang pagpili sang mangin ka date ang paagi sa pagsimhot sang body odor ukon baho sang isa ka tawo.
english: It's like a blind date but choosing a date is by smelling someone's body odor.

text: Ang Smell Dating ang gintukod nanday Tega Brain, isa ka artist kag manunudlo sa New York’s School for Poetic Computation kag Sam Lavigne, isa ka editor kag researcher sa New York University.
english: Smell Dating was founded by Tega Brain, an artist and teacher at New York’s School for Poetic Computation and Sam Lavigne, an editor and researcher at New York University.

text: Ang duha ang nag-umpisa sa 100 ka mga customer kun sa diin ang kada isa ang nagbayad sang tag $25 ukon masobra sa P1,200.
english: The two started with 100 customers who each paid $25 each or more than P1,200.

text: Ang mga customer ang ginapadal-an sang kompaniya sang T-shirt nga ila suksukon sa sulod sang tatlo ka adlaw.
english: Customers are sent T-shirts by the company to wear for three days.

text: Ang amo nga mga tshirt ang kinahanglan nga ibalik sa sweat shop sang kompaniya kag ini ang pagaguntingon sa magagmay nga parte.
english: Such tshirts will have to be returned to the company's sweat shop and they will be cut into small parts.

text: Ang gingunting nga bayo ang ipadala naman sa mga customer kag ila ini simhutan kag kun nakapili na sila, ang kompaniya mismo ang magaset-up sang date.
english: The cut clothes will be sent to the customers and they will smell them and once they have chosen, the company itself will set-up the date.

text: Bangud sa pinasahi nga dating service sang kompaniya, madamo ang gusto nga makaeksperyensya sini.
english: Due to the company’s unique dating service, many people want to experience it.

text: Ginpamatukan nanday Senador Alan Peter Cayetano kag Joel Villanueva ang pag-apruba sa ikaduha nga pagbasa sang ginaproponer nga 2026 National Budget.
english: Senators Alan Peter Cayetano and Joel Villanueva opposed the approval in the second reading of the proposed 2026 National Budget.

text: Gin-aprubahan sa plenaryo sang Senado sa 2nd reading ang 2026 General Appropriations Bill nga nagabalor sang P6.793 trillion.
english: The Senate plenary approved in 2nd reading the 2026 General Appropriations Bill worth P6.793 trillion.

text: Nagboto sang No sanday Cayetano kag Villanueva bangud nakabutang sa gihapon sa proposed ang budget ang unprogrammed appropriations nga naga-gamit para pondohan ang mga ghost projects.
english: Cayetano and Villanueva voted No because the proposed budget still includes unprogrammed appropriations used to fund ghost projects.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagpromisa ang Senate Minority Leader nga makig-angot sa gihapon sa majority bloc, ilabi na sa Bicameral Conference Committee kaupod ang mga myembro sang House of Representatives.
english: Meanwhile, the Senate Minority Leader promised to continue to engage with the majority bloc, especially the Bicameral Conference Committee with members of the House of Representatives.

text: Ginsiling man ni Villanueva nga ginasuportahan niya ang posisyon ni Cayetano.
english: Villanueva also said he supports Cayetano's position.

text: Natalana nga i-roll out sang Department of Agriculture (DA) ang bag-o nga credit program sa masunod nga bulan sa balor nga P60,000 sa manubo nga interest rate sa mga rice farmers agud gastuhan ang ila input needs kag monthly expenses samtang nagahulat sang tig-alani.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is scheduled to roll out the new credit program next month worth P60,000 at a low interest rate to rice farmers to finance their input needs and monthly expenses while waiting for the harvest.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., katuyuan sini nga mapasanyog ang productivity sang irrigated farm lands.
english: According to Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the purpose of this is to increase the productivity of irrigated farm lands.

text: Target sang ahensya ang 50,000 ka mga mangunguma nga may yara sang irrigated lands para sa inisyal nga implementasyon sang programa.
english: The agency targets 50,000 farmers with irrigated lands for the initial implementation of the program.

text: Sa idalom sang programa nga ginatawag Agri-Puhunan at Pantawid, ang kada mangunguma nga kabahin sang irrigators’ associations ang magabaton sang P60,000 nga may interest rate nga two percent.
english: Under the program called Agri-Phununan at Pantawid, each farmer who is part of the irrigators’ associations will receive P60,000 with an interest rate of two percent.

text: Sa amo nga amount, ang P28,000 ang gamiton sa pagbakal sang binhi kag fertilizer samtang ang P22,000 ang mahimo nga i- withdraw kada bulan agud may gamiton sa adlaw-adlaw nga gasto samtang nagahulat sang ila patubas.
english: Of the amount, P28,000 will be used to purchase seeds and fertilizer while P22,000 can be withdrawn monthly to cover daily expenses while waiting for their harvest.

text: Ang mga farmers nga mag-enroll sa programa ang hatagan man sang insurance agud protektahan ang ila pananom gikan sa indi mapaktan nga sirkumstansya kaangay sang natural nga kalamidad.
english: Farmers who enroll in the program will also be provided with insurance to protect their crops from unpredictable circumstances such as natural disasters.

text: Wala pa sang kumpirmasyon halin sa Gilas Pilipinas apang daku ang paglaum nga makahampang si Kai Sotto sa semifinals sang FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament kasunod sang pagpa-check sini sa ospital bangud sa insidente nga natabo sa hampang sang national team batok sa Georgia.
english: There is no confirmation from Gilas Pilipinas but Kai Sotto is expected to play in the semifinals of the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament following his check-up at the hospital due to an incident that occurred in the national team's match against Georgia.

text: Sa 6:42-mark sang ikaduha nga quarter sa Riga Arena sa Latvia sang Huwebes sang gab-i, natumba kag napintalan si Sotto sang Georgian star nga si Goga Bitadze kag wala na nakabalik pa sa hampang.
english: At the 6:42-mark of the second quarter at the Riga Arena in Latvia on Thursday night, Sotto was knocked down and pinned by Georgian star Goga Bitadze and never returned to the game.

text: Kasunod sang pagbisita sa ospital, nakumpirma nga wala sang rib fracture si Sotto kag wala man sang injuries sa internal organs ukon sa parte sang iya lawas nga nagsalo gid sa bug-at ni Bitadze.
english: Following a visit to the hospital, it was confirmed that Sotto had no rib fractures and no injuries to internal organs or parts of his body that were severely affected by Bitadze's weight.

text: Ginpahayag nga indi na tuman ka budlay para sa 7-foot-3 center sang Gilas nga maghulag subong apang bilang kabahin sang treatment plan, ginpasuksok ini sang patch kag protective compression wear nga may hex foam pads.
english: It was reportedly not too difficult for the 7-foot-3 Gilas center to move now but as part of the treatment plan, he was made to wear a patch and protective compression wear with hex foam pads.

text: Mismo si Sotto ang nagsiling nga nagalaum siya sa “Milagro” para maka-upod siya sa Gilas sa masunod nga hampang.
english: Sotto himself said he hopes for a “Miracle” to join the Gilas in the next game.

text: Matandaan nga nagpangaduha si Sotto kay Justin Brownlee sa pinakamataas nga puntos sa 89-80 nga maragtason nga pagdaog sang Pilipinas batok sa world no.
english: Sotto finished second to Justin Brownlee in the Philippines' 89-80 historic win over world no.

text: 6 nga Latvia sa opening match sa Olympic qualifiers.
english: 6 Latvia in the opening match of the Olympic qualifiers.

text: 18 puntos kag walo ka rebounds ang nabubo sini batok sa European squad, apang sa hampang batok sa Georgia, yara lamang sa 4 points kag 2 blocks ang iya nahimo bangud sa 11 minutos lamang kag 49 segundos nga pagtinir sini sa sambuwa.

text: Subong nga bulan sang Setyembre, masobra 500,000 nga mga high school graduates sa Sudan ang makuha sang university admission exams kag agud nga indi maka-cheat ang mga estudyante pinaagi sa mobile internet, ini ang i-shutdown nationwide sa sulod sang tatlo ka oras kada adlaw.

english: This was a move by the Sudanese authorities to prevent the large scale exam cheating from happening three years ago when the exam question was leaked online.

text: Kada adlaw, humalin alas 8 tubtob alas 11 sang aga, gina-shutdown ang mobile internet sa diin ginabanta 13 million data subscribers ang apektado.

english: According to the First Lady’s Facebook post with the caption, “An evening with James Taylor”, the date took place last Monday, April 8, at the Mall of Asia.

english:

english: According to the management of the said zoo, the purpose of their program is to bring closer bonding between the animals and those who care for them.

text: Magluwas diri, isa man ini ka paagi agud ma-discover kag ma-develop ang iban pa nga kinaadman sang mga sapat kasubong sang Seal, Elepante, Amo, Parrot, Giraffe, Kanding kag Kulunaknit.
english: In addition, it is also a way to discover and develop other knowledge of animals such as Seal, Elephant, Amo, Parrot, Giraffe, Goat and Kulunaknit.

text: Ang matipon nga pondo gikan sa auction ang para sa educational program sang mga estudyante nga gina-sponsoran sang nasambit nga zoo.
english: The funds raised from the auction will be used for the educational program of the students sponsored by the zoo.

english: A concerned citizen called the police for help and responded to the crime scene and arrested the suspect.

english: To use me and my sister VP Sara to divert the truth, passing the blame and mislead the Filipino people is highly unacceptable and deplorable,” it said.
