text: Kun sa Japan, may yara sang Hachiko, ang ido nga naghulat sang pila ka tuig sa iya nga amo matapos ini magtaliwan, sa California naman aton kilalahon si Odin.
english: If in Japan, there is Hachiko, the dog who waited for several years for his master after he passed away, in California we will meet Odin.

text: Sang ginlamon sang kalayo ang balay ni Roland Handel sa California, ang tag-iya nga nagatatap sa ido nga si Odin, kinahanglan niya nga magdesisyon kun bala piliton ang iya hinuptanan nga ido nga pasudlon ini sa salakyan ukon pabay-an na lamang ini bangud sa nagadako nga kalayo sa lugar.
english: When fire engulfed the home of Roland Handel in California, the owner who cared for the dog, Odin, had to decide whether to force his pet dog into the car or leave it alone due to the growing fire in the area.

text: Si Odin amo ang nagabantay sa walo ka mga kanding sang pamilya.
english: Odin is the guardian of the family’s eight goats.

text: Suno kay Handel, sang gab-i nga ginalamon na sang sunog ang ila lugar, indi gid maghalin ang ido sa mga kanding — bisan ano nga pilit kay Odin, nagapakatig-a ini nga maghalin sa lugar sa diin nagpungko pa ini sa atubang sang mga kanding kag wala naga hulag-hulag.
english: According to Handel, on the night that the fire was engulfing their area, the dog would not leave the goats — no matter how much Odin was forced, he refused to leave the place where he sat in front of the goats and did not move.

text: Wala na sang oras ang tag-iya nga salbaron pa ang mga kanding bangud tuman ka delikado gani iya na desisyonan nga maghalin na sa lugar kaupod ang iya 14 anyos nga bata.
english: The owner did not have time to save the goats because they were so dangerous that he decided to leave the area with his 14-year-old son.

text: Kaupod ni Handel sa pag-evacuate amo ang tatlo pa nila nga ido kag duha ka mga kuring.
english: Along with Handel in the evacuation were their three other dogs and two cats.

text: Indi man kuntani niya luyag nga ibilin si Odin kag walo ka mga kanding apang wala siya sang may mahimo bangud mahimo man nga mabutang sa peligro ang ila kaugalingon sang iya anak.
english: She hadn't wanted to leave Odin and eight goats behind but she had no choice as her son could put themselves in danger as well.

text: Apisar sini, tuman ang pagpangamuyo sang tag-iya kag nagalaom nga yara lang sa maayo nga sitwasyon si Odin kag mga kanding.
english: Despite this, the owner prayed a lot and hoped that Odin and the goats were in a good situation.

text: Isa ka adlaw ang nagligad kag nagbalik si Handel sa ila nga lugar, nakit-an niya nga sunog na ang iya balay magluwas lang sa nagahulat sa iya.
english: A day later, when Handel returned to his hometown, he found his house on fire except for the one waiting for him.

text: Naglumaw-lumaw ang mata ni Handel bangud sa iya nakit-an.
english: Handel's eyes widened at what he saw.

text: Buhi ang iya ido nga si Odin kag kumpleto man ang walo ka mga kanding.
english: His dog Odin was alive and the eight goats were complete.

text: Daw indi makapati si Handel sa iya nakita gani tuman na lang ang kasadya nga iya nabatyagan.
english: Handel couldn't believe his eyes and was overjoyed.

text: Gindalagan niya ang iya ido, ginkup-an kag gin-halukan.
english: She ran to her dog, hugged him and kissed him.

text: May nakita nga minor nga mga pilas tuga sang kalayo sa lawas ni Odin.
english: Minor fire injuries were found on Odin's body.

text: Pahayag ni Handel, apisar nadula kag nasunog ang iya balay, wala siya sang iban nga nabatyagan kundi lunsay kalipay kag pagpasalamatan sa Diyos.
english: Handel said that despite the loss and burning of his house, he felt nothing but joy and gratitude to God.

text: Sa subong, naka-recover na si Odin kag nagbalik man ang iya nga kapagsik.
english: Now, Odin has recovered and his vitality has returned.

text: Padayunon ni Pharmally Pharmaceuticals Corporation director Linconn Ong ang iya detention sa Senado pagkatapos sang kapin duha ka semana nga pagka-house arrest matapos na-infect sang COVID-19.
english: Pharmally Pharmaceuticals Corporation director Linconn Ong will continue his detention in the Senate after more than two weeks of house arrest after being infected with COVID-19.

text: ‘las tres kahapon sang hapon sang nag-abot si Ong sa Senate Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms (OSAA) matapos nga gin-aresto mismo sang OSAA security officers sa iya balay.
english: Ong arrived at the Senate Office of the Sergeant-at-Arms (OSAA) at 3 pm yesterday after being arrested by OSAA security officers at his house.

text: Matandaan nga ginpatigayon ang pag-aresto samtang naga-attend virtually si Ong sang hearing sa Senate Blue Ribbon committee nga ginapamunuan ni Senator Richard J, Gordon.
english: The arrest was made while Ong was virtually attending a hearing in the Senate Blue Ribbon committee headed by Senator Richard J. Gordon.

text: Septyembre 10 pa sang nagmandu ang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee nga arestuhon si Ong bangud sa iya pagpalagyo kag pagbinutig sa mga pamangkot sang Senado sa hearing sang ginapahayag anomalous purchase sang gobyerno sang medical supplies kun sa diin contractor ang Pharmally.
english: On September 10, the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee ordered Ong's arrest for fleeing and lying to Senate questions during the hearing of the government's alleged anomalous purchase of medical supplies for which Pharmally was a contractor.

text: Una nga nagsugot si Gordon nga i-house arrest lang anay si Ong bangud nagsuprer ini sa COVID-19.
english: Gordon initially agreed to place Ong under house arrest because he was suffering from COVID-19.

text: Magasulod sa San Antonio Spurs ang veteran point guard kag 12-time NBA All-Star nga si Chris Paul matapos ini nga gin-waive sang Golden States Warriors.
english: Veteran point guard and 12-time NBA All-Star Chris Paul will join the San Antonio Spurs after he was waived by the Golden States Warriors.

text: Ginalantaw nga siya ang mangin starting point guard sang team kag makabulig bilang playmaker sa San Antonio star kag 7ft 4in center nga si Victor Wembanyama kag magadugang man sa pwersa sang four-year veteran nga si Tre Jones nga amo ang point guard.
english: He is expected to be the team’s starting point guard and help as a playmaker to San Antonio star and 7ft 4in center Victor Wembanyama and will also add to the force of four-year veteran Tre Jones at point guard.

text: Isa ka season ang gintinir ni Paul sa San Francisco kun sa diin nangin backcourt mate kag backup siya sa superstar nga si Stephen Curry.
english: Paul spent one season in San Francisco where he became a backcourt mate and backup to superstar Stephen Curry.

text: Sa 58 games lakip na ang 18 sang nagligad nga season, may average siya nga 9.2 points, 6.8 assists, 3.9 rebounds, 1.3 turnovers kag 1.2 steals per game.
english: In 58 games including 18 last season, he averaged 9.2 points, 6.8 assists, 3.9 rebounds, 1.3 turnovers and 1.2 steals per game.

text: 39-anyos na ang edad ni CP3 kag malayo na ang scoring abilities sa iya All-Star prime apang ginalantaw nga maayo gihapon nga playmaker kag floor general.
english: CP3 is 39 years old and his scoring abilities are far from his All-Star prime but he is still seen as a good playmaker and floor general.

text: Sandig sa inisyal nga reports, nagsugtanay si Paul kag ang Spurs sa kontrata nga isa ka tuig kag $11 million-plus.
english: According to initial reports, Paul and the Spurs have agreed to a one-year, $11 million-plus contract.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, isa naman ka free agent ang Golden State star guard nga si Klay Thompson.
english: Meanwhile, Golden State star guard Klay Thompson is another free agent.

text: Ang nasambit nga 13-year NBA veteran ang ginabati-bati nga gina-istorya sang Dallas, Philadelphia, Clippers kag Los Angeles Lakers.
english: The 13-year NBA veteran is rumored to be in talks with Dallas, Philadelphia, the Clippers and the Los Angeles Lakers.

text: Patay ang 21 ka mga atleta matapos nadulaan sang kontrol ang ginasakyan nila nga bus kag nahulog halin sa taytay sa Kura, Nigeria.
english: Twenty-one athletes were killed after their bus lost control and fell off a bridge in Kura, Nigeria.

text: Naghalin ang mga atleta sa National Sports Festival sa Ogun State kag pauli na sang matabo ang aksidente sang Sabado, Mayo 31.
english: The athletes had left the National Sports Festival in Ogun State and were on their way home when the accident happened on Saturday, May 31.

text: May sakay nga 35 ka pasahero ang bus kag kalabanan ang mga atleta kag opisyal.
english: The bus was carrying 35 passengers, mostly athletes and officials.

text: Ang National Sports Festival ang nagapanguna nga multi-sport event sa Nigeria kun sa diin naghalin pa sa nanuhay-tuhay nga states ang mga atleta nga nagapasakop diri.
english: The National Sports Festival is the leading multi-sport event in Nigeria with athletes from different states participating.

text: Nanari-sari ang paagi sang mga business owners agud masustiner ang ila negosyo subong nga may COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Business owners have a variety of ways to sustain their businesses during the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Didto sa isa ka sushi restaurant sa Japan, lawas ang ginakapital agud mangin daku ang income kag magbakal sa gihapon ang mga customer.
english: In a sushi restaurant in Japan, the body is capitalized to increase income and keep customers buying.

text: Ang 60 anyos nga restaurant sa syudad sang Anjo sa Aichi Prefecture sa Japan ang ginapanag-iyahan ni Masanori Sugiura.
english: The 60-year-old restaurant in the city of Anjo in Aichi Prefecture in Japan is owned by Masanori Sugiura.

text: Suno kay Masanori, tuman ka daku ang pierde sang iya negosyo kag halin sa 50 ka mga staff, apat na lang ang nabilin bangud wala na siya sang inugpasweldo.
english: According to Masanori, his business has suffered a huge loss and out of 50 staff, only four are left because he has nothing to pay.

text: Bangud sini nga mga kapierdehan, naisipan sang tag-iya nga gamiton ang iya hobby sa pag-work out sa gym agud makahimo sang paagi.
english: Due to these losses, the owner decided to use his hobby of working out at the gym to make a way.

text: Ini ang gintawag nga Delivery Macho service kun sa diin ginagamit niya ang buff bodybuilders bilang delivery boys.
english: This is called Delivery Macho service where he uses buff bodybuilders as delivery boys.

text: Mismo ang mga gym buddies sang tag-iya ang nagbulig sa iya sa bag-o nga Delivery Macho service kag bangud ginakilig ang mga babayi kag ginapicturan sila, nangin viral ang restaurant kag nagdamo liwat ang orders.
english: The owner's own gym buddies helped him with the new Delivery Macho service and because the women were excited and taking pictures of them, the restaurant became viral and orders increased again.

text: Sa subong, ang nasambit nga sushi restaurant ang may ara sang walo tubtob napulo ka Delivery Macho orders kada adlaw kag bangud sini, ang monthly revenue sa service ang yara na sa 1.5 million yen ukon masobra P680,000.
english: Currently, the said sushi restaurant has eight to ten Delivery Macho orders per day and as a result, the monthly revenue from the service is now 1.5 million yen or more than P680,000.

text: Madugangan pa ang pwersa sang Philadelphia 76ers sa National Basketball Association (NBA) matapos nakuha sini ang 34-anyos kag nine-time All-Star nga si Paul George para sa apat ka tuig kag $212 million ukon P12.46-billion nga free-agent contract.
english: The Philadelphia 76ers will increase their strength in the National Basketball Association (NBA) after signing 34-year-old nine-time All-Star Paul George to a four-year, $212 million or P12.46-billion free-agent contract.

text: Natalana nga pirmahan ni George ang kontrata kun matapos na ang moratorium on signings sang NBA sa Hulyo 6.
english: George is scheduled to sign the contract when the NBA's moratorium on signings ends on July 6.

text: Makaupod na sini sa Philadelphia ang 2023 NBA MVP nga si Joel Embiid kag ang All-Star guard nga si Tyrese Maxey nga amo man ang ginalantaw nga mangin kabahin sang “most formidable trios” sa liga.
english: That will now join Philadelphia with 2023 NBA MVP Joel Embiid and All-Star guard Tyrese Maxey who are also projected to be part of the “most formidable trios” in the league.

text: Antes sa 76ers, lima ka tuig si George sa Los Angeles Clippers kag naka-average sang at least 21.5 points kada season.
english: Before the 76ers, George spent five years with the Los Angeles Clippers and averaged at least 21.5 points per season.

text: Sa 14 ka tuig sini nga karera, nakaupod man ini sa Indiana kag sa Oklahoma City.
english: In this 14-year career, he also played for Indiana and Oklahoma City.

text: Nangin six-time member siya sang All-NBA Team; four-time member sang NBA All-Defensive Team; kag nangin most improved player sang NBA sang 2013.
english: He was a six-time member of the All-NBA Team; four-time member of the NBA All-Defensive Team; and was named the NBA’s most improved player in 2013.

text: Nangin finalist man si George sa NBA MVP kag Defensive Player of the Year sang 2019 sang nagpanguna ini sa liga sang amo nga tion nga may 2.21 steals per contest.
english: George was also a finalist for NBA MVP and Defensive Player of the Year in 2019 when he led the league at the time with 2.21 steals per contest.

text: Nagsirado sang mabaskog ang Philippine peso sa katapusan sang trading day subong nga Agosto apisar sang projection sang bangko sentral nga nagnubo ang inflation subong nga bulan.
english: The Philippine peso closed strongly at the end of the trading day this August despite the central bank's projection that inflation will decline this month.

text: Bangud diri, ang local currency nagsaka sang P17.2 centavos batok sa US dollar, nga nagsirado sa P56.11 sang Biyernes gikan sa P56.28 sang Huwebes.
english: As a result, the local currency rose by P17.2 centavos against the US dollar, closing at P56.11 on Friday from P56.28 on Thursday.

text: Suno sa chief economist nga si Michael Ricafort, ang pagsirado sang peso sang Agosto 30 amo ang pinakamabaskog sa sulod sang lima ka bulan sang ini ang nagsirado sa P56.03 per $1 sang Marso 21, 2024.
english: According to chief economist Michael Ricafort, the peso's closing on August 30 was the strongest in five months when it closed at P56.03 per $1 on March 21, 2024.

text: Sa iya forecast, ang BSP nagsiling nga ang inflation rate sa Agosto mahimo nga mag-untat sa sulod sang 3.2% tubtob 4%, isa ka paghinay halin sa 4.4% nga nakit-an sang Hulyo.
english: In its forecast, the BSP said the inflation rate in August is likely to hover in a range of 3.2% to 4%, a slowdown from the 4.4% seen in July.

text: Nagbalibad si Davao City First District Rep.
english: Davao City First District Rep.

text: Paolo Duterte nga mag-atubang sa imbestigasyon sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) kaangot sa mga ginapahayag nga iregularidad sa flood control projects.
english: Paolo Duterte to face the investigation of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) regarding alleged irregularities in flood control projects.

text: Sa ginsapubliko nga sulat sang kongresista kay ICI Chair Andres Reyes Jr., ginpahayag sini nga wala sang gahum ang panel nga ipatawag siya bilang mamalidha.
english: In a public letter to ICI Chair Andres Reyes Jr., the congressman said the panel has no power to summon him as a lawmaker.

text: “I am a sitting member of Congress.
english: “I am a sitting member of Congress.

text: Considering that ICI is a creation of President Marcos, Jr.
english: Considering that ICI is a creation of President Marcos, Jr.

text: per E.O. No.
english: per E.O. No.

text: 94, the ICI appears without power nor jurisdiction over me,” kabahin sang iya statement.
english: 94, the ICI appears without power nor jurisdiction over me,” part of his statement.

text: Gintawag man sini nga “vague and ambiguous” ang request sang ICI nga mag-atubang siya sa ila.
english: He also called the ICI’s request for him to appear before them “vague and ambiguous”.

text: Ginlakip man ni Duterte sa iya sulat ang mga alegasyon batok kay President Bongbong Marcos Jr., iya pamilya, kag former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Duterte also included in his letter allegations against President Bongbong Marcos Jr., his family, and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: “I feel that ICI must immediately investigate President Marcos Jr., his family and ex-Speaker Romualdez, forthwith, most especially flood control and other infrastructure projects in Regions I and VIII from 2022 to 2025, and incidentally all projects prior thereto from 2000 to 2025,” suno pa kay Duterte.
english: “I feel that ICI must immediately investigate President Marcos Jr., his family and ex-Speaker Romualdez, forthwith, most especially flood control and other infrastructure projects in Regions I and VIII from 2022 to 2025, and incidentally all projects prior thereto from 2000 to 2025,” Duter said.

text: Matandaan nga gin-akusaran ni resigned lawmaker Elizaldy Co sanday Marcos kag Romualdez nga nagabaton sang kuwarta halin sa budget insertions sa 2025 national budget.
english: It can be recalled that resigned lawmaker Elizaldy Co accused Marcos and Romualdez of receiving money from budget insertions in the 2025 national budget.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Congressman Duterte ginagamit ang inquiry para i-harass siya kag si Vice President Sara Duterte antes ang 2028 presidential, national, kag local elections.
english: Congressman Duterte said the inquiry is being used to harass him and Vice President Sara Duterte before the 2028 presidential, national, and local elections.

text: Gintawag sini ang ICI nga paagi ni President Marcos kag isa ka “pure political propaganda” agud nga paluyahon kag gub-on si VP Sara, former President Rodrigo Duterte, kag ang ila nga pamilya.
english: He called the ICI a means of President Marcos and a “pure political propaganda” to weaken and destroy VP Sara, former President Rodrigo Duterte, and their families.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagapangatubang ang Davao City districts sang alegasyon nga may P4.44 billion nga balor sang anomalous flood control projects halin sang 2019 tubtub sang 2022.
english: It is known that Davao City districts are facing allegations of P4.44 billion worth of anomalous flood control projects from 2019 to 2022.

text: Naghingyo anay si Rep.
english: Earlier, Rep.

text: Antonio Tinio (ACT Teachers Party-list) sa ICI sang December 2 nga imbestigaran man ang 80 flood control contracts sa Davao bangud sa ginaalegar nga “double funding,” “overpricing,” kag mga proyekto nga wala gihapon natapos.#
english: Antonio Tinio (ACT Teachers Party-list) to ICI on December 2 to also investigate 80 flood control contracts in Davao due to alleged “double funding,” “overpricing,” and projects that are still not completed.

text: Isa ka 17-anyos nga dalagita nga TikTok star sa Pakistan ang ginluthang-patay sa iya nga balay sa Islamabad, Pakistan.
english: A 17-year-old Pakistani TikTok star was shot dead in her home in Islamabad, Pakistan.

text: Ginatudlo nga suspek amo ang lalaki nga madugay na nga nagatuyo nga makig-angot sa iya online.
english: The suspect is believed to be the man who has been trying to contact her online for a long time.

text: Natabo ang krimen pila ka adlaw lang matapos ini nga nagselebrar sang iya birthday.
english: The crime occurred just days after he celebrated his birthday.

text: May masobra isa ka milyon nga followers sa iya nga social media accounts si Yousaf, kalakip na ang 800,000 nga followers sa TikTok.
english: Yousaf has more than a million followers on his social media accounts, including 800,000 followers on TikTok.

text: Natigayon nga madakpan ang suspek nga 22-anyos.
english: The 22-year-old suspect was arrested.

text: Ginpahayag nga masami makit-an ang lalaki nga nagalibot sa balay sang biktima.
english: The man was reportedly seen walking around the victim's house.

text: Suno sa Human Rights Commission sa Pakistan, ordinary na ang mga kalakasan sa kababainhan sa amo nga pungsod kalakip na ang pag-atake sa mga babaye nga nagapamalibad sa tanyag nga kasal.
english: According to the Human Rights Commission in Pakistan, violence against women is commonplace in the country, including attacks on women who refuse marriage offers.

text: Sang 2021, isa ka babaye ang gin-utdan sang liog sang iya nga nobyo matapos niya nga namalibad sa kasal.
english: In 2021, a woman was beheaded by her boyfriend after he refused to marry her.

text: Nag-resign si former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Babes Singson sa Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) bangud sa isyu sa ikaayong lawas.
english: Former DPWH secretary Babes Singson resigned from the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) over health issues.

text: Ginpahayag ni ICI chair Andres Reyes nga ang intense kag stressful nga trabaho sa ICI ang may epekto sa lawas ni Singson.
english: ICI chair Andres Reyes said the intense and stressful work at ICI had an impact on Singson's body.

text: Suno kay ICI chair Andres Reyes, magaepekto ang resignation ni Singson sa December 15, apang mahimo ma-extend tubtob December 31.
english: According to ICI chair Andres Reyes, Singson's resignation will take effect on December 15, but can be extended until December 31.

text: Ginsiling naman ni Reyes nga sa pihak sang resignation ni Singson, makasalig gihapon ang publiko sa ICI kag ginpahayag nga ang mga kaso kag ebidensya nga ila gin-file ang pamatuod sang ila trabaho.
english: Reyes said that despite Singson's resignation, the public can still trust the ICI and said the cases and evidence they filed are proof of their work.

text: Ang ila imbestigasyon magapadayon suno kay Reyes.
english: Their investigation will continue, Reyes said.

text: AUSTRALIA – Nakahibalo ka bala kun ano ang sekreto sang tuman ka namit kag saboroso nga karne sang baka kasubong sang Wagyu beef?
english: AUSTRALIA – Do you know the secret of a delicious and tasty beef like Wagyu beef?

text: Pakauna sila, este ang mga baka, sang chocolate.
english: Feed them, or the cows, chocolate.

text: Huo!
english: Yes!

text: chocolate ang rason sang saboroso nga karne sang baka sang Mayura Station farm sa Southern Australia nga sa sulod na sang 10 ka tuig, nagpadayon ang ila negosyo bangud sa nasambit nga sekreto.
english: chocolate is the reason for the delicious beef of the Mayura Station farm in Southern Australia, which has been running for 10 years because of the secret.

text: Suno kay Scott de Bruin, managing partner sang Mayura Station, nagbalik siya sa Limestone Coast sa Australia agud subli-on ang negosyo nga ginbilin sang iya amay.
english: According to Scott de Bruin, managing partner of Mayura Station, he returned to the Limestone Coast in Australia to take over the business left by his father.

text: Si de Bruin ang nakapaminsar nga maghimo sang espesyal ukon tuman gid ka espesyal nga meat preparation.
english: It was de Bruin who thought of making a special or very special meat preparation.

text: Nagkonsulta si de Bruin sa isa ka cattle nutritionist sa Japan kag natun-an ang espesyal nga pagpatambok kag kun paano mapahumok ang karne sang baka.
english: De Bruin consulted a cattle nutritionist in Japan and learned about special fattening and how to tenderize beef.

text: Sa iya paino-ino, kun sweets lamang ang pagahambalan, nga-a abi indi paghatagan sang chocolates ang baka?
english: In his mind, if it's just sweets, why not give chocolates to the cow?

text: kag the rest is history.
english: and the rest is history.

text: Si de Buin ang isa na karon sa mga madinalag-on nga cattle raisers sa Southern Australia.
english: De Buin is now one of the most successful cattle raisers in Southern Australia.

text: Nagpaguwa sang official statement ang Iloilo National High School (INHS) nga magapadayon ang school operations subong nga adlaw, Nobyembre 17, matapos nakumpirma nga wala sang anuman nga explosive devices sa sulod sang eskwelahan.
english: The Iloilo National High School (INHS) issued an official statement that school operations will continue today, November 17, after it was confirmed that there are no explosive devices inside the school.

text: Ginkadtuan kag gin-check sang Iloilo City Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) team ang lugar kasunod sang bomb threat nga nabaton kaina sang kaagahon.
english: The Iloilo City Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) team visited and checked the area following the bomb threat received yesterday morning.

text: “At 4:06 am, the EOD declared the school cleared; no explosive devices were found or confirmed,” kabahin sang official statement.
english: “At 4:06 am, the EOD declared the school cleared; no explosive devices were found or confirmed,” the official statement said.

text: Dugang sini, “The safety and well-being of our school community remain our highest priority.
english: It added, “The safety and well-being of our school community remains our highest priority.

text: We want to assure everyone that all necessary precautions are in place, and the school environment is secure.
english: We want to assure everyone that all necessary precautions are in place, and the school environment is secure.

text:
Normal school operations will continue as scheduled.”

Ginpasalamatan man sini ang awtoridad sa madasig nga pagresponde agud ma-check gilayon ang area.
english:
Normal school operations will continue as scheduled.”

He also thanked the authorities for their quick response to check the area immediately.

text: “We sincerely thank the authorities for their swift and professional response.
english: “We sincerely thank the authorities for their swift and professional response.

text: We also extend our gratitude to our teachers, school personnel, and learners for remaining calm throughout the process,” suno pa sa INHS.
english: We also extend our gratitude to our teachers, school personnel, and learners for remaining calm throughout the process,” INHS said.

text: Dugang pa sa statement, “We strongly discourage actions that create unnecessary alarm, as these can disrupt learning and affect the well-being of our learners and personnel.
english: The statement added, “We strongly discourage actions that create unnecessary alarm, as these can disrupt learning and affect the well-being of our learners and personnel.

text:
Please continue to stay connected through our official communication channels for updates and guidance.”

KAUNDAN SANG BOMB THREAT

Ginpadala man sang certain “Nestor Villagracia” ang mensahe sa Bombo Radyo Iloilo kun sa diin ginsiling sini nga nagbutang siya sang siyam ka time bombs sa campus.
english:
Please continue to stay connected through our official communication channels for updates and guidance.”

CONTENTS OF BOMB THREAT

A certain “Nestor Villagracia” also sent a message to Bombo Radyo Iloilo where he said he placed nine time bombs on the campus.

text: Pahayag sang nag-send sang mensahe, ginbutang niya ang bomba bangud sa indi patas nga pag-tratar sang mga faculty kag staff sa regular class students samtang ginapaboran naman ang special program students.
english: The sender of the message said he planted the bomb because of the unfair treatment of faculty and staff to regular class students while favoring special program students.

text: Sa pag-check sang Bombo Radyo, nakit-an nga bag-o lang nahimo ang Facebook account sang amo nga indibidwal kag isa lang ang nakabutang sa Friends’ List.
english: When Bombo Radyo checked, it was found that the Facebook account of the individual was recently created and only one person was placed on the Friends' List.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga semana, may nabaton man nga bomb threat ang University of San Agustin- Basic Education Department samtang duha ka sunod-sunod nga bomb threat man ang nabaton sang Iloilo Science and Technology University.
english: Last week, the University of San Agustin-Basic Education Department also received a bomb threat while the Iloilo Science and Technology University also received two consecutive bomb threats.

text: Lunsay ini na-clear sang awtoridad kag nadeklarar nga wala sang bomba.
english: Both were cleared by the authorities and declared bomb-free.

text: Napilian gihapon ang actress kag singer nga si Kyline Alcantara bilang honorary ambassador para sa Korean tourism sa Pilipinas sa sulod sang isa pa ka tuig.
english: Actress and singer Kyline Alcantara was also elected as the honorary ambassador for Korean tourism in the Philippines for another year.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga tuig nga gin-tap ang 21-anyos nga aktres para sa amo nga papel kun sa diin ang bag-o sini nga termino para sa ambassadorship ang magalawig tubtub sa Marso 23, 2025.
english: This is the third year that the 21-year-old actress has been tapped for the role where her new term for ambassadorship will run until March 23, 2025.

text: Ang reappointment sa iya ang gindungan sa 75th year sang diplomatic relations sa tunga sang South Korea kag Pilipinas kag promotion man sang Visit Korea Year 2024.
english: His reappointment coincided with the 75th year of diplomatic relations between South Korea and the Philippines and the promotion of Visit Korea Year 2024.

text: Bilang honorary ambassador, siya ang mangin celebrity representative para sa tourism promotional campaigns, programs, kag events sang Korea Tourism Organization diri sa Pilipinas.
english: As an honorary ambassador, he will be the celebrity representative for the tourism promotional campaigns, programs, and events of the Korea Tourism Organization here in the Philippines.

text: Lakip man sa iya nga katungdanan ang pagbisita sa Korea kag pagpakigbahin sang nga iya eksperyensya sa iya nga social media accounts agud nga ma-promote ang amo nga pungsod.
english: His duties also include visiting Korea and sharing his experience on his social media accounts to promote the country.

text: Yara man ang iya nga presensya sa dalagku nga kampanya kag aktibidad sang organisasyon kaangay sang familiarization tours, travel seminars, kag travel fairs.
english: He is also present in the organization's major campaigns and activities such as familiarization tours, travel seminars, and travel fairs.

text: Antes kay Alcantara, ang iban pa mga aktres nga napilian bilang honorary ambassadors para sa Korea Tourism amo sanday Jessy Mendiola (2013-2016) kag Sue Ramirez (2016-2019).
english: Before Alcantara, other actresses chosen as honorary ambassadors for Korea Tourism were Jessy Mendiola (2013-2016) and Sue Ramirez (2016-2019).

text: Nagdaog si Lee Jae Myung sang Democratic Party sa snap presidential election sang Martes, base sa exit poll.
english: The Democratic Party’s Lee Jae Myung won Tuesday’s snap presidential election, according to an exit poll.

text: Nakuha ni Lee ang 51.7 percent sang boto, kontra sa 39.3 percent sang iya kontra nga si Kim Moon-soo sang People Power Party.
english: Lee won 51.7 percent of the vote, against the 39.3 percent of his opponent Kim Moon-soo of the People Power Party.

text: Ginpahayag sang mga South Korean media nga si Lee nag-angkon sang madinalag-on nga pagdaog batok kay Kim Moon-soo, base sa mga datos halin sa exit polls.
english: South Korean media reported that Lee claimed a comfortable victory over Kim Moon-soo, based on data from exit polls.

text: Ginpatigayon ang snap election bangud sa impeachment ukon pagpahalin sa puwesto ni anay President Yoon Suk Yeol matapos ini nagdeklara sang martial law sa madasig lang nga tinion.
english: The snap election was held due to the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol after he declared martial law in a short time.

text: Ang pagbalik ni Lee sa politika ginakabig nga isa ka dramatiko nga comeback, matapos siya napyerde kay Yoon sang 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: Lee’s return to politics is seen as a dramatic comeback, after he lost to Yoon in the 2022 election.

text: Ginahulat subong ang desisyon sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC) kun sin-o sa duha ka nagaaway nga faction sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) ang opisyal nga kilalahon para sa 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: The Commission on Elections (COMELEC) is now awaiting a decision on which of the two warring factions of the Philippine Democratic Party–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) will be officially recognized for the 2022 elections.

text: Ini matapos nag-appoint man sang separado nga standard bearer ang faction ni Senator Manny Pacquiao apisar una naman nga naka-appoint sang lain nga standard bearer ang faction ni Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi.
english: This is after Senator Manny Pacquiao's faction also appointed a separate standard bearer despite the fact that Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi's faction had already appointed another standard bearer.

text: Kun matandaan, si Senator Christopher Lawrence ‘Bong’ Go ang gin-endorse sang Cusi Faction bilang kandidato sa pagka-presidente samtang si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte naman ang gin-endorso bilang iya running-mate sa national elections.
english: Senator Christopher Lawrence 'Bong' Go was endorsed by the Cusi Faction as its presidential candidate while President Rodrigo Duterte was endorsed as his running-mate in the national elections.

text: Apang kahapon, sa national assembly sang Pacquiao faction sa PDP-Laban, pormal man nga ginbaton ni Pacquiao ang nominasyon sang partido nga siya ang magapadalagan sa pagka-presidente sa 2022.
english: But yesterday, at the national assembly of the Pacquiao faction in the PDP-Laban, Pacquiao also formally accepted the party's nomination that he will run for president in 2022.

text: Ginhatagan man si Pacquiao sang otoridad nga magpili sang iya nga running-mate kag sang iya kaalyado para sa Senado.
english: Pacquiao was also given the authority to choose his running-mate and his ally for the Senate.

text: “Sa mga nagtatanong kung ano ang ating kakayahan?
english: “To those who ask what we are capable of?

text: Naranasan niyo na po bang magutom… walang makain… mangutang sa kapitbahay o mag abang ng tira sa karinderya?
english: Have you ever been hungry... had nothing to eat... borrowed from a neighbor or waited for food in the cafeteria?

text: Alam niyo po ba ang pakiramdam ng isang Pilipino na nakikipaglaban sa boxing?
english: Do you know how it feels to be a Filipino fighting in boxing?

text: Nagpapabugbog sa kalaban na mas malaki at malakas para makabili ng pagkain?
english: Beating up a bigger and stronger opponent to buy food?

text: Ang Manny Pacquiao na nasa harap ninyo ngayon ay pinanday ng hirap… Ang Manny Pacquiao na pilit nilang pinababagsak ay ilang beses nang bumangon, nagsikap at nagtagumpay… Alam ko ang hirap na naranasan ninyo at alam kong pagod na pagod na kayong lahat,” kabahin sang acceptance speech ni Pacquiao.
english: The Manny Pacquiao in front of you now is forged by hardship... The Manny Pacquiao they are trying to knock down has risen several times, tried and succeeded... I know the hardship you have experienced and I know you are all tired,” part of Pacquiao's acceptance speech.

text: Excited ang Philippine Retailers Association (PRA) sa ginatawag nga ‘ber’ months nga magasugod sa masunod nga semana nga unofficial nga nagasenyas sang pagsugod sang Christmas season sa pungsod.
english: The Philippine Retailers Association (PRA) is excited for the so-called ‘ber’ months that will begin next week unofficially signaling the beginning of the Christmas season in the country.

text: Ang ‘Ber’ nagapatuhoy sa mga bulan nga nagatapos sa ‘ber’ halin September tubtob Dismember.
english: ‘Ber’ refers to the months ending in ‘ber’ from September to December.

text: Ang mga manugbaligya nagsiling nga ini ang quarter nga ang mga benta masami nga nagasugod sa pagtaas.
english: Retailers said this is the quarter sales usually start to pick up.

text: Suno kay Philippine Retailers Association Chairwoman Rosemarie Ong, nga amo man ang Chief Operating Officer sang Wilcon Depot, maayo para sa mga retailers ang holiday season.
english: According to Philippine Retailers Association Chairwoman Rosemarie Ong, who is also the Chief Operating Officer of Wilcon Depot, the holiday season is good for retailers.

text: Ginalauman man niya nga maganubo ang inflation kag interest rates sa masunod nga mga binulan nga makaganyat sa mga konsumidor nga maggasto sang dugang.
english: He also expects inflation and interest rates to fall in the coming months which will entice consumers to spend more.

text: Si Sam Gregory Lim, nga amo man ang Chief Operating Officer sang Blims Lifestyle Group, nagsiling nga ang mga Pilipino magabakal gihapon sang mga butang pareho sang mga regalo sa masunod nga bulan.
english: Sam Gregory Lim, who is also the Chief Operating Officer of Blims Lifestyle Group, said Filipinos will still buy things like gifts next month.

text: Dugang pa niya nga ang mga retailers ang pirme excited para sa sini nga ber period, kag handa para sa mga promosyon kag mga events.
english: He added that retailers are always excited for this ber period, and ready for promotions and events.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Lim nga ang tanan nagahulat kay Jose Mari Chan nga magguwa sa ad sang isa ka tawo, kon sa diin, nagatanyag sang mga promo kag bag-o nga mga produkto.
english: Lim also revealed that everyone is waiting for Jose Mari Chan to appear in someone’s ad, somewhere, offering promos and new products.

text: Tinawag na walang basehan at walang anumang ebidensiya ni Senator Mark Villar na nagdadawit sa kaniya sa anomalya ng flood control projects.
english: Senator Mark Villar called it unfounded and without any evidence implicating him in the anomaly of flood control projects.

text: Kasunod ito sa naging rekomendasyon ng Independent Commission on Infrastructure’s (ICI) na sampahan siya ng kaso sa Office of the Ombudsman.
english: This follows the recommendation of the Independent Commission on Infrastructure (ICI) to file a case against him with the Office of the Ombudsman.

text: Ayon sa Senador na mayroong itong integredad at ang kaniyang mga track record ay siyang nagpapakita ng kaniyang trabaho ay tama.
english: According to the Senator, he has integrity and his track record shows that his work is correct.

text: Inihayag nito ang kaniyang buong kahandaan sa anumang imbestigasyon na gagawin ng ICI kung saan tanggap nito ang masusing imbestigasyon para malaman ang katotohanan.
english: He expressed his full readiness for any investigation conducted by the ICI where he welcomes a thorough investigation to find out the truth.

text: Magugunitang bukod kay Villar ay inirekomenda rin ng ICI sa Ombudsman na imbestigahan at kasuhan sina Senator Francis Chiz Escudero at mga dating senador na sina Nancy Binay at Grace Poe.
english: Besides Villar, the ICI also recommended to the Ombudsman to investigate and prosecute Senator Francis Chiz Escudero and former senators Nancy Binay and Grace Poe.

text: Kahapon imo nahibaluan ang world’s most expensive peanut butter and jelly sandwich, gani bilang promisa bangud paborito mo ang taco, ari ang para sa imo.
english: Yesterday you learned about the world’s most expensive peanut butter and jelly sandwich, so as a promise because you love tacos, here’s the one for you.

text: Kun ang world’s most expensive peanut butter and jelly sandwich ang nagabalor sang P17,000, mapati ka bala nga ang taco nga ini halin sa Baja California sa Mexico ang imo mabakal sang P1.2 million?
english: If the world's most expensive peanut butter and jelly sandwich costs P17,000, can you believe that this taco from Baja California in Mexico can be bought for P1.2 million?

text: Maggasto ka bala sang amu sina kadako nga kantidad para lang sa paborito mo nga taco?
english: Would you spend that much money just for your favorite taco?

text: Daw kaangay lang ini nga nagbakal ka sang salakyan.
english: It’s like buying a car.

text: Si Juan Licerio Alcala, ang executive chef sa Grand Velas Los Cabos Resort, isa ka luxury vacation destination sa Baja California kag naghimo sang world’s most expensive taco.
english: Juan Licerio Alcala, the executive chef at Grand Velas Los Cabos Resort, a luxury vacation destination in Baja California and created the world’s most expensive taco.

text: Ginpasalig ni Alcala nga “worth it” ang bayad mo nga P1.2 million para lang sa isa ka taco.
english: Alcala assured that it is “worth it” to pay P1.2 million for just one taco.

english: An estimated 4 million tons of pearl fish will be harvested and sold for $40,000 or P1.9 million in the Middle East.

english: According to the 1987 Constitution, the party-list system in the Philippines is a mechanism that ensures that different sectors of society particularly disadvantaged groups have representation in Congress.

english: In each election, each voter can only vote for one partylist.

english: The group that wins at least 2% of the national vote will be awarded a seat in Congress.
