english: 24 Turkey Tarik Biberovic had a game-high 23 points including 5-of-9 on threes.

text: Balantayan ang masunod nga exhibition match sang Gilas sa Hunyo 30 batok sa Polish National Team sa Sosnowiec, Poland antes ini dalayon magsabak sa Olympic qualifiers kun sa diin maatubang sini ang early-favorite nga Latvia kag ang team sang Georgia.
english: Watch out for the Gilas' next exhibition match on June 30 against the Polish National Team in Sosnowiec, Poland before they immediately move on to the Olympic qualifiers where they will face early-favorite Latvia and the team of Georgia.

text: ILOILO – Amat-amat na nga gina-areglo ang mga kandidato nga magapadalagan sa 3rd district sa Probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: ILOILO – The candidates who will run in the 3rd district in Iloilo Province are being arranged.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd District Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo 3rd District Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga sa Sangguniang Panlalawigan, magapare-elect sa gihapon sanday Board Members Jason Gonzales kag Matt Palabrica sa diin wala pa ang mga ini sang mangin kasumpong.
english: Lorenz Defensor, he said that in the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, Board Members Jason Gonzales and Matt Palabrica will still be elected where they have no opponents.

text: Ang mga line-up naman sa mga banwa sa tirsier distrito ang malapit na lang nga matapos sa diin duha na lang ka mga banwa ang ila mga ginahikutar sa subong.
english: The line-ups in the towns in the third district are nearing completion with only two towns being worked on.

text: Samtang, sa probinsya sang Iloilo, ginkumpirma man ni Defensor nga naka-istorya na siya sa mga kongresista magluwas lang sa 1st kag 4th district.
english: Meanwhile, in Iloilo province, Defensor also confirmed that he has already spoken to congressmen except for the 1st and 4th districts.

text: Ginatugyan naman ni Defensor sa iya utod nga si Iloilo Gov.
english: Defensor handed over to his brother, Iloilo Gov.

text: Arthur Defensor Jr., ang desisyon sa iya nga suportahan sa magapadalagan bilang bise gobernador.
english: Arthur Defensor Jr., the decision to support him to run for vice governor.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang mamalidha nga may tatlo na ka mga luyag magkandidato sa vice gubernatorial race, apang wala pa nakadesisyon ang gobernador tuhoy diri.
english: The lawmaker also confirmed that there are already three candidates in the vice gubernatorial race, but the governor has not yet decided on the matter.

text: Inilantad ni dating Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co ang umano’y mga larawan ng male-maletang pera na aniya’y personal niyang idineliver, kasama ang kaniyang mga tauhan, kina Pangulong Bongbong Marcos at dating House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: Former Ako Bicol representative Zaldy Co allegedly revealed pictures of suitcases of money that he personally delivered, along with his men, to President Bongbong Marcos and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Ayon kay Co, ang mga naturang deliveries ay isinagawa mula Forbes Park hanggang sa Malacañang.
english: According to Co, the deliveries were made from Forbes Park to Malacañang.

text: Ipinakita niya ang mga larawan sa ikalawang bahagi ng kanyang video message na tumatalakay sa umano’y utos ni Pangulong Marcos na naglalaman ng P100 bilyong insertions sa 2025 national budget.
english: He showed the images in the second part of his video message discussing President Marcos' alleged order containing P100 billion insertions in the 2025 national budget.

text: Sinabi pa nito na totoo ang mga unang rebelasyon ng retiradong Marines Orly Guteza.
english: He said the earlier revelations of retired Marines Orly Guteza were true.

text: Sa naunang bahagi ng kanyang video message, ibinunyag ni Co ang umano’y anomalya sa flood control at iba pang infrastructure projects, na sinasabing may kinalaman sa malalaking budget insertions.
english: In an earlier part of his video message, Co revealed alleged anomalies in flood control and other infrastructure projects, which are said to be related to large budget insertions.

text: Ang alegasyon ay nakatuon sa umano’y P100 bilyong dagdag na pondo sa national budget para sa 2025, na iniuugnay sa magpinsang Marcos at Romualdez.
english: The allegation is based on the alleged P100 billion additional funds in the national budget for 2025, attributed to the Marcos and Romualdez cousins.

text: Pero ang mga pahayag ni Co ay nagbukas ng mas malawak na diskusyon hinggil sa transparency at accountability sa pamahalaan, lalo na sa proseso ng budget allocation.
english: But Co's statements opened up a broader discussion about transparency and accountability in government, especially in the budget allocation process.

text: Si Co ay dati ring nasangkot sa mga kontrobersiya kaugnay ng infrastructure projects at umano’y anomalya sa paggamit ng pondo, dahilan upang mas lalong mabigyan ng bigat ang kanyang mga bagong rebelasyon.
english: Co has also been involved in controversies over infrastructure projects and alleged anomalies in the use of funds, giving his new revelations more weight.

text: Ang mga inilabas na larawan ng male-maletang pera ay nagdulot ng matinding interes at pangamba sa publiko, na ngayon ay naghihintay ng tugon mula sa Malacañang at sa kampo ni Romualdez.
english: The released pictures of the money suitcases have caused great interest and concern among the public, who are now waiting for a response from Malacañang and Romualdez's camp.

text: Kun kaisa diri sa aton sa syudad sang Iloilo, naga-ugtas ang aton nga mga otoridad bangud sa mga nagaliho-liho kag nagapangkayo-kayo sa dalan.
english: Sometimes here in Iloilo City, our authorities are angry because of those who are wandering around and begging on the streets.

text: Apang sa Okinawa, Japan mas naga-ugtas pa gid didto ang mga otoridad bangud sa ginatawag nila nga “rojo-ne” ukon “sleeping on the road” phenomenon.
english: But in Okinawa, Japan, authorities are even more aggressive because of what they call the “rojo-ne” or “sleeping on the road” phenomenon.

text: Imagine mga ka-Bombo, gab-i na kag mapauli kana sa inyo balay samtang nagamaneho sang imo salakyan sang gilayon ka nga may nakit-an nga tawo nga nagahigda sa tunga sang dalan.
english: Imagine, it's late at night and you're driving home when you suddenly see someone lying in the middle of the road.

text: Sang 2019, 7,000 ka mga kaso ang na rekord sang provincial police kag ang iban diri ang nag resulta pa sa pagkapatay.
english: In 2019, 7,000 cases were recorded by the provincial police and some of them resulted in death.

text: Apisar nga madamo na sang mga paamaagi ang ginhimo sang mga pulis kaangay sang pagbutang sang multa sa sin-o man ang makit-an nga nagakatulog sa dalan, wala ini sa gihapon sang pagbag-o kag kaangay nga mas naglala pa ang sitwasyon.
english: Although the police have taken many measures such as imposing fines on anyone found sleeping on the street, this has not changed and the situation seems to be getting worse.

text: Ano ayhan ang rason kun ngaa nagakatulugan sa dalan ang mga tawo didto sa Okinawa?
english: What is the reason why people sleep on the streets in Okinawa?

text: Pila sa mga ginalantaw rason sang otoridad amo ang impluwensya sa alcohol kag ang klima.
english: Some of the reasons cited by the authorities are the influence of alcohol and the climate.

text: Ang iban nga tawo nga nagahigda sa dalan agud nga makapa-bugnaw sa diin may yara sang tatlo ka mga kababainhan ang naghublas pa sang ila nga panapton.
english: Some people were lying on the road to cool off, including three women who had taken off their clothes.

text: Delikado man nga pukawon ang mga rojo-ne offenders bangud kun kaisa, nagapangita ini ang away gani gina-abisohan sang kapulisan ang mga driver nga pasigahon ang emergency lights sang ila salakyan kag tawgan ang pulis.
english: It is also dangerous to wake up rojo-ne offenders because sometimes, they are looking for a fight so the police advise drivers to turn on the emergency lights of their vehicles and call the police.

text: Gani kun magkadto ikaw sa Okinawa ukon sa mga ka-Bombo nga yara na dira, mag-focus sa pagmaneho, siguraduhon nga ang imo mata ang nakatutok sa dalan bangud mahimo nga may isa ka tawo na naman ang magdumdom nga katre ang iya ginahigdaan.
english: So if you go to Okinawa or the Bombo friends who are already there, focus on driving, make sure your eyes are on the road because someone else may think that he is sleeping in a bed.

text: (Photos from Okinawa Prefectural Police’s Yaeyama Police Station via Oddity Central)
english: (Photos from Okinawa Prefectural Police’s Yaeyama Police Station via Oddity Central)

text: AUSTRALIA – Sa imo nga birthday, ano ang luyag mo nga mabaton?
english: AUSTRALIA – On your birthday, what would you like to receive?

text: Didto sa Australia, gindayaw ang isa ka iloy bangud sa iya Do-It-Yourself (DIY) gift para sa iya anak nga lalaki nga nagsaulog sang ika-18 sini nga kaadlawan.
english: In Australia, a mother was praised for her Do-It-Yourself (DIY) gift for her son who celebrated his 18th birthday.

text: Bisan sin-o man nga ginikanan nga may yara sang dalaga ukon soltero nga bata ang nakahibalo kun ano ka budlay magpangita sang regalo nga ila maluyagan.
english: Any parent with a teenage child knows how difficult it can be to find a gift they will love.

text: Gani na desisyonan sang iloy nga i-arrange ang lima ka mga nagkalain-lain nga gift cards sa isa ka board sa diin may yara man sang sulat nga nasaad.
english: So the mother decided to arrange five different gift cards on a board with a promised letter.

text: Sa sulat, ginpahayag sang iloy sa iya nga soltero nga anak nga i-treat sini ang iya nga kaugalingon kag i-enjoy lang ang pagsaulog sang iya kaadlawan.
english: In the letter, the mother told her only son to treat himself and just enjoy celebrating his birthday.

text: Nagkalain-lain nga gift cards para sa nagkalain-lain man nga shops ang regalo sang iloy sa iya anak agud nga siya mismo ang makahibalo magpili sang iya nga naluyagan.
english: The mother gave her daughter different gift cards for different shops so that she could choose what she liked.

text: Wala napilian ang subang nga anak ni LeBron James nga si Bronny sa una nga round sang 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA) Draft.
english: LeBron James’ youngest son Bronny was not selected in the first round of the 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA) Draft.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan sang nag-deklarar ang 19-anyos nga player nga magapapili ini sa liga apisar sang isa ka tuig lang sini nga eksperyensya sa college basketball sa Southern California kun sa diin naka-average ini sang 4.8 points, 2.8 rebounds kag 2.1 assists per game sang nagligad nga season.
english: Last month, the 19-year-old declared that he would join the league despite having only one year of college basketball experience in Southern California where he averaged 4.8 points, 2.8 rebounds and 2.1 assists per game last season.

text: Antes pa man nagsugod ang iya collegiate career, nagsuprer pa ini sang cardiac arrest sang Hulyo 2023 kag sang ulihi ginsapubliko nga may yara siya sang congenital heart defect.
english: Even before his collegiate career began, he suffered a cardiac arrest in July 2023 and later made it public that he had a congenital heart defect.

text: Apisar sini nga kondisyon, sang nagligad nga bulan, nahatagan ini sang medical clearance nga makahampang sa NBA.
english: Despite this condition, last month, he was given medical clearance to play in the NBA.

text: Posible nga matumod ang iya karera sa liga sa pag-resume sang second round sang draft kun sa diin ginabati-bati man sa pila ka reports nga kuhaon siya sang Lakers.
english: His career in the league is likely to be determined by the resumption of the second round of the draft where some reports are also rumored to be taken by the Lakers.

text: Apisar makasulod ini sa second-round, matunog gihapon nga gina-istoryahan ang iya pangalan nga wala nadala sa first-round bangud sa iya apelyido.
english: Although he made it to the second-round, his name was still being talked about because he was not included in the first-round because of his surname.

text: Ang iya amay nga si LeBron nga amo ang scoring leader kag four-time champion sa NBA kag subong naga-edad na sang 39-anyos ang magasulod na sa iya ika-22 nga season sa liga.
english: His father LeBron who is the scoring leader and four-time champion in the NBA and is now 39-years-old will be entering his 22nd season in the league.

text: Pananglitan makahampang si Bronny sa masunod nga season, siya kag si LeBron ang mangin una nga father-son duo nga dungan magahampang sa liga.
english: Should Bronny play next season, he and LeBron will become the first father-son duo to play in the league together.

text: May yara na sang ginabanta 100 ka mga anay kaso sa NBA history kun sa diin nakasulod ang players matapos nga nakahampang man ang ila amay, apang wala pa sang na-rekord nga nagdungan sila sa paghampang.
english: There have been approximately 100 previous cases in NBA history where players got in after their father also played, but none have been recorded that they played together.

text: Hindi naniniwala si Councilor Nene Dela Llana sa pahayag ni Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) Officer in Charge Engineer Roy Pacanan na walang ghost flood control project sa Iloilo.
english: Councilor Nene Dela Llana does not believe the statement of Iloilo City District Engineering Office (ICDEO) Officer in Charge Engineer Roy Pacanan that there is no ghost flood control project in Iloilo.

text: Matandaan Dumalo si Dela Llana kasama si Councilor Rex Sarabia sa People’s Meeting na pinangunahan ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda.
english: Dela Llana attended the People's Meeting led by Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jam-Jam” Baronda.

text: Dito, tinanong niya si Pacanan kung totoo ngang walang ghost project, sa kabila ng post sa social media ng Presidente noong bumisita sa Iloilo noong Agosto.
english: Here, he asked Pacanan if it is true that there is no ghost project, despite the post on social media of the President when he visited Iloilo in August.

text: Pinaliwanag ni Pacanan na maaaring hindi lamang updated si Dela Llana dahil hindi niya nakita ang post ng Presidente.
english: Pacanan explained that Dela Llana may not be updated because he did not see the President's post.

text: Kahapon, muling binanggit ng Presidente sa press conference sa Malacañang ang Iloilo bilang isa sa mga lugar na may ghost at hindi natapos na mga proyekto.
english: Yesterday, the President again mentioned Iloilo in a press conference in Malacañang as one of the places with ghost and unfinished projects.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, nananatiling tanong ni Dela Llana kay Pacanan: sino nga ba ang nagsasabi ng hindi totoo?
english: For now, Dela Llana's question to Pacanan remains: who is saying the wrong thing?

text: Nagtipon ang masobra 50,000 ka tawo sa Plaza de San Pedro agud magtambong sa selebrasyon sang Jubilee sang mga Pamilya nga ginpatigayon ni Pope Leo XIV.
english: More than 50,000 people gathered in the Plaza de San Pedro to attend the celebration of the Jubilee of Families conducted by Pope Leo XIV.

text: Sa iya homiliya, ginpabutyag sang Santo Papa ang kaimportansya sang pamilya bilang pundasyon sa pagpadayon sang pagtuo, paghigugma, kag kabuhi halin sa isa ka henerasyon padulong sa masunod.
english: In his homily, the Pope stressed the importance of the family as the foundation for the continuation of faith, love, and life from one generation to the next.

text: Ginpanugyan niya nga ang mga “balaan nga kasal” amo ang ehemplo sang pagbinuligay, pagkabuhi nga may pag-unongay.
english: He suggested that “holy marriages” are the example of cooperation, living in harmony.

text: Ginpakita niya bilang ehemplo ang pamilya nanday Luigi kag Celia Martin, mga ginikanan ni Santa Therese of Lisieux, kag ang pamilya Ulma halin sa Poland nga naghalad sang ila kabuhi bangud sang pagtuo.
english: He pointed as examples to the family of Luigi and Celia Martin, parents of Saint Therese of Lisieux, and the Ulma family from Poland who sacrificed their lives for the faith.

text: Suno kay Pope Leo XIV, sa pamilya ginapasa ang pagtuo kag ginapakigbahin pareho sang tinapay kag paghigugma sa tagsa ka miyembro.
english: According to Pope Leo XIV, in the family faith is passed on and shared like bread and love with each member.

text: “Ang pamilya amo ang pinakamaayo nga lugar nga makita si Jesus nga pirmi nagahigugma kag nagahandum sang kaayuhan sang tanan,”.
english: “The family is the best place to find Jesus who always loves and wants the good of all,”.

text: Ginsaysay man niya ang pahayag ni Pope Francis nga ang kabuhi nakuha naton antes pa naton ini ginhingyo, kag ginpahanumdom niya nga ang kabuhi sang tawo nagasugod sa sulod sang isa ka pamilya.
english: He also recounted Pope Francis’ statement that life is ours before we ask for it, and he reminded that human life begins within a family.

text: Bilang katapusan sang selebrasyon, ginpangunahan ni Pope Leo XIV ang pag-ampo sang Regina Caeli, isa ka Marian nga pangamuyo, kag naghatag sang mensahe sang paglaum sa mga kabataan kag pasalamat sa tanan nga pamilya, labi na gid sa mga lolo kag lola bilang mga modelo sang pagtuo.
english: As the end of the celebration, Pope Leo XIV led the invocation of the Regina Caeli, a Marian prayer, and gave a message of hope to children and gratitude to all families, especially grandparents as models of faith.

text: ILOILO – Nagalaom ang pila ka mga myembro sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) nga mahitso na ang indi pag-intindihanay sang duha ka faction.
english: ILOILO – Some members of the Philippine Democratic Party-Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) hope that the misunderstanding between the two factions will be resolved.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang duha ka factionang ginapamunuan ni Energy Sec.
english: It was learned that the two factions led by Energy Sec.

text: Alfonso Cusi kag ang original party naman ang ginapamunuan ni Sen.
english: Alfonso Cusi and the original party led by Sen.

text: Aquilino ‘Koko’ Pimentel III.
english: Aquilino ‘Koko’ Pimentel III.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd District Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Iloilo 3rd District Rep.

text: Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong kumplikado pa ang sitwasyon sang ila partido bangud sa indi pag-intindihanay sang duha ka faction.
english: Lorenz Defensor, he said that the situation of their party is still complicated due to the misunderstanding between the two factions.

text: Ini man ang isa sa mga rason ni Defensor sa indi niya pagtambong sa national convention sang PDP-Laban sa diin ginproklamar si Sen.
english: This is also one of the reasons Defensor did not attend the national convention of PDP-Laban where Sen.

text: Bong Go bilang presidential candidate kag si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte naman bilang vice presidential candidate sa 2022 elections sa idalom sang PDP-Laban Cusi Faction.
english: Bong Go as presidential candidate and President Rodrigo Duterte as vice presidential candidate in the 2022 elections under the PDP-Laban Cusi Faction.

text: Suno kay Defensor, luyag niya anay nga kuhaon ang pulso sang iya mga kasimanwa antes pormal nga magdesisyon kun sin-o ang ila suportahan sa national elections.
english: Defensor said he wants to take the pulse of his fellow citizens before formally deciding who they will support in the national elections.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa kaangay nga mga politiko ilabi na sa ruling party nga likawan ang pagsaylo-saylo sang partido.
english: He also advised fellow politicians especially in the ruling party to avoid switching parties.

text: Mas maayo suno sa mamalidha nga hulaton na lang ang pormal nga pag-file sang certificate of candidacy (COC) sang ila mga mangin standard bearer sa diin diri mahibaluan kun sin-o ang iya nga suportahan.
english: The lawmaker said it is better to wait for the formal filing of the certificate of candidacy (COC) of their standard bearers where it will be known who he will support.

text: Gin-kwestyon ni Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano ang kakulangan sang committee amendments sa 2026 Budget Bill.
english: Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano questioned the lack of committee amendments to the 2026 Budget Bill.

text: Suno kay Cayetano, kon indi magpaguwa sang ila kaugalingon nga amendments ang committee, kaangay nga wala na sang pulos ang madugay nga proseso sang interpellation.
english: According to Cayetano, if the committee does not issue its own amendments, it seems that the long process of interpellation is useless.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginsabat ni Senate Committee on Finance Chairman Sen.
english: Senate Committee on Finance Chairman Sen.

text: Sherwin Gatchalian, iya ginpahayag nga ang committee report nga ila ginpresentar amo na mismo ang nagaserbi bilang committee amendments.
english: Sherwin Gatchalian, he said that the committee report they presented is already serving as committee amendments.

text: Ginpabutyag niya nga may yara sang technical working group nga nag-analisa sa nagkalain-lain nga ahensya sang gobyerno kag halin man sa pila ka senador.
english: He said there is a technical working group that has analyzed various government agencies and also from some senators.

text: Apang padayon gihapon ang pag-insister ni Cayetano nga dapat may yara man sang dugang nga pagbag-o sa committee report matapos ang malawig sang nagligad nga mga adlaw.
english: However, Cayetano continues to insist that there should be further changes in the committee report after the long past few days.

text: Nagpirma sang Memorandum of Agreement ang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kag ang United Fraternities and Sororities of Panay (UFSP) para sa Dugong Bombo 2025.
english: Bombo Radyo Iloilo and the United Fraternities and Sororities of Panay (UFSP) signed a Memorandum of Agreement for Dugong Bombo 2025.

text: Ang MOA signing ginpangunahan sang Station Manager sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo nga si Bombo John Talento.
english: The MOA signing was led by Station Manager of Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Bombo John Talento.

text: Ang UFSP ang gintiglawas naman sang ila presidente nga si Ian Rico kag ang ila adviser nga si Engr.
english: The UFSP was represented by its president Ian Rico and its adviser Engr.

text: Roy Miranda.
english: Roy Miranda.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang UFSP ginabug-usan sang 15 tanan nga mga fraternities kag sororities.
english: The UFSP is composed of 15 fraternities and sororities.

text: Ginaagda naman ni Rico ang publiko nga makigbahin kag magdonar sang dugo.
english: Rico invites the public to participate and donate blood.

text: Ang Dugong Bombo 2025 patigayunon sa Nobyembre 15, 2025, adlaw sang Sabado sa Iloilo Science and Technology University sa La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: The Dugong Bombo 2025 will be held on November 15, 2025, Saturday at the Iloilo Science and Technology University in La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: USA – Karma is real!
english: USA – Karma is real!

text: Isa ka kawatan sa Estados Unidos ang diutayan lang nga mapatay matapos ginsulod ang isa ka Pizza store sa Michigan sa Estados Unidos.
english: A thief in the United States almost died after breaking into a Pizza store in Michigan in the United States.

text: Nakabaton sang report ang Oakland County Sheriff’s Office nga may yara sang na-trap sa oven exhaust vent sa isa ka Pizza store.
english: The Oakland County Sheriff’s Office received a report that someone was trapped in an oven exhaust vent at a Pizza store.

text: Bangud sini, gilayon nga nagresponde ang mga otoridad agud luwason ang 32 anyos nga lalaki nga na-trap sa sulod sang 11 ka oras.
english: As a result, authorities immediately responded to rescue the 32-year-old man who was trapped for 11 hours.

text: Natukiban sang otoridad nga indi lamang isa ka simple nga emergency response ang ila ginhimo kundi santo sa imbestigasyon, ang lalaki ang na-trap sa sulod sang oven exhaust vent bangud sa iya tuyo nga magpangawat.
english: The authorities discovered that they did not only perform a simple emergency response but according to the investigation, the man was trapped inside the oven exhaust vent because of his intention to steal.

text: Santo sa imbestigasyon, gintuyo sang suspek nga magsulod sa building paagi sa rooftop exhaust vent apang sa wala ginlauman, ang nasambit nga vent ang konektado sa oven nga ginalutu-an sang pizza.
english: According to the investigation, the suspect tried to enter the building through the rooftop exhaust vent but unexpectedly, the said vent was connected to the oven where the pizza was cooked.

text: Bangud sa nasambit nga near-death experience, gindala sa hospital ang suspek bangud sa minor injuries kag dehydration.
english: Due to the near-death experience, the suspect was taken to the hospital for minor injuries and dehydration.

text: Natukiban man nga magluwas sa nasambit nga insidente, naulamid man sa illegal drugs kag sa home invasion ang nasambit nga suspek.
english: It was also discovered that besides the incident, the suspect was also involved in illegal drugs and home invasion.

text: Nagsulod liwat sa Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang Bagyo Uwan.
english: Typhoon Uwan has re-entered the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Ang sentro sini ang ginabulubanta nga yara sa kalayuon nga 210 km Northwest sang Itbayat, Batanes.
english: Its center is estimated to be 210 km Northwest of Itbayat, Batanes.

text:
Dala sini ang kabaskugon sang hangin nga nagadangat sa 75 km/h malapit sa sentro kag pagmadlos nga tubtob sa 90 km/h.

Nagahulag ini sa East northeastward sa kadasigon nga 10 km/h.

Suno sa Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), sakop sang Philippine Area of Responsibility (PAR) ang Taiwan.
english:
It brought winds of 75 km/h near the center and gusts of up to 90 km/h.

It is moving East northeastward at a speed of 10 km/h.

According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (PAGASA), Taiwan is part of the Philippine Area of ​​Responsibility (PAR).

text: Ang PAR ang geographical area sa western Pacific sa diin ang Pilipinas ang responsable sa pag-monitor sa weather disturbances kaangay sang bagyo.
english: The PAR is the geographical area in the western Pacific where the Philippines is responsible for monitoring weather disturbances such as typhoons.

text: LIMA, PERU – Atensyon sa mga tawo nga indi kabalo makuntento.
english: LIMA, PERU – Attention to people who are not satisfied.

text: Nagapati ka man bala sa hambalanon nga wala sang sekreto nga indi mahibaluan?
english: Do you also believe in the saying that there is no secret that cannot be known?

text: Sang gin lunsyar sang 2005 ang Google Maps, nangin mas malapit kag mahapos makit-an ang lugar.
english: When Google Maps was launched in 2005, it became closer and easier to find places.

text: Ang ini nga tool ang nagahatag sang kahigayunan agud nga mabisita ang isa ka lugar sa diin may yara ikaw sang makit-an nga pictures lakip na ang mga tawo sa lugar.
english: This tool allows you to visit a place where you can see pictures including the people in the place.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga may yara na sang na heartbroken kag naghilibi-on bangud lang sa Street View tool sang Google Maps?
english: But did you know that someone has been heartbroken and cried just because of Google Maps' Street View tool?

text: Didto sa Lima, Peru, nagtuga sang sakit sa balatyagon sang bana ang iya nakit-an nga picture sa diin nagapungko ang iya nga asawa samtang may iban nga lalaki nga nagahigda sa paa sini.
english: In Lima, Peru, a husband was hurt when he saw a picture of his wife sitting while another man was lying on her leg.

text: Apisar nga blurred ang bahin sang nawong sang babaye sa diin ini ang standard practice sa Google Maps agud man ma protektahan ang privacy sang mga tawo, nakilal-an sa gihapon sang bana ang iya asawa bangud pamilyar ini sa panapton nga suksok sang babaye.
english: Although the woman's face was blurred which is standard practice in Google Maps to protect people's privacy, the husband still recognized his wife because he was familiar with the woman's clothes.

text: Bangud sini, iya ginprangka ang babaye kag sa ulihe nag-ako man ini nga may yara siya sang iban nga lalaki.
english: Because of this, he confronted the woman and she later admitted that she had another man.

text: Apisar nga masakit para sa bana, iya na desisyonan nga bulagan na lang ang asawa.
english: Although it was painful for the husband, he decided to divorce his wife.

text: Gani sa inyo dira, agud indi kamo pag bayaan sang inyo nobyo, nobya, bana ukon asawa, makahibalo makuntento sa isa.
english: So to you there, in order not to be abandoned by your boyfriend, girlfriend, husband or wife, know how to be content with one.

text: Sunod-sunod ang exposure sang Filipina actress nga si Lovi Poe sa Hollywood!
english: Filipina actress Lovi Poe's exposure in Hollywood is one after another!

text: Ang pinakauli nga nakumpirma nga proyekto sini amo ang pelikula kaupod sa Canadian actor nga si Adam Beach kun sa diin ang maga-direct kag maga-produce amo ang “Prison Break” kag Marvel – “Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.” series director nga si Garry A. Brown.
english: His latest confirmed project is a film with Canadian actor Adam Beach where he will direct and produce “Prison Break” and Marvel – “Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.” series director Garry A. Brown.

text: Ang bag-o nga proyekto sang aktres ang maga-sentro sa matuod nga istorya sang decorated Native American fire captain nga si Paul Fullerton.
english: The actress’ new project will center on the true story of decorated Native American fire captain Paul Fullerton.

text: Si Lovi ang magadala sang papel ni Marie nga amo ang asawa ni Paul.
english: Lovi will play the role of Marie who is Paul’s wife.

text: Ginapahayag nga matabo ang shoot sang pelikula sa Dallas, Texas subong nga tuig.
english: The shoot of the film will reportedly take place in Dallas, Texas this year.

text: “Couldn’t be happier to share this with you guys.
english: “Couldn’t be happier to share this with you guys.

text: Really grateful for the opportunity to work with such amazing filmmakers and be part of the inspiring true story of Paul and Marie Fullerton,” suno sa aktres.
english: Really grateful for the opportunity to work with such amazing filmmakers and be part of the inspiring true story of Paul and Marie Fullerton,” said the actress.

text: Antes sini, bag-o lang nakatapos si Lovi sa filming sang US indie film nga “Bad Man” kaupod sa “American Pie” star nga si Seann William Scott.
english: Before that, Lovi had just finished filming the US indie film “Bad Man” alongside “American Pie” star Seann William Scott.

text: Kabahin man siya anay sang Hollywood project nga “The Chelsea Cowboy” nga wala pa na-release sa publiko kun sa diin gintungdan sini ang papel sang British blues singer nga si Dana Gillespie.#
english: He was also part of the Hollywood project “The Chelsea Cowboy” which has not yet been released to the public where he played the role of British blues singer Dana Gillespie.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Indi magnubo sa 6.8% sang mga Pilipino sa labor force ang unpaid workers, suno sa Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE).
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —At least 6.8% of Filipinos in the labor force are unpaid workers, according to the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE).

text: Ginkumpirmar ni DOLE Secretary Bievenido Laguesma ang mga numero sa tion sang budget deliberations sa ginaduso nga 2025 budget sa atubang sang House committee on appropriations sang ginpamangkot angut sini sang Marikina Representative nga si Stella Quimbo.
english: DOLE Secretary Bivenido Laguesma confirmed the figures during budget deliberations on the proposed 2025 budget before the House committee on appropriations when asked about it by Marikina Representative Stella Quimbo.

text: Suno kay Quimbo, sang Hunyo 2023, ang mga unpaid workers ang yara sa 9.4%.
english: According to Quimbo, as of June 2023, unpaid workers will be at 9.4%.

text: Nagatrabaho sila apang wala sila ginaswelduhan.
english: They work but they don’t get paid.

text: Samtang sang Hunyo 2024, ang wala ginabayaran nga mga mamumugon nagnubo sa 6.8%.
english: Meanwhile by June 2024, unpaid workers have dropped to 6.8%.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga isa ka milyon ka mga mamumugon ang wala sweldo nga nangin wage workers na.
english: He also said that one million unpaid workers have become wage workers.

text: Trahedya ang gindangatan sang isa ka pamilya sa Barangay Poblacion, Talitay, Maguindanao del Norte matapos mapatay ang isa ka walo ka tuig nga bata nga lalaki sa isa ka sunog nga naglamon sa masobra 10 ka mga balay.
english: Tragedy struck a family in Barangay Poblacion, Talitay, Maguindanao del Norte after an eight-year-old boy died in a fire that engulfed more than 10 houses.

text: Suno sa otoridad, madasig ang paglapta sang kalayo gani wala gid sang may nasalbar nga gamit ang mga pumuluyo.
english: According to authorities, the fire spread quickly and no belongings were saved.

text: Wala nga makagwa sa balay ang napatay nga bata matapos ma-trap sa sulod sang ila nga balay samtang nagakatulog.
english: The deceased child was unable to leave the house after being trapped inside their house while sleeping.

text: Nahibaluan nga may ginabatyag nga sakit ang iloy sang biktima rason nga wala na niya maluwas ang iya bata.
english: It was learned that the victim's mother was suffering from illness and could not save her child.

text: Padayon ang imbestigasyon sang Bureau of Fire Protection agud matumod ang ginhalinan sang sunog.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection is conducting an investigation to determine the cause of the fire.

text: Nagkaroon ng bomb threat sa University of San Agustin – Basic Education Department sa Sambag, Jaro, Iloilo City kaninang umaga.
english: There was a bomb threat at the University of San Agustin – Basic Education Department in Sambag, Jaro, Iloilo City this morning.

text: Ayon kay Police Captain Mavin Laraño, hepe ng Police Station 3, nakatanggap ang ilang guro ng text message na nagsasabing may ilang bomba sa paaralan.
english: According to Police Captain Mavin Laraño, chief of Police Station 3, some teachers received a text message saying there was a bomb in the school.

text: Nakasaad sa mensahe na may dalawang bomba sa kindergarten at apat sa main building.
english: The message said there were two bombs in the kindergarten and four in the main building.

text: Ayon sa text, ginawa umano ang bomb scare dahil sa diumano’y “unjust treatment” ng mga guro sa mga estudyante.
english: According to the text, the bomb scare was allegedly made because of the alleged “unjust treatment” of the teachers to the students.

text: Dahil dito, maingat na inilipat ang mga estudyante at ipinaliwanag sa kanila na ito ay bahagi lamang ng fire drill upang hindi sila mag-panic.
english: Because of this, the students were carefully moved and explained to them that this was just part of the fire drill so they would not panic.

text: Agad ding ipinaalam ng school administrator sa mga magulang na maaaring sunduin ang kanilang mga anak upang masiguro ang kaligtasan.
english: The school administrator immediately informed parents who could pick up their children to ensure safety.

text: Dinalaw ng Explosives and Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Unit ang paaralan at idineklarang cleared ang campus matapos ang inspeksyon.
english: The Explosives and Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Unit visited the school and declared the campus cleared after the inspection.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga ginpatay nila ang isa ka lider sang Hamas nga si Mohammad Sinwar.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced that they had killed a Hamas leader named Mohammad Sinwar.

text: Ini amo ang manghod sang napatay man nga lider sang Hamas nga si Yahya Sinwar nga amo ang mastermind sang Oktubre 2023 nga pag-atake sa southern Israel nga amo ang nangin rason sang pag-ibwal sang gyera sa Gaza.
english: This is the younger brother of also deceased Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar who was the mastermind of the October 2023 attack in southern Israel that sparked the Gaza war.

text: Suno kay Netanyahu, si Mohammad amo ang target sang Israeli strike sa ospital sa southern Gaza subong nga bulan.
english: Netanyahu said Mohammad was the target of an Israeli strike on a hospital in southern Gaza this month.

text: Natalana naman nga kumpirmahon sang militante nga grupo ang kamatayon sang isa sa ila mga lider.
english: The militant group is set to confirm the death of one of its leaders.

text: Napasaka si Mohammad sa top ranks sang Palestinian militant group sang nagligad nga tuig matapos nga ginpatay sang Israel ang iya utod nga si Yahya.
english: Mohammad rose to the top ranks of the Palestinian militant group last year after Israel killed his brother Yahya.

text: Ang anunsyo ni Netanyahu ang ginhimo matapos ginpabaskog pa sang Israeli military ang ila nga war campaign sa Gaza matapos nga nagtakop na ang ceasefire agreement sang Marso 2025.
english: Netanyahu's announcement came after the Israeli military stepped up its war campaign in Gaza after the ceasefire agreement expired in March 2025.

text: Wala sang usikon nga tiyempo ang Filipino Olympians samtang nga yara na sa training camp sa France isa ka bulan antes ang pormal nga pagsugod sang 2024 Summer Games sa Paris.
english: The Filipino Olympians have no time to waste as they are already in training camp in France a month before the formal start of the 2024 Summer Games in Paris.

text: Nagpanguna sa mga atleta nga Pilipino si Chef de Mission Jonvic Remulla kag Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino sang nag-abot na sa camp sa Metz.
english: Chef de Mission Jonvic Remulla and Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino led the Filipino athletes upon arrival at the camp in Metz.

text: Una nga nakatapak sa Paris agud magpreparar sa Olympics ang weightlifters nga sanday John Febuar Ceniza, Vanessa Sarno kag Elreen Ando, boxers nga sanday Aira Villegas, Hergie Bacyadan, Carlo Paalam kag Nesthy Petecio, kag rower nga si Joanie Delgaco.
english: Weightlifters John Febuar Ceniza, Vanessa Sarno and Elreen Ando, ​​boxers Aira Villegas, Hergie Bacyadan, Carlo Paalam and Nesthy Petecio, and rower Joanie Delgaco were the first to arrive in Paris to prepare for the Olympics.

text: Ginapaabot man sa masunod nga adlaw ang isa pa ka boksidor nga si Eumir Felix Marcial, fencer nga si Samantha Catantan kag gymnasts nga sanday Carlos Yulo, Emma Malabuyo, kag Levi Ruivivar.
english: Also expected the next day are another boxer Eumir Felix Marcial, fencer Samantha Catantan and gymnasts Carlos Yulo, Emma Malabuyo, and Levi Ruivivar.

text: “The athletes are excited and enthusiastic about this training camp, the main objective of which is to make sure our athletes are in top shape for the competitions,” suno kay Remulla.
english: “The athletes are excited and enthusiastic about this training camp, the main objective of which is to make sure our athletes are in top shape for the competitions,” according to Remulla.

text: Ini ang una nga tion nga nag-sulod sa training camp ang Filipino athletes nga ginapadala sa Olympiada kag ginalauman nga daku ang mabulig sini agud malampasan ang apat ka medalya nga nakuha sang pungsod sa Tokyo Olympics sang 2021.
english: This is the first time that Filipino athletes who are being sent to the Olympics have entered the training camp and it is expected that it will help them surpass the four medals won by the country in the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.

text: Ang training sa Metz ang magalawig tubtub sa Hulyo 22.
english: The training in Metz will last until July 22.

text: Lakip sa features sang camp amo ang gyms, sports labs, medical facilities, kag kitchens.
english: Among the camp’s features are gyms, sports labs, medical facilities, and kitchens.

text: “It’s all systems go here at La Moselle and the morale of the team is very high,”pahayag naman ni Tolentino, “The first batch of athletes that flew in with us here last Saturday morning are amazed with the facility and are eager to wind up their training for their respective events for the Olympics.”#
english: “It’s all systems go here at La Moselle and the morale of the team is very high,”said Tolentino, “The first batch of athletes that flew in with us here last Saturday morning are amazed with the facility and are eager to wind up their training for their respective events for the Olympics.”#

text: CHINA – Para sa mga adventurous person, patok ang thrill rides sa mga theme park.
english: CHINA – For adventurous persons, thrill rides in theme parks are popular.

text: Apang sa pungsod China, isa ka pinasahi nga theme park ang nagatanyag sang shrill ride.
english: But in China, a unique theme park offers a shrill ride.

text: Ang Window of the World theme park ang nagatanyag sang “Samadhi: 4D Experience of Death” ukon sensation of death, cremation and reborn sa tagsa ka rider.
english: The Window of the World theme park offers a “Samadhi: 4D Experience of Death” or sensation of death, cremation and reborn to every rider.

text: Ang tagsa ka rider ang ginapasulod sa morgue antes isulod sa lungon, pagkatapos sini, ang lungon ang ibutang sa conveyor belt para sa cremation.
english: Each rider is brought into the morgue before being loaded into the coffin, after which, the coffin will be placed on the conveyor belt for cremation.

text: Sa proseso sang cremation, mabatyagan sang rider ang sudden blast sang mainit nga hangin kun sa diin ang temperatura sa sulod ang nagalab-ot sa 105 degrees Fahrenheit kag may yara sang kasanag nga makita nga kasubong nga nagakasunog ang lungon para sa “authentic experience of burning”.
english: During the cremation process, the rider will feel a sudden blast of hot air where the temperature inside reaches 105 degrees Fahrenheit and there is a light that can be seen as if the coffin is burning for an authentic experience of burning.

text: Sa proseso naman sang “reborn”, may yara sang projected womb image nga makita sa kisame kag ang rider ang kinahanglan nga magkamang tubtub makalab-ot sa padded room nga nagaduag sang puti.
english: In the process of “reborn”, there is a projected womb image that can be seen on the ceiling and the rider has to crawl until they reach a padded room that is white.

text: Suno sa mga creator, ila gid nga ginpanumduman sang maayo kun paano ma-achieve ang legit death experience paagi sa paghimo sang crematorium kag incinerator.
english: According to the creators, they thought carefully about how to achieve a legit death experience by creating a crematorium and incinerator.

text: Kalabanan sa mga nagbisita sa nasambit nga theme park ang nakatapos sang death, cremation kag reborn process apang indi man hamak nga kakulba ang ila nabatyagan.
english: Most of the visitors to the theme park have completed the death, cremation and reborn process but they are not insignificantly nervous.

text: Ginkoronahan ang tiglawas sang Pilipinas nga si Maria Gigante bilang Universal Woman 2024 sa finals sang pageant nga ginpatigayon sa Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
english: Philippine representative Maria Gigante was crowned Universal Woman 2024 in the finals of the pageant held in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.

text: Ang 30-anyos nga host, model, kag beauty queen nga tumandok sang Bantayan Island, Cebu amo man ang nakakuha sang Social Media Award.
english: The 30-year-old host, model, and beauty queen native of Bantayan Island, Cebu also won the Social Media Award.

Sabat sang Pinay: “𝘛𝘰 𝘮𝘦, 𝘜𝘯𝘪𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘴𝘢𝘭 𝘞𝘰𝘮𝘢𝘯 𝘮𝘦𝘢𝘯𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘧𝘶𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘦.

text: 𝘛𝘰 𝘴𝘶𝘱𝘱𝘰𝘳𝘵 𝘢 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘯𝘰𝘵 𝘰𝘯𝘭𝘺 𝘴𝘶𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯𝘢𝘣𝘭𝘦, 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘯𝘥𝘴 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘦𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘰𝘮𝘪𝘤 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘨𝘳𝘦𝘴𝘴, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦, 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘭𝘶𝘴𝘪𝘷𝘦, 𝘴𝘰𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘪𝘮𝘱𝘢𝘤𝘵.
english: 𝘛𝘰 𝘴𝘶𝘱𝘱𝘰𝘳𝘵 𝘢 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘯𝘵 𝘰𝘯𝘭𝘺 𝘴𝘶𝘴𝘵𝘢𝘪𝘯𝘣𝘭𝘦, 𝘣𝘶𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘴𝘴𝘴 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘦𝘤𝘰𝘯𝘮𝘪𝘤 𝘱𝘳𝘰𝘨𝘳𝘦𝘴𝘴, 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘪𝘵𝘪𝘷𝘦, 𝘪𝘯𝘤𝘭𝘶𝘴𝘪𝘷𝘦, 𝘴𝘰𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘪𝘮𝘱𝘢𝘤𝘵.

text:
𝘐𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰𝘯𝘪𝘨𝘩𝘵, 𝘸𝘦𝘭𝘤𝘰𝘮𝘦 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘯𝘦𝘸 𝘦𝘳𝘢 𝘰𝘧 𝘣𝘦𝘢𝘶𝘵𝘺.”

Nagpangaduha kay Gigante ang tiglawas sang Vietnam nga si Lisandra Chirinos samtang second runner-up naman si Elisa Mysyshyne sang France.
english:
𝘐𝘧 𝘺𝘰𝘶 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘩𝘦𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘰𝘯𝘪𝘨𝘩𝘵, 𝘸𝘦𝘭𝘰𝤘 𝘵𝘰 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘯𝘦𝘸 𝘦𝘳𝘢 𝘰𝘧 𝘣𝘦𝘢𝘶𝘵𝘺.”

Gigante was second to Vietnam's Lisandra Chirinos while France's Elisa Mysyshyne was second runner-up.

text: Antes nagpasakop sa Universal Woman 2024, kabahin man si Gigante sang Miss World Philippines Competition sang 2022 kag nakuha man anay ang Binibining Cebu – Charity title sang 2017.
english: Before participating in Universal Woman 2024, Gigante was also part of the Miss World Philippines Competition in 2022 and won the Binibining Cebu – Charity title in 2017.

text:
Ang Universal Woman, suno sa ila official website, amo ang “platform that champions the unique brilliance and beauty of women making a positive impact in the world today.” Ginapahanugutan diri nga mag-compete ang kababainhan edad 25-45 kag wala sang limit sa kataason, bug-at, kag marital status.#

(PhotO: Missosology)
english:
Universal Woman, according to their official website, is the “platform that champions the unique brilliance and beauty of women making a positive impact in the world today.” Women ages 25-45 are allowed to compete here and there is no limit on height, weight, and marital status.

(Photo: Missosology)

text: Posible nga ipatuman ang bigtime oil price rollback antes magtakop ang bulan sang Agusto.
english: The bigtime oil price rollback is likely to be implemented before the end of August.

text:
Sandig sa nauna nga tatlo ka adlaw sang trading, yari ang ginalauman nga pagnubo sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo:

Gasoline – P0.80 – P1.20/literDiesel – P1.50 – P1.90/literKerosene – P1.40 – P1.80/liter

Suno sa oil companies, mahimo pa maglain ang price adjustment base sa end-week trading buwas, Agusto 23, apisar ang sigurado subong amo ang price downtrend trajectory.
english:
Based on the previous three trading days, here is the expected decline in petroleum product prices:

Gasoline – P0.80 – P1.20/literDiesel – P1.50 – P1.90/literKerosene – P1.40 – P1.80/liter

According to oil companies, the price adjustment could be worse based on end-week trading tomorrow, August 23, although what is certain now is the price downtrend trajectory.

text: Matandaan nga sang Martes, Agusto 20, ginpatuman ang price hike kasunod sang lima ka sunod-sunod nga semana sang rollback.#
english: It can be recalled that on Tuesday, August 20, the price hike was implemented following five consecutive weeks of rollback.

text: Nagpanawagan liwat si Pope Leo XIV sang ceasefire sa Gaza kadungan sang iya ikaduha nga general audience sa St.
english: Pope Leo XIV once again called for a ceasefire in Gaza during his second general audience in St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican.
english: Peter’s Square in the Vatican.

text: Nag-apelar man ang Santo Papa sa Israel kag Hamas militants nga magtahod sa international humanitarian law.
english: The Pope also appealed to Israel and Hamas militants to respect international humanitarian law.

text: Pahayag sini, dapat nga hilwayon na ang nabilin pa nga mga bihag.
english: He said the remaining hostages should be released.

text:
“From the Gaza Strip,” pahayag sang Pope, “we hear rising ever more insistently to the heavens, the cries of mothers and fathers who clutch the lifeless bodies of their children, and who are continually forced to move about in search of a little food and water and safer shelter from bombardments.”

Duha ka semana ang nagligad matandaan nga naglunsar ang Israeli military sang bag-o nga opensiba saarea nga sentro na nga daan sang gyera halin sang October 2023.
english:
“From the Gaza Strip,” the Pope declared, “we hear rising ever more insistently to the heavens, the cries of mothers and fathers who clutch the lifeless bodies of their children, and who are continually forced to move about in search of a little food and water and safer shelter from bombardments.”

Two weeks ago, the Israeli military launched a new offensive in the area, which has been the center of the war since October 2023.

text: Nag-apelar man ang Pope nga tapuson na ang gyera sa Ukraine.
english: The Pope also called for an end to the war in Ukraine.

text: Ginmuno sini ang bag-o nga mga atake batok sa mga sibilyan kag impastraktura sa Ukraine inadlaw halin sang ginhimo man sang Russia ang pinakadaku nga aerial attack sa maragtas sang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera.
english: It led fresh attacks against civilians and infrastructure in Ukraine days after Russia also carried out the largest aerial attack in the history of the three-year war.

text: “I pledge my closeness and prayers for all the victims, especially children and families,” suno sa Santo Papa.
english: “I pledge my closeness and prayers for all the victims, especially children and families,” the Pope said.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini na ang ikatatlo nga semana sang pagpungko ni Pope Leo XIV bilang lider sang Roman Catholic Church.
english: This is the third week of Pope Leo XIV's tenure as head of the Roman Catholic Church.

text: Pila ka beses naman sini nga ginhinambit sa iya mga speech ang panawagan sa pag-untat sa gyera — bagay nga masami man anay ginapangabay ni Pope Francis antes ini napatay.
english: He has repeatedly mentioned in his speeches the call for an end to the war — something that Pope Francis had often called for before his death.

text: CUBA – Umpisa sa pagsuksok sang face mask, pagbutang sang barrier sa mga motorsiklo kag plano nga pag implementar sang face shield… madamo ang naga pamangkot kun ano naman bala ang masunod?
english: CUBA – Starting from wearing face masks, putting barriers on motorcycles and planning to implement face shields... many are asking what's next?

text: May mga ordinaryo nga tawo nga nagasiling nga mabakal na lang sila sang personal protective equipment bangud indi mapaktan sa ulihe kag amo naman ini ang i-implentar sang gobyerno.
english: There are ordinary people who say that they will just buy personal protective equipment because it will not be affected later and this is what the government will implement.

text: Apang sang naglab-ot na ang COVID-19 didto sa Cuba, makit-an ang mataas nga carboard box nga may kamot kag tiil nga nagalagaw sa Havana suburb.
english: But when COVID-19 reached Cuba, a tall carboard box with hands and feet could be found wandering the Havana suburbs.

text: Na desisyonan ni Feridia Rojas, 82 anyos nga maghimo kag magsuksok sang karton agud nga ma protektahan ang iya kaugalingon batuk sa virus nga mas delikado sa mga tigulang.
english: Feridia Rojas, 82, decided to make and wear cardboard to protect herself against the virus that is more dangerous for the elderly.

text: Ang personal protective equipment pahayag ni Rojas ang indi mabakal sa mga tindahan sa Cuba.
english: Personal protective equipment, Rojas said, is not available in stores in Cuba.

text: Ang karton nga ginasuksok ni Rojas ang may nakabutang nga “I am at home, what about you?”.
english: The cardboard box Rojas was wearing had the words “I am at home, what about you?” written on it.

text: Gindayaw naman sang mga kasilingan ang pagka-creative ni Rojas.
english: Neighbors praised Rojas' creativity.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, sa tunga sang pandemya, stress kag anxiety nga nabatygan sang mga tawo sa Cuba, ang nangin lihok niya nga paghimo sang alternatibo nga PPE ang nakahatag sang yuhom sa mga tawo.
english: He added that in the midst of the pandemic, stress and anxiety felt by the people of Cuba, his initiative to make alternative PPE has brought a smile to the people.

text: Back-to-back nga gold medals ang nakuha sang World No.
english: Back-to-back gold medals were won by World No.

text: 2 kag Pinoy pole vaulter nga si Ernest John “EJ” Obiena sa Poland isa ka bulan antes ang Paris Olympics!
english: 2 and Pinoy pole vaulter Ernest John “EJ” Obiena in Poland a month before the Paris Olympics!

text: Nagpangibabaw si Obiena sa 10 ka mga atleta nga nagpasakop sa Memorial Czeslawa Cybulskiego sa Poznan matapos nalukso ang 5.87-metros tatlo ka adlaw matapos nadag-an man sini ang bulawan nga medalya sa Irena Szewinska Memorial sa Bydgoszcz sa amo man nga pungsod sa Europa.
english: Obiena topped 10 athletes who competed at the Memorial Czeslawa Cybulskiego in Poznan after jumping 5.87-meters three days after she also won the gold medal at the Irena Szewinska Memorial in Bydgoszcz in the same European country.

text: Nangin perpekto ang pagsugod sang hampang sang tag-isa ka attempt lang ang nahimo ni Obiena kag na-clear ang 5.62m, 5.77m, kag 5.87m.
english: The match started perfectly with Obiena making only one attempt each and clearing 5.62m, 5.77m, and 5.87m.

text: Tatlo naman ka sunod-sunod nga straight fouls ang iya nahimo sa 6.01m sang gintuyo sini nga gub-on kuntani ang iya Asian record nga 6.00m nga iya nalab-ot sang 2023.
english: He made three straight fouls at 6.01m when he tried to break his Asian record of 6.00m, which he set in 2023.

text: Matandaan nga ang 5.97m clearance sini sa Bydgoszcz sang nagligad nga adlaw amo ang na-set nga pinakamataas nga iya nalukso subong nga tuig.
english: It can be recalled that his 5.97m clearance in Bydgoszcz yesterday was set as the highest he has jumped this year.

text: Sa nagligad nga mga kumpetisyon, pila ka beses nga nabali ang iya pole kag nagpang-hulam lamang apang napadal-an ini sang bag-o sa bulig sang Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA).
english: In previous competitions, he broke his pole several times and only borrowed it but was sent a new one with the help of the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA).

text: Sunod nga magapasakop si Obiena sa Meeting de Paris nga isa ka leg sang Diamond League sa France sa Hulyo 7 antes sini dalayon nga i-todo ang preparasyon para sa Paris Summer Games.
english: Obiena will next participate in the Meeting de Paris, a leg of the Diamond League in France on July 7 before continuing to prepare for the Paris Summer Games.

text: Pinahintulutan ng Iloilo City Government ang pansamantalang pagbebenta sa mga sidewalk o temporary open sidewalk vending sa piling lugar ng lungsod simula Nobyembre 15, 2025 (Sabado).
english: The Iloilo City Government has allowed temporary open sidewalk vending in selected areas of the city starting November 15, 2025 (Saturday).

text: Batay ito sa Executive Order No.
english: This is based on Executive Order No.

text: 139, Series of 2025, na nilagdaan ni Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas, bilang bahagi ng mga aktibidad sa pagdiriwang ng holiday season.
english: 139, Series of 2025, signed by Iloilo City Mayor Raisa Treñas, as part of the activities to celebrate the holiday season.

text: Sa nasabing kautusan, papayagan ang sidewalk vending sa mga petsang Nobyembre 15, 16, 22, 23, 29, 30, at mula Disyembre 1 hanggang 31, 2025.
english: In the said order, sidewalk vending will be allowed on November 15, 16, 22, 23, 29, 30, and from December 1 to 31, 2025.

text: Kabilang sa mga lugar na pinapayagan ang pagtitinda ay ang ilang bahagi ng Iznart, J.M. Basa, Ledesma, Valeria, at Delgado Streets, pati na rin ang mga itinalagang lugar malapit sa Jaro Plaza, Molo Plaza, at Mandurriao Plaza.
english: Among the places where sales are allowed are some parts of Iznart, J.M. Basa, Ledesma, Valeria, and Delgado Streets, as well as designated areas near Jaro Plaza, Molo Plaza, and Mandurriao Plaza.

text: Ayon kay Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, tagapagsalita ni Mayor Treñas, ipinalabas ang nasabing executive order upang makatulong sa kabuhayan ng mga residente, lalo na ngayong panahon ng Kapaskuhan.
english: According to Joy Fantilaga-Gorzal, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, the executive order was issued to help the livelihood of the residents, especially during the Christmas season.

text: Nilinaw rin ni Gorzal na hindi maaaring magtinda ang mga sidewalk vendors kung saan-saan lamang upang maiwasan ang pagsisikip ng daloy ng trapiko at mapanatiling maayos ang biyahe ng mga motorista.
english: Gorzal also clarified that sidewalk vendors will not be allowed to sell anywhere to avoid traffic congestion and maintain the smooth movement of motorists.

text: Nanawagan naman ang pamahalaang lungsod sa mga magtitinda na sumunod sa lahat ng kinakailangang dokumento tulad ng barangay clearance, special permit, health card, at pagsunod sa stall size guidelines.
english: The city administration appealed to vendors to comply with all required documents such as barangay clearance, special permit, health card, and compliance with stall size guidelines.

text: Dagdag pa rito, mahigpit na ipatutupad ng city government ang “No Permit, No Stall” na polisiya.
english: In addition, the city government will strictly enforce the “No Permit, No Stall” policy.

text: Wala sang iloy nga wala nagapalangga sa ila anak.
english: There is no mother who does not love their child.

text: Tanan ila himuon agud lamang nga mahatag ang kinahanglanon kag mangin malipay ang ila mga kabataan.
english: They will do everything just to make ends meet and make their children happy.

text: Apang didto sa Nikolaev sa Ukrain, ang 51 anyos nga iloy ang gindakop sang mga otoridad matapos matukiban nga nagakutkot ini sang underground tunnel malapit sa bintana sang presohan sa diin nahamtang ang iya nga anak bangud sa kaso nga murder.
english: But in Nikolaev, Ukraine, the 51-year-old mother was arrested by authorities after she was discovered digging an underground tunnel near the window of the prison where her son was being held on murder charges.

text: Ini agud nga mabuligan sang iloy ang iya anak nga makapalagyo.
english: This is so that the mother can help her son escape.

text: Nag-arkila ang babaye nga wala na ginhingadlan malapit sa presohan sa diin yara ang iya anak.
english: The woman, who has not been named, rented a rental near the jail where her son is.

text: Kada gab-i, hinay-hinay niya nga ginakutkot ang duta tubtob nga nangin 10 ka tapak na ang kadalumon sini sa sulod sang tatlo ka semana.
english: Every night, he slowly dug the soil until it was 10 feet deep in three weeks.

text: Malapit na kuntani malab-ot sang iloy ang presohan sang iya anak apang nadakpan ini sang mga otoridad.
english: The mother was about to reach her son's prison but was caught by the authorities.

text:
Suno kay Serhey Pilnyansky, residente sa lugar, wala gid niya matalupangdan ang iloy nga nagaguwa ini kun gab-i.

Mismo ang mga pulis sa lugar ang nag-ako nga ginkakibot nila ang ginhimo sang iloy nga apisar babaye ini, natinguhaan niya magkutkot sang duta nga tuman na ka dalom.
english:
Serhey Pilnyansky, a resident of the area, said he never noticed his mother going out at night.

The police themselves in the area admitted that they were surprised by the mother's actions that despite being a woman, she tried to dig the ground that was too deep.

text: Apisar sala ang ginhimo sang iloy nga ipalagyo ang iya anak, nag-angkon naman ini sang pagdayaw sa mga residente sa Nikolaev bangud sa pagpalangga nga may yara ang iloy sa iya nga bata.
english: Although the mother did wrong to send her son away, she earned praise from the residents of Nikolaev for the love that the mother had for her son.

text: (Via Oddity Central)
english: (Via Oddity Central)

text: Ginpabati-batian ni Cavite 4th District Rep.
english: Cavite 4th District Rep.

text: Kiko Barzaga ang iban nga kongresista nga may personal nga mga isyu apang wala man ginpasakaan sang ethics complaint sa Kamara.
english: Kiko Barzaga said other congressmen have personal issues but have not filed an ethics complaint with the House.

text: “Yung ibang congressman nga, nahuhuling may kabit pero ‘di sila nae-ethics complaint eh,” pahayag ni Barzaga kasunod sang gindagdag sa iya sang Ethics Committee sang House of Representatives nga 60 ka adlaw nga suspension.
english: “Some congressmen who are caught with a wife but they don't have an ethics complaint,” Barzaga said after the Ethics Committee of the House of Representatives added a 60-day suspension.

text: Ini nga penalidad ang kaangot sa ginapahayag nga disorderly behavior sang kongresista bangud sa iya nga social media posts.
english: The penalty is related to the congressman's alleged disorderly behavior due to his social media posts.

text: “Personally speaking, the suspension does not truly negatively affect me.
english: “Personally speaking, the suspension does not truly negatively affect me.

text: It mostly negatively affects the institution as a whole because people are losing trust in Congress and this would decrease the trust in Congress even more,” suno kay Barzaga.
english: It mostly negatively affects the institution as a whole because people are losing trust in Congress and this would decrease the trust in Congress even more,” according to Barzaga.

text: Kahapon, 249 ka mga mamalidha ang nagboto pabor sa desisyon, lima ang negative, kag isa ang nag-abstain.
english: Yesterday, 249 lawmakers voted in favor of the decision, five against, and one abstained.

text: Sandig kay House Ethics Committee chairperson 4Ps party-list Rep.
english: According to House Ethics Committee chairperson 4Ps party-list Rep.

text: JC Abalos, magluwas sa 60-day suspension, wala man sang sweldo si Barzaga kag wala sang allowances sa sulod sang amo nga inadlaw.
english: JC Abalos, besides the 60-day suspension, Barzaga also received no salary and no allowances during that day.

text: May ginlakip man nga warning nga pananglitan himuon pa sini liwat ang kaangay nga disorderly behavior, mangin mas malala ang pag-disiplina sa iya.
english: There was also a warning that if he did the same disorderly behavior again, the discipline would be worse.

text: “His actions reflected negatively upon the dignity, integrity, and reputation of the House of Representatives as an institution of the members of the House individually and collectively.
english: “His actions reflected negatively upon the dignity, integrity, and reputation of the House of Representatives as an institution of the members of the House individually and collectively.

text: Consequently, the committee finds respondent, Rep.
english: Consequently, the committee finds respondent, Rep.

text: Kiko Barzaga of the 4th district of Cavite guilty of disorderly behavior by violating Sec.
english: Kiko Barzaga of the 4th district of Cavite guilty of disorderly behavior by violating Sec.

text: 141 (a) Rule 20 of the Rules of House of Representatives, 4(c) of RA 6713 or the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees,” kabahin sang ginbasa ni Abalos sa plenary session kahapon.
english: 141 (a) Rule 20 of the Rules of House of Representatives, 4(c) of RA 6713 or the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees,” Abalos read in plenary session yesterday.

text: Present sa plenaryo si Barzaga kahapon kag nagsiling nga ginabaton niya ang desisyon.
english: Barzaga was present at the plenary yesterday and said he accepts the decision.

text: “I wholeheartedly accept the decision of the committee, but I maintain my stance that President Marcos must be held accountable for his crimes.
english: “I wholeheartedly accept the decision of the committee, but I maintain my stance that President Marcos must be held accountable for his crimes.

text: Too many people have died, and too much money was plundered from the Filipino people for us to stand down now,” suno sa kongresista.
english: Too many people have died, and too much money was plundered from the Filipino people for us to stand down now,” the congressman said.

text:
“Whatever punishment may fall upon me and others who stand against this president, who has lost his constitutional mandate of serving the people is inconsequential in relation to the number of lives and futures that will be saved once President Marcos leaves the Malacañang.”

Nahibaluan nga ang ginpuntariya kay Barzaga amo ang ginaalegar paglapas sini sa Code of Conduct para sa public officials kag employees bangud sa posts sa iya nga Facebook page nga ginalaragway nga “inappropriate” kag wala nagatahod sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno.#
english:
“Whatever punishment may fall upon me and others who stand against this president, who has lost his constitutional mandate of serving the people is inconsequential in relation to the number of lives and futures that will be saved once President Marcos leaves the Malacañang.”

Barzaga was targeted for allegedly violating the Code of Conduct for public officials and employees because of posts on his Facebook page that were described as “inappropriate” and disrespectful to government officials.

text: Nagapabilin sa ospital ang duha ka tuig nga bata nga napilasan matapos gin-arado sang 10-wheeler truck ang duha ka balay sa kilid sang karsada sang Maharlika highway, Sitio Javier, Barangay Daguit, Labo, Camarines Norte.
english: A two-year-old boy who was injured after a 10-wheeler truck plowed into two houses on the side of the road of Maharlika highway, Sitio Javier, Barangay Daguit, Labo, Camarines Norte remains in the hospital.

text: Halin sa Santa Rosa, Laguna ang truck nga may karga nga grocery items pakadto sa Daet, Camarines Norte sang natabo ang aksidente.
english: The truck was heading from Santa Rosa, Laguna to Daet, Camarines Norte when the accident occurred.

text: Yara sa sulod sang isa sa mga balay nga gin-arado sang truck ang bata.
english: The child was inside one of the houses plowed by the truck.

text: Wala naman napilasan ang drayber kag pahinante sang truck nga ginaimbestigaran pa sang otoridad para sa pagpasaka sang kaso.
english: The driver and passenger of the truck were not injured and are still being investigated by the authorities for filing a case.

text: Itiglawas sang 29-anyos nga Filipina-Kiwi actress nga si Franki Russell ang pungsod New Zealand sa Miss Universe pageant subong nga tuig.
english: 29-year-old Filipina-Kiwi actress Franki Russell will represent New Zealand in this year's Miss Universe pageant.

text: Na-appoint si Russel sa amo nga posisyon matapos nga ginhingadlan man ang Filipino entrepreneur nga si Josh Yugen bilang bag-o nga national director kag franchise owner sang Miss Universe New Zealand.
english: Russel was appointed to the position after Filipino entrepreneur Josh Yugen was also named as the new national director and franchise owner of Miss Universe New Zealand.

text: Sang 2021, nagpasakop man ang aktres sa Miss Universe UAE kun sa diin sulod ini sa top 30.
english: In 2021, the actress also participated in Miss Universe UAE where she was in the top 30.

text: Sa Pilipinas, lakip sa pinakaulihi sini nga proyekto amo ang pelikula nga “Pabuya” kun sa diin kaupod sini ang ex-boyfriend nga si Diego Loyzaga.
english: In the Philippines, her latest project is the film “Pabuya” with her ex-boyfriend Diego Loyzaga.

text: Patigayunon ang 73rd Miss Universe edition sa Mexico kun sa diin pagapilian ang magabulos sa trono ni Sheynnis Palacios sang Nicaragua.
english: The 73rd Miss Universe edition will be held in Mexico where the successor to Sheynnis Palacios of Nicaragua will be chosen.

text: Nagpahayag si United States President Donald Trump nga nagbuang na gid si Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: United States President Donald Trump has said that Russian President Vladimir Putin has gone mad.

text: Reaksyon ini sang presidente matapos ginlunsar sang Russia ang aerial attack nga amo ang ginakabig pinakadaku sini nga atake sa Ukraine sa sulod sang tatlo ka tuig nga gyera.
english: The president's reaction came after Russia launched an aerial attack that is considered its largest attack on Ukraine in the three-year war.

text: “I’ve always had a very good relationship with Vladimir Putin of Russia, but something has happened to him.
english: “I’ve always had a very good relationship with Vladimir Putin of Russia, but something has happened to him.

text: He has gone absolutely CRAZY!
english: He has gone absolutely CRAZY!

text: He is needlessly killing a lot of people, and I’m not just talking about soldiers.
english: He is needlessly killing a lot of people, and I’m not just talking about soldiers.

text: Missiles and drones are being shot into Cities in Ukraine, for no reason whatsoever,” post ni Trump sa Truth Social.
english: Missiles and drones are being shot into Cities in Ukraine, for no reason whatsoever,” Trump posted on Truth Social.

text: Sa separado nga pahayag, ginsiling sini nga maayo man kuntani ang ila relasyon ni Putin, apang wala siya nakahibalo kun ano na ang natabo diri.
english: In a separate statement, he said his relationship with Putin should have been good, but he did not know what had happened.

text: Dugang sang US leader, wala sang kaluoy ang Russian president sa pagpamatay sa mga tawo kag pagpadala sang mga missiles kag drones sa Ukraine bisan wala man siya sang rason nga himuon ini.
english: The US leader added that the Russian president has no mercy in killing people and sending missiles and drones to Ukraine even though he has no reason to do so.

text: “I’m not happy with what Putin is doing.
english: “I’m not happy with what Putin is doing.

text: He’s killing a lot of people, and I don’t know what the hell happened to Putin,” dugang sini.
english: He’s killing a lot of people, and I don’t know what the hell happened to Putin,” it added.

text: Byernes, Sabado, kag Domingo nga sunod-sunod nga atake ang ginhimo sang Moscow nga nagpatay na sang 29 ka mga tawo.
english: Friday, Saturday, and Sunday back-to-back attacks were carried out by Moscow that have already killed 29 people.

text: Sandig sa Ukrainian air force, 355 drones kag siyam ka cruise missiles ang ginpadala sang Moscow sang nagligad nga gab-i nga amo subong ang largest drone attack nga ila nahimo sa Ukraine halin sang 2022.
english: According to the Ukrainian air force, Moscow sent 355 drones and nine cruise missiles last night, which is now the largest drone attack it has carried out in Ukraine since 2022.

text: Ginbaton sang Hamas militants ang ceasefire proposal sang US envoy nga si Steve Witkoff.
english: Hamas militants accepted US envoy Steve Witkoff’s ceasefire proposal.

text: Ini nga anunsyo ang nagadala sang panibag-o nga paglaum sang pagtapos sang gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas sa Gaza nga nag-umpisa sang Oktubre 2023.
english: This announcement brings renewed hope of an end to the war between Israel and Hamas in Gaza that began in October 2023.

text: Sa bag-o nga proposal, nakasaad ang paghilway sang 10 ka mga bihag kag 70 ka adlaw nga pag-untat sang away.
english: The new proposal promised the release of 10 hostages and a 70-day ceasefire.

text: Ginpahayag nga ang mga bihag amo ang mga Israeli nga ginahuptan sang Hamas kag ginseparar sa duha ka grupo.
english: It was reported that the hostages were Israelis held by Hamas and separated into two groups.

text: Nakabutang man sa proposal ang pagpaguwa sang Israel sang mga ginpang-preso sini nga mga Palestino.
english: The proposal also calls for Israel to release its Palestinian prisoners.

text: As of press time, wala pa sang kumpirmasyon nga ginpaguwa ang gobyerno sang Israel kaangot diri.
english: As of press time, no confirmation has been released by the Israeli government in this regard.

text: Matandaan nga sang Enero, may ceasefire agreement man sa tunga sang Hamas kag Israel, apang natapos na sang Marso kag nagbalik ang Israel sa ila military campaign nga rason sang pagbayluhanay sang duha ka kampo sang rockets kag mga atake.
english: It can be recalled that in January, there was also a ceasefire agreement between Hamas and Israel, but it ended in March and Israel returned to its military campaign that caused the two camps to exchange rockets and attacks.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga magasugot lamang sila sa temporary ceasefire kun buy-an sang militante ang tanan nga hostages kag tapuson lamang nila ang gyera kun mapanas na nila ang Hamas.
english: Earlier, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said they would only agree to a temporary ceasefire if the militants released all hostages and would end the war only if they wiped out Hamas.

text: Picture diri, picture didto.
english: Picture here, picture there.

text: Amu ina ang ulubrahon sang mga mahilig sa photography.
english: That's what photography enthusiasts do.

text: Apang didto sa India, isa ka lalaki ang obsess sa photography nga mismo ang iya mga kabataan ang ginhatagan niya sang pangalan halin mismo sa mga brand sang camera.
english: But back in India, a man was so obsessed with photography that he named his children after the camera brands themselves.

text: Sila amo sanday Nikon, Epson kag Canon.
english: They are Nikon, Epson and Canon.

text: Apang indi lang na!
english: But that's not all!

text: Bangud ang balay ni Ravi Hongal, 49 anyos, ang camera-shaped man.
english: Because the house of Ravi Hongal, 49 years old, is also camera-shaped.

text: Pinasahi ang balay ni Ravi sa diin naglab-ot sa 95,000 US dollars ukon P4,699,175 ang naggasto sini sa pagpahimo lamang sang pinasahi niya nga balay.
english: Ravi's house is unique and he spent 95,000 US dollars or P4,699,175 to build his unique house.

text: Kaangay sang camera, makit-an man saguwa sang balay ni Ravi ang lens-shaped nga bintana, flash kag giant SD card.
english: Like the camera, a lens-shaped window, flash and giant SD card can also be found outside Ravi's house.

text: Nagkahilig sa photography si Ravi umpisa sang bata pa ini — wala man siya nagapanguna sa sulod sang klase apang kun sa patag sang photography ang pagahambalan, si Ravi ang masami nga ginapakuha sang litrato.
english: Ravi has been interested in photography since he was a child — he doesn't lead in class but when it comes to photography, Ravi is often photographed.

text: Nagpatindog man sang studio si Ravi kag ginpangalanan ini sa iya nga asawa nga si Rani.
english: Ravi also built a studio and named it after his wife Rani.

text: Nagtipon, naghugyaw, kag nag-isa ang linibo ka Celtics fans samtang ginaselebrar ang nakuha sang Boston nga kampyonato sa 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA) finals!
english: Thousands of Celtics fans gathered, cheered, and united as Boston celebrated its championship in the 2024 National Basketball Association (NBA) finals!

text: Ang 90-minutos nga parada ang nagsugod sa TD Garden, nagliso sa Causeway Street sa atubang sang arena kag naglabay man sa City Hall, Boston Common, Boylston Street kag nagtapos sa Hynes Convention Center.
english: The 90-minute parade started at TD Garden, turned onto Causeway Street in front of the arena and also passed City Hall, Boston Common, Boylston Street and ended at the Hynes Convention Center.

text: “Thank you for honoring the Celtics tradition.
english: “Thank you for honoring the Celtics tradition.

text: For this team in particular, we are in love with this team.
english: For this team in particular, we are in love with this team.

text: Because it is a team and they have given us so much,” kabahin sang mensahe ni Massachusetts Gov.
english: Because it is a team and they have given us so much,” Massachusetts Gov.

text: Maura Healey.
english: Maura Healey.

text:
“Today we’re going to party and celebrate the Boston Celtics.”

Sa amo man nga selebrasyon, gindayaw ni Boston Mayor Michelle Wu ang liderato sa Celtics — ang nagauyat sang 18 ka kampyonato sa NBA nga amo ang pinakadamo sa bug-os nga maragtas sang liga.
english:
“Today we’re going to party and celebrate the Boston Celtics.”

At the same celebration, Boston Mayor Michelle Wu praised the leadership at the Celtics — the holders of 18 NBA championships which is the most in all of league history.

text: “This was a team willing to face challenging decision, face the non-believers, and work together to build something extraordinary.
english: “This was a team willing to face challenging decision, face the non-believers, and work together to build something extraordinary.

text: As a result, Boston is home to the undisputed greatest team in the NBA,” suno kay Wu.
english: As a result, Boston is home to the undisputed greatest team in the NBA,” according to Wu.

text: Mangin ang superstar sang Boston nga si Jayson Tatum ang halos indi man makapati sa ila nga nalab-ot bilang team.
english: Even Boston superstar Jayson Tatum could hardly believe what they achieved as a team.

text: “It’s unbelievable.
english: “It’s unbelievable.

text: It still doesn’t seem true.
english: It still doesn’t seem true.

text:
But just trying to stay in the moment.”

Bangud sa kadamo sang fans nga nag-upod sa parada, mangin ang Celtics owner nga si Wyc Grousbeck ang indi man makalusot sa alagyan.
english:
But just trying to stay in the moment.”

Because of the large number of fans who joined the parade, even Celtics owner Wyc Grousbeck could not get through the aisle.

text: Nagtuyo ini nga magmaneho pasulod sa arena samtang dala ang Larry O’Brien Trophy kag bag-o himo nga 2024 championship banner kaupod sa iya asawa nga si Emilia Fazzalari kag ila anak.
english: He intended to drive into the arena while carrying the Larry O’Brien Trophy and a newly made 2024 championship banner with his wife Emilia Fazzalari and their son.

text: Bangud indi makalabay sa tunga sang traffic kag mga barikada, naglakat na lamang ang mga ini sa Causeway Street samtang dala ang trophy kag banner.
english: Unable to pass between traffic and barricades, they walked along Causeway Street carrying the trophy and banner.

text: Sa sulod sang Garden, kaupod sa nagtambong amo ang players kag ila family members, mga katapo sang Celtics organization, arena staff, season-ticket holders kag guests lakip ang gobernador kag alkalde.
english: Inside the Garden, among those in attendance were players and their family members, members of the Celtics organization, arena staff, season-ticket holders and guests including the governor and mayor.

text: Ang lima ka starters sang team– Tatum, Jaylen Brown, Jrue Holiday, Derrick White kag Kristaps Porzingis — ang yara gihapon sa kontrata para sa next season.
english: The team’s five starters– Tatum, Jaylen Brown, Jrue Holiday, Derrick White and Kristaps Porzingis — are still under contract for next season.

text: Matapos naka-secure sang long-term extensions kay Brown, Holiday kag Porzingis, ginalauman nga amo man ini ang himuon sang Celtics kanday Tatum kag White subong nga summer.
english: After securing long-term extensions with Brown, Holiday and Porzingis, the Celtics are expected to do the same with Tatum and White this summer.

text: Martes sang aga (oras sa Pilipinas) sang nakuha nanday Tatum ang kampyonato matapos ginlutos ang Dallas Mavericks sa Game 5, 106-88, nga kadungan man sa anibersaryo sang ila ika-17 ang kampyonato nga nakuha sang 2008.#
english: Tatum won the championship on Tuesday morning (Philippine time) after beating the Dallas Mavericks in Game 5, 106-88, which also coincided with the anniversary of their 17th championship won in 2008.#

text: Makikilahok ang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) Region 6 sa taunang “Dugong Bombo 2025: A Little Pain… A Life to Gain” ng Bombo Radyo Philippines, Philippine Red Cross at Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation, Inc.
