english: The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) Region 6 will participate in the annual “Dugong Bombo 2025: A Little Pain… A Life to Gain” of Bombo Radyo Philippines, Philippine Red Cross and Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation, Inc.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay JSSupt Jhon Montero, Regional Director ng BJMP Region 6, sinabi nito na layunin ng kanilang pakikilahok na hikayatin ang mga kawani na magbigay ng donasyon ng dugo upang makatulong sa mga nangangailangan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, JSSupt Jhon Montero, Regional Director of BJMP Region 6, said that their campaign aims to encourage employees to donate blood to help those in need.

text: Binanggit din nito ang kahalagahan ng pagkakaisa at malasakit sa kapwa bilang bahagi ng serbisyong panlipunan.
english: It also mentioned the importance of unity and compassion for others as part of social service.

text: Hinikayat ng BJMP Region 6 ang publiko at iba pang ahensya ng gobyerno na makiisa at makibahagi sa naturang kampanya.
english: BJMP Region 6 encourages the public and other government agencies to unite and participate in this campaign.

text: Gaganapin ang Dugong Bombo sa Nobyembre 15 (Sabado) sabay-sabay sa 25 key cities sa buong bansa kung saan nag-o-operate ang 32 fully-digitalized AM at FM stations ng network.
english: Dugong Bombo will be held on November 15 (Saturday) simultaneously in 25 key cities nationwide where 32 fully-digitized AM and FM stations of the network are operating.

text: Sa Iloilo area, idaraos ang Dugong Bombo sa Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) sa La Paz, Iloilo City simula alas-siyete ng umaga.
english: In the Iloilo area, the Dugong Bombo will be held at the Iloilo Science and Technology University (ISAT-U) in La Paz, Iloilo City starting at 7 am.

text: SANTA, ILOCOS SUR — Nasawi ang dalawang motorcycle rider matapos magsalpukan ang kanilang mga motorsiklo sa national highway sa Barangay Basug habang bumubuhos ang malakas na ulan.
english: SANTA, ILOCOS SUR — Two motorcycle riders were injured after their motorcycles collided on the national highway in Barangay Basug during heavy rain.

text: Batay sa imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad, lumihis sa kabilang linya ng kalsada ang isa sa mga rider upang iwasan ang isang butas.
english: According to the investigation of the authorities, one of the riders swerved to the other side of the road to avoid a pothole.

text: Sa kasamaang-palad, kasalubong nito ang isa pang rider kaya’t naganap ang banggaan.
english: Unfortunately, he met another rider and the collision occurred.

text: Pareho umanong nagtamo ng matitinding sugat sa ulo at katawan ang dalawang biktima na naging sanhi ng kanilang agarang pagkamatay.
english: Both victims sustained serious head and body injuries that led to their immediate deaths.

text: Patuloy ang paalala ng otoridad sa mga motorista na magdoble-ingat, lalo na sa masamang panahon.
english: Authorities continue to remind motorists to be extra careful, especially in bad weather.

text: Natalana kuntani nga magpauli sa Pilipinas sa Disyembre ang isa ka overseas Filipino worker (OFW) nga lakip sa napatay sang nasunog ang high-rise residential complex sa Hong Kong.
english: An overseas Filipino worker (OFW) who was among those killed when a high-rise residential complex in Hong Kong caught fire was scheduled to return to the Philippines in December.

text: Na-identify ang biktima nga si Maryan Pascual Esteban, 40-anyos, tumandok sang Cainta, Rizal.
english: The victim was identified as Maryan Pascual Esteban, 40, a native of Cainta, Rizal.

text: Disyembre 16 kuntani ang abot ni Esteban, ilabi na bangud ginakalangkagan sini nga makaupod sa Paskuwa ang iya 10-ka-tuig nga anak nga lalaki.
english: Esteban was supposed to arrive on December 16, especially since he was looking forward to spending Christmas with his 10-year-old son.

text: Magluwas diri suno sa iya pamilya, kaadlawan man kuntani sang iya nga amay, apang haluson sila makahanda sang bisan gamay bangud sa kasubo nga ila nabatyagan subong.
english: Besides, according to his family, it was supposed to be his father's birthday, but they could hardly prepare anything because of the sadness they felt now.

text: Nagalaum ang pamilya nga makapauli na ang bangkay sang ila himata sa labing-madali nga tion.
english: The family hopes that the body of their relative will be returned home as soon as possible.

text: Una na nga nagpasalig ang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) kag Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) nga iga-repatriate gilayon ang bangkay kag may ihatag nga financial assistance sa pamilya.
english: Earlier, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) and Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) assured that the body will be repatriated immediately and financial assistance will be provided to the family.

text: Nahibaluan nga apat ka tuig na nga nagatrabaho ang biktima sa Hong Kong antes natabo ang sunog sa high-rise residential complex nga nagpatay sang 151 na ka mga tawo.
english: The victim had been working in Hong Kong for four years before the fire broke out in the high-rise residential complex that killed 151 people.

text: Kita tanan ang may yara sang mga paborito — kaangay na lang sang paborito nga pagkaon, paborito nga panapton kag paborito nga lugar.
english: We all have our favorites — just like favorite food, favorite clothes and favorite place.

text: Apang ikaw, ano bala ang imo paborito nga duag?
english: But you, what is your favorite color?

text: Madamo sang mga manami nga lugar nga mahimo mabisita sa South Korea apang kun luyag mo nga dugangan sang exciting nga content ang imo Instagram feed, idugang sa imo itinerary ang Purple island.
english: There are many great places to visit in South Korea but if you want to add exciting content to your Instagram feed, add Purple island to your itinerary.

text: Bangud may yara pa sang kahangawa sang COVID-19 subong, madamo ka pa sang oras agud nga planohan ang imo masunod nga adventure.
english: Since there is still the concern of COVID-19 now, you still have plenty of time to plan your next adventure.

text: Gani indi gid pagkalimtan ang Purple Island.
english: So don’t miss the Purple Island.

text: Sa pangalan pa lang sang isla, ini ang ginapalibotan sang lavender, duag purple nga mga balay, taytay kag dalan.
english: From the name of the island itself, it is surrounded by lavender, purple houses, bridges and roads.

text: Nagtanom ang mga residente sang Banwol Island kag Parkji Island sang 40,000 nga mga lavender plants lakip na ang linibo nga mga empress trees.
english: Residents of Banwol Island and Parkji Island planted 40,000 lavender plants including thousands of empress trees.

text: Ang ginadagsa sang mga dumuluong amo ang purple Cheona Bridge nga naga konekta sa duha ka mga nasambit nga isla ilabi na kun gab-i bangud naga banaag ang duag.
english: Foreigners flock to the purple Cheona Bridge that connects the two islands especially at night because it is bright.

text: Indi lamang mga balay ang purple kundi mangin ang mga hotel rooms, restaurants kag restrooms ang duag purple man kag mangin ang mga salakyan.
english: Not only houses are purple but also hotel rooms, restaurants and restrooms are also purple and even vehicles.

text:
Kun luyag mo mag check in, ang purple-colored rooms ang naga balor 50,000 Korean Won ukon P2,060 lang ang kada gab-i.

Gani, sa mga nagaplano nga maglagaw sa luwas sang pungsod, ihanda na ang passport kag unahon sa inyo travel list ang Purple Island sa South Korea.
english:
If you want to check in, the purple-colored rooms cost only 50,000 Korean Won or P2,060 per night.

So, for those who are planning to travel abroad, get the passport ready and put the Purple Island in South Korea first on your travel list.

text: Asud-asud ang pagkontra sang pila ka opisyal sang gobyerno kag mga abogado sa pahayag ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga magapadalagan siya sa pagka-bise presidente agud nga makaangkon siya sang legal immunity ukon makalikaw nga pasakaan sang kaso kun matapos na ang iya nga presidential term.
english: Some government officials and lawyers have strongly opposed President Rodrigo Duterte's statement that he will run for vice president in order to gain legal immunity or avoid prosecution when his presidential term ends.

text: Suno kay former Senator kag incumbent Sorsogon Governor Francis “Chiz” Escudero nga isa man ka abogado, presidente lang ang may yara sang immunity from suit.
english: According to former Senator and incumbent Sorsogon Governor Francis “Chiz” Escudero, who is also a lawyer, only the president has immunity from suit.

text: Santo sa 1987 constitution, indi immune from suit ang bise-presidente.
english: According to the 1987 constitution, the vice-president is not immune from suit.

text: Ini nga statement ang kaangay man sa pahayag ni Albay 1st Dist.
english: This statement is also similar to the statement of Albay 1st Dist.

text: Rep.
english: Rep.

text: Edcel Lagman kag Former Supreme Court Public Information Office chief Theodore “Ted” Te.
english: Edcel Lagman and Former Supreme Court Public Information Office chief Theodore “Ted” Te.

text: Suno kay Te, by law ukon by tradition, indi immune from suit ang bisan sin-o man nga mangin bise-presidente.
english: According to Te, by law or by tradition, anyone who becomes vice-president is not immune from suit.

text: Nagdugang si Scottie Thompson sa lista sang Filipino players nga indi makaupod sa hampang sang Gilas Pilipinas sa Fiba Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa Latvia.
english: Scottie Thompson has been added to the list of Filipino players who will not be able to participate in the Gilas Pilipinas match in the Fiba Olympic Qualifying Tournament in Latvia.

text: Suno sa website sang Philippine Basketball Association (PBA), ginasuprer pa sang former PBA MVP ang bulging disc — ang injury nga iya naangkon sa Philippine Cup semifinals kun sa diin nalutos man ang Ginebra batok sa reigning champions nga Meralco.
english: According to the website of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA), the former PBA MVP is still suffering from a bulging disc — the injury he suffered in the Philippine Cup semifinals where Ginebra also lost against reigning champions Meralco.

text: Base sa mga laragway nga gin-post sang Inspire Sports Academy sa Laguna, ang present lamang sa una nga adlaw sang training amo ang naturalized player nga si Justin Brownlee, Kai Sotto, June Mar Fajardo, Chris Newsome, Dwight Ramos, CJ Perez, Carl Tamayo, Calvin Oftana, kag Kevin Quiambao.
english: Based on pictures posted by Inspire Sports Academy in Laguna, the only ones present on the first day of training were naturalized player Justin Brownlee, Kai Sotto, June Mar Fajardo, Chris Newsome, Dwight Ramos, CJ Perez, Carl Tamayo, Calvin Oftana, and Kevin Quiambao.

text: Yara man si former PBA import kag newly appointed Far Eastern University head coach Sean Chambers amo man ang Barangay Ginebra players nga sanday Ralph Cu kag Donald Gumaru.
english: Also present were former PBA import and newly appointed Far Eastern University head coach Sean Chambers as well as Barangay Ginebra players Ralph Cu and Donald Gumaru.

text: Naghanas man sa camp sanday Japeth Aguilar kag Mason Amos nga amo ang magabulos kanday AJ Edu kag Jamie Malanzo nga pareho man nga nagasuprer sang injuries.
english: Also training in camp were Japeth Aguilar and Mason Amos, who will replace AJ Edu and Jamie Malanzo, who are both suffering from injuries.

text: Antes magsabak sa Latvia para sa Olympic qualifiers, atubangon anay sang Gilas ang Taiwan Mustangs sa isa ka exhibition match sa Lunes sa PhilSports Arena sa Pasig.
english: Before taking on Latvia for the Olympic qualifiers, the Gilas will face the Taiwan Mustangs in an exhibition match on Monday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig.

text: Sa aktwal na nga OQT sa Hulyo 3-4, maatubang sang Pilipinas ang host nation kag ang Georgia.
english: In the actual OQT on July 3-4, the Philippines will face the host nation and Georgia.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Nagpositibo sa African swine fever ang mga baboy gikan sa isa sa duha ka mga truck nga na-intercept sa mga livestock checkpoint sa Quezon City kag Valenzuela City.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Pigs from one of two trucks intercepted at livestock checkpoints in Quezon City and Valenzuela City tested positive for African swine fever.

text: Suno sa Bureau of Animal Industry, 147 ka mga baboy nga may African swine fever ang nakumpiskar sa Quezon City checkpoint.
english: According to the Bureau of Animal Industry, 147 pigs with African swine fever were confiscated at the Quezon City checkpoint.

text: Ginpahayag man sang Bureau of Animal Industry, nga ang 11 ka mga baboy nga ginkarga sang isa sa mga truck ang nagapakita sang mga senyales sang impeksyon sang ASF antes pa man ginhimo ang mga blood test.
english: The Bureau of Animal Industry, too, said 11 pigs loaded by one of the trucks were showing signs of ASF infection before blood tests were conducted.

text: Ang 38 pa ka mga baboy nga gindala sang isa pa ka truck ang nagnegatibo sa ASF, kon sa diin, gintugutan sang ahensya nga ihawon sila gilayon.
english: Another 38 pigs brought by another truck tested negative for ASF, whereupon, the agency allowed them to be slaughtered immediately.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag man sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga ginpahamtang ang border controls sa pila ka mga lugar agud mapunggan ang paglapta sang ASF gikan sa isa ka outbreak, partikular sa Batangas.
english: Meanwhile, the Department of Agriculture (DA) also said that border controls have been imposed in some areas to prevent the spread of ASF from an outbreak, particularly in Batangas.

text: Ginsulit man ni Agriculture Assistant Secretary for Swine and Poultry Constante Palabrica, isa ka beterinaryo, nga dapat valid ang tanan nga permit kag ang mga kasapatan nga nagapakita sang anuman nga senyales sang balatian ang ipaidalum sa testing.
english: Agriculture Assistant Secretary for Swine and Poultry Constante Palabrica, a veterinarian, also reiterated that all permits must be valid and animals showing any signs of disease will be subjected to testing.

text: Nagahingyo man ang ahensya sa mga negosyante kag transporter sang baboy nga magsunod sa mga pagsulundan agud malikawan ang dugang nga paglapta sang ASF kag maprotektahan ang industriya sang baboy sang pungsod.
english: The agency also urged pork traders and transporters to follow the guidelines to prevent further spread of ASF and protect the country's pork industry.

text: Narekober na ang mga bangkay ng dalawang mangingisdang nawala sa laot noong Lunes ng gabi sa bayan ng Sibunag sa lalawigan ng Guimaras.
english: The bodies of two fishermen who went missing at sea on Monday night in the town of Sibunag in Guimaras province have been recovered.

text: Kinilala ang mga nasawi na sina Ryan Galfo, 32 anyos, at Vincent Paul Valles, 30 anyos, kapwa residente ng Sitio Liningwan, Maabay, Sibunag.
english: The victims were identified as Ryan Galfo, 32, and Vincent Paul Valles, 30, both residents of Sitio Liningwan, Maabay, Sibunag.

text: Ayon kay Teresita Siason, pinuno ng Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), pumalaot ang apat na mangingisda—sina Ryan, Vincent, Reynaldo Galfo, at Agosto Galfo—noong Lunes ng gabi upang mangisda.
english: According to Teresita Siason, head of the Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO), the four fishermen—Ryan, Vincent, Reynaldo Galfo, and Agosto Galfo—went fishing on Monday night.

text: Habang nasa laot, inutusan umano ni Reynaldo si Ryan na kunin ang boya ng lambat, ngunit tinangay ito ng malakas na alon.
english: While at sea, Reynaldo allegedly ordered Ryan to pick up the net buoy, but it was hit by a strong wave.

text: Tinangka ni Reynaldo na sagipin si Ryan ngunit nabigo rin.
english: Reynaldo tried to save Ryan but failed.

text: Sumunod na tumalon sa dagat si Vincent upang tumulong, ngunit siya rin ay tinangay ng agos.
english: Vincent next jumped into the sea to help, but he too was swept away by the current.

text: Sa kabila ng ginawang pagsagip at paghahanap ng mga nakaligtas, bigo silang mahanap agad ang dalawa.
english: Despite rescue and search efforts by survivors, they were unable to find the two immediately.

text: Matapos ang ilang araw ng search and rescue operation, natagpuan ngayong araw ang bangkay ng mga nawawala.
english: After several days of search and rescue operation, the bodies of the missing were found today.

text: Patuloy ang imbestigasyon at paalala ng PDRRMO sa mga mangingisda na iwasan ang paglalayag sa gitna ng masamang panahon.
english: The PDRRMO is continuing its investigation and reminds fishermen to avoid sailing in the middle of bad weather.

text: ILOILO – Suportado ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.
english: ILOILO – Supported by Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor, Jr.

text: ang desisyon sang Partido Demokratiko Pilipino–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) nga i-eleher si Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi bilang bag-o nga presidente sang partido.
english: the decision of the Democratic Party of the Philippines–Lakas ng Bayan (PDP-Laban) to elect Energy Secretary Alfonso Cusi as the party’s new president.

text: Si Defensor amo ang chairman sang PDP-Laban sa Iloilo.
english: Defensor is the chairman of the PDP-Laban in Iloilo.

text: Kahapon, sa ginpatigayon nga national assembly sang ruling party sa Clark, Pampanga kun sa diin yara mismo ang chairman nga si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, ginpahalin na si Senator Manny Pacquiao bilang presidente kag ginbulos ang anay vice chairman nga si Cusi.
english: Yesterday, at the national assembly of the ruling party in Clark, Pampanga where chairman President Rodrigo Duterte was present, Senator Manny Pacquiao was removed as president and replaced by former vice chairman Cusi.

text: 250 ka PDP-Laban members ang nag-attend sang assembly — physically kag virtually.
english: 250 PDP-Laban members attended the assembly — physically and virtually.

text: Si Duterte mismo ang nagpamuno sa oathtaking sang bag-o nga mga officers.
english: Duterte himself presided over the oathtaking of the new officers.

text: Sa nauna na nga interview kay Defensor, ginpahayag sini nga nagalaum siya nga masolusyunan na ang indi paghangpanay sang mga mata-as nga pinuno sang partido kag maplastar sang maayo ang pila ka mga plano para sa maabot nga eleksyon.
english: In an earlier interview with Defensor, he said he hopes to resolve the misunderstanding between the party's top leaders and lay out some plans for the upcoming elections.

text: Posible nga ipaguwa na subong nga semana ang report sang medical experts kaangot sa ginpatigayon nga medical examination kay former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The report of medical experts regarding the medical examination of former President Rodrigo Duterte is likely to be released this week.

text: “On the 5th of December, we’re due to receive the panel of experts’ reports, the medical evaluations of the former President.
english: “On the 5th of December, we’re due to receive the panel of experts’ reports, the medical evaluations of the former President.

text: Until then, I’m not really entitled to comment or even suggest what might be contained in those reports because there’s an ongoing litigation,” suno kay Nicholas Kaufman, legal counsel sang anay presidente.
english: Until then, I’m not really entitled to comment or even suggest what might be contained in those reports because there’s an ongoing litigation,” according to Nicholas Kaufman, legal counsel to the former president.

text: Nagalaum si Kaufman nga mapamatud-an sa evaluation sang medical experts nga husto ang defense team sa ila petisyon, ilabi na bangud mabudlay mag-trabaho sa kaso ni Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC) bangud sa iya kondisyon subong.
english: Kaufman hopes that the evaluation of medical experts will prove that the defense team is right in their petition, especially since it is difficult to work on Duterte's case in the International Criminal Court (ICC) because of his current condition.

text: “We hope that the evaluation of the medical experts will prove that we are right in our submissions.
english: “We hope that the evaluation of the medical experts will prove that we are right in our submissions.

text: We work with [Duterte] on a daily basis, and we find it extremely difficult because of the impediments that he’s facing,” pahayag pa sang abogado.
english: We work with [Duterte] on a daily basis, and we find it extremely difficult because of the impediments that he’s facing,” the lawyer said.

text: Kun makaguwa na ang report sa medical evaluation, magapasa sang ila sabat ang kampo ni Duterte antes ukon mismo sa Disyembre 12.
english: Once the report on the medical evaluation is released, Duterte's camp will submit its response before or on December 12.

text: Pahayag pa sini, dismayado sila, apang wala na nakibot sang ginbasura sang ICC Appeals Chamber ang apelar ni Duterte para sa interim release.
english: He said they were disappointed, but not surprised when the ICC Appeals Chamber rejected Duterte's appeal for interim release.

text: Ginkumpirma man sini nga napahibalo na niya sa anay presidente ang amo nga desisyon sang korte.
english: He also confirmed that he had already informed the former president of the court's decision.

text: “In fact, we told him that never in the history of the ICC has a suspect been released when charged with crimes against humanity.
english: “In fact, we told him that never in the history of the ICC has a suspect been released when charged with crimes against humanity.

text: If we’d have succeeded, it would have been miraculous.
english: If we’d have succeeded, it would have been miraculous.

text: It would have been a great occasion,” pahayag ni Kaufman.
english: It would have been a great occasion,” stated Kaufman.

text: Nahibaluan nga may pending appeal pa ang kampo ni Duterte sa Appeals Chamber may kaangtanan sa paghangkat sa hurisdiksyon sang ICC sa Pilipinas.
english: It is known that Duterte's camp still has a pending appeal to the Appeals Chamber regarding the challenge to the jurisdiction of the ICC in the Philippines.

text: Mahimo ipaguwa ang desisyon sang Chamber kasunod sang judicial recess sang ICC.
english: The Chamber's decision may be released following the ICC's judicial recess.

text: Magabukas ang ICC sang 2026 judicial year sa Enero 27, 2026.#
english: The ICC will open the 2026 judicial year on January 27, 2026.#

text: Naghatag sang statement of support ang Archdiocese of Jaro sa “Dugong Bombo 2025: A Little Pain… A Life to Gain” sang Bombo Radyo Philippines.
english: The Archdiocese of Jaro gave a statement of support to Bombo Radyo Philippines' “Dugong Bombo 2025: A Little Pain... A Life to Gain”.

text: Sa sulat ni Most Rev.
english: In a letter from Most Rev.

text: Midyphil B. Billones, D.D., Metropolitan Archbishop of Jaro, iya gin-engganyo ang mga parokya, religious communities kag mga tumuluo nga sakop sang Archdiocese of Jaro nga magsuporta kag magpartisipar sa sini nga inisyatibo.
english: Midyphil B. Billones, D.D., Metropolitan Archbishop of Jaro, encouraged the parishes, religious communities and faithful under the Archdiocese of Jaro to support and participate in this initiative.

text: Antes sini, gin-endorso man ni Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) President Pablo Virgilio S. Cardinal David, Bishop of Kalookan, ang Dugong Bombo.
english: Earlier, Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) President Pablo Virgilio S. Cardinal David, Bishop of Kalookan, also endorsed Dugong Bombo.

text: Gin-engganyo sini ang mga diocese, mga parokya, kag mga Katoliko nga institusyon sa bilog nga Pilipinas nga suportahan ini nga nationwide bloodletting activity.
english: He urged dioceses, parishes, and Catholic institutions throughout the Philippines to support this nationwide bloodletting activity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Archbishop Billones, iya ginpahayag nga narealisar niya kun ano ka importante ang dugo sang ginkinahangan nga tughungan sadto ang iya iloy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Archbishop Billones said he realized how important the blood was when his mother had to be transfused.

text: Suno sa arsobispo, bangud sa isa ka volunteer nga nagdonar sang dugo, nasugpunan ang kabuhi sang iya iloy.
english: According to the archbishop, thanks to a volunteer who donated blood, his mother's life was saved.

text: Ini ang rason kun nga suportado gid niya ini nga hilikuton sang Bombo Radyo Philippines, kaupod ang Philippine Red Cross kag ang Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation Inc.
english: This is why he strongly supports this activity of Bombo Radyo Philippines, together with the Philippine Red Cross and the Bombo Radyo Philippines Foundation Inc.

text: Hiwaton ini sa 𝗡𝗼𝗯𝘆𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗿𝗲 𝟭𝟱 (𝗦𝗮𝗯𝗮𝗱𝗼) dululungan sa 25 key cities sa bilog nga pungsod kun sa diin naga-operate ang 32 ka fully-digitalized AM kag FM stations sang network.
english: It will be held in 25 key cities nationwide where 32 FM and full-AM are operating. stations of the network.

text: Sa area sang Iloilo, hiwaton ang Dugong Bombo sa 𝗜𝗹𝗼𝗶𝗹𝗼 𝗦𝗰𝗶𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 (𝗜𝗦𝗔𝗧-𝗨) sa La Paz, Iloilo City umpisa alas syete sang aga.
english: In the Iloilo area, the Dugong Bombo will be held on Saturday. 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗼𝗹𝗼𝗴𝘆 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 (𝗜𝗦𝗰𝗔𝗔𝗔𝗔𝗔𝗔𝗻𝗻𝗻𝗻𝗻𝗻𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗿𝗻 seven in the morning.

text: Nakakita kana bala sang cactus nga tuman ka taas?
english: Have you ever seen a cactus that is so tall?

text: Madamo sang mga pictures sa social media ang nagalagaw sa diin makit-an ang cactus nga tuman ka taas sa kilid sang building sa Tokyo, Japan.
english: Many pictures are circulating on social media showing a cactus that is very tall on the side of a building in Tokyo, Japan.

text: Gin post sang isa ka netizen nga si Yang ang kontrobersyal nga mga pictures sang building nga iya nakit-an sa Takinogawa, Tokyo Metropolitan Area.
english: A netizen named Yang posted controversial pictures of a building he found in Takinogawa, Tokyo Metropolitan Area.

text: Apang indi ang building ang nangin sentro kag nakakuha sang atensyon sa mga netizens kundi ang mataas nga cactus.
english: But it was not the building that became the center of attention and caught the attention of netizens but the tall cactus.

text: Sa una nga paglantaw ni Yang, nagdumdom siya nga poste lamang nga duag green ang nagatindog sa kilid sang building apang sang iya ginpalapitan, isa gali ini ka cactus.
english: At first glance, Yang thought it was just a green pole standing on the side of the building but when he approached it, it was a cactus.

text: Pahayag ni Yang, may yara mismo sang tawo nga naga atipan sa cactus sa diin iya ini ginahigtan agud indi ini mabali kag ginakuhaan man niya sang tunok agud malikawan ang aksidente.
english: Yang said there is a person who takes care of the cactus where he ties it so that it does not break and he also removes the thorn to avoid accidents.

text: Indi man mapat-od kun pila na ang edad sang cactus ukon ano nga sahi sang cactus ini bangud tuman ini ka pinasahi.
english: It is not certain how old the cactus is or what kind of cactus it is because it is very unique.

text: Sa subong, ang Mexican Giant Cardon cactus ang nagakapot sang Guinness World Record nga pinakamataas nga cactus sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Today, the Mexican Giant Cardon cactus holds the Guinness World Record for the tallest cactus in the world.

text: Nagpaathag-dugang ang regional office sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) agud nga suportahan ang panindugan sang national office nga wala sang missing nga pondo sa ayuda sa idalom sang Social Amelioration Program (SAP) — baliskad sa mga alegasyon ni Senator Manny Pacquiao.
english: The regional office of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) clarified to support the national office's position that there is no missing fund in the assistance under the Social Amelioration Program (SAP) — contrary to the allegations of Senator Manny Pacquiao.

text: Kun balik-balikan ang nangin expose ni Pacquaio sang Sabado sang hapon, Hulyo 3, ginpahayag nga nadula ang P10.4 billion nga nakapain kuntani para sa pandemic aid ukon mas kilala nga ayuda.
english: Looking back at Pacquaio's exposure on Saturday afternoon, July 3, it was reported that P10.4 billion that was supposed to be allocated for pandemic aid or better known as aid was lost.

text: Suno sa senador, nagsulod ang DSWD sa agreement sa e-wallet app nga Starpay agud mapanagtag ang pondo apang may yara sang 1.3 million ka benepisyaryo nga wala nakabaton sang ikaduha nga hugnat sang ayuda.
english: The senator said the DSWD entered into an agreement with the e-wallet app Starpay to distribute the funds but there are 1.3 million beneficiaries who have not received the second phase of assistance.

text: Ginpatpat ni Pacquiao nga sa 1.8 million ka benepisyaryo, 500,000 lang ang nakadownload sang application sang Starpay kag nakakuha sang kwarta.
english: Pacquiao explained that out of 1.8 million beneficiaries, only 500,000 downloaded the Starpay application and withdrew money.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mae Castillo, spokesperson sang DSWD Region VI, iya ginpahayag nga ang nakabaton lang sang ikaduha nga hugnat sang SAP distribution sa Western Visayas amo ang Bacolod City kag Iloilo Province.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mae Castillo, spokesperson of DSWD Region VI, said that only Bacolod City and Iloilo Province received the second phase of SAP distribution in Western Visayas.

text: Ang una nga hugnat suno kay Castillo ang ginpanagtag direkta sang DSWD kaupod ang local government units (LGUs).
english: The first phase, Castillo said, was distributed directly by the DSWD in collaboration with local government units (LGUs).

text: Ginpahayag ni Castillo nga Abril pa lang sang sang 2020, gin-untat na ang kontrata sang DSWD sa Financial Service Providers (FSPs) kaangay sang Starpay.
english: Castillo said that as early as April 2020, the DSWD terminated its contract with Financial Service Providers (FSPs) such as Starpay.

text: Sang natapos na ang kontrata suno kay Castillo, direkta nga nag-pay-out ang DSWD sa tanan nga wala nakakuha sang ayuda sa sini nga FSPs.
english: When the contract was completed, Castillo said, the DSWD directly paid out to all those who did not receive assistance from these FSPs.

text: Ginpaathag pa ni Castillo nga antes pa man natapos ang kontrata, ‘ALL ACCOUTED FOR’ ang tanan nga pondo nga nag-agi sa FSPs bangud regular ini nga gina-liquidate.
english: Castillo explained that even before the contract ended, all funds that went through the FSPs were 'ALL ACCOUTED FOR' because they were regularly liquidated.

text: Wala sang nangin seryoso nga problema ang DSWD sa deal sa sini nga service providers.
english: The DSWD has not had any serious problems with the deal with these service providers.

text: Ginsulit man sang regional office ang pahayag sang DSWD central office nga handa sila mag-atubang sa imbestigasyon.
english: The regional office also reiterated the statement of the DSWD central office that they are ready to face the investigation.

text: Ginaplano sang Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) nga pabaskugon ang border controls sa Metro Manila kag malapit nga mga probinsya agud malikawan ang dugang nga paglapta sang African Swine Fever (ASF).
english: The Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) plans to strengthen border controls in Metro Manila and nearby provinces to prevent further spread of African Swine Fever (ASF).

text: Bag-o lang man nagbutang sang meat inspection checkpoint ang ahensya nga yara sa idalum sang Department of Agriculture (DA) sa San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan agud malikawan nga makalab-ot sa naaminhan nga mga probinsya ang mga baboy nga natapikan halin sa nabagatnan nga naga-repopulate sang ila mga kasapatan.
english: The agency under the Department of Agriculture (DA) recently set up a meat inspection checkpoint in San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan to prevent infected pigs from the south that are repopulating their livestock from reaching the northern provinces.

text: Ang lokal nga gobyerno nagabulig sa amo nga inisyatibo paagi sa pagdeploy sang dugang nga manpower, kasunod sang pagbalhag sang San Jose Del Monte sang ila una nga kaso sang ASF sa isa sang mga ihawan sini.
english: The local government is assisting in such an initiative by deploying additional manpower, following San Jose Del Monte’s publication of its first case of ASF in one of its slaughterhouses.

text: Sa subong, naga-coordinate man ang Bureau of Animal Industry sa Probinsya sang Rizal agud makabutang ini sang isa pa ka checkpoint, partikular sa banwa sang Rodriguez.
english: The Bureau of Animal Industry is also coordinating with the Province of Rizal to set up another checkpoint, particularly in Rodriguez town.

text: Samtang, may yara na karon sang anum ka meat inspection checkpoints sa bug-os nga National Capital Region (NCR) agud masiguro nga wala sang ASF ang mga baboy nga ginadul-ong sa mga slaughterhouse kag sa mga merkado.
english: Meanwhile, there are now six meat inspection checkpoints across the National Capital Region (NCR) to ensure that pigs delivered to slaughterhouses and markets are ASF-free.

text: Apang pagkatapos nga ma-assess ang ila mga operasyon sining nagligad nga apat ka adlaw, ginpahayag sang BAI nga kinahanglan na sini nga magpangayo sang bulig sa Metropolitan Manila Development Authority kag local traffic enforcers.
english: However, after assessing its operations over the past four days, the BAI said it needs to seek assistance from the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority and local traffic enforcers.

text: Heads up, basketball fans!
english: Heads up, basketball fans!

text: Natalana nga mag-atubangay ang Gilas Pilipinas kag ang Taiwan Mustangs sa isa ka exhibition match sa Lunes sa Pasig City.
english: Gilas Pilipinas and Taiwan Mustangs are scheduled to face each other in an exhibition match on Monday in Pasig City.

text: Suno sa Samahang Basketbol ng Pilipinas, libre lang ang paglantaw sa sini nga hampang.
english: According to the Philippine Basketball Association, the game is free to watch.

text: Sang damlag, nagpirma sang kontrata sa Taiwan sanday anay NBA stars Dwight Howard kag DeMarcus Cousins apang indi pa maathag subong kun kabahin man sila sang friendly game.
english: Recently, former NBA stars Dwight Howard and DeMarcus Cousins ​​signed contracts in Taiwan but it is not clear whether they will be part of the friendly game.

text: Ini nga hampang ang kabahin sang preparasyon sang team sa kampanya sa FIBA Olympic Qualifying Tournament sa Hulyo 2-7 nga patigyunon sa Latvia.
english: This game is part of the team's preparation for the FIBA ​​Olympic Qualifying Tournament campaign on July 2-7 in Latvia.

text: Kaupod sang Pilipinas sa Group A ang host country kag ang Georgia.
english: The Philippines is in Group A with the host country and Georgia.

text: Nahibaluan nga diri na sa Pilipinas ang Gilas star nga si Justin Brownlee nga amo ang magapanguna sa team para sa tournament.
english: Gilas star Justin Brownlee is already in the Philippines to lead the team for the tournament.

text: Siya man ang naghakwat sang Gilas Pilipinas sa FIBA Asia Cup 2025 Qualifiers subong nga tuig nga naglutos sa Hong Kong kag Chinese Taipei.
english: He also led Gilas Pilipinas to the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2025 Qualifiers this year beating Hong Kong and Chinese Taipei.

text: Para sa tournament sa Latvia, makaupod sini ang PBA stalwarts nga sanday June Mar Fajardo, Chris Newsome, CJ Perez, Japeth Aguilar, Scottie Thompson, kag Calvin Oftana; paga-updan man sang international players nga sanday Kai Sotto (Koshigaya), Dwight Ramos (Hokkaido), kag Carl Tamayo (Changwon LG); kag ang amateur standouts nga sanday Kevin Quiambao (La Salle) kag Mason Amos (Ateneo).
english: For the tournament in Latvia, it will feature PBA stalwarts June Mar Fajardo, Chris Newsome, CJ Perez, Japeth Aguilar, Scottie Thompson, and Calvin Oftana; will also be joined by international players Kai Sotto (Koshigaya), Dwight Ramos (Hokkaido), and Carl Tamayo (Changwon LG); and amateur standouts Kevin Quiambao (La Salle) and Mason Amos (Ateneo).

text: Indi makahampang sanday Jamie Malonzo kag AJ Edu bangud sa ila injuries.
english: Jamie Malonzo and AJ Edu are out with injuries.

text: Natalana man ang friendly games sang pungsod batok sa Turkey sa Hunyo 27 kag batok saPoland sa Hunyo 29.
english: The country is also scheduled to play friendly games against Turkey on June 27 and against Poland on June 29.

text: Apisar wala nalawagan sa expose ni Senator Manny Pacquiao, nagpagwa man sang statement ang Philippine National Police (PNP) agud ipanginwala ang mga alegasyon sang kurapsyon sa bug-os nga hanay sang kapulisan ilabi na sa procurement sang body cameras.
english: Although not called on Senator Manny Pacquiao's expose, the Philippine National Police (PNP) also issued a statement to deny allegations of corruption in the entire police force especially in the procurement of body cameras.

text: Suno kay PNP chief Gen.
english: According to PNP chief Gen.

text: Guillermo Eleazar, naglupok kag nagcirculate ini nga alegasyon sa social media.
english: Guillermo Eleazar, this allegation exploded and circulated on social media.

text: Hunyo 4 sang gin-launch sang PNP ang paggamit sang body cameras agud malikawan ang kaso sang police abuse sa mga operasyon.
english: On June 4, the PNP launched the use of body cameras to prevent cases of police abuse in operations.

text: Suno sa PNP chief, fully-accounted sa Senado kag Kamara ang kwarta nga gingamit sa pagprocure sang mga camera.
english: According to the PNP chief, the money used to procure the cameras is fully accounted for in the Senate and House of Representatives.

text: Nagapakig-angot subong ang PNP sa opisina ni Senator Pacquiao agud ma-verify kun na-mensyonar ang PNP sa ginaalegar listahan sang kurap nga ahensya sa gobyerno.
english: The PNP is now in contact with Senator Pacquiao's office to verify whether the PNP is mentioned in the list of alleged corrupt government agencies.

text: Masami naton makit-an nga bilog ang shape sang mga prutas, apang nakahibalo ka bala nga ang imo paborito nga watermelon ukon sandiya ang may yara sang shape nga… square?!
english: We often see round shaped fruits, but did you know that your favorite watermelon or watermelon is shaped like… square?!

text: Didto sa Japan, ginakabig ang square watermelon bilang iconic symbol kag ini ang nagabalor sang $100 kada isa.
english: In Japan, the square watermelon is considered an iconic symbol and costs $100 each.

text: Suno kay Mototaka Nishimura, manager sa luxury fruit shop, apisar nga manaya-naya sa panan-awan ang sandiya bangud sa iya nga shape, indi manigar nga mas manamit sa gihapon ang sandiya nga bilog.
english: According to Mototaka Nishimura, manager of the luxury fruit shop, although the watermelon looks beautiful because of its shape, there is no denying that the whole watermelon is still tastier.

text: Agud nga mangin square ang shape sang sandiya, ini ang ginabutang sa special acrylic box.
english: In order to keep the shape of the watermelon square, it is placed in a special acrylic box.

text: Pahayag ni Nishimura, bangud indi man maayo ang sabor sang square watermelon, mas maayo nga ini ang i-display lamang bangud indi ini madasig nga madunot kag nagadugay tubtob isa pa ka tuig.
english: Nishimura said that since the square watermelon does not taste good, it is better to display it because it does not rot quickly and lasts up to another year.

text: Suksukon nanday Carlo Paalam kag Nesthy Petecio — flag-bearers sang Pilipinas sa Paris Olympics — ang barong nga gin-desinyo sang popular nga Filipino designer nga si Francis Libiran.
english: Carlo Paalam and Nesthy Petecio — flag-bearers of the Philippines at the Paris Olympics — will wear the barong designed by popular Filipino designer Francis Libiran.

text: “This barong symbolize[s] bravery and national pride.
english: “This barong symbolize[s] bravery and national pride.

text: On the detail, every element of the design showcases the rich cultural heritage of the Philippines,” suno sa post sang Philippine Olympic Committee.
english: On the detail, every element of the design showcases the rich cultural heritage of the Philippines,” suno sa post sang Philippine Olympic Committee.

text: Ini nga barong ang human sang piña-jusi fabric.
english: This barong is made of piña-jusi fabric.

text: Ang boksidor nga sanday Petecio kag Paalam ang magasabak sa Olympiada sa ikaduha nga tion matapos pareho man nga nagdaog sang silver medal sa Tokyo Olympics sang 2021.
english: Boxers Petecio and Paalam will compete in the Olympics for the second time after both won silver medals at the Tokyo Olympics in 2021.

text: Marso sang nakuha ni Petecio ang ticket sini para sa Paris Games paagi sa paglutos kay Esra Yildiz Kahraman sang Turkey sa women’s 57kg division sa una nga World Olympic Qualification Tournament sa Italy.
english: Petecio punched her ticket to the Paris Games in March by defeating Turkey’s Esra Yildiz Kahraman in the women’s 57kg division at the first World Olympic Qualification Tournament in Italy.

text: Nangin mabudlay naman ang banas ni Paalam bangud nag-atras ini sa una nga qualification tournament bangud sa injury sa abaga, apang sang nahatagan sang ikaduha nga tyansa nga maka-compete sa qualifying games sa Bangkok, Thailand subong nga bulan, wala na sini ginpalampas ang oportunidad kag nag-qualify maan paagi sa paglutos kay Sachin Siwach sang India sa men’s 57kg class.
english: Paalam's path was difficult as he withdrew from the first qualifying tournament due to a shoulder injury, but when given a second chance to compete in the qualifying games in Bangkok, Thailand this month, he did not miss the opportunity and qualified by defeating Sachin Siwach of India in the men's 57k class.

text: Patigayuon ang 2024 Olympics halin sa Hunyo 26 tubtub sa Agusto 11 kun sa diin nakatalana naman ang opening ceremony sa Jardins du Trocadéro kag River Seine.
english: The 2024 Olympics will be held from June 26 to August 11 with the opening ceremony scheduled at the Jardins du Trocadéro and River Seine.

text: As of press time, ang mga kuwalipikado na nga magtiglawas sa Pilipinas amo sanday Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist Eumir Marcial, ang debutants nga sanday Aira Villegas kag Hergie Bacyadan sa boxing; pole vaulter nga si EJ Obiena; fencer nga si Samantha Catantan; gymnasts nga sanday Carlos Yulo, Aleah Finnegan, Emma Malabuyo kag Levi Ruivivar; rower nga si Joanie Delgaco; kag weightlifters nga sanday John Ceniza, Elreen Ando, kag Vanessa Sarno.
english: As of press time, those already qualified to represent the Philippines are Tokyo Olympics bronze medalist Eumir Marcial, debutants Aira Villegas and Hergie Bacyadan in boxing; pole vaulter EJ Obiena; fencer Samantha Catantan; gymnasts Carlos Yulo, Aleah Finnegan, Emma Malabuyo and Levi Ruivivar; rower Joanie Delgaco; and weightlifters John Ceniza, Elreen Ando, ​​and Vanessa Sarno.

text: Nabuhi ang paglaum sang fans nga makaayo pa ang gina-alegar naghuyang na nga relasyon nanday Catriona Gray kag Sam Milby.
english: Fans have revived their hopes that the allegedly strained relationship between Catriona Gray and Sam Milby will be repaired.

text: Ini matapos nakit-an ang duha nga magkaupod liwat kun sa diin yara man ang ila abyan nga aktor kag direktor nga si John Prats kag asawa sini nga si Isabel Oli.
english: This was after the two were seen together again in the presence of their friend actor and director John Prats and his wife Isabel Oli.

text: Base sa picture nga naka-post Marso 10, magkaupod sila nga apat nga naghampang sang pickleball — isa ka sahi sang paddle sport nga nakadesinyo para sa duha ukon apat ka mga players.
english: Based on the picture posted March 10, the four of them played pickleball together — a type of paddle sport designed for two or four players.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila ka bulan na nga nagaguwa ang huring-huring nga sanday Cat kag Sam ang biktima man sang showbiz breakups ilabi na bangud indi na suksok sang beauty queen ang iya nga engagement ring.
english: It is known that for several months, rumors have been circulating that Cat and Sam are also victims of showbiz breakups especially since the beauty queen is no longer wearing her engagement ring.

text: Pebrero 28 sang ginkumpirma sang talent agency sang celebrity couple nga nagapangatubang matuod sila nga duha sa “pagpanghangkat” sa ila nga relasyon, apang ginahimuan pa sang aktibo nga mga tikang agud nga ma-resolba pa kag masalbar ang ila nga pag-updanay.
english: On February 28, the talent agency of the celebrity couple confirmed that they are indeed facing “challenges” in their relationship, but are still taking active steps to resolve and save their relationship.

text: 2020 sang ginsapubliko sang duha ang ila relasyon kag na-engage sang Pebrero 2023.#
english: 2020 when the two made their relationship public and got engaged in February 2023.#

text: Nagabakal ang Department of Health (DOH) sang mga bulong nga malapit na lang mag-expire.
english: The Department of Health (DOH) is buying medicines that are about to expire.

text: Ini ang bag-o nga alegasyon ni Senator Manny Pacquiao batok sa amo nga ahensya.
english: This is the latest allegation by Senator Manny Pacquiao against the agency.

text: Ginpahayag sang senador nga santo ini sa iya nga kaugalingon nga imbestigasyon sa ginaalegar kurapsyon sa gobyerno kag sa mga ahensya sini.
english: The senator said this is based on his own investigation into alleged corruption in the government and its agencies.

text: “Bumibili ito ng mga malapit nang mag-expire na mga gamot.
english: “It buys expired medicines.

text: Binibili ang mga gamot na ito sa regular price samantalang dapat ay bagsak na ang presyo ng mga ito,” pahayag ni Pacquiao.
english: These drugs are being bought at regular prices when the price of these drugs should have fallen,” Pacquiao said.

text: Suno sa senador, pila sa sini nga mga bulong ang naga-expire na antes pa man magamit sang mga tawo.
english: According to the senator, some of these drugs expire before people can use them.

text: Sa press conference kahapon, ginpahayag ni Pacquiao nga madamo pa siya sang ibuyagyag kaangot sa kinawatay sang kwarta sa DOH apang ginahulat niya ang husto nga tion.
english: In a press conference yesterday, Pacquiao said he still has a lot to reveal about the theft of money in the DOH but he is waiting for the right time.

text: “Marami pa akong mga hinahanda at sinusuri na mga dokumento tungkol sa korapsyon sa DOH.
english: “I still have many documents to prepare and review regarding corruption in the DOH.

text: Ilalantad ko rin po iyan sa takdang panahon.”
english: I will also expose that in due course.”

text: Binigyang-diin ni dating Senate President Franklin Drilon na ang Jaro Floodway Project ay produkto ng disente at tapat na pamumuno, bagay na patuloy ngayong tumatanggap ng papuri mula sa mga Ilonggo dahil sa matagumpay nitong pagpigil sa pagbaha sa loob ng mahigit isang dekada.
english: Former Senate President Franklin Drilon stressed that the Jaro Floodway Project is the product of decent and honest leadership, which continues to receive praise from Ilonggos for its successful flood control for more than a decade.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay Drilon, sinabi niya na mas nakikita ngayon ang kahalagahan ng nasabing proyekto, lalo na matapos ang sunod-sunod na bagyong tumama sa bansa na nagdulot ng matinding pagbaha sa maraming lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Drilon said the importance of the project is now more visible, especially after a series of typhoons hit the country that caused severe flooding in many areas.

text: Ayon kay Drilon, ang Jaro Floodway ay isa sa mga pangunahing imprastrakturang nagbigay-proteksyon sa buong lungsod ng Iloilo laban sa malalakas na pag-ulan at bagyo.
english: According to Drilon, the Jaro Floodway is one of the main infrastructures that provides protection to the entire city of Iloilo against heavy rains and typhoons.

text: Dagdag pa niya, hamon ito sa bagong henerasyon ng mga lider na magpatupad din ng mga proyektong may pangmatagalang benepisyo at maipagmamalaki ng mga Ilonggo, lalo na sa panahon ng kalamidad.
english: He added that it is a challenge to the new generation of leaders to implement projects that have long-term benefits and that Ilonggos can be proud of, especially in times of disaster.

text: Natapos ang konstruksyon ng Jaro Floodway noong 2011 sa ilalim ng administrasyon ni dating Pangulong Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, matapos masiguro ni Drilon ang pondo para rito.
english: The construction of the Jaro Floodway was completed in 2011 under the administration of former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, after Drilon secured the funds for it.

text: Layunin ng proyekto na magbigay ng daluyan ng tubig mula kabundukan patungo sa baybayin, upang maiwasan ang malawakang pagbaha sa mga tirahan sa lungsod tuwing may bagyo.
english: The project aims to provide water flow from the mountains to the coast, to avoid widespread flooding of residential areas in the city during typhoons.

text: ITALY– Nakabati ka na bala sang istorya sang preso nga nagpromisa nga magabalik sa presohan sa tion nga makapalagyo?
english: ITALY– Have you ever heard the story of the prisoner who promised to return to prison once he escaped?

text: Sa Italy, duha ka preso ang nagsulat sa mga jail guards nga sila ang magabalik sa presohan matapos makapalagyo bangud sa personal nga rason.
english: In Italy, two prisoners wrote to jail guards that they would return to prison after escaping for personal reasons.

text: Si Davad Zukanovic, 40 anyos kag Lil Ahmetovic, 46 anyos, ang nagpalagyo gikan sa Rebibbia Prison sa Rome, Italy pinaagi sa pag-utod sang duha ka porsyon sang prison cell window, nag-rapel panaog gamit ang fire hydrant hose, nagsaka sa pader kag gin-utod ang barbed wire gamit ang wire cutter.
english: Davad Zukanovic, 40 and Lil Ahmetovic, 46, escaped from Rebibbia Prison in Rome, Italy by cutting two portions of a prison cell window, rappelling down with a fire hydrant hose, climbing a wall and cutting barbed wire with a wire cutter.

text: Makabig naman nga pang holywood movie ang abilidad nga ginpakita sang duha sa ila pagpalagyo.
english: The skills shown by the two in their escape can be considered a Hollywood movie.

text: Suno sa duha, nagpalagyo sila bangud luyag nila salbarun ang ila kabataan gikan sa indi maayo nga buluhaton.
english: According to the two, they fled because they wanted to save their children from the unsavory act.

text: Santo sa sulat nga ginbilin sang duha, magabalik sila kag atubangon kun ano man ang nahimo nga mga sala sa tion nga masolbar na ang problema tuhoy sa ila pamilya.
english: According to the letter left by the two, they will return and face whatever mistakes they have made once the problem regarding their family is resolved.

text: Santo naman sa Italian Police, may nabilin pa nga fingerprint sa presohan apang nagaduda sila kun magabalik gid man ang duha ka preso.
english: According to Italian Police, there are still fingerprints left in the jail but they doubt if the two inmates will return.

text: Sa subong, nagahimo na sang lihok ang Italian police agud makita sanday Zukanovic kag Ahmetovic.
english: Italian police are now making efforts to find Zukanovic and Ahmetovic.

text: Ginkalipay ni anay anay Senate President Franklin Drilon nga sa subong napuslan na sang mga Ilonggo ang Jaro Floodway, nga ginadayaw sang kadam-an bangud sa daku sini nga bulig sa pagpugong sang pagbaha sa syudad.
english: Former Senate President Franklin Drilon is pleased that Ilonggos are now benefiting from the Jaro Floodway, which is praised by many for its great help in preventing flooding in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Drilon, iya ginpahayag nga matapos ang asud-asud nga bagyo nga naglaslas sa pungsod kag nagtuga sang pagbaha sa madamo nga lugar, mas nakita sini ang importansya kag resulta sang proyekto nga iya ginpatigayon sang una.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Drilon said that after the typhoon that hit the country and caused flooding in many areas, he saw more the importance and results of the project he carried out earlier.

text: Suno sa iya, ang Jaro Floodway amo ang isa sa mga infrastructure projects nga naghatag sang proteksyon sa mga pumuluyo sa bilog nga syudad sang Iloilo.
english: He said the Jaro Floodway is one of the infrastructure projects that has provided protection to the residents of the entire city of Iloilo.

text: Gindugang ni Drilon nga isa ini ka panghangkat sa bag-o nga henerasyon sang mga lider nga magpatukod man sang mga proyekto nga makahatag sang bugal kag benepisyo sa mga Ilonggo, ilabi na sa tion sang kalamidad.
english: Drilon added that this is a challenge to the new generation of leaders to also build projects that will bring pride and benefit to Ilonggos, especially in times of disaster.

text: Ginpabutyag man sini nga natungdan na niya ang iya bahin bilang isa ka public servant kag ginbilin nga padayonon kag sustineron sang mga bag-o nga lider ang mga proyekto nga nagahatag sang “sense of pride” sa Iloilo.
english: He also expressed that he has done his part as a public servant and left it to the new leaders to continue and sustain the projects that give a sense of pride to Iloilo.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakumpleto ang konstruksyon sang Jaro Floodway sang 2011, pinaagi sa pagpaninguha ni Drilon sa pagpasiguro nga makumpleto ang pondo sa idalom sang administrasyon ni anay President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.
english: The construction of the Jaro Floodway was completed in 2011, through Drilon's efforts to ensure that the funds were completed under the administration of former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.

text: Ang proyekto naghatag sang alagyan sang tubig halin sa kabukiran padulong sa baybayon, nga nagprotekta sa madamo nga mga pamalay sa syudad batok sa lapnagon nga pagbaha nga dala sang bagyo.
english: The project provided a waterway from the mountains to the coast, protecting many homes in the city against widespread flooding caused by the typhoon.

text: ADEN– Ginkumpirma sang Houthis sa Yemen, ang una nila nga kaso sang coronavirus disease 2019, matapos nadiskubrehan ang kamatayon sang isa ka Somali national, sa Sanaa hotel.
english: ADEN – The Houthis in Yemen confirmed their first case of coronavirus disease 2019, after the death of a Somali national was discovered in a Sanaa hotel.

text: Suno kay Houthi Health Minister Taha Al- Mutawakkil, nakabatun sila sang report tuhoy sa sitwasyon sa hotel (Sanaa), kag gilayun man nga ginpadala ang epidemiological investigation team, agud magpatigayun sang imbestigasyon sa kamatayon sang Somali national.
english: According to Houthi Health Minister Taha Al-Mutawakkil, they received a report about the situation in the hotel (Sanaa), and immediately sent an epidemiological investigation team, to conduct an investigation into the death of the Somali national.

text: Pahayag pa ni Mutawakkil, ang napatay nga Somali ang may yara na nga daan sang problema sa liver kag kidney.
english: Mutawakkil said the deceased Somali already had liver and kidney problems.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Yemen ang pinakaulihi nga pungsod nga nagdeklara sang Covid-19 infections sadtong Abril 10, lakip na ang tatlo ka mga nagkalamatay sa teritoryo nga sakop sang internationally recognized government, kag ‘one case, one death’ naman sa lugar nga sakop sang Iran-aligned Houthis.
english: Yemen was the latest country to declare Covid-19 infections on April 10, including three deaths in internationally recognized government territory, and one case, one death in Iran-aligned Houthis-held territory.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —Nagnubo pabalik sa P57 ang peso sang Pilipinas: $1 nga lebel sang Biernes, isa ka adlaw pagkatapos nga ginbuhinan sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) ang policy rates sa labing una nga tion sa sulod sang halos apat ka tuig.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔 —The Philippine peso fell back to the P57:$1 level on Friday, a day after the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) cut policy rates for the first time in nearly four years.

text: Ang lokal nga kuwarta nagnubo sang 34.5 centavos agud magsira sa P57.245:$1 halin sa pagtapos sang Huwebes nga P56.9:$1.
english: The local currency fell 34.5 centavos to close at P57.245:$1 from Thursday’s close of P56.9:$1.

text: Suno kay Michael Ricafort, chief economist sang Rizal Commercial Banking Corp.
english: According to Michael Ricafort, chief economist of Rizal Commercial Banking Corp.

text: (RCBC),ang pagnubo sang balor sang peso nag-abot isa ka adlaw pagkatapos sang -0.25 [porsyento] nga pagnubo sa lokal nga mga polisiya sa 6.25%.
english: (RCBC),the devaluation of the peso came a day after a -0.25 [percent] decline in local policies to 6.25%.

text: Sang Huwebes, ang Monetary Board sang BSP nagbuhin sang mga policy rates sang 25 basis points, nga nagdala sang target nga reverse repurchase (RRP) rate sa 6.2%, ang overnight deposit rate sa 5.75%, kag ang overnight lending facility rate sa 6.75%.
english: On Thursday, the BSP’s Monetary Board cut policy rates by 25 basis points, bringing the target reverse repurchase (RRP) rate to 6.2%, the overnight deposit rate to 5.75%, and the overnight lending facility rate to 6.75%.

text: Ini ang una nga pag-adjust halin sang 25-basis point off-cycle hike sang Oktubre 2023, kag ang first cut halin sang 25-basis point nga pagnubo sang Nobyembre 2020.
english: This is the first adjustment since the 25-basis point off-cycle hike in October 2023, and the first cut since the 25-basis point decline in November 2020.

text: Suno naman kay Security Bank chief economist Robert Dan Roces, sa iya bahin, nagsiling nga ang dolyar sang Estados Unidos nag-uswag ang datos sang mga sales and jobs data sang Estados Unidos makatilingala nga nag-imprinta sang mas mabaskog sangsa mga pagbanta.
english: Security Bank chief economist Robert Dan Roces, for his part, said the US dollar has improved US sales and jobs data surprisingly printed stronger than estimates.

text: Ginsulit ini ni Ricafort, nga nagasiling nga ang greenback nakaangkon sang footing batok sa iban nga global currencies pagkatapos sang mas maayo sangsa ginapaabot nga mga retail sales and jobless claims data sang Estados Unidos nga mahimo makapanubo sang risk of recession.
english: Ricafort reiterated this, saying the greenback has gained footing against other global currencies after better-than-expected US retail sales and jobless claims data that could reduce the risk of recession.

text: Ini ang nangin sabat ni anay Senate President Franklin Drilon sang ini ang ginpamangkot tuhoy sa ginapatigayon nga imbistigasyon sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: This was the response of former Senate President Franklin Drilon when asked about the ongoing investigation into anomalous flood control projects in the country.

text: Suno kay Drilon, makabig niya nga tuman ka hinay ang development sang imbestigasyon sa diin madamo sang mga tawo ang padayon nga nagahulat sang possible nga resulta.
english: Drilon said he considers the development of the investigation to be very slow where many people are still waiting for possible results.

text: Pahayag pa sini, indi nangin mahapos ang nasambit nga investigation sa mga ghost projects sang pungsod, apang suno sa iya, nagakinahanglan lamang ini sang pagbuyluganay sang mga ahensya nga responsable diri.
english: He said the investigation into the country's ghost projects has not been easy, but he said it only requires the cooperation of the agencies responsible.

text: Dugang pa sang anay senador, madamo na sang mga tawo ang akig sa korapsyon, ilabi na sa subong nga mahinay pa ang lakat sang imbistigasyon apisar nga may gintukod na nga Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).
english: The former senator added that many people are already angry with corruption, especially now that the investigation is still slow despite the establishment of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).

text: Matandaan nga ang ICI gintukod agud magbulig sa Ombudsman nga mapahapos kag mapadasig ang investigation sa maanomaliya nga mga proyekto sa pungsod.
english: It can be recalled that the ICI was established to assist the Ombudsman to facilitate and expedite the investigation of anomalous projects in the country.

text: Ginpabutyag man ni Drilon nga sa iya 34 ka tuig nga serbisyo publiko, wala siya naka-encounter sang lapnagon nga korapsyon kaangay sini.
english: Drilon also said that in his 34 years of public service, he has never encountered such widespread corruption.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga possible umpisahan na sang Senado ang debate sa new independent commission, sa diin hatagan sang dako nga puder ang ICI agud mangin epektibo ang ila ginapatigayon nga imbistigasyon angot sa mga ghost projects sa pungsod.
english: He also said the Senate is likely to start a debate on a new independent commission, which will give the ICI greater powers to make its investigation into ghost projects in the country more effective.

text: Yara sa gihapon sa state of trauma ang duha ka ilongga nga nagikan sa banwa sang Maasin, Iloilo matapos nga nasaksikhan ang sunog nga nagluntad sa pito ka high-rise towers sang Wang Fuk Court complex sa Tai Po, Hong Kong.
english: Two Ilonggas from Maasin, Iloilo are still in a state of trauma after witnessing a fire that broke out in the seven high-rise towers of the Wang Fuk Court complex in Tai Po, Hong Kong.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Cynthia Dario, Head sang Public Employment Service Office (PESO) sang probinsya sang Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga ang duha ka mga ilongga ang nagaubra bilang mga domestic helpers kag nagatinir man mismo sa amo nga building kag natabuan nga ara sa ti-on sang nagluntad ang sunog kag sa maayo nga kahimtangan, wala ang mga ini nasamaran.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Cynthia Dario, Head of the Public Employment Service Office (PESO) of Iloilo province, said the two Ilonggas were working as domestic helpers and were staying in the building.

text: Samtang, nakadepende naman sa request sang mga biktima ang bulig nga ipalab-ot sang Iloilo Provincial Government apang inkaso nga magpauli ang mga ini mahimo ini nga makabaton sang financial assistance nga P10,000.
english: Meanwhile, the assistance provided by the Iloilo Provincial Government depends on the request of the victims but in case they return home, they can receive financial assistance of P10,0

text: Una na nga gin-activate sang PESO sang probinsya sang Iloilo ang “Operation Bulig Ilonggo” agud nga makapakig-angot sa mga Barangay PESO coordinators, Municipal PESO managers kag OFW association agud gilayon makakuha sang impormasyon inkaso may Ilonggo nga naulamid sa insidente.
english: Earlier, the PESO of Iloilo province activated “Operation Bulig Ilonggo” to liaise with Barangay PESO coordinators, Municipal PESO managers and OFW associations to immediately obtain information in case an Ilonggo is involved in the incident.

text: Base sa regional data, yara sa 54,629 ka mga OFWs ang naga-ubra sa Hong Kong.
english: Based on regional data, there are 54,629 OFWs working in Hong Kong.

text: VIETNAM- Nagahandum ka bala nga magbakal sang motorsiklo ukon sports car?
english: VIETNAM- Are you dreaming of buying a motorcycle or sports car?

text: kag nakakita kana bala sang motorsiklo kag sports car nga nagabyahe sa dalan, nga human sa card board?
english: and have you ever seen a motorcycle and a sports car traveling on the road, made of card board?

text: Sa pungsod Vietnam, isa ka grupo sang mga motoring enthusiast ang nagsikat bangud sila ang nagihimo sang makabig ‘driveable cardboard replicas’ sang mga malahalon nga salakyan.
english: In Vietnam, a group of motoring enthusiasts have become famous for making drivable cardboard replicas of expensive cars.

text: Ang materyales nga gingamit sang nasambit nga grupo sa pagpasad sang motorsiklo kag salakyan, amo ang scrap metal,spareparts sang motorbikes akg ang pinaka importante tuman ka damo nga mga cardboard.
english: The materials used by the group to build the motorcycle and vehicle were scrap metal, spare parts of motorbikes and most importantly a lot of cardboard.

text: Nakaangkon naman sang nagkalain-lain ngfa reaksyon ang ginhimo sang  mga motoring enthusiasts sa diin kalabanan ang nagdayaw sang  ila ginhimo.
english: The motoring enthusiasts' actions received mixed reactions, most of whom praised their actions.

text: Nangin inspirasyon man ini sa iban nga indi makasarang magbabakal sang malahalon nga sporstcar kag motorsiklo, bangud magluwas nga indi sila tuman nga magastuhan,ma eksperyensyahan man nila magsakay sa salakyan nga  ginatangla sang tanan ang brand.
english: It also became an inspiration to others who cannot afford to buy expensive sportscars and motorcycles, because besides not being too expensive, they can also experience riding in a vehicle that everyone looks up to the brand.

text: Nagmandu si Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga pasakaon ang security measures para sa Israeli missions kag state representatives sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has ordered increased security measures for Israeli missions and state representatives around the world.

text: Ini nga statement ang kasunod sa natabo sa guwa sang Capital Jewish Museum sa Washington, DC, USA kun sa diin ginluthang-patay ang duha ka staffers sang Israeli embassy.
english: This statement follows the incident outside the Capital Jewish Museum in Washington, DC, USA where two staffers of the Israeli embassy were shot dead.

text: “My heart grieves for the families of the young beloveds, whose lives were cut short in a moment by an abhorrent antisemitic murderer,” suno sa prime minister.
english: “My heart grieves for the families of the young beloveds, whose lives were cut short in a moment by an abhorrent antisemitic murderer,” according to the prime minister.

text: Nagpaguwa man sang pahayag si US President Donald Trump nga nagakondenar sa insidente.
english: US President Donald Trump also issued a statement condemning the incident.

text: “These horrible D.C. killings, based obviously on antisemitism, must end, NOW!
english: “These horrible D.C. killings, based obviously on antisemitism, must end, NOW!

text: Hatred and Radicalism have no place in the USA.
english: Hatred and Radicalism have no place in the USA.

text: Condolences to the families of the victims.
english: Condolences to the families of the victims.

text: So sad that such things as this can happen!” post sini sa social media.
english: So sad that such things as this can happen!” post it on social media.

text: Sang natabo ang pagpangluthang, may yara sang event nga ginahiwat ang American Jewish Committee.
english: When the shooting happened, the American Jewish Committee was having an event.

text: Ang mga biktima nga sanday Yaron Lischinsky kag Sarah Milgrim ang na-identify nga magkahagugma kag malapit na lang kuntani ma-engage.
english: The victims, Yaron Lischinsky and Sarah Milgrim, were identified as lovers and were about to get engaged.

text: Natumod man ang suspek nga amo ang 31-anyos nga si Elias Rodriguez halin sa Chicago.
english: The suspect was also identified as 31-year-old Elias Rodriguez of Chicago.

text: Samtang yara siya sa kustodiya sang pulis, nagasinggitan ini nga hilwayon ang Palestine.
english: While he was in police custody, he was shouting to liberate Palestine.

text: Base sa nauna nga mga impormasyon, ginklaro man sini sa pulis nga ginhimo niya ang krimen para sa Gaza.
english: Based on previous information, he also clarified to the police that he committed the crime for Gaza.

text: Nakasuhan na siya sang two counts sang first-degree murder kasunod sang krimen.
english: He has been charged with two counts of first-degree murder following the crime.

text: Natabo ang shooting 18 ka bulan matapos gin-umpisahan sang Israel ang gyera batok sa Hamas militants sa Gaza kasunod man sang pag-atake sa ila sang Hamas sang Oktubre 7, 2023 nga nagbilin sang 1,200 ka mga patay kag ginatos nga na-hostage.
english: The shooting came 18 months after Israel launched a war against Hamas militants in Gaza following a Hamas attack on them on October 7, 2023 that left 1,200 dead and hundreds taken hostage.

text: MALAYSIA – Nakakita ka na bala sang wedding cake nga  naka upside down kag naga-amat-amat panaog nagikan sa kisame?
english: MALAYSIA – Have you ever seen a wedding cake that is upside down and slowly coming down from the ceiling?

text: Sa mga nagaplano nga magpakasal,  abah mahimo nga ang ini nga cake ang mangin ideal sa imo ginahandum nga kasal.
english: For those who are planning to get married, abah this cake may be ideal for your dream wedding.

text: Sa Malaysia, napawow ang mga guest sa kasal sang Malaysian actors nga sanday Zahirah Macwilson kag Aiman Hakim Redza’s bangud sa pinasahi nga cake.
english: In Malaysia, guests at Malaysian actors Zahirah Macwilson and Aiman ​​Hakim Redza’s wedding were wowed by the special cake.

text: Mas nakuha ang atensyon sang tanan sang nag-amat-amat na panaog ang cake bangud indi ini kaangay sang iban nga kasal nga ang cake nahanda na sa lamesa kag igaslice nalang.
english: Everyone's attention was drawn when the cake slowly came down because it was not like other weddings where the cake was ready on the table and just sliced.

text: Ang nasambit nga cake ang nangin sentro sang tanan imbes nga magafocus kuntani ang mga tawo sa newlywed couple.
english: The cake became the center of everything instead of people focusing on the newlywed couple.

text: Suno naman sa naghimo sang cake nagikan sa isa ka kilala nga cake shop sa Malaysia, ang nasambit nga ideya ang naisipan sang iya utod, kag ang kasal nanday Zahirah kag Aiman ang nangin palaagyan agud  mapakita nila ang ila  makabig ‘golden idea’.
english: According to the cake maker from a well-known cake shop in Malaysia, the idea was thought of by his brother, and the wedding of Zahirah and Aiman ​​became a way for them to show their 'golden idea'

text: Tuman naman ang kalipay sang duha ka bag-ong kasal samtang ginaslice ang amo nga cake bangud magluwas sa enggrande nga seremonya, mas nangin enggrande pa kag indi malimtan ang ila kasal bangud sa indi kinaandan nga cake.
english: The two newlyweds were very happy while slicing the cake because besides the grand ceremony, their wedding became more grand and unforgettable because of the unusual cake.

text: Sa subong, padayun nga gina-istoryahan sang kadam-an ang nasambit nga chandelier cake kag nakaangkon na ini sang pagdayaw nagikan sa mga persona sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: Currently, the chandelier cake continues to be the talk of the town and has received praise from people around the world.

text: Wala na makatulog ang pila ka mga pumuluyo sa Barangay Sto.
english: Some residents in Barangay Sto.

text: Niño Sur, Arevalo tungod sa mabaskog nga balod kag hangin dala sang Bagyong Uwan.
english: Niño Sur, Arevalo due to strong waves and winds brought by Typhoon Uwan.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Robert Cagbay, iya ginpahayag nga nag-usmod ang flooring sang ila kusina kag CR kagab-e pasado `las-10:00.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Robert Cagbay said the flooring of their kitchen and CR collapsed last night around 10:00 pm.

text: Guba ang pila nila ka mga gamit kag nagkalabuka ang ila mga pinggan.
english: Some of their belongings were broken and their dishes were broken.

text: Temporaryo nila ginbutangan sang sako nga may unod nga balas ang ila sala agud mahagan-hagan ang pagsaka sang balod.
english: They temporarily put a sack of sand in their living room to ease the rise of the waves.

text: Sa karon, padayon ang ila pag monitor sa sitwasyon sang panahon kag kabaskugon sang hangin.
english: Currently, they continue to monitor the weather situation and wind strength.

text: By: Bombo Bryan Gonzales
english: By: Bombo Bryan Gonzales

text: Gin-file sa Senado ang resolution agud nga kilalahon ang nagtaliwan nga beterana nga aktres nga si Jaclyn Jose.
english: A resolution was filed in the Senate to recognize the late veteran actress Jaclyn Jose.

text: Sa Senate Resolution 942 nga gin-propose ni Senator Jinggoy Estrada, nakasaad ang mensahe sang simpatiya halin sa Senado kasunod sang pagtaliwan sang aktres nga Mary Jane Guck ang matuod nga pangalan.
english: Senate Resolution 942 proposed by Senator Jinggoy Estrada contains a message of sympathy from the Senate following the death of actress Mary Jane Guck.

text: Ginlaragway man ini bilang “versatile and hardworking actress” kag “Queen of Under Acting”.
english: She has also been described as a “versatile and hardworking actress” and “Queen of Under Acting”.

text: “Jaclyn Jose has proven to be a versatile and hardworking actress… known as the ‘Queen of Under Acting’ for her distinctive and exceptional ‘no acting style of acting’ which captivated audiences.
english: “Jaclyn Jose has proven to be a versatile and hardworking actress… known as the ‘Queen of Under Acting’ for her distinctive and exceptional ‘no acting style of acting’ which captivated audiences.

text: Jaclyn Jose’s sterling acting career spanned four decades, inspiring generations of actors and film enthusiasts,” kabahin sang nakabutang sa resolution.
english: Jaclyn Jose’s sterling acting career spanned four decades, inspiring generations of actors and film enthusiasts,” the resolution reads.

text: Nakabutang man ang maragtason nga award sang aktres bilang labing-una nga Filipino kag Southeast Asian nga nakadaog sang Best Actress award sa 69th Cannes Film Festival.
english: The actress also made a historic award as the first Filipino and Southeast Asian to win the Best Actress award at the 69th Cannes Film Festival.

text: “Her acting prowess, profound portrayals of different characters, and depth as an actress truly made an indelible mark in the country’s entertainment industry.
english: “Her acting prowess, profound portrayals of different characters, and depth as an actress truly made an indelible mark in the country’s entertainment industry.

text: Jaclyn Jose brought life to her roles, making them feel real and relatable, transcending borders, and touching the hearts of those who watched,” kabahin pa diri.
english: Jaclyn Jose brought life to her roles, making them feel real and relatable, transcending borders, and touching the hearts of those who watched,” she added.

text: Kahapon sang ginkumpirma sang anak ni Jaclyn nga si Andi Eigenmann nga napatay ang iya iloy sang Marso 2 sa edad nga 60-anyos bangud sa atake sa korason.#
english: Jaclyn's daughter Andi Eigenmann confirmed yesterday that her mother died on March 2 at the age of 60 due to a heart attack.

text: Nagpromisa si Vice President Sara Duterte sini nga Lunes nga padayon pamatokan sang iya opisina ang lapnagon nga korapsyon kag hatagan punto ang pagpadayon sang integridad sa tanan sang programa kag proyekto sini sa Office of the Vice President.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte promised on Monday that her office will continue to fight widespread corruption and emphasize maintaining integrity in all its programs and projects in the Office of the Vice President.

text: Ginpasiguro man ni VP Duterte nga ipadayon sang OVP ang mga proyekto sini sa edukasyon, palibot, kag health.
english: VP Duterte also assured that the OVP will continue its projects in education, environment, and health.

text: Sa iya year-end report, ginpunto man niya ang mga nahimo kag ang padayon nga paghimakas sang opisina para magserbe sa publiko.
english: In his year-end report, he also pointed out the achievements and the continuous struggle of the office to serve the public.

text: Dugang pa niya, ginapakita suno sa OVP ang importansya sang maayo nga plano, maayo nga implementasyon sang proyekto, pagbato sa korapsyon, kag pag-ulikid para sa pungsod.
english: He added that the OVP shows the importance of good planning, good project implementation, fighting corruption, and caring for the country.

text: Temporaryo lamang nga nahaw-asan ang mga motorista sa rollback sa presyo sang produktong-petrolyo subong nga semana bangud ginalantaw nga magasaka na naman ini epektibo sa Martes.
english: Motorists were only temporarily relieved by the rollback in the price of petroleum products this week as it is expected to rise again effective Tuesday.

text: Base sa kalkulasyon sang oil companies, ginalantaw nga magasaka ang presyo sang gasolina sang P1.10 tubtub sa P1.50 per liter; ang presyo sang diesel naman ang ginalantaw man nga magtaas sang P1.00 tubtub sa P1.40 per liter; samtang ang presyo sang kerosene ang ginalantaw nga magsaka sang P1.05 tubtub sa P1.45 per liter.
english: Based on the calculations of the oil companies, the price of gasoline is expected to rise by P1.10 to P1.50 per liter; the price of diesel is also expected to increase by P1.00 to P1.40 per liter; while the price of kerosene is expected to rise by P1.05 to P1.45 per liter.

text: Apang suno sa mga kumpaniya sang produktong petrolyo, pwede pa maglain ang final projection sa price hikes buwas, Agusto 16, bangud may duha pa ka adlaw nga nabilin para sa settlements subong nga semana.
english: However, according to petroleum products companies, the final projection of price hikes could be different tomorrow, August 16, because there are still two days left for settlements this week.

text: Suno sa industry experts, ang liwat nga pagsaka sang presyo sa international market ang bangud man sa liwat nga pagsaka sang tension sa Middle East.
english: According to industry experts, the resurgence in prices in the international market is also due to the resurgence of tensions in the Middle East.

text: Ina bangud naka-high alert subong ang Israel sa posible balos sang Iran, amo man ang atake sang Hezbollah halin sa Lebanon kag Houthis nga naka-base sa Yemen.
english: That's because Israel is now on high alert for possible Iranian retaliation, as well as attacks by Hezbollah from Lebanon and Houthis based in Yemen.

text: Ginsaad man nga ang kinagamo sa Gaza ang labi man nga naglala ilabi na kasunod sang kamatayon sang masobra 100 ka sibilyan sa isa lamang ka atake kun sa diin ang Israeli Army ang ginatudlo nga may kahimuan.
english: It was also promised that the unrest in Gaza has also worsened especially following the death of more than 100 civilians in a single attack in which the Israeli Army is allegedly involved.

text: Magluwas sa sini nga economic kag geopolitical factors, gina-monitor man sang market traders ang release sang bag-o nga supply-demand outlook sang Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) amo man ang International Energy Agency (IEA) nga naka-base sa Paris, France.
english: In addition to these economic and geopolitical factors, market traders are also monitoring the release of the new supply-demand outlook by the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) as well as the International Energy Agency (IEA) based in Paris, France.

text: Missing ang duha ka mga manugpangisda sa Sibunag, Guimaras.
english: Two fishermen are missing in Sibunag, Guimaras.

text:
Ini amo sanday:

-Ryan Galfo, 32-anyos

-Vincent Paul Valles, 30-anyos
