Ang duha ang lunsay residente sang Sitio Liningwan, Maabay, Sibunag, Guimaras.
english:
These are:

-Ryan Galfo, 32-year-old

-Vincent Paul Valles, 30-year-old

The two are both residents of Sitio Liningwan, Maabay, Sibunag, Guimaras.

text: Ulihi sila nga nakit-an sa kalalawran nga sakop sang Sebaste, Sibunag.
english: They were last seen in the waters of Sebaste, Sibunag.

text: Sa sin-o man nga may impormasyon tuhoy sa ila, makig-angot lang sa MDRRMC Sibunag sa numero 0945 516 1584 / 0995 263 3652.
english: Anyone with information about them should contact MDRRMC Sibunag at 0945 516 1584 / 0995 263 3652.

text: Kaangay sa mga kinaandan nga panawagan ni Pope Francis sang buhi pa ini, nagpangabay man si Pope Leo XIV nga tugutan nga makalab-ot sa Gaza ang ayuda kag mga pagkaon.
english: As in the usual appeals of Pope Francis during his lifetime, Pope Leo XIV also asked that aid and foodstuffs be allowed to reach Gaza.

text: Sa tunga ini sang tuman nga gutom nga ginasuprer sang mga Palestino samtang nagapadayon ang gyera sang Israel batok sa militante nga Hamas.
english: It comes amid severe hunger suffered by Palestinians as Israel's war against militant Hamas continues.

text: Suno sa Santo Papa, ang kabataan, ang mga tigulang, kag ang nagabalatian amo ang nagabayad sa mga kunsekwensya sang mga kalakasan sa gyera.
english: According to the Pope, children, the elderly, and the sick pay the consequences of the atrocities of war.

text: Ini nga apelar sang Santo Papa ang ginhimo kadungan sang iya una nga general audience sa St.
english: The Pope's appeal was made during his first general audience at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican.
english: Peter’s Square in the Vatican.

text: Ang general audience sa kada Myerkules amo ang weekly appointment nga ginahimo sang Pope sa sulod na sang malawig nga tinuig kun sa diin may yara sang malip-ot nga reflection sa isa ka tema ukon Scripture passage.
english: The general audience every Wednesday is a weekly appointment that the Pope has been making for many years where there is a brief reflection on a theme or Scripture passage.

text: May summaries man nga ginahatag sa mga tumuluo kag nagahatag man ang Pope sa partikular nga mensahe sa nagkalain-lain nga grupo sang mga tumuluo.
english: There are also summaries given to the faithful and the Pope also gives specific messages to different groups of faithful.

text: Suno sa Vatican, 40,000 ka mga tawo ang nagtambong sa sini nga una nga weekly general audience sang newly-elected pontiff.#
english: According to the Vatican, 40,000 people attended this first weekly general audience of the newly-elected pontiff.#

text: Ginkilala si Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach bilang isa sa mga celebrities nga may mataas nga media value sa bag-o lamang nagtakop nga Milan Fashion Week.
english: Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach was recognized as one of the celebrities with high media value at the recently concluded Milan Fashion Week.

text: Sa report sang influencer marketing platform nga Lefty, nagapang-anum si Pia sa “most visible influencers” sa amo nga prestihiyoso nga Fashion Week sa Italya.
english: According to a report by influencer marketing platform Lefty, Pia ranks sixth among the “most visible influencers” at the prestigious Fashion Week in Italy.

text: Ini nga event ang ginadugukan sang designers agud nga ipakita ang ila bag-o nga mga desinyo kag sunod nga mga koleksyon.
english: This event is where designers flock to showcase their new designs and upcoming collections.

text: Isa ini sa ginabansagan “Big Five” global fashion weeks kaupod sa New York, Paris, London, kag Tokyo.
english: It is one of the so-called “Big Five” global fashion weeks along with New York, Paris, London, and Tokyo.

text: Kun lantawon ang gin-release nga statistics, nakatipon ang Filipino beauty queen sang $2.95M ukon P165.3-million sa media value paagi sa pagtambong sa runway shows sang dalagku nga brands kaangay sang Gucci, Tod’s, Bally, Onitsuka Tiger, Missoni, Max Mara, Fendi, kag iban pa.
english: According to released statistics, the Filipino beauty queen has amassed $2.95M or P165.3-million in media value by attending runway shows of major brands such as Gucci, Tod's, Bally, Onitsuka Tiger, Missoni, Max Mara, Fendi, and others.

text: Nagasunod si Pia sa Hollywood actress nga si Anne Hathaway nga nagapang-lima ($2.98-million), samtang nagapanguna naman si Hyunjin sang Stray Kids ($4.02M).
english: Pia follows Hollywood actress Anne Hathaway in fifth place ($2.98-million), while Hyunjin of Stray Kids ($4.02M) leads the way.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, sanday Pia, Heart Evangelista kag Liza Soberano ang nalakip sa ginpahayag man nga may high media impact value sa Milan Fashion Week.
english: Last year, Pia, Heart Evangelista and Liza Soberano were among those who were also said to have high media impact value at Milan Fashion Week.

text: Sang 2023, una na ginsapubliko sang bana ni Pia nga si Jeremy Jauncey nga wala naghaum ang beauty queen nga makatambong pa ini sa fashion weeks bangud tatlo ka tuig man ini nga nabudlayan nga makasulod sa European fashion scene.#
english: In 2023, Pia's husband Jeremy Jauncey earlier revealed that the beauty queen was not ready to attend fashion weeks because she had been struggling to enter the European fashion scene for three years.

text: Balik na sa home floor sang Boston Celtics sa Massachusetts, USA ang Game 5 sa 2024 NBA Finals.
english: Game 5 of the 2024 NBA Finals is back on the home floor of the Boston Celtics in Massachusetts, USA.

text: Posible nga diri na tapuson sang Celtics ang best-of-seven series kag makuha na ang ila ika-18 nga franchise championship, apang posible man nga indi ini pagpasugtan sang Dallas Mavericks kag suliton sini ang natabo sa Game 4 sa American Airlines Center.
english: It’s possible that the Celtics end the best-of-seven series here and capture their 18th franchise championship, but it’s also possible that the Dallas Mavericks won’t let that happen and repeat what happened in Game 4 at the American Airlines Center.

text: Sa amo nga hampang, ginlutos nanday Luka Doncic ang team ni Jayson Tatum paagi sa 38-point margin of victory nga amo ang ikatatlo sa pinakadaku sa NBA Finals history.
english: In that game, Luka Doncic defeated Jayson Tatum’s team by a 38-point margin of victory that was the third-largest in NBA Finals history.

text: Nagpanguna ang Slovenian superstar nga may 29 points (25 in the first half), five assists, five rebounds kag three steals, samtang si Kyrie Irving naman ang nakadugang sang 21 points kag six assists.
english: The Slovenian superstar led the way with 29 points (25 in the first half), five assists, five rebounds and three steals, while Kyrie Irving added 21 points and six assists.

text: Pananglitan magdaog ang Boston sa Game 5, magapangibabaw na sila sa may pinakadamo nga kampyonato sa bug-os nga maragtas sang NBA.
english: If Boston wins Game 5, they will take the lead in having the most championships in NBA history.

text: May labaw na sila nga isa sa Los Angeles Lakers nga may yara subong sang 17 ka championship trophies.
english: They already have a lead over the Los Angeles Lakers who currently have 17 championship trophies.

text: Magasugod ang Game 5 buwas, 8:30 sa aga, oras sa Pilipinas.
english: Game 5 starts tomorrow, 8:30 am, Philippine time.

text: NEPAL– Nakakita ka na bala sang beauty pageant nga indi tawo ang contestants kundi sapat?
english: NEPAL – Have you ever seen a beauty pageant where the contestants are not humans but animals?

text: Sa Nepal, ginapatigayon ang isa ka pinasahi nga beauty contest sa diin ang contestants indi tawo kundi elepante.
english: In Nepal, a special beauty contest is held where the contestants are not humans but elephants.

text: Natural ginapagwapahan ang mga elepante,naka make-up,mapula-pula ang guya, naka- polish ang mga malapad nga kuko,nga kaangay sang isa ka matahum nga dalaga, nga elepante.
english: Naturally, elephants are beautified, wearing make-up, red faces, polished broad nails, like a beautiful young elephant.

text: Ini nga contest ang ginpatigayon sa  Chitwan district, puluy-an sang pinakaimportante nga conservation area kag  tourist destination humalin sang  2004.
english: This contest was held in Chitwan district, home to the most important conservation area and tourist destination since 2004.

text: Magluwas diri, nagaintra man ang mga elepante sa football, polo kag palumbaanay dalagan kag may picnic pa sa diin sila ang ginapakaon sang saging kag tubo.
english: Besides, the elephants also participate in football, polo and running races and have a picnic where they are fed bananas and sugarcane.

text: Suno kay Deepak Bhattarai, chairman sang  local hotel association  nga nag organisa sang festival, sila ang nagatuyo nga i- highlight ang relasyon sang elepante kag tawo  kag mangin mas  “elephant friendly” kada tuig.
english: According to Deepak Bhattarai, chairman of the local hotel association that organized the festival, they aim to highlight the relationship between elephants and humans and become more “elephant friendly” every year.

text: Apang suno naman sa local Animal Rights Club, ila ginpakamalaot ang nasambit nga kahiwatan bangud sa pagpang-abuso sa mga sapat.
english: However, the local Animal Rights Club condemned the event for its abuse of animals.

text: Sila nagpanugyan kag dapat magfocus nalang sa local culture kag indi na paghilabtan ang mga elepante.
english: They advised that they should focus on local culture and not interfere with the elephants.

text: Matandaan nga may  popular event man sa Nepal nga elephant polo championships  nga gin untat sang 2016 bangud sa isyu tuhoy sa indi husto nga pagtrato sa mga sapat.
english: It can be recalled that there is also a popular event in Nepal, the elephant polo championships, which was discontinued in 2016 due to the issue of ill-treatment of animals.

text: Indi lang Pilipinas kundi pati na ang iban nga mga pungsod sa Southeast Asia ang naka-benepisyo sang maisog nga nagpanindugan si former President Benigno Simeon ‘Noynoy’ Aquino III batok sa agresibo nga akto kag pag-angkon sang China sa West Philippine Sea.
english: Not only the Philippines but also other countries in Southeast Asia have benefited from former President Benigno Simeon 'Noynoy' Aquino III's courageous stand against China's aggressive actions and claims in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Kadungan sang kamatayon ni Aquino kahapon, Hunyo 24, ginbalikan sang kadam-an ang iya nangin kontribusyon sa pungsod sang siya pa ang presidente kag ang iya legasiya sa standoff batok sa China ang isa sa ginakabig ‘best-remembered’ sa iya administrasyon.
english: With Aquino's death yesterday, June 24, many looked back on his contribution to the country when he was president and his legacy in the standoff against China is one of the best-remembered of his administration.

text: Bilang chief architect sang foreign policy sang iya termino, si Aquino ang nag-initiate sa pag-file sang arbitration sa West Philippine Sea sa Permanent Court of Arbitration.
english: As the chief architect of foreign policy during his term, Aquino initiated the filing of arbitration in the West Philippine Sea with the Permanent Court of Arbitration.

text: Ang pag-exercise sang Pilipinas sang sini nga international legal rights sa pagpanguna sang administrasyon ni Aquino ang ginsuportahan sang iban nga mga pungsod kaangay sang Australia, Japan, kag sang Estados Unidos — ang tatlo ka importante nga security partners sang pungsod.
english: The Philippines' exercise of these international legal rights under the leadership of the Aquino administration has been supported by other countries such as Australia, Japan, and the United States — the country's three important security partners.

text: Apisar nangin talalupangdon ang ginapahayag ‘silent than central’ nga response sang Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), daku ang nangin epekto sini sa territorial dynamics sang kaiping nga mga pungsod.
english: Although the so-called 'silent than central' response of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) has been remarkable, it has had a profound impact on the territorial dynamics of neighboring countries.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Joenar Pueblo, isa ka international and domestic arbitration practitioner, iya ginpahayag nga sang nag-gwa ang arbitral award sang 2016, katumbas sini ang pahayag sang The Hague nga wala sang legal nga basehan ang nine-dash line nga gina-insister sang China.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Joenar Pueblo, an international and domestic arbitration practitioner, said that when the arbitral award came out in 2016, it corresponded to The Hague's statement that the nine-dash line insisted on by China had no legal basis.

text: Ang nine-dash line amo ang demarcation line nga ginagamit sang People’s Republic of China sa ila pag-claim sa mayor nga mga teritoryo sa dagat kag ginadalasa sini pati na ang teritoryo nga sakop sang Pilipinas, Vietnam, Malaysia, Japan, Korea, kag iban pa.
english: The nine-dash line is the demarcation line used by the People's Republic of China in its claim to major maritime territories and includes the territory of the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, Japan, Korea, and others.

text: Sang Hulyo 2016, ang arbitral tribunal nga gin-constitute sa idalom sang United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea ang nagpahayag nga WALA SANG LAWFUL EFFECT ang historic-rights claim sang China sa sini nga maritime areas sa sulod sang ila ginapahayag nga nine-dash line.
english: In July 2016, the arbitral tribunal constituted under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea declared NO LAWFUL EFFECT on China's historic-rights claim in these maritime areas within its purported nine-dash line.

text:
‘Not a mere scrap of paper…’

Indi na presidente si Aquino sang ginbasura sang Permanent Court of Arbitration ang historic claim sang China paagi sa ila 9-dash line doctrine.
english:
‘Not a mere scrap of paper…’

Aquino was no longer president when the Permanent Court of Arbitration rejected China's historic claim through its 9-dash line doctrine.

text: Si Presidente Rodrigo Duterte na ang nagapungko nga presidente sang gin-uphold sang korte ang sovereign rights sang Pilipinas sa 200-nautical-mile exclusive economic zone sa ginaawayan nga teritoryo.
english: President Rodrigo Duterte was already the incumbent president when the court upheld the Philippines' sovereign rights to the 200-nautical-mile exclusive economic zone in the disputed territory.

text: Apisar sang nangin legasiya ni Aquino, sang nagbulos si Duterte, wala na ginsapak ang amo nga ruling bangud mas ginhatagan prayoridad ang economic ties sang Pilipinas sa China.
english: Despite Aquino's legacy, when Duterte took over, the ruling was ignored because the Philippines' economic ties with China were given priority.

text: Matandaan nga subong lang nga 2021, gintawag pa ni Duterte ang 2016 Arbitral Award nga ‘mere scrap of paper’ kag mahimo mahaboy sa basurahan.
english: It can be recalled that as recently as 2021, Duterte even called the 2016 Arbitral Award a 'mere scrap of paper' and can be thrown in the trash.

text: Suno kay Pueblo, bisan pa naggwa ang award sa tion ni Aquino, wala man ini sang kinalain bangud indi man basta-basta nga ma-execute ang award ukon matampa sa China nga nagdaug ang Pilipinas.
english: According to Pueblo, even if the award came out during Aquino's time, it makes no difference because the award cannot be executed easily or slapped on China that the Philippines won.

text: Apang ang maathag suno sa natungdan, nakuha sang Pilipinas ang international respect kag ginpanawong sang arbitral award sa pungsod China nga wala sang legal nga basehan ang ila claim nga sakop nila ang West Philippine Sea rason man nga nabuhin-buhinan ang ila pagka-agresibo.
english: But what is clear, he said, is that the Philippines has gained international respect and an arbitral award against China that has no legal basis for their claim that they occupy the West Philippine Sea, which has reduced their aggression.

text: SULTAN KUDARAT – Ginpamatud-an sang isa ka motorcyle rider didto sa Tacurong City,Sultan Kudarat nga ang color pink kag ang pag idolo sa sikat nga anime character nga si Hello Kitty ang indi lang para sa mga babayi.
english: SULTAN KUDARAT – A motorcycle rider in Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat proved that the color pink and the idolization of the famous anime character Hello Kitty is not only for women.

text: Suno kay Mark Lansica certified Hello Kitty kag pink lover sya kag indi ini mangin rason agud kwestyunon ang iya nga sekswalidad nga masami ginapanumdom sang iban nga mga tawo.
english: According to Mark Lansica, she is a certified Hello Kitty and pink lover and this will not be a reason to question her sexuality that some people often remember.

text: Ginpabugal pa ni Lansica ang iya kwarto nga ginbuta niya sa nagkalain lain nga koleksyon sang paborito niya nga anime character.
english: Lansica even boasted of her room that she filled with various collections of her favorite anime characters.

text: Lakip na diri ang iya color pink kag Kitty themed nga motorsiklo.
english: This includes her pink and Kitty themed motorcycle.

text: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔—Nagpaguwa ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) sang bag-o nga mga regulasyon para sa pagbaton sang bayad sang mga merchant agud maprotektahan ang pondo sang mga merchant kag mga customer.
english: 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗜𝗟𝗔—The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) has issued new regulations for merchant payment acceptance to protect merchant and customer funds.
